opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

description.zh: 绕过对 COPY ... TO STDOUT 语句特征的拦截：改用 adminpack 的 pg_file_write 写文件；目标文件出现 marker 即成功。
description.en: Swap COPY TO STDOUT for the adminpack pg_file_write primitive; the marker appearing in the target file confirms success.

title.zh: 注释分词 COPY 语句

description.zh: 绕过对 COPY (SELECT...) TO STDOUT 整串匹配：逐段插入注释保持语义；标准输出打印 marker 即成功。
description.en: Insert comments segment by segment in the COPY statement while preserving semantics; the marker printed to stdout confirms success.

description.zh: 目标从 STDOUT 回显改为直接落盘：绕过对输出流的监控；文件内容为 marker 即成功。
description.en: Redirect the marker to disk instead of stdout to bypass output-stream monitoring; file content equal to the marker confirms success.

name.zh: SQLite UNION 与 sqlite_master 枚举

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于SQLite UNION 与 sqlite_master 枚举的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to SQLite UNION and sqlite_master Enumeration into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SQLite 注入的 UNION 枚举链：读取 sqlite_version() 版本与 sqlite_master 中的表名、建表 SQL。适用于确认后端为 SQLite 的场景，利用其单文件元数据特性直接获取完整 schema。
overview.en: Covers the UNION enumeration chain for SQLite injection: reading sqlite_version() and table names plus CREATE statements from sqlite_master. Suitable when the backend is confirmed SQLite, leveraging its single-file metadata to obtain the full schema directly.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入拼接进 SQL 未做参数化；SQLite 无独立权限体系，sqlite_master 对任何会话完全可读，对齐列数后建表语句一并泄露，敏感字段与自定义逻辑随之暴露。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into SQL without parameterization; SQLite has no independent privilege system and sqlite_master is fully readable to any session, so once column counts align, CREATE statements leak, exposing sensitive fields and custom logic.

exploitation.zh: 用第 1 步主验证命令注入 UNION 查询：先读 sqlite_version() 确认可控，再从 sqlite_master 读取表名与建表 SQL；回显版本号与表结构即确认 schema 可枚举。建表语句较长时用 substr 分段读取并拼合；获得完整 schema 后按表筛选敏感列，为后续数据提取定位目标。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 main verification command to inject UNION queries: first read sqlite_version() to confirm controllability, then read table names and CREATE statements from sqlite_master; an echoed version and table structure confirms the schema is enumerable. Segment long CREATE statements with substr and reassemble; after the full schema is in hand, filter sensitive columns per table to target later data extraction.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询消除注入点；SQLite 场景应限制应用对数据库文件的系统权限并隐藏敏感表结构，必要时迁移到带权限控制的存储层。修复后重放 UNION 载荷应报列不匹配或无回显。
mitigation.en: Eliminate the injection point with parameterized queries; for SQLite, restrict application OS permissions on the database file, hide sensitive table structures, and migrate to a storage layer with access control when necessary. After the fix, replaying UNION payloads must fail or produce no echo.

description.zh: 提交 OR 恒真与恒假条件比对响应，差异稳定或触发 SQLite 报错即确认注入点，记下闭合引号类型供后续使用。
description.en: Compare responses for OR tautologies versus falsehoods; stable differences or SQLite errors confirm injection and quoting style.

title.en: Align columns and read the version

description.zh: UNION SELECT NULL 递增对齐列数后，把 sqlite_version() 放进回显位确认引擎版本，选择对应函数与语法继续推进。
description.en: Pad UNION SELECT NULL to align columns, then echo sqlite_version() to identify the engine and pick matching syntax.

description.zh: 从 sqlite_master 按类型取表名，再读 sql 列拿完整建表语句，直接获得列名与类型，无需再查列信息视图。
description.en: Pull table names from sqlite_master where type='table', then read the sql column for full CREATE statements exposing columns and types.

description.zh: 语句被过滤时用 CHAR() 与十六进制字面量改写载荷，保持第 3 步枚举语义不变，绕过关键字与引号特征匹配。
description.en: Rewrite the step 3 payload with CHAR() and hex literals to keep enumeration semantics while dodging keyword and quote matching.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认SQLite UNION 与 sqlite_master 枚举所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。

opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

name.zh: SQLite 扩展与文件函数边界

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于SQLite 扩展与文件函数边界的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to SQLite Extension and File-Function Boundary into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SQLite 扩展加载与文件函数的能力边界验证：尝试 load_extension 加载共享库、以 readfile 读取目标文件。适用于评估 SQLite 编译开关（enable_load_extension、readfile）是否开放的高权限场景。
overview.en: Covers capability-boundary verification of SQLite extension loading and file functions: attempting load_extension for shared libraries and readfile for target files. Suitable for high-privilege scenarios assessing whether compile-time switches such as enable_load_extension and readfile are enabled.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 SQLite 实例启用了 load_extension 或 readfile 等非默认能力，注入点可借其加载本地共享库或读取服务端文件；编译开关未按需关闭且注入未修复时，能力直接暴露给攻击者。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a SQLite instance with non-default capabilities such as load_extension or readfile enabled: the injection point can load local shared libraries or read server files through them. Compile switches left on plus an unfixed injection expose these capabilities directly to attackers.

exploitation.zh: 用第 1 步命令先尝试 load_extension 加载共享库，再以 readfile 读取目标文件；扩展加载成功或回显文件内容即确认对应能力存在。把路径替换为隔离 marker 验证；加载失败或函数不存在按阴性依据记录，不影响注入点本身的结论。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to first attempt load_extension for a shared library, then readfile for a target file; a successful load or echoed file content confirms the capability exists. Replace paths with isolated markers for verification; record load failures or missing functions as negative evidence that does not change the injection-point conclusion.

mitigation.zh: 以 SQLITE_DBCONFIG_ENABLE_LOAD_EXTENSION 关闭扩展加载，避免编译进 readfile 等文件函数，应用连接权限最小化；修复后重放 load_extension 应报错，readfile 应提示函数不存在。
mitigation.en: Disable extension loading via SQLITE_DBCONFIG_ENABLE_LOAD_EXTENSION, avoid compiling in file functions like readfile, and minimize application-connection privileges. After the fix, load_extension must error and readfile must report no such function.

title.zh: 探测注入与函数可用性

description.zh: 先确认 UNION 注入点可用，再观察 readfile 与 load_extension 是否被编译启用，函数不存在时报错信息会直接暴露边界。
description.en: Confirm a working UNION injection, then probe whether readfile and load_extension are compiled in; errors reveal their availability.

description.zh: 把 readfile 放进 UNION 回显位并把路径占位替换为配置或源码路径，响应出现文件内容即完成服务器文件读取。
description.en: Place readfile in the echo position with a config or source path; file contents in the response complete the server-side read.

title.en: Load a malicious extension for code execution

description.zh: 用 load_extension 加载可控 so 扩展文件，扩展内导出函数随即注册进 SQL，调用该函数即可获得系统命令执行能力。
description.en: Call load_extension on a controllable .so; its exported functions register into SQL, and invoking them yields OS command execution.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认SQLite 扩展与文件函数边界所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by SQLite Extension and File-Function Boundary in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

analysis.zh: SQLite 扩展与文件函数边界的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive SQLite Extension and File-Function Boundary evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

title.zh: 注释分词与字符串拼接

description.zh: 绕过对 load_extension 明文库路径特征的拦截：拆分库名并注释分词；扩展加载报错消失或功能生效即成功。
description.en: Split the library name and insert comments to evade the plaintext load_extension signature; disappearance of the load error or a working function confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过只读场景的回显检测：写入后再读回验证文件函数能力；readfile 能取回相同内容即成功。
description.en: Write then read back to verify file functions beyond read-only echoes; retrieving identical content via readfile confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 .so 后缀字符串的过滤：路径用 CHAR 逐码构造；扩展加载行为发生即成功。
description.en: Construct the path with CHAR codes to evade .so suffix filters; any extension load behavior confirms success.

name.zh: 固定 Marker 布尔盲注差分

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于固定 Marker 布尔盲注差分的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Fixed-Marker Boolean Blind Differential into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖布尔盲注的响应差分验证：以恒真/恒假条件与 marker 长度、ASCII 位判断构造真假请求，通过页面差异逐位提取数据。适用于 UNION 回显不可用、但注入条件能改变响应内容的场景。
overview.en: Covers boolean blind injection via response differential: crafting true/false requests with always-true/false conditions plus marker-length and ASCII-bit checks, extracting data bit by bit from page differences. Suitable when UNION echo is unavailable but injected conditions still change the response.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入点可控查询条件而应用不回显数据，攻击者以真/假条件制造响应差异作为逐位判定的 oracle；缺少参数化绑定时任何可观测差异都会被转化为数据提取通道。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an injection point controlling query conditions while the application does not echo data: attackers turn true/false response differences into a bit-level oracle. Without parameterized binding, any observable difference becomes a data-extraction channel.

exploitation.zh: 用第 1 步主验证命令先提交恒真/恒假条件建立响应基线，再注入 marker 长度与 ASCII 位判断条件；真条件返回正常页、假条件返回差异页即可逐位提取数据。每轮只改变一个条件并记录响应差异，命中后按位推进直到提取完整目标值。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 main verification command to establish a response baseline with always-true/false conditions, then inject marker-length and ASCII-bit checks; the true condition returning the normal page and the false condition returning a differing page enables bit-by-bit extraction. Change one condition per round, record response differences, and advance bit by bit until the target value is complete.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询消除条件注入，统一真/假业务路径的响应模板以压缩差分信号；修复后重放恒真/恒假载荷响应应无差异，并对异常条件请求添加监控告警。
mitigation.en: Eliminate condition injection with parameterized queries and unify response templates across true/false business paths to compress differential signals. After the fix, replaying always-true/false payloads must produce no difference, with anomalous condition requests alerting in monitoring.

title.zh: 真假条件差分确认盲注
title.en: Confirm blind injection via differential responses

description.zh: 分别提交 1=1 与 1=2 条件，两次响应存在稳定可分差异即存在布尔盲注，无回显也能据此推断查询结果内容。
description.en: Submit 1=1 versus 1=2 conditions; a stable, repeatable difference marks boolean blind injection usable to infer query results.

description.zh: 用 LENGTH 递增比对测定当前库名等目标长度，条件命中时页面回到真分支，锁定边界后开始逐字符提取内容。
description.en: Walk LENGTH comparisons upward to size the target such as the current database; locking the boundary prepares per-character extraction.

title.en: Extract content via per-character binary search

description.zh: 组合 MID、LEFT 与比较符或 CASE 表达式二分猜测每一位，真分支响应指示命中，循环推进即可还原完整字符串。
description.en: Combine MID/LEFT with comparisons or CASE to binary-search each character; true-branch responses reveal hits until the string is rebuilt.

title.zh: 换子查询扩展到表数据
title.en: Extend to table data by swapping subqueries

description.zh: 保持第 3 步载荷骨架不变，把目标换成表名、列名与字段值的子查询，逐项把库结构与敏感数据完整推出数据库。
description.en: Keep the step 3 skeleton and swap in subqueries for tables, columns and values to walk out the full schema and sensitive data.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认固定 Marker 布尔盲注差分所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by Fixed-Marker Boolean Blind Differential in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

analysis.zh: 固定 Marker 布尔盲注差分的阳性必须由同一 marker 的解析差分与最终后端行为共同证明；本地工具输出、普通超时、连接关闭、错误页和另一 DBMS 的成功语句均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive for Fixed-Marker Boolean Blind Differential requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

name.zh: MySQL 一秒固定 Marker 延迟

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于MySQL 一秒固定 Marker 延迟的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to MySQL One-Second Fixed-Marker Delay into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 MySQL 时间盲注的验证：以 SLEEP 配合 IF 条件与固定 marker 构造延迟，用响应时间差确认注入成立。适用于无回显、布尔差分也不可用时的最后一条确认路径。
overview.en: Covers verification of MySQL time-based blind injection: building delays with SLEEP wrapped in IF conditions and fixed markers, confirming injection via response-time differences. Suitable as the last confirmation path when neither echo nor boolean differential is available.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入点可控 SQL 条件而应用无任何回显差分，SLEEP/IF 组合把查询逻辑转化为可观测的时间信号；缺少参数化绑定时时间通道即可用于逐位提取数据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an injection point controlling SQL conditions with no echo differential in the application: the SLEEP/IF combination turns query logic into an observable time signal. Without parameterized binding, the timing channel supports bit-by-bit data extraction.

exploitation.zh: 用第 1 步命令注入 IF 条件包裹的 SLEEP，条件引用固定 marker；命中条件的请求响应时间比基线长约 1 秒即确认时间盲注生效。先采集多次基线延迟再对比载荷延迟，末行直连 SLEEP(1) 仅作环境对照；延迟保持一秒以免拖垮服务，命中后可用位判断条件逐字符提取数据。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject SLEEP wrapped in an IF condition referencing a fixed marker; requests about one second slower than baseline confirm time-based blind injection. Collect several baseline delays before comparing payload latency — the final direct SLEEP(1) line is only an environment control; keep delays to one second to avoid straining the service, then extract data character by character with bit-check conditions.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询消除注入，配置查询超时（如 max_execution_time）与慢查询告警；修复后注入 SLEEP 载荷响应应无延迟，时间差分通道消失。
mitigation.en: Eliminate injection with parameterized queries and configure query timeouts such as max_execution_time with slow-query alerting. After the fix, injected SLEEP payloads must return without delay and the timing differential channel must disappear.

title.zh: SLEEP 探测确认延迟通道可控

description.zh: 提交 SLEEP 注入并比对响应时间，稳定出现约一秒延迟即确认时间盲注通道，网络抖动时多测几次取平均参考。
description.en: Submit SLEEP payloads and compare response times; a stable ~1s delay confirms a time-based channel (retest to average jitter).

title.zh: IF 条件区分真假延迟

description.zh: 真假条件分别包进 IF 触发或跳过延迟，两组请求时间稳定可分即建立时间信号源，替代布尔盲注的页面差异判断。
description.en: Wrap true/false conditions in IF to trigger or skip the delay; separable timing groups form an oracle replacing page-difference signals.

title.en: Extract character by character via conditional delay

description.zh: 构造 IF 与 ASCII、SUBSTR 组合的条件延迟语句，按位命中即延迟，脚本循环推进即可还原库名表名与数据内容。
description.en: Build IF plus ASCII/SUBSTR conditional delays; each matching bit costs a second, and scripted loops recover names and data.

description.zh: 把第 3 步载荷交给 sqlmap 指定时间型技术或自写脚本并发跑多线程，按表逐列批量提取，完成整个库的数据收割。
description.en: Feed the step 3 payload to sqlmap with the time-based technique or a custom threaded script to bulk-extract tables column by column.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认MySQL 一秒固定 Marker 延迟所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by MySQL One-Second Fixed-Marker Delay in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

analysis.en: A positive for MySQL One-Second Fixed-Marker Delay requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

name.zh: SQL Server WAITFOR 一秒延迟

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于SQL Server WAITFOR 一秒延迟的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to SQL Server WAITFOR One-Second Delay into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SQL Server 时间盲注的验证：注入 WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:01' 以固定一秒延迟确认注入成立。适用于无回显场景下确认 SQL Server 注入可控性的时间通道测试。
overview.en: Covers verification of SQL Server time-based blind injection: injecting WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:01' to confirm injection through a fixed one-second delay. Suitable for timing-channel confirmation of SQL Server injection in no-echo scenarios.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入拼接进 T-SQL 且应用不回显数据，WAITFOR DELAY 把任意条件求值转化为响应时间信号；缺少参数化绑定时时间通道可携带逐位判定逻辑。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into T-SQL with no data echo in the application: WAITFOR DELAY turns arbitrary condition evaluation into a response-time signal. Without parameterized binding, the timing channel carries bit-level decision logic.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令注入 WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:01'；响应时间比基线延迟约 1 秒即确认 SQL Server 时间盲注生效。先采集多次基线排除网络抖动，再重复载荷确认延迟稳定复现；需要携带判定逻辑时用 IF 包裹 WAITFOR 构造条件延迟，按位推进提取目标数据。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:01'; a response about one second behind baseline confirms SQL Server time-based blind injection. Collect several baselines to rule out network jitter, then repeat the payload to confirm stable reproduction; wrap WAITFOR in IF for conditional delays when carrying decision logic, advancing bit by bit to extract target data.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询消除注入点，数据库端配置查询超时并监控异常耗时语句；修复后注入 WAITFOR 载荷响应应即时返回，审计中不应出现来自应用连接的 WAITFOR 语句。
mitigation.en: Eliminate the injection point with parameterized queries, configure database query timeouts, and monitor unusually long statements. After the fix, injected WAITFOR payloads must return immediately, and no WAITFOR statements from application connections should appear in audit logs.

title.zh: WAITFOR 注入建立延迟信号
title.en: Establish a delay signal with WAITFOR

description.zh: 注入 WAITFOR DELAY 并观察响应是否稳定延迟一秒，命中即确认 SQL Server 时间盲注通道可以承载条件判断。
description.en: Inject WAITFOR DELAY and watch for a stable one-second slowdown; a repeatable delay confirms a SQL Server timing channel.

title.zh: IF 条件化 WAITFOR 二分判断
title.en: Gate WAITFOR with IF for binary decisions

description.zh: 把真假条件包进 IF 再触发延迟语句，命中延迟、未命中立即返回，以此做二分判断，逐步推断出库名与数据内容。
description.en: Wrap conditions in IF before WAITFOR so hits delay and misses return instantly, enabling binary decisions to infer data.

description.zh: 循环提交第 2 步形态的载荷，对目标字符做二分猜测并记录延迟结果，最终还原库名、表名与字段值完成盲取。
description.en: Loop the step 2 payload shape, binary-searching each target character and logging delays to rebuild names and values.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认SQL Server WAITFOR 一秒延迟所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by SQL Server WAITFOR One-Second Delay in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

analysis.zh: SQL Server WAITFOR 一秒延迟的阳性必须由同一 marker 的解析差分与最终后端行为共同证明；本地工具输出、普通超时、连接关闭、错误页和另一 DBMS 的成功语句均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive for SQL Server WAITFOR One-Second Delay requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

name.zh: PostgreSQL pg_sleep 一秒延迟

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于PostgreSQL pg_sleep 一秒延迟的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to PostgreSQL pg_sleep One-Second Delay into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 PostgreSQL 时间盲注的验证：注入 pg_sleep(1) 以固定一秒延迟确认注入成立。适用于无回显场景下确认 PostgreSQL 注入可控性的时间通道测试。
overview.en: Covers verification of PostgreSQL time-based blind injection: injecting pg_sleep(1) to confirm injection through a fixed one-second delay. Suitable for timing-channel confirmation of PostgreSQL injection in no-echo scenarios.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入拼接进 SQL 且应用不回显数据，pg_sleep 把任意条件求值转化为响应时间信号；缺少参数化绑定时时间通道可承载逐位判定逻辑用于数据提取。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into SQL with no data echo in the application: pg_sleep turns arbitrary condition evaluation into a response-time signal. Without parameterized binding, the timing channel carries bit-level decision logic for data extraction.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令注入 SELECT pg_sleep(1)；响应延迟约 1 秒即确认 PostgreSQL 时间盲注生效。先采集基线再重复载荷确认延迟稳定，可用 CASE WHEN 包裹 pg_sleep 使延迟携带条件语义，按位推进逐字符提取数据；全程保持一秒延迟避免影响共享连接池。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject SELECT pg_sleep(1); a delay of about one second confirms PostgreSQL time-based blind injection. Take a baseline first and repeat the payload to confirm stable delay, wrapping pg_sleep in CASE WHEN so the delay carries condition semantics for character-by-character extraction; keep the one-second delay throughout to protect shared connection pools.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询消除注入点，配置 statement_timeout 限制单语句耗时并告警异常延迟；修复后注入 pg_sleep 载荷响应应即时返回。
mitigation.en: Eliminate the injection point with parameterized queries, configure statement_timeout to cap single-statement duration, and alert on abnormal delays. After the fix, injected pg_sleep payloads must return immediately.

title.en: Probe the delay channel with pg_sleep

description.zh: 注入 pg_sleep 观察响应是否延迟约一秒，稳定命中即确认 PostgreSQL 时间盲注通道，可承载真假条件判断信号。
description.en: Inject pg_sleep and check for a stable one-second delay; repeatable hits confirm a PostgreSQL timing channel for conditional inference.

title.zh: 条件化 pg_sleep 构造信号源
title.en: Build an oracle with conditional pg_sleep

description.zh: 附加 WHERE 条件或 CASE 控制延迟是否触发，真假两组请求时间可分即建立时间判断源，替代页面差异判断。
description.en: Add WHERE or CASE gating so the delay fires selectively; separable timing between branches forms an oracle without page differences.

title.en: Infer data bit by bit from delays

description.zh: 组合 SUBSTR 与 ASCII 做条件延迟逐位猜测，记录每次是否延迟拼出完整字符串，随后换子查询遍历全库数据。
description.en: Pair SUBSTR and ASCII with gated delays to guess each character, then swap subqueries to walk the entire database.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认PostgreSQL pg_sleep 一秒延迟所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by PostgreSQL pg_sleep One-Second Delay in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

analysis.en: A positive for PostgreSQL pg_sleep One-Second Delay requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

name.zh: Oracle 一秒过程与 Pipe 延迟
name.en: Oracle One-Second Procedure and Pipe Delay

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于Oracle 一秒过程与 Pipe 延迟的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Oracle One-Second Procedure and Pipe Delay into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Oracle 时间盲注的验证：执行 DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP(1) 以一秒延迟确认注入成立，权限缺失时以报错作为阴性依据。适用于无回显场景下确认 Oracle 注入可控性的时间通道测试。
overview.en: Covers verification of Oracle time-based blind injection: running DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP(1) to confirm injection through a one-second delay, with permission errors as negative evidence when the package is unavailable. Suitable for timing-channel confirmation of Oracle injection in no-echo scenarios.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入拼接进 PL/SQL 调用且应用不回显数据，DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP 等过程把条件求值转化为响应时间信号；EXECUTE 权限开放范围过大时注入即可调用这些延迟原语。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into PL/SQL calls with no data echo in the application: procedures such as DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP turn condition evaluation into a response-time signal. Overly broad EXECUTE grants let injection invoke these delay primitives.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令执行 DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP(1)；响应延迟约 1 秒即确认时间盲注生效。无 DBMS_LOCK 权限时以权限报错为阴性依据，可改试 DBMS_PIPE.RECEIVE_MESSAGE 等替代延迟原语；先采集基线再对比载荷延迟，保持一秒延迟并记录所用原语供报告引用。多轮采样取中位数对比，避免单次网络抖动造成误判。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to run DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP(1); a delay of about one second confirms time-based blind injection. With no DBMS_LOCK privilege, record the permission error as negative evidence and try alternative delay primitives such as DBMS_PIPE.RECEIVE_MESSAGE; baseline before comparing payload latency, keep the one-second delay, and log the primitive used for the report. Compare medians across multiple sampling rounds, avoiding single-jitter misjudgments.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询消除注入点，回收应用账户对 DBMS_LOCK/DBMS_PIPE 的 EXECUTE 授权；修复后重放延迟载荷应报权限错误或即时返回。
mitigation.en: Eliminate the injection point with parameterized queries and revoke EXECUTE on DBMS_LOCK/DBMS_PIPE from application accounts. After the fix, replaying delay payloads must raise permission errors or return immediately.

description.zh: 注入匿名块调用 DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP，响应稳定延迟一秒即确认 Oracle 时间通道，作为后续盲注推断的信号载体。
description.en: Inject an anonymous block invoking DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP; a stable one-second delay confirms an Oracle timing channel as the oracle signal.

title.en: Use DBMS_PIPE waits as an alternative delay

description.zh: SLEEP 被禁或权限不足时改用 RECEIVE_MESSAGE 指定等待秒数，同样产生可控延迟，绕开对锁包的依赖继续盲注。
description.en: When SLEEP is restricted, switch to RECEIVE_MESSAGE with a chosen wait to produce controllable delays without the lock package.

description.zh: 把真假条件接入第 2 步延迟调用，命中即等待，循环二分逐字符还原目标内容，再扩展到表与字段遍历提取。
description.en: Attach conditions to the step 2 wait call so matches stall, then binary-search characters and extend across tables and columns.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认Oracle 一秒过程与 Pipe 延迟所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。

name.zh: UNION Marker 与只读查询变体集
name.en: UNION Marker and Read-Only Query Variant Set

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于UNION 列对齐与只读查询变体的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to UNION Column Alignment and Read-Only Query Variants into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 UNION 注入的列对齐与只读查询验证链：ORDER BY 递增与 UNION NULL 序列确定列数，固定 marker 定位回显列，再读取 users 表与 information_schema 元数据。适用于已确认注入点、走 UNION 读取路径的场景。
overview.en: Covers the column-alignment and read-only query chain for UNION injection: ORDER BY increments and UNION NULL sequences to fix the column count, a fixed marker to locate echo columns, then reading the users table and information_schema metadata. Suitable once an injection point is confirmed and the UNION read path is available.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入拼接进 SQL 且查询结果直接回显，攻击者用 UNION 追加等列数的 SELECT 即可把任意查询结果并入原结果集；缺少参数化与列类型校验时读取链直接成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into SQL with query results echoed directly: a UNION appends an equal-column SELECT merging arbitrary query results into the original set. Without parameterization and column-type checks, the read chain stands immediately.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步主验证命令：先以 ORDER BY 递增确定列数上限，再用 UNION SELECT NULL 序列验证列数与类型占位，固定 marker 定位回显列；回显出现 marker 与数据即确认 UNION 读取链可用，随后读取 users 表与 information_schema 元数据。执行前把表名替换为隔离 marker；被 WAF 拦截时参考绕过区的受控变体。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 main verification command: cap the column count with increasing ORDER BY, verify count and type slots with UNION SELECT NULL sequences, and locate echo columns with a fixed marker; an echoed marker and data confirm the UNION read chain, after which read the users table and information_schema metadata. Replace table names with isolated markers beforehand; when blocked by a WAF, use the controlled variants in the bypass section.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询消除 UNION 注入面，按列校验返回数据类型；修复后重放 ORDER BY/UNION 载荷应报列不匹配，回显区不再出现注入内容。
mitigation.en: Eliminate the UNION injection surface with parameterized queries and validate returned column types; after the fix, replaying ORDER BY/UNION payloads must raise column-mismatch errors and no injected content may appear in echo areas.

title.zh: ORDER BY 递增锁定列数
title.en: Lock the column count with ORDER BY

description.zh: 从 1 递增 ORDER BY 序号直到触发列数报错，最后一个正常返回值即查询列数，为 UNION 对齐划出边界。
description.en: Increase ORDER BY until a column error fires; the last clean index is the query's column count for UNION alignment.

description.zh: 按列数提交 UNION SELECT NULL 组合，NULL 兼容任意类型，整条查询恢复正常即列数与类型占位全部就绪。
description.en: Submit UNION SELECT NULL series matching the count; NULL fits any type, and a clean result means structure alignment is done.

title.en: Locate echo positions with a marker

description.zh: 用固定字符串替换某个 NULL 占位提交，标记出现在页面即该列可回显，后续提取的数据全部经此位置读取。
description.en: Replace a NULL with a fixed string; wherever the marker surfaces in the page is a readable column for extracting data.

title.zh: 拦截时切换注释与编码变体
title.en: Switch to comment and encoding variants when blocked

description.zh: UNION 关键字被拦截时改用内联注释、URL 编码与换行混排变体，保持第 3 步查询结构穿透 WAF 特征检测。
description.en: If UNION is blocked, use inline comments, URL encoding or newline-mixed variants to keep the step 3 structure past the WAF.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认UNION 列对齐与只读查询变体所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by UNION Column Alignment and Read-Only Query Variants in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

name.zh: SQL Marker Chunked 载体（validate 端点）

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于SQL Marker HTTP Chunked 载体的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to SQL Marker HTTP Chunked Carrier into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖以 HTTP Chunked 传输承载注入载荷的载体验证：把 marker 作为参数值分块发送，确认服务端重组后仍进入参数处理。适用于评估分块编码对 WAF 与参数解析链影响的场景。
overview.en: Covers carrier verification of injection payloads over HTTP chunked transfer: sending a marker as a chunked parameter value to confirm it still reaches parameter handling after server-side reassembly. Suitable for assessing how chunked encoding affects WAF and parameter-parsing chains.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是边缘组件与应用对 chunked 分帧的重组规则不一致：分块把关键字打散后可绕过基于原始请求体的检测，而重组后的值仍进入 SQL 拼接；分帧语义未统一即为风险根源。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is inconsistent chunked-framing reassembly rules between edge components and the application: chunking scatters keywords past body-based detection while the reassembled value still reaches SQL concatenation. Un-unified framing semantics are the source of risk.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以完整 chunked 请求把 marker 作为参数值分块发送到本地验证端点，Host 保持本地夹具地址；服务端重组后按普通参数处理并回显 marker 即确认分块载体可承载注入载荷。可改变块边界重复提交，验证各组件重组行为一致。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to send a marker as a chunked parameter value in a full chunked request to a local verification endpoint, keeping Host at the local fixture; the server reassembling and echoing the marker confirms the chunked carrier can carry injection payloads. Vary chunk boundaries across submissions to verify consistent reassembly across components.

mitigation.zh: 在边缘统一 HTTP 分帧与内容类型规则，拒绝歧义分帧或统一重组后再做检测；修复后分块发送的 marker 应被一致处理，检测层与应用层不再出现解析不一致。
mitigation.en: Unify HTTP framing and content-type rules at the edge, rejecting ambiguous framing or reassembling before inspection; after the fix, chunked markers must be handled consistently with no parsing divergence between the detection and application layers.

title.zh: 构造 chunked 分块请求载体

description.zh: 手工构造 Transfer-Encoding chunked 请求，把参数名与值拆进多个分块依次给出，先建立可控可复现的传输载体。
description.en: Hand-craft a Transfer-Encoding: chunked request that splits the parameter name and value across multiple chunks as a controllable carrier.

title.zh: 分块拆分载荷穿透检测
title.en: Split the payload across chunks to evade detection

description.zh: 把 SQL 关键字与语句片段分散到不同分块，检测设备若不重组分块即漏检，标记值完整到达后端即拆分绕过生效。
description.en: Scatter SQL keywords across chunks; a WAF that does not reassemble chunked bodies misses the payload once it re-forms at the backend.

title.zh: 差异提交确认绕过并接入注入链
title.en: Confirm the bypass and chain into injection

description.zh: 同一载荷分别用常规与分块方式提交，仅分块版本触发数据库行为变化即确认绕过，随后接入 UNION 或盲注提取链。
description.en: Submit the same payload plain versus chunked; only the chunked copy altering database behavior proves the bypass, ready for UNION or blind chains.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认SQL Marker HTTP Chunked 载体所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。

name.zh: MySQL 堆叠语句边界

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于MySQL 堆叠语句边界的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to MySQL Stacked-Statement Boundary into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 MySQL 堆叠语句执行边界的验证：在注入点后追加第二条 SELECT 语句，以 SLEEP 延迟与立即返回的对照确认多语句执行能力。适用于评估驱动是否允许多语句（如 mysqli multi_query）的场景。
overview.en: Covers verification of the MySQL stacked-statement execution boundary: appending a second SELECT after the injection point, using SLEEP latency versus immediate return to confirm multi-statement capability. Suitable for assessing whether the driver allows multi-statements such as mysqli multi_query.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用使用允许多语句的驱动或连接配置，注入点以分号追加第二条语句即可执行；堆叠能力把注入从读取升级为任意 DML 与过程调用，权限未收敛时影响全面扩大。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application using a driver or connection configuration that allows multi-statements: a semicolon appends and executes a second statement. Stacking upgrades injection from reading to arbitrary DML and procedure calls, widening impact wherever privileges are unconverged.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令堆叠 SELECT SLEEP(5) 与 SELECT 1；前者响应延迟约 5 秒、后者立即返回即确认 MySQL 堆叠执行成立。两行互为对照可排除单纯慢查询干扰；在隔离环境把 5 秒降为可区分的最短延迟重复验证，确认后再评估堆叠能触达的语句类型与权限边界。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to stack SELECT SLEEP(5) and SELECT 1; the former delaying about five seconds while the latter returns immediately confirms MySQL stacked execution. The two rows cross-check against mere slow queries; repeat verification in an isolated environment with the shortest distinguishable delay, then assess which statement types and privilege boundaries stacking can reach.

mitigation.zh: 关闭驱动的多语句支持（如禁用 multi_query），参数化查询消除注入点；修复后堆叠载荷应报语法错误或被截断，审计中不应出现第二条语句。
mitigation.en: Disable driver multi-statement support such as multi_query and eliminate the injection point with parameterized queries; after the fix, stacked payloads must raise syntax errors or be truncated, with no second statement in audit logs.

description.zh: 在注入点后接分号附加第二条语句，多数 MySQL 连接不支持堆叠，语句生效即说明场景罕见地允许多语句执行。
description.en: Append a semicolon and a second statement; most MySQL drivers reject stacking, so execution implies a rare multi-statement context.

title.en: Confirm execution with a delay statement

description.zh: 堆叠 SLEEP 延迟语句观察响应时间，命中即二次确认任意语句可执行，堆叠通道可用于 UPDATE 等写操作利用。
description.en: Stack a SELECT SLEEP and watch the delay; a hit re-confirms arbitrary statement execution usable for writes such as UPDATE.

title.zh: 预编译十六进制绕过过滤

description.zh: 关键字被过滤时把整条语句十六进制赋给变量，经 PREPARE 与 EXECUTE 还原执行，绕开对明文语句的匹配规则。
description.en: When keywords are filtered, hex-encode the whole statement into a variable and run it via PREPARE/EXECUTE to sidestep plaintext matching.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认MySQL 堆叠语句边界所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by MySQL Stacked-Statement Boundary in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

analysis.en: A positive for MySQL Stacked-Statement Boundary requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

name.zh: SQL Server 堆叠语句边界

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于SQL Server 堆叠语句边界的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to SQL Server Stacked-Statement Boundary into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SQL Server 堆叠语句执行边界的验证：在注入点后追加 WAITFOR DELAY 延迟语句与 marker 查询，确认多语句批处理能力。SQL Server 驱动普遍支持堆叠，重点验证注入点能否触达该能力。
overview.en: Covers verification of the SQL Server stacked-statement boundary: appending a WAITFOR DELAY statement and a marker query after the injection point to confirm multi-statement batching. SQL Server drivers commonly support stacking, so the focus is whether the injection point reaches that capability.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入拼接进 T-SQL 且 SQL Server 驱动默认支持多语句批处理，注入点以分号追加语句即可执行；堆叠使注入可触达任意 T-SQL 包括过程调用与 DDL，权限未收敛时风险全面。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into T-SQL with drivers batching multiple statements by default: a semicolon executes appended statements. Stacking reaches arbitrary T-SQL including procedure calls and DDL, a comprehensive risk when privileges are unconverged.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令堆叠 WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5' 与 marker 查询；延迟约 5 秒或回显 marker 即确认 SQL Server 堆叠执行成立。先验证延迟证明第二条语句执行，再验证 marker 证明结果可回传，两者结合形成完整证据链；采集多次基线排除网络与连接池等待干扰。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to stack WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5' and a marker query; a delay of about five seconds or an echoed marker confirms SQL Server stacked execution. Verify the delay first to prove the second statement ran, then the marker to prove results return, combining both into a complete evidence chain; collect several baselines to rule out network and connection-pool waits.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询消除注入点，应用登录最小权限并禁用不需要的过程执行权限；修复后堆叠载荷应报语法错误，审计中不应出现注入追加的语句。
mitigation.en: Eliminate the injection point with parameterized queries, grant the application login least privilege, and disable unneeded procedure execution; after the fix, stacked payloads must raise syntax errors and no injected statements may appear in audit logs.

title.zh: 分号加 WAITFOR 探测堆叠
title.en: Probe stacking with semicolon plus WAITFOR

description.zh: 提交分号接 WAITFOR DELAY 的堆叠语句，响应延迟五秒即确认 SQL Server 堆叠执行通道开放可执行多语句。
description.en: Submit a stacked semicolon plus WAITFOR DELAY; a five-second delay confirms an open stacked-execution channel on SQL Server.

title.en: Echo a marker via DECLARE variables

description.zh: 堆叠声明变量并赋标记值再 SELECT 返回，响应出现标记即任意 T-SQL 可执行，为调用存储过程铺平道路。
description.en: Stack a variable declaration, assign a marker and SELECT it back; the marker in the response proves arbitrary T-SQL execution.

description.zh: 用 sp_executesql 执行动态拼接的语句字符串，可组装任意命令文本，配合 xp_cmdshell 等过程向系统命令延伸。
description.en: Run dynamic statement text through sp_executesql to compose arbitrary commands and reach procedures like xp_cmdshell.

title.zh: 被过滤时 EXEC 拼接变体

description.zh: 语句特征被拦截时改用 EXEC 括号内拼接或变量中转再执行，打散关键字连续匹配保持堆叠通道持续可用。
description.en: If statement signatures are blocked, wrap text in EXEC(N'...') or route through a variable to break matching and keep stacking alive.

name.zh: PostgreSQL 堆叠语句边界

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于PostgreSQL 堆叠语句边界的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to PostgreSQL Stacked-Statement Boundary into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 PostgreSQL 堆叠语句执行边界的验证：在注入点后堆叠 COPY TO STDOUT 与 SELECT marker 语句，确认多语句执行能力。适用于评估驱动（简单查询协议）是否允许多语句的场景。
overview.en: Covers verification of the PostgreSQL stacked-statement boundary: stacking COPY TO STDOUT and SELECT marker statements after the injection point to confirm multi-statement execution. Suitable for assessing whether the driver (simple query protocol) allows multiple statements.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入拼接进 SQL 且驱动经简单查询协议允许多语句，注入点以分号追加语句即可执行；堆叠能力让 COPY 等语句可被注入触达，权限未收敛时形成文件读写原语。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into SQL with the driver accepting multiple statements over the simple query protocol: a semicolon executes appended statements. Stacking lets injection reach statements like COPY, forming a file read/write primitive when privileges are unconverged.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令堆叠 COPY TO STDOUT 与 SELECT marker；STDOUT 返回 marker 即确认 PostgreSQL 堆叠执行成立。COPY TO STDOUT 同时验证语句执行与结果回传，可作为后续 COPY 文件能力测试的前置确认；先确认驱动使用简单查询协议，再在隔离环境重复验证堆叠行为稳定。堆叠成立后再按需评估其余可触达语句类型，不扩大初始验证范围。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to stack COPY TO STDOUT and SELECT marker; STDOUT returning the marker confirms PostgreSQL stacked execution. COPY TO STDOUT verifies both statement execution and result return, serving as the precursor check for later COPY file-capability tests; confirm the driver uses the simple query protocol first, then re-verify stacking stability in an isolated environment. Once stacking holds, assess other reachable statement types as needed without expanding the initial scope.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询消除注入点，应用连接禁用多语句并最小化角色权限；修复后堆叠载荷应报语法错误或仅执行首条语句。
mitigation.en: Eliminate the injection point with parameterized queries, disable multi-statements on the application connection, and minimize role privileges; after the fix, stacked payloads must raise syntax errors or execute only the first statement.

title.zh: 堆叠 COPY 探测执行

description.zh: 分号后接 COPY TO STDOUT 语句，输出流出现标记即确认 PostgreSQL 堆叠多语句通道开放，具备执行前提。
description.en: Follow a semicolon with COPY TO STDOUT; the marker in the output stream confirms an open stacked channel on PostgreSQL.

title.zh: 多语句 SELECT 巩固通道
title.en: Reinforce the channel with stacked SELECTs

description.zh: 连续堆叠 SELECT 返回标记值，确认多语句顺序执行稳定可用，通道巩固后即可执行 DO 块与函数调用利用。
description.en: Stack successive SELECTs returning markers to verify sequential execution, then advance to DO blocks and function calls.

title.zh: 条件延迟与 DO 块变体
title.en: Use conditional delay and DO block variants

description.zh: 被规则匹配时改用条件 pg_sleep 延迟或 DO 块 RAISE 语句承载标记，改变语句形态绕过过滤维持执行通道。
description.en: To evade matching, carry the marker via conditional pg_sleep delays or DO-block RAISE statements that reshape the payload.

opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

name.zh: 事务回滚 Marker DML

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于事务回滚 Marker DML的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Transaction-Rolled-Back Marker DML into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖堆叠 DML 语句的无副作用验证形态：在同一事务内对临时表执行 INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE 并在提交前回滚，以 marker 输出与无残留数据证明 DML 可注入。适用于评估堆叠能力能否升级为写操作的场景。
overview.en: Covers the side-effect-free verification form of stacked DML: running INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE against a temporary table inside one transaction and rolling back before commit, using marker output and zero residue to prove DML injectability. Suitable for assessing whether stacking escalates to write operations.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入点具备堆叠执行能力且应用账户持有 DML 权限，攻击者可追加任意写语句；事务回滚只是验证期的无副作用形态，真实攻击中提交即持久化，DML 权限过宽是风险根源。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is stacked execution at the injection point plus DML grants on the application account, letting attackers append arbitrary write statements. Transaction rollback is only the verification-time side-effect-free form; in real attacks a commit persists, and overly broad DML grants are the source of risk.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令在同一事务内对临时表执行 INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE 并在提交前 ROLLBACK；输出始终为 marker 且库中无残留数据即确认 DML 可注入且回滚保证无副作用。只在授权环境的临时表上操作，不得对业务表执行或提交任何写语句。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to run INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE against a temporary table in one transaction and ROLLBACK before commit; constant marker output with zero database residue confirms DML injectability while rollback guarantees no side effects. Operate only on temporary tables in the authorized environment; never run or commit writes against business tables.

mitigation.zh: 应用账户按需授予最小 DML 权限并禁止堆叠语句，参数化消除注入点；修复后堆叠 DML 应报语法错误，并以审计确认无未授权写操作发生。
mitigation.en: Grant the application account minimal DML as needed, forbid stacked statements, and eliminate injection with parameterization; after the fix, stacked DML must raise syntax errors and audits must confirm no unauthorized writes occurred.

title.en: Create a temp table inside a transaction

description.zh: 堆叠 BEGIN 开启事务并建随事务丢弃的临时表，表仅在事务内可见，为写入标记准备隔离容器避免污染业务数据。
description.en: Stack BEGIN and create an ON COMMIT DROP temp table; it lives only inside the transaction as an isolated container for markers.

title.en: Insert a marker and SELECT it back

description.zh: 向临时表 INSERT 标记串再 SELECT 返回，输出出现标记即证明写读闭环可用，整组 DML 语句全部生效。
description.en: INSERT a marker into the temp table and SELECT it back; output containing the marker proves the write-read loop executes.

title.en: Roll back to leave no trace

description.zh: 语句组末尾统一 ROLLBACK，临时表随事务丢弃，目标库无任何持久变更，确认整条链路可安全重复推进验证写能力。
description.en: Close each statement group with ROLLBACK so temp tables vanish and no persistent change remains, keeping the chain repeatable.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认事务回滚 Marker DML所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。

prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

analysis.en: A positive for Transaction-Rolled-Back Marker DML requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

wafBypass.command: ';BE/**/GIN;CRE/**/ATE TEM/**/P TA/**/BLE payloader_marker(value text) ON COMMIT DROP;INS/**/ERT IN/**/TO payloader_marker VALUES('PAYLOADER_MARKER');ROL/**/LBACK;-- -

description.zh: 绕过对堆叠事务语句链的特征匹配：每个关键字注释分词并保持事务语义；回显 marker 且表随回滚消失即成功。
description.en: Comment-split every keyword in the stacked transaction chain while preserving semantics; the marker echoing and the table vanishing on rollback confirm success.

wafBypass.command: ';CREATE TEMP TABLE payloader_marker(value text) ON COMMIT DROP;SAVEPOINT sp;INSERT INTO payloader_marker VALUES('PAYLOADER_MARKER');ROLLBACK TO sp;-- -

description.zh: 绕过对 ROLLBACK 全量回滚特征的审计：改用保存点局部回滚验证写入路径；SELECT 可见插入且随后回退即成功。
description.en: Use a savepoint-scoped rollback to validate the write path while evading full-ROLLBACK signatures; a visible insert that then reverts confirms success.

wafBypass.command: ';WITH t AS (INSERT INTO payloader_marker VALUES('PAYLOADER_MARKER') RETURNING 1) SELECT count(*) FROM t;ROLLBACK;-- -

description.zh: 绕过对 INSERT VALUES 直写的检测：把 DML 包进 CEE 表达式执行；计数返回 1 且回滚后无残留即成功。
description.en: Wrap the DML inside a CTE to evade direct INSERT VALUES detection; a returned count of 1 with no residue after rollback confirms success.

name.zh: HTTP Chunked 完整请求载体（transport-check）

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Complete HTTP Chunked Marker Carrier into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖以完整 HTTP Chunked 请求承载 SQL 注入载荷的端到端载体验证：marker 作为参数值分块发送，服务端重组后进入查询处理并回显。适用于验证分块传输编码在注入链路中的完整可用性。
overview.en: Covers end-to-end carrier verification of SQL injection payloads over a complete HTTP chunked request: the marker is sent as a chunked parameter value, reassembled server-side, processed by the query, and echoed. Suitable for verifying full usability of chunked transfer encoding in the injection chain.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务端按传输层标准重组 chunked 请求体，而检测设备可能只检查原始分块字节；重组后的参数值进入 SQL 拼接，分块不改变语义但改变检测可见性。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the server reassembling chunked bodies per the transfer-layer standard while inspection devices may only examine raw chunked bytes; the reassembled parameter value reaches SQL concatenation — chunking changes no semantics but changes detection visibility.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令构造完整 chunked 请求，把 marker 作为参数值分块发送，Host 保持本地夹具地址；服务端重组后按普通参数处理并回显 marker 即确认分块载体可承载注入载荷。先发送明文对照建立基线，再以不同块边界分块发送同一 marker 验证各组件重组一致。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to build a complete chunked request sending the marker as a chunked parameter value with Host kept at the local fixture; the server reassembling and echoing the marker confirms the chunked carrier can carry injection payloads. First send a plaintext control to set the baseline, then chunk the same marker at different boundaries to verify consistent reassembly across components.

mitigation.zh: 边缘统一分帧重组后再检测，拒绝歧义分帧与极端块边界；修复后分块与明文请求应产生一致的处理结果与日志，检测层不再被分块形态绕过。
mitigation.en: Unify framing reassembly at the edge before inspection and reject ambiguous framing and extreme chunk boundaries; after the fix, chunked and plaintext requests must produce identical handling and logs, with the detection layer no longer bypassed by chunked shapes.

description.zh: 按原始 HTTP 格式写出分块传输报文，参数名与值分属不同分块，先建立完整可复现的分块载体请求模板。
description.en: Write the raw Transfer-Encoding: chunked request with the parameter name and value in separate chunks as a reusable carrier template.

title.zh: 分块边界拆分注入语句
title.en: Split the injection across chunk boundaries

description.zh: 把 SQL 语句在关键字处切断后分块传输，每个分块内容均无完整特征，后端重组后语句整体生效穿透检测。
description.en: Cut the SQL at keyword boundaries across chunks; each piece lacks full signatures while the reassembled backend query still fires.

title.en: Confirm the bypass via differential submission

description.zh: 同一注入分别以常规与分块两种方式提交，仅分块版本出现报错或回显变化即确认绕过成立，可接入后续提取链。
description.en: Submit the same injection plain and chunked; only the chunked copy changing database behavior proves the bypass for later chains.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by Complete HTTP Chunked Marker Carrier in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

analysis.zh: 完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体的阳性必须由同一 marker 的解析差分与最终后端行为共同证明；本地工具输出、普通超时、连接关闭、错误页和另一 DBMS 的成功语句均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive for Complete HTTP Chunked Marker Carrier requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

wafBypass.command:
POST /transport-check HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8080
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

3;x=1
id=
10;ok
PAYLOADER_MARKER
0
X-Pad: z

description.zh: 绕过对标准 chunk 帧格式的解析差异：尺寸行加扩展参数并附尾随头；服务端仍能取到完整参数即成功。
description.en: Add chunk-size extensions plus a trailing header to exploit parser divergence; the server still receiving the full parameter confirms success.

wafBypass.command:
POST /transport-check HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8080
transfer-encoding: CHUNKED

3
id=
A
PAYLOADER_
6
MARKER
0

description.zh: 绕过对小写 transfer-encoding 头与纯小写帧的匹配：头与尺寸行大小写变形；注入参数完整到达即成功。
description.en: Vary the case of the header and hex size lines against lowercase-only framing rules; complete arrival of the injected parameter confirms success.

wafBypass.command:
POST /transport-check HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8080
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

3
id=
E
%2527%2520OR%252
7
01%253D1--
0

description.zh: 绕过一次性解码的 WAF：chunk 体内放置二次编码 payload，应用解码两次后还原注入；语法报错出现即成功。
description.en: Place doubly encoded payloads inside chunks for WAFs that decode once; the application decoding twice restores the injection, confirmed by a syntax error.

name.zh: HTTP 重复参数载体

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于HTTP 重复参数载体的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to HTTP Duplicate-Parameter Carrier into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖以 HTTP 重复参数（HPP）承载注入语句的载体验证：把 SQL 关键字拆分到多个同名 id 参数提交，验证服务端拼接策略对参数解析的影响。适用于探测框架与中间件参数合并行为差异的场景。
overview.en: Covers carrier verification of injection statements over HTTP parameter pollution (HPP): splitting SQL keywords across multiple same-named id parameters to probe how server-side merge strategies affect parameter parsing. Suitable for detecting behavioral differences in parameter merging across frameworks and middleware.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是不同组件对同名参数的合并策略不一致（取首、取末或拼接），WAF 检查的参数视图与应用实际使用的视图可能不同；拆分后的关键字在服务端重组后仍进入 SQL 拼接。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is inconsistent merge strategies for same-named parameters across components (first-wins, last-wins, or concatenation): the parameter view inspected by the WAF may differ from the one the application actually uses, and split keywords rejoin into SQL concatenation server-side.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令把 SQL 关键字拆分到多个同名 id 参数提交；服务端按其拼接策略重组后执行并出现响应差异即确认 HPP 载体对参数解析的影响。先以单参数完整载荷建立对照，再逐种拆分方式测试平台的取值策略。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to split SQL keywords across multiple same-named id parameters; the server reassembling per its merge strategy and executing with response differences confirms the HPP carrier's effect on parameter parsing. Start with a single-parameter full payload as a control, then test each split pattern to map the platform's merge behavior.

mitigation.zh: 在应用入口统一同名参数合并策略（如仅取首个）并拒绝重复参数，WAF 与应用参数视图对齐；修复后拆分载荷应被拒绝或与完整载荷同样处理，不再出现视图差异。
mitigation.en: Unify the merge strategy for same-named parameters at the application entry (e.g., first-wins) and reject duplicates, aligning WAF and application parameter views; after the fix, split payloads must be rejected or handled identically to complete payloads with no view divergence.

title.en: Split the statement across repeated parameters

description.zh: 把注入语句按段拆进多个同名参数提交，单个参数内容均不构成完整攻击特征，逐值检测难以命中任何一段载荷。
description.en: Break the statement into several same-name parameters; no single value carries a complete signature to match.

title.zh: 利用服务端取值差异重组

description.zh: 服务端对重复参数按末值或拼接方式取值，片段被重组为完整 SQL 执行，注入语义在数据库侧恢复生效命中。
description.en: The server resolves duplicates by last-value or concatenation, reassembling fragments into a full statement that executes.

title.zh: 观察响应确认语句重组生效

description.zh: 以报错或联合查询回显观察重组语句是否生效，响应出现注入特征即确认该载体可用，换任意载荷继续攻击推进。
description.en: Watch for error or UNION echoes proving the reassembled query ran; any payload can now ride this carrier.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认HTTP 重复参数载体所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by HTTP Duplicate-Parameter Carrier in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

analysis.zh: HTTP 重复参数载体的阳性必须由同一 marker 的解析差分与最终后端行为共同证明；本地工具输出、普通超时、连接关闭、错误页和另一 DBMS 的成功语句均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive for HTTP Duplicate-Parameter Carrier requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

title.zh: 参数名大小写与注释插入

description.zh: 绕过对同参数名重复+UNION 特征的组合检测：参数名大小写不一致并给值加注释分词；后端取最后一个/拼接值注入生效即成功。
description.en: Vary parameter-name case and comment-split values to defeat duplicate-param plus UNION signatures; effective injection via the backend-chosen value confirms success.

title.zh: GET 与 POST 混合传参

wafBypass.command:
POST /?id=1 HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8080
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

id=' UNION&id=SELECT&id=1,2,3--

description.zh: 绕过只解析查询串或只解析体的单侧规则：注入拆到 POST 体与 GET 串两侧；服务端合并后注入成立即成功。
description.en: Split the injection across the query string and POST body to bypass single-side parsing; an effective merged injection confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 id= 直接赋值的键名匹配：用数组下标形态传值，后端 implode 后注入；报错或回显异常即成功。
description.en: Use array-subscript naming to bypass plain key matching, relying on backend imploding; an error or anomalous echo confirms success.

name.zh: DBMS 标注 SQL 等价表达式

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于DBMS 标注 SQL 等价表达式的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to DBMS-Scoped SQL Equivalent Expressions into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖 DBMS 标注的 SQL 等价表达式变体：以 GREATEST、JOIN 派生表与 CAST 等价构造恒真与列对齐。适用于关键字过滤拦截 AND/OR/UNION 等字面形态、需要等价表达式维持注入链的场景。
overview.en: Covers DBMS-annotated SQL equivalent-expression variants: building always-true conditions and column alignment via GREATEST, JOIN-derived tables, and CAST equivalences. Suitable when keyword filtering blocks literal AND/OR/UNION shapes and equivalent expressions are needed to keep the injection chain alive.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入点存在而检测按固定关键字签名匹配；SQL 表达式语义等价但字面形态多样，签名覆盖不了等价嵌套时过滤即被绕过。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a live injection point with detection matching fixed keyword signatures; SQL expressions are semantically equivalent but vary in literal shape, and signatures that miss equivalent nestings are bypassed.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 GREATEST、JOIN 派生表与 CAST 等价表达式构造恒真与列对齐；语句仍执行并回显 marker 即确认表达式等价变体可用于绕过关键字检测。先确认原始形态被拦截作为对照，再逐个等价形式验证并记录各自效果。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to build always-true conditions and column alignment via GREATEST, JOIN-derived tables, and CAST equivalents; statements still executing and echoing the marker confirm the equivalent-expression variants bypass keyword detection. First confirm the original form is blocked as a control, then verify each equivalent form one by one and record its effect.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询消除注入面，检测按解析后的查询结构而非字面签名匹配；修复后重放全部等价表达式应被同样处理，回归测试覆盖完整变体族。
mitigation.en: Eliminate the injection surface with parameterized queries and match detection on parsed query structure rather than literal signatures; after the fix, replaying all equivalent expressions must be handled identically, with regression tests covering the full variant family.

title.zh: 等价函数替代被滤运算符

description.zh: 等号或比较运算符被过滤时用等价函数构造真假判断，布尔语义保持完整不变，盲注推理链路不被过滤规则打断。
description.en: When '=' is filtered, rebuild true/false tests with functions like GREATEST so boolean semantics survive for blind chains.

title.zh: JOIN 链替代 UNION 对齐
title.en: Align with JOIN chains instead of UNION

description.zh: UNION 被拦截时用子查询逐个拼接列位，语义上等价于联合查询，同样能把目标数据并入结果行完成读取。
description.en: If UNION is blocked, join subqueries one by one to align columns, matching union semantics and merging target data into rows.

title.zh: CAST 固定类型稳定回显

description.zh: 用 CAST 把标记值定型为定长字符串，规避隐式类型转换导致的报错，保证回显位内容稳定可读利于提取。
description.en: CAST markers into fixed-length strings to avoid implicit-conversion errors and keep the echo position reliably readable.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认DBMS 标注 SQL 等价表达式所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by DBMS-Scoped SQL Equivalent Expressions in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

wafBypass.command:
1' AND COALESCE(NULL,1)=1--
1' AND NULLIF(1,2) IS NULL--

description.zh: 绕过对等号比较和常见函数的过滤：用集合函数构造等价布尔谓词；真/假条件响应可区分即成功。
description.en: Construct equivalent boolean predicates with set functions to evade equals-sign and common-function filters; distinguishable true/false responses confirm success.

title.zh: IIS 宽字节 Unicode 编码

description.zh: 绕过不识别 %u 系列编码的 WAF（IIS 场景）：用 %u0027 表示引号；数据库报错或条件差异出现即成功。
description.en: Use %u-style encoding for the quote on IIS targets whose WAF misses this form; a database error or conditional difference confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 UNION 关键字与空格分隔的规则：用 JOIN 链替代 UNION 对齐列数并混淆大小写；三列回显即成功。
description.en: Replace UNION column alignment with a JOIN chain and mixed case; a three-column echo confirms success.

name.zh: 有界 SQL 注释填充

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于有界 SQL 注释填充的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Bounded SQL Comment Padding into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖有界 SQL 注释填充的绕过验证：在语句前注入超长注释块填充检测窗口，确认大注释填充可绕过长度或正则限制。适用于检测层存在请求长度或正则回溯上限的场景。
overview.en: Covers bounded SQL comment-padding bypass verification: injecting an oversized comment block before the statement to fill the inspection window, confirming large comment padding defeats length or regex limits. Suitable when the detection layer caps request length or regex backtracking.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是检测层为控制性能对检查范围设置长度或正则回溯上限，超长注释把真实载荷推出检测窗口；数据库解析器忽略注释内容，语句语义不受影响。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is detection layers capping inspection scope with length or regex-backtracking limits for performance: oversized comments push the real payload out of the inspection window, while the database parser ignores comment content and statement semantics stay intact.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令在语句前注入超长注释块填充检测窗口；语句仍执行并返回 marker 即确认大注释填充可绕过长度或正则限制。从短到长递增注释长度提交，观察检测失效的临界点并记录对应长度；确认后在报告中给出临界值，供检测层调整检查窗口时参考。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject an oversized comment block before the statement, filling the inspection window; the statement still executing and returning the marker confirms comment padding defeats length or regex limits. Increase comment length from short to long, observing the critical failure point and recording the corresponding length; report the threshold afterward for detection teams resizing inspection windows.

mitigation.zh: 对请求体设置合理长度上限并对全量内容检测，检测层不因长度截断而跳过检查；参数化消除注入面后，注释填充变体回归应全部无效。
mitigation.en: Set a sensible request-body length cap and inspect the full content, never skipping checks due to truncation; once injection is eliminated via parameterization, comment-padding variants must fail all regression replays.

title.en: Confirm the plain injection is blocked

description.zh: 直接提交标准注入语句观察响应表现，被拦截的响应特征先完整记录下来，作为后续各种变形尝试的比对参考起点。
description.en: Submit the plain statement and log the blocked response signature as the reference point for later reshaping.

title.zh: 前置注释填充改变长度特征
title.en: Pad with a long leading comment to shift signatures

description.zh: 在语句前插入超长注释块提交，改变内容长度与特征偏移，按固定偏移或长度匹配的规则失效，语句本体保持不变。
description.en: Prepend an oversized comment block to shift length and offsets; rules keyed to fixed offsets miss the unchanged statement body.

title.zh: 标记回显确认绕过生效
title.en: Confirm the bypass via the echoed marker

description.zh: 注释填充后语句携带固定标记执行，响应中出现标记即绕过生效确认，把该载体推广到数据提取载荷继续利用推进。
description.en: With padding applied, the statement carries a fixed marker; its appearance in the response proves the bypass generalizes to dump payloads.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认有界 SQL 注释填充所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by Bounded SQL Comment Padding in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

analysis.zh: 有界 SQL 注释填充的阳性必须由同一 marker 的解析差分与最终后端行为共同证明；本地工具输出、普通超时、连接关闭、错误页和另一 DBMS 的成功语句均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive for Bounded SQL Comment Padding requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

description.zh: 绕过对单一长注释特征的匹配：拆成多段注释交错填充超长内容；语句正常执行并回显 marker 即成功。
description.en: Split padding across multiple interleaved comment segments to defeat single-long-comment matching; normal execution echoing the marker confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过剥离标准注释后重组语句的 WAF：利用 MySQL 版本注释让内容在执行期还原；marker 回显即成功。
description.en: Abuse MySQL versioned comments so the payload is restored at execution time after comment stripping; an echoed marker confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过按单行归一化的解析器：注释内嵌换行并在注释间夹带换行分隔；语句执行且回显即成功。
description.en: Embed newlines inside and between comments against single-line normalizing parsers; execution with echo confirms success.

name.zh: Multipart SQL Marker 载体

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于Multipart SQL Marker 载体的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Multipart SQL Marker Carrier into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖以 multipart 表单字段承载 SQL 注入语句的载体验证：注入语句放入 multipart 字段值，服务端解析后进入 SQL 拼接。适用于文件上传等 multipart 接口的参数注入面评估场景。
overview.en: Covers carrier verification of SQL injection statements over multipart form fields: statements placed in multipart field values reach SQL concatenation after server-side parsing. Suitable for assessing the parameter injection surface of multipart endpoints such as file uploads.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 multipart 字段值经服务端解析后与其他参数同样进入 SQL 拼接，而检测层可能只扫描 URL/JSON 参数或仅做文件类型检查；字段值因此成为被忽视的注入通道。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is multipart field values reaching SQL concatenation like any other parameter after server-side parsing, while detection may only scan URL/JSON parameters or check file types; field values thus become an overlooked injection channel.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令把注入语句放入 multipart 表单字段发送；服务端解析字段值进入 SQL 拼接并出现响应差异即确认 multipart 载体可达注入层。先以合法值建立对照基线，再把字段值替换为布尔与 UNION 载荷逐个验证；同时记录字段名与 Content-Type，便于复现与回归。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to place injection statements in multipart form fields; server-side parsing feeding values into SQL concatenation with response differences confirms the multipart carrier reaches the injection layer. Baseline with legitimate values first, then substitute boolean and UNION payloads field by field, recording field names and Content-Type for reproducibility and regression.

mitigation.zh: multipart 字段值与其他参数同等参数化处理，检测层覆盖完整 multipart 体；修复后注入字段值应报错或无响应差异，文件内容检查与字段检查分离执行。
mitigation.en: Parameterize multipart field values like any other parameter and cover the full multipart body in detection; after the fix, injected field values must error or show no response difference, with file-content checks separated from field checks.

title.zh: 构造 multipart 表单载体

description.zh: 按边界符组装完整的表单报文内容，把注入语句写入目标字段值中，建立起完整可直接发送的分块载体请求模板。
description.en: Assemble a boundary-delimited multipart body carrying the injection in the id field as a ready-to-send template.

description.zh: 部分检测只解析简单表单请求体，分块字段内容不在扫描范围之内，语句完整进入后端查询执行，绕过由此成立。
description.en: Inspectors that only parse urlencoded bodies skip multipart fields, letting the intact statement reach and run in the backend query.

description.zh: 观察联合查询回显或数据库报错信息是否出现，语句生效即确认载体可用，后续提取载荷均经该分块通道投递执行。
description.en: Watch for UNION echoes or SQL errors; once fired, the carrier is proven and further payloads ride the multipart channel.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认Multipart SQL Marker 载体所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by Multipart SQL Marker Carrier in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

analysis.zh: Multipart SQL Marker 载体的阳性必须由同一 marker 的解析差分与最终后端行为共同证明；本地工具输出、普通超时、连接关闭、错误页和另一 DBMS 的成功语句均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive for Multipart SQL Marker Carrier requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

wafBypass.command:
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary

------WebKitFormBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data;
 name="id"

1' UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
------WebKitFormBoundary--

description.zh: 绕过按单行解析 Content-Disposition 的 WAF：头部折行使参数名在重组时才拼合；注入参数生效即成功。
description.en: Fold the Content-Disposition header so the parameter name reassembles only at the application layer; an effective injected parameter confirms success.

wafBypass.command:
------WebKitFormBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="id"
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="id"

' UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
------WebKitFormBoundary--

description.zh: 利用解析器对重复头取值差异：一侧取空值一侧取注入值；服务端最终采用注入值即成功。
description.en: Exploit divergent duplicate-header handling between parser and app; the injected value ultimately adopted by the server confirms success.

wafBypass.command:
------WebKitFormBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="id"

1' UNI
------WebKitFormBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="id"

ON SELECT 1,2,3--
------WebKitFormBoundary--

description.zh: 绕过按 part 全值匹配的规则：把注入串拆进两个同名 part 依赖后端拼接；完整语句生效即成功。
description.en: Split the injection across two same-name parts relying on backend concatenation; the complete statement taking effect confirms success.

name.zh: JSON SQL Marker 载体

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于JSON SQL Marker 载体的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to JSON SQL Marker Carrier into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖以 JSON 字段值承载 SQL 注入语句的载体验证：注入语句放入 JSON 字段值提交，服务端反序列化后进入 SQL 拼接。适用于 REST API 等以 JSON 为主传输形态的注入面评估场景。
overview.en: Covers carrier verification of SQL injection statements over JSON field values: statements placed in JSON field values reach SQL concatenation after server-side deserialization. Suitable for assessing injection surfaces of REST APIs and other JSON-primary transports.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 JSON 反序列化后的字段值与其他参数同样进入 SQL 拼接，检测层可能只匹配查询串形态的关键字；JSON 的转义形态同时可帮助绕过字面匹配。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is deserialized JSON field values reaching SQL concatenation like any other parameter while detection may match only query-string-shaped keywords; JSON escaping additionally helps defeat literal matching.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令把注入语句放入 JSON 字段值提交；服务端反序列化后进入 SQL 拼接并出现响应差异即确认 JSON 载体可达注入层。先以合法 JSON 建立对照基线，再逐字段替换布尔、报错与 UNION 载荷验证；记录字段路径与嵌套层级，确认反序列化行为稳定可复现。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to place injection statements in JSON field values; deserialization feeding them into SQL concatenation with response differences confirms the JSON carrier reaches the injection layer. Baseline with legitimate JSON first, then substitute boolean, error-based, and UNION payloads field by field, recording field paths and nesting depth to confirm stable, reproducible deserialization.

mitigation.zh: JSON 字段经 DTO 类型约束后参数化处理，检测层解析 JSON 后按语义检查；修复后注入字段值应报错或无响应差异，编码形态不再影响处理结果。
mitigation.en: Process JSON fields through DTO type constraints and parameterization, with detection inspecting parsed JSON semantics; after the fix, injected field values must error or show no response difference, and encoding shapes must not affect handling.

description.zh: 接口收 JSON 时把注入写进对应字段值提交，请求类型变为 JSON 格式，载荷随结构化数据进入后端处理链路。
description.en: For JSON APIs, place the injection in the field value and post as application/json so the payload rides structured data inward.

title.zh: 利用解析位置差异绕过

description.zh: 部分规则仅检查表单与查询参数，JSON 体内容不在覆盖范围，语句顺利进入解析后的 SQL 拼接并执行生效。
description.en: Rules covering only form or query parameters skip JSON bodies, so the statement reaches the SQL builder and executes.

title.en: Confirm the channel via error echo

description.zh: 提交带单引号的语句观察报错与回显，数据库特征错误出现即通路成立，切换联合查询或盲注载荷继续提取数据。
description.en: Submit quote-bearing statements and watch for database-specific errors; their appearance proves the channel for UNION or blind follow-ups.
