prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认JSON SQL Marker 载体所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by JSON SQL Marker Carrier in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

analysis.zh: JSON SQL Marker 载体的阳性必须由同一 marker 的解析差分与最终后端行为共同证明；本地工具输出、普通超时、连接关闭、错误页和另一 DBMS 的成功语句均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive for JSON SQL Marker Carrier requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

description.zh: 绕过对明文引号元字符的 JSON 体扫描：引号以 \u0027 转义，应用解码后注入；报错或回显异常即成功。
description.en: Escape the quote as \u0027 so it survives JSON body scanning and decodes at the application; an error or anomalous echo confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对字符串标量值的类型校验：用数组包裹注入串，后端字符串化后拼入查询；注入生效即成功。
description.en: Wrap the payload in an array to pass scalar-type checks, stringified on the backend before query assembly; an effective injection confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对单字段整串特征的检测：把语句拆到多个业务字段，依赖后端 ORDER BY 拼接；合成语句执行即成功。
description.en: Distribute the statement across multiple business fields relying on backend ORDER BY assembly; the composed statement executing confirms success.

name.zh: WordPress URL 包装 UNION 查询

description.zh: 使用完整 WordPress 风格 URL 中的 vulnparam 验证查询参数从 HTTP 路由进入 SQL UNION 语义的端到端数据流。
description.en: Uses a complete WordPress-style URL with vulnparam to test the end-to-end flow from HTTP routing into SQL UNION semantics.

overview.zh: 覆盖 WordPress 场景下 URL 查询参数到 SQL 的端到端验证：以完整 URL 中的 vulnparam 携带 UNION 注入，验证查询参数从 HTTP 路由进入 SQL UNION 语义的数据流。
overview.en: Covers end-to-end verification from URL query parameters to SQL in WordPress: a full URL carrying UNION injection in vulnparam, testing the dataflow from HTTP routing into SQL UNION semantics.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 WordPress 插件或自定义处理器从查询字符串读取 vulnparam 并拼接 SQL；附加参数可能触发特定路由或绕过常规入口，URL 编码与参数路由由框架处理后数据库仍收到未参数化结构。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is WordPress plugins or custom handlers reading vulnparam from the query string into SQL concatenation; extra parameters may trigger specific routes or bypass common entries, and after framework URL decoding and routing the database still receives non-parameterized structure.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令把完整 URL 查询参数样例发到隔离实例，{LAB_APP} 渲染为隔离实验应用主机；返回版本常量注入结果即确认该参数可达 SQL。确认插件、路由和版本后，在隔离副本用合法 vulnparam 建立基线，将 UNION 目标替换为固定常量请求一次，并确认 iThemes 参数是否只是路由条件。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to send the full URL query-parameter sample to an isolated instance, with {LAB_APP} rendered as the isolated lab host; version-constant injection results returning confirm the parameter reaches SQL. After confirming plugin, route, and version, baseline with a legitimate vulnparam on the isolated copy, send one request with the UNION target swapped for a fixed constant, and check whether the iThemes parameter is only a routing condition.

mitigation.zh: 升级或修复对应插件，使用 WordPress 数据库参数化 API 与严格参数类型，移除隐藏路由触发条件；边界只允许预期参数，数据库账户最小权限，并保留完整 URL 回归用例。
mitigation.en: Upgrade or fix the affected plugin, use WordPress database parameterization APIs with strict parameter types, and remove hidden route triggers; allow only expected parameters at the boundary with least-privileged database accounts, keeping full-URL regression cases.

description.zh: 审计 WordPress 插件代码或历史漏洞库，找出未净化的查询参数名及其触发页面，确定注入落点与调用路径。
description.en: Audit plugin code or vuln databases for unescaped query parameters and their pages to pin the injection point.

title.zh: URL 编码联合语句注入

description.zh: 按完整地址格式提交编码后的联合查询语句，参数进入插件 SQL 拼接执行，响应回显版本号即命中确认注入点。
description.en: Submit the URL-encoded union select @@version per the wrapped sample; the plugin concatenates and runs it, echoing the version on hit.

description.zh: 保持第 2 步参数与编码方式不变，替换查询体枚举用户表，提取管理员账户哈希用于离线破解接管站点后台。
description.en: Keep the step 2 parameter and encoding, swap the query to enumerate wp_users and pull admin hashes for offline cracking.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认目标插件或测试路由使用 vulnparam 构造数据库查询
prerequisites.en: A target plugin or test route is confirmed to build a database query from vulnparam.

prerequisites.zh: host.com 替换为隔离实例且数据库只含伪版本标记
prerequisites.en: host.com is replaced with an isolated instance whose database exposes only a synthetic version marker.

analysis.zh: 该卡强调端到端归因：完整 URL 命中路由不等于数据库注入，必须有最终 SQL 与测试常量结果。若目标并非对应插件，应视为不适用。
analysis.en: This card emphasizes end-to-end attribution: route matching does not equal SQL injection without final SQL and fixed-constant output. It is not applicable when the identified plugin or route is absent.

opsecTips.zh: 仅对已确认插件的隔离副本请求一次，不扫描公共 WordPress 站点。
opsecTips.en: Request once only against an isolated copy of the confirmed plugin and do not scan public WordPress sites.

opsecTips.zh: 把版本函数替换为固定常量并限制数据库返回，不收集产品版本或真实数据。
opsecTips.en: Replace the version function with a fixed constant and limit output; do not collect product versions or real data.

description.zh: 绕过 WordPress 侧只解码一次的过滤：空格与@二次编码；错误日志或响应差异出现即成功。
description.en: Double-encode spaces and @ against single-decode filtering in the WordPress layer; an error log entry or response delta confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过针对固定参数名 vulnparam 的规则：尝试主题的备用注入参数并附加噪声参数；注入报错出现即成功。
description.en: Try an alternate injectable parameter with noise params against rules pinned to the original name; an injection error confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过仅规范化 %20 的编码规则：用 %09 制表符作分隔；SQL 语义保持并触发报错即成功。
description.en: Use %09 separators where only %20 is normalized; preserved SQL semantics triggering an error confirm success.

name.zh: 本地 Marker 文件读取边界

description.zh: 本地 Marker 文件读取边界验证相对路径是否在一次解码与规范化后离开批准读取根目录。它只保留一个 include/read 输入，并以 PAYLOADER_MARKER、请求 ID 和最终解析记录作为证据。
description.en: Local Marker File Read Boundary validates whether a relative path leaves the approved read root after one decoding and canonicalization pass. It retains one include or read input and uses PAYLOADER_MARKER, request ID, and final resolution records as evidence.

overview.zh: 本地 Marker 文件读取边界针对文件包含/读取入口接受相对路径的攻击场景：路径经一次解码与规范化后可能越过批准根目录。使用受控 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具完成一次读取验证，以响应体、最终解析路径与请求 ID 作为证据。
overview.en: The local marker file-read boundary targets file-inclusion/read endpoints that accept relative paths, which may escape the approved root after one decoding and normalization pass. It validates a single read against a controlled PAYLOADER_MARKER fixture, using the response body, final resolved path, and request ID as evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用在最终解码、规范化或 wrapper 选择之前做安全判断，相对路径随后被文件 API 解析出预期资源映射，../ 段得以越过批准读取根目录。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the application makes its safety decision before final decoding, normalization, or wrapper selection, so the relative path is later resolved by the file API beyond the expected resource mapping and ../ segments escape the approved read root.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的请求对包含/读取入口提交 ../payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt，一次只提交一行；命中判据为 HTTP 200 且响应体恰好为 PAYLOADER_MARKER 文本，同时结合最终路径或 wrapper 日志确认解析结果。命中即证明相对路径可在一次解码与规范化后离开批准根目录，随后按同一入口测试其余变体并记录请求 ID 形成证据链。
exploitation.en: Submit ../payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt to the inclusion/read endpoint as in step 1, one line per request; a hit is HTTP 200 with the response body exactly the PAYLOADER_MARKER text, cross-checked against the final path or wrapper log. A hit proves a relative path can leave the approved root after one decoding and normalization pass; then test remaining variants on the same endpoint and record request IDs to build the evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定资源 ID 到文件或模板的服务端映射，拒绝用户提供的 scheme 与路径；必须读取文件时只解码一次，在最终规范路径上验证根目录，并以低权限只读方式打开。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认遍历路径被拒绝而合法资源 ID 仍正常。
mitigation.en: Map fixed resource IDs to files or templates server-side and reject user-supplied schemes and paths; when reading files is required, decode once, validate the root on the final canonical path, and open read-only with low privilege. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm traversal paths are rejected while legitimate resource IDs still work.

description.zh: 先以正常文件名请求包含接口，记录返回内容与报错形态，判断参数流向 include 还是 readfile。命中判据：正常文件内容随请求按预期返回。
description.en: Request the include endpoint with a normal file to learn response and error shapes. Success: normal content returns as expected.

title.zh: 提交遍历路径读取越界文件
title.en: Read outside the root via traversal

description.zh: 在第 1 步定位的参数上提交 ../ 前缀路径，读取 Web 根之外的标记文件，测试目录约束是否失效。命中判据：HTTP 200 且响应体为标记文本。
description.en: Submit a ../ prefixed path to read a marker file outside the web root. Success: HTTP 200 with the marker text in the body.

title.zh: 调整深度读取敏感文件
title.en: Tune depth to reach sensitive files

description.zh: 沿第 2 步的遍历格式增减 ../ 数量定位文件系统根，再转向 /etc/passwd 与应用配置文件。命中判据：目标文件内容出现在响应中。
description.en: Vary ../ depth from step 2 to reach the filesystem root, then read /etc/passwd and app configs. Success: sensitive content returned.

title.en: Scope a path to code execution

description.zh: 读取日志、会话与源码文件寻找可写且可包含的入口，为日志投毒或过滤器链执行做准备。命中判据：找到可写入且随后可包含的文件路径。
description.en: Read logs, sessions and sources to find a writable includable target for poisoning. Success: a writable then includable path is identified.

prerequisites.zh: 工作目录中存在随机只读 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具，并记录其规范路径与清理责任。
prerequisites.en: A random read-only PAYLOADER_MARKER fixture exists in the working directory with its canonical path and cleanup owner recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 本地服务只监听 127.0.0.1，并可查看 URL 解码、最终路径、stream wrapper 和 include 结果日志。
prerequisites.en: The local service listens only on 127.0.0.1 and exposes URL-decoding, final-path, stream-wrapper, and include-result logs.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是响应精确返回工作目录 marker，且最终路径日志显示请求解析到该只读夹具。单独的 HTTP 200、PHP warning、空响应、WAF 告警或一次超时都不足以证明文件包含。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the response returns the exact working-directory marker and final-path logs show resolution to that read-only fixture. HTTP 200 alone, a PHP warning, an empty response, a WAF alert, or a single timeout does not prove file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用工作目录 marker、localhost 与一次性请求 ID，禁止真实系统、凭据、环境和其他进程路径。
opsecTips.en: Use only working-directory markers, localhost, and one-time request IDs; prohibit real system, credential, environment, and other-process paths.

opsecTips.zh: 不提交可执行 PHP、WebShell、反向通道或序列化对象；每个请求设置三秒超时并在结束后清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit executable PHP, web shells, reverse channels, or serialized objects; cap each request at three seconds and clean fixtures afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对 ../ 明文遍历特征的过滤：分隔符编码后由应用解码；返回 marker 内容即成功。
description.en: Encode separators so ../ disappears until application decoding; returned marker content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过执行单次 ../ 删除的过滤逻辑：....// 删一层后剩 ../；文件内容返回即成功。
description.en: Use ....// so single-pass ../ removal still leaves a working traversal; returned file content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过强制附加扩展名的包含逻辑：路径后接 %00 截断后缀（旧版 PHP）；marker 原文返回即成功。
description.en: Truncate the appended extension with %00 on older PHP; raw marker content returning confirms success.

name.zh: 日志 Marker 文件读取边界

description.zh: 日志 Marker 文件读取边界验证受控请求写入的纯文本 marker 是否能经文件包含入口被读取，而不执行日志内容。它只保留一个 include/read 输入，并以 PAYLOADER_MARKER、请求 ID 和最终解析记录作为证据。
description.en: Log Marker File Read Boundary validates whether a plain-text marker written by a controlled request can be read through the inclusion entry without executing log content. It retains one include or read input and uses PAYLOADER_MARKER, request ID, and final resolution records as evidence.

overview.zh: 日志 Marker 文件读取边界针对日志内容可经文件包含入口被读取的场景：受控请求写入的纯文本 marker 落入访问日志后，包含参数可把它读回。验证只读取日志不执行内容，以 grep 命中与请求 ID 作为证据。
overview.en: The log marker file-read boundary targets logs reachable through a file-inclusion endpoint: a plain-text marker written by a controlled request lands in the access log and the inclusion parameter reads it back. Validation only reads the log without executing content, using the grep hit and request ID as evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是包含/读取入口接受用户控制的日志路径且缺少根目录约束，受控请求写入日志的任意文本可被读回；若该入口是 include 语义且日志含代码，还会升级为代码执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an inclusion/read endpoint that accepts user-controlled log paths without root-directory constraints, letting arbitrary text written to the log be read back; if the endpoint has include semantics and the log contains code, it escalates to code execution.

exploitation.zh: 先发送带 PAYLOADER_MARKER 的受控请求使其写入访问日志，再按第 1 步经包含入口读取日志文件并用 grep --fixed-strings 过滤 PAYLOADER_MARKER；命中判据为 grep 输出包含 marker 行，证明日志文件可被包含读取。结合最终解析路径与请求 ID 留证；确认后可评估同一入口对包含执行类变体的暴露面。
exploitation.en: First send a controlled request carrying PAYLOADER_MARKER so it lands in the access log, then read the log through the inclusion endpoint as in step 1 and filter with grep --fixed-strings PAYLOADER_MARKER; a hit is marker lines in the grep output, proving the log file is includable. Keep the final resolved path and request ID as evidence; afterwards assess the same endpoint's exposure to inclusion-execution variants.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定资源 ID 到文件的服务端映射，拒绝用户提供的路径；必须读取文件时只解码一次，在最终规范路径上验证根目录并以低权限只读方式打开。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认日志路径被拒绝且业务读取不受影响。
mitigation.en: Map fixed resource IDs to files server-side and reject user-supplied paths; when reading is required, decode once, validate the root on the final canonical path, and open read-only with low privilege. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm log paths are rejected while business reads are unaffected.

title.zh: 探测日志文件包含入口

description.zh: 确认 file 参数能包含服务器本地文件，从报错与响应长度推断 Apache 或 Nginx 日志的绝对路径。命中判据：包含日志时响应出现可辨变化。
description.en: Confirm the file parameter includes local files and infer Apache/Nginx log paths from errors and length changes. Success: log inclusion alters the response.

title.zh: 植入带标记的请求日志

description.zh: 以携带唯一标记的 User-Agent 或 URI 访问目标，让 Web 服务器把标记写入访问日志。命中判据：后续包含日志时能检索到该标记行。
description.en: Hit the target with a unique marker in User-Agent or URI so it lands in the access log. Success: the marker is retrievable from the log later.

title.en: Include the log and grep the marker

description.zh: 提交日志路径的包含请求并检索标记，确认越界读取原语可用。命中判据：输出包含标记行，证明日志内容被完整读出。
description.en: Include the access log path and grep for the marker to confirm the read primitive. Success: the marker line appears in output.

description.zh: 把标记换成 PHP 代码重新写入日志并再次包含，配合 cmd 参数执行命令。命中判据：命令输出返回到响应中。
description.en: Replace the marker with PHP code, re-log and re-include with a cmd parameter. Success: command output lands in the response.

prerequisites.zh: 工作目录中存在随机只读 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具，并记录其规范路径与清理责任。
prerequisites.en: A random read-only PAYLOADER_MARKER fixture exists in the working directory with its canonical path and cleanup owner recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 本地服务只监听 127.0.0.1，并可查看 URL 解码、最终路径、stream wrapper 和 include 结果日志。
prerequisites.en: The local service listens only on 127.0.0.1 and exposes URL-decoding, final-path, stream-wrapper, and include-result logs.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是同一请求 ID 的 User-Agent marker 出现在受控日志并由读取入口原样返回，PHP 代码从未提交或执行。单独的 HTTP 200、PHP warning、空响应、WAF 告警或一次超时都不足以证明文件包含。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the User-Agent marker for the same request ID appears in the controlled log and is returned verbatim, with no PHP code submitted or executed. HTTP 200 alone, a PHP warning, an empty response, a WAF alert, or a single timeout does not prove file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用工作目录 marker、localhost 与一次性请求 ID，禁止真实系统、凭据、环境和其他进程路径。
opsecTips.en: Use only working-directory markers, localhost, and one-time request IDs; prohibit real system, credential, environment, and other-process paths.

opsecTips.zh: 不提交可执行 PHP、WebShell、反向通道或序列化对象；每个请求设置三秒超时并在结束后清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit executable PHP, web shells, reverse channels, or serialized objects; cap each request at three seconds and clean fixtures afterward.

description.zh: 绕过相对路径拼接逻辑与 ../ 特征：直接绝对路径读日志；日志 marker 内容返回即成功。
description.en: Read via an absolute path to skip relative concatenation and ../ signatures; returned log marker content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 ../ 与 var/log 组合特征的过滤：编码分隔符并上跳两级；日志内容回显即成功。
description.en: Encode separators and ascend two levels past combined ../ and var/log filtering; echoed log content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过基于 /var 起始路径的黑名单：借 /proc/self/root 前缀等价到达；日志 marker 读取成功即成功。
description.en: Reach the same file through the /proc/self/root alias against path-prefix blacklists; a successful marker read confirms success.

name.zh: LFI 路径遍历 Marker 读取边界

description.zh: LFI 路径遍历 Marker 读取边界验证相对段经过 URL 解码与路径规范化后是否越过批准根目录并读取相邻 marker 夹具。它只保留一个 include/read 输入，并以 PAYLOADER_MARKER、请求 ID 和最终解析记录作为证据。
description.en: LFI Path-Traversal Marker Read Boundary validates whether relative segments cross the approved root after URL decoding and canonicalization and read an adjacent marker fixture. It retains one include or read input and uses PAYLOADER_MARKER, request ID, and final resolution records as evidence.

overview.zh: LFI 路径遍历 Marker 读取边界针对 ../ 相对段穿越批准根目录的文件读取场景。验证相对段经 URL 解码与路径规范化后的最终落点，使用相邻目录的 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具与请求 ID 作为可重复证据。
overview.en: The LFI path-traversal marker read boundary targets file reads where ../ segments escape the approved root. It verifies where relative segments land after URL decoding and path normalization, using a PAYLOADER_MARKER fixture in an adjacent directory and request IDs as repeatable evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用在最终解码与规范化之前做安全判断，../ 相对段随后由路径解析折叠，使读取目标越过批准根目录进入相邻目录。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the safety decision precedes final decoding and normalization, so ../ segments are later collapsed by path resolution and the read target escapes the approved root into adjacent directories.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步向包含/读取入口提交 ?file=../payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt；命中判据为响应体为 PAYLOADER_MARKER 文本，说明 ../ 遍历解析到夹具目录。结合 wrapper 或最终路径日志确认规范化行为，并在同一入口递增遍历深度与编码变体，逐条记录请求 ID 形成证据链。
exploitation.en: Submit ?file=../payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt to the inclusion/read endpoint as in step 1; a hit is the response body being the PAYLOADER_MARKER text, showing the traversal resolved into the fixture directory. Confirm normalization behavior via wrapper or final-path logs, then increase traversal depth and encoding variants on the same endpoint, recording request IDs to build the evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定资源 ID 到文件的服务端映射，拒绝用户路径；必须读取时只解码一次，在最终规范路径上验证根目录并以低权限只读打开。修复后重放第 1 步遍历请求，确认返回拒绝且合法对象读取保持可用。
mitigation.en: Map fixed resource IDs to files server-side and reject user paths; when reading is required, decode once, validate the root on the final canonical path, and open read-only with low privilege. After the fix, replay the step-1 traversal and confirm rejection while legitimate object reads keep working.

description.zh: 用正常路径请求摸清包含接口的参数与响应形态，从报错信息中提取路径线索。命中判据：存在与不存在文件返回可区分的响应。
description.en: Probe the include endpoint with normal paths and mine errors for path hints. Success: existing vs missing files give distinct responses.

title.zh: 提交遍历载荷读取标记文件

description.zh: 用 ../ 相对路径提交到包含参数，读取上级目录的标记文件。命中判据：响应体为标记文本，说明目录约束被穿越。
description.en: Submit a ../ relative path to include a marker file one level up. Success: marker text in the body proves the boundary was crossed.

title.zh: 扩展遍历读取任意文件

description.zh: 按第 2 步模式叠加 ../ 或改用绝对路径，尝试读取 /etc/passwd 与应用配置。命中判据：敏感文件内容返回到响应。
description.en: Stack ../ or switch to absolute paths following step 2 to read /etc/passwd and configs. Success: sensitive content is returned.

title.en: Read sources via a stream wrapper

description.zh: 改用 php://filter 等包装器读取 PHP 源码，挖掘密钥与包含逻辑为升级做准备。命中判据：返回内容可解码为完整源码。
description.en: Switch to php://filter style wrappers to read PHP sources for secrets. Success: returned payload decodes to full source.

prerequisites.zh: 工作目录中存在随机只读 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具，并记录其规范路径与清理责任。
prerequisites.en: A random read-only PAYLOADER_MARKER fixture exists in the working directory with its canonical path and cleanup owner recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 本地服务只监听 127.0.0.1，并可查看 URL 解码、最终路径、stream wrapper 和 include 结果日志。
prerequisites.en: The local service listens only on 127.0.0.1 and exposes URL-decoding, final-path, stream-wrapper, and include-result logs.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是异常路径读取相邻 marker，正常根内基线成功、缺失 marker 对照失败，最终规范路径完整记录。单独的 HTTP 200、PHP warning、空响应、WAF 告警或一次超时都不足以证明文件包含。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the variant reads the adjacent marker, the normal in-root baseline succeeds, the missing-marker control fails, and the final canonical path is recorded. HTTP 200 alone, a PHP warning, an empty response, a WAF alert, or a single timeout does not prove file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用工作目录 marker、localhost 与一次性请求 ID，禁止真实系统、凭据、环境和其他进程路径。
opsecTips.en: Use only working-directory markers, localhost, and one-time request IDs; prohibit real system, credential, environment, and other-process paths.

opsecTips.zh: 不提交可执行 PHP、WebShell、反向通道或序列化对象；每个请求设置三秒超时并在结束后清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit executable PHP, web shells, reverse channels, or serialized objects; cap each request at three seconds and clean fixtures afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对 ../ 连续特征过滤：编码部分分隔符混合明文；marker 文件内容返回即成功。
description.en: Mix encoded separators with plaintext against contiguous ../ filtering; returned marker content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过 Tomcat 类中间件对 ; 的规范化差异：路径段附加分号仍解析到目标；文件读取成功即成功。
description.en: Append semicolons to segments exploiting middleware normalization; a successful file read confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对字面 .. 的删除过滤：单点编码后组合仍构成父目录引用；读取成功即成功。
description.en: Encode single dots so the pair survives literal-dot removal while still referencing the parent; a successful read confirms success.

name.zh: php://filter 源码读取边界

description.zh: php://filter 源码读取边界验证php://filter 是否对受控 PHP marker 文件应用读取过滤器并返回转换后的内容，而不是执行源文件。它只保留一个 include/read 输入，并以 PAYLOADER_MARKER、请求 ID 和最终解析记录作为证据。
description.en: php://filter Source Read Boundary validates whether php://filter applies a read filter to a controlled PHP marker file and returns transformed content instead of executing the source. It retains one include or read input and uses PAYLOADER_MARKER, request ID, and final resolution records as evidence.

subCategory.zh: PHP 流包装器与远程包含

overview.zh: php://filter 源码读取边界针对包含/读取入口接受 PHP 流包装器的场景：convert.base64-encode 过滤器可把目标文件以编码形式返回。验证使用受控 PAYLOADER_MARKER.php 夹具，以 Base64 解码比对作为证据。
overview.en: The php://filter source-read boundary targets inclusion/read endpoints that accept PHP stream wrappers: the convert.base64-encode filter returns the target file in encoded form. It validates against a controlled PAYLOADER_MARKER.php fixture with Base64 decode comparison as evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入直接进入支持 wrapper 的文件 API 且未限制 scheme，php://filter 在读取前对目标资源应用转换，使本应被解释器执行的源码以数据形式返回给调用方。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user input entering a wrapper-capable file API without scheme restrictions; php://filter applies a transform to the target resource before reading, returning source code that should only be executed by the interpreter as data to the caller.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步向包含/读取入口提交 ?file=php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=./payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.php；命中判据为响应是 Base64 串且解码后等于 marker.php 源码，证明过滤器被应用且目标被读取而非执行。确认后可在授权范围内用同一语法读取其他受控夹具，逐条记录 wrapper 日志与请求 ID。
exploitation.en: Submit ?file=php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=./payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.php to the endpoint as in step 1; a hit is a Base64 response that decodes to the marker.php source, proving the filter applied and the target was read rather than executed. Then read other controlled fixtures with the same syntax within scope, logging wrapper activity and request IDs.

mitigation.zh: 禁止用户输入进入 include/require，读取接口只接受服务端对象 ID 并拒绝非 file scheme；必须读取时在固定根目录内解析规范路径。修复后重放第 1 步 filter URI，确认被拒绝且合法读取不受影响。
mitigation.en: Keep user input out of include/require, accept only server-side object IDs in read endpoints, and reject non-file schemes; when reading is required, resolve canonical paths within a fixed root. After the fix, replay the step-1 filter URI and confirm rejection while legitimate reads are unaffected.

title.zh: 定位包含点与运行时形态
title.en: Locate the include point and runtime

description.zh: 提交正常文件请求判断包含接口可用，并从响应特征判断目标为 PHP 运行时环境。命中判据：参数变化能直接改变包含结果。
description.en: Confirm the include works with a normal file and fingerprint a PHP runtime. Success: parameter changes alter included content.

title.en: Read source through the filter chain

description.zh: 以 convert.base64-encode 过滤器包裹目标路径提交包含请求，源码被编码返回。命中判据：Base64 解码后为完整 PHP 源码。
description.en: Wrap the target path with convert.base64-encode and include it. Success: the Base64 body decodes to full PHP source.

description.zh: 解码第 2 步返回的内容，查找数据库账号、密钥与上传处理逻辑。命中判据：获得可直接复用的凭据或密钥。
description.en: Decode step 2 output and hunt for DB accounts, keys and upload logic. Success: a reusable credential or key is found.

title.en: Escalate the chain to code execution

description.zh: 把读取原语升级为 iconv 与 base64 组合的长链，尝试不落地文件直接执行代码。命中判据：组合链返回预期的执行输出。
description.en: Escalate to long iconv+base64 chains for fileless code execution. Success: the chained payload yields execution output.

prerequisites.zh: 工作目录中存在随机只读 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具，并记录其规范路径与清理责任。
prerequisites.en: A random read-only PAYLOADER_MARKER fixture exists in the working directory with its canonical path and cleanup owner recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 本地服务只监听 127.0.0.1，并可查看 URL 解码、最终路径、stream wrapper 和 include 结果日志。
prerequisites.en: The local service listens only on 127.0.0.1 and exposes URL-decoding, final-path, stream-wrapper, and include-result logs.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是Base64 输出可解码为唯一 marker 源文本，且日志确认 resource 位于批准工作目录。单独的 HTTP 200、PHP warning、空响应、WAF 告警或一次超时都不足以证明文件包含。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the Base64 output decodes to the unique marker source text and logs confirm the resource is inside the approved working directory. HTTP 200 alone, a PHP warning, an empty response, a WAF alert, or a single timeout does not prove file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用工作目录 marker、localhost 与一次性请求 ID，禁止真实系统、凭据、环境和其他进程路径。
opsecTips.en: Use only working-directory markers, localhost, and one-time request IDs; prohibit real system, credential, environment, and other-process paths.

opsecTips.zh: 不提交可执行 PHP、WebShell、反向通道或序列化对象；每个请求设置三秒超时并在结束后清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit executable PHP, web shells, reverse channels, or serialized objects; cap each request at three seconds and clean fixtures afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对单一 base64 过滤器特征的检测：先 ROT13 再 Base64 双层转换；Base64 解码并反转后得到源码即成功。
description.en: Stack ROT13 before base64 against single-filter signatures; decoding and reversing the output yields the source, confirming success.

description.zh: 绕过对 convert.base64 关键字的规则：改用字符集转换过滤器读源码；按 UTF-16 解码输出即成功。
description.en: Read through a charset-conversion filter instead of base64 to evade the keyword rule; decoding the UTF-16 output confirms success.

title.zh: 过滤器名大小写与编码

description.zh: 绕过对 php://filter 小写全字匹配：包装器大写化并编码资源路径；Base64 回显可解即成功。
description.en: Uppercase the wrapper and encode the resource path against lowercase matching; a decodable base64 echo confirms success.

name.zh: php://input 请求体读取边界

description.zh: php://input 请求体读取边界验证php://input 是否以只读方式向目标 API 提供非 multipart 原始请求体。它只保留一个 include/read 输入，并以 PAYLOADER_MARKER、请求 ID 和最终解析记录作为证据。
description.en: php://input Request-Body Read Boundary validates whether php://input exposes a non-multipart raw request body to the target API in read-only form. It retains one include or read input and uses PAYLOADER_MARKER, request ID, and final resolution records as evidence.

subCategory.zh: PHP 流包装器与远程包含

overview.zh: php://input 请求体读取边界针对包含入口接受 PHP 运行时流的场景：php://input 以只读方式提供非 multipart 原始请求体。验证请求体中的受控 marker 能否经流被目标 API 读回，以回显内容与请求 ID 作为证据。
overview.en: The php://input request-body read boundary targets inclusion endpoints that accept PHP runtime streams: php://input exposes the non-multipart raw body read-only. It verifies whether a controlled marker in the body can be read back through the stream, using the echoed content and request ID as evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户控制的文件参数进入支持运行时流的读取或包含 API 且未限制 scheme；php://input 把原始请求体暴露为流，若进入 include 语义则请求体内容可被解释为代码。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a user-controlled file parameter entering a read/inclusion API that supports runtime streams without scheme restrictions; php://input exposes the raw body as a stream, and under include semantics the body can be interpreted as code.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步以 text/plain 请求头向 /include?file=php://input 发送 --data-binary 携带 PAYLOADER_MARKER 的请求体；命中判据为响应体回显请求体中的 marker，证明 php://input 流被目标 API 读取。确认读取成立后，再判断同一入口是否为 include 语义：若请求体中的 PHP 代码被执行则升级为代码执行并单独取证。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, send a --data-binary body carrying PAYLOADER_MARKER with Content-Type: text/plain to /include?file=php://input; a hit is the response echoing the body marker, proving the php://input stream reached the target API. After confirming the read, determine whether the endpoint has include semantics: if PHP code in the body executes, escalate to code execution with separate evidence.

mitigation.zh: 不要让用户选择运行时流 wrapper：读取接口只接受服务端对象 ID，禁止动态 include 并关闭 allow_url_include；请求体只作为数据解析。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认 php://input 被拒绝且正常接口不受影响。
mitigation.en: Never let users choose runtime stream wrappers: read endpoints accept only server-side object IDs, dynamic include is forbidden, and allow_url_include stays off; parse the body as data only. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm php://input is rejected while normal endpoints are unaffected.

title.zh: 探测包含点与协议支持
title.en: Probe include point and protocol support

description.zh: 确认 file 参数可控后测试 php://input 是否被接受，推断 allow_url_include 类配置的状态。命中判据：包含请求未被直接拒绝。
description.en: With a controllable file parameter test php://input acceptance to infer allow_url_include. Success: the include is not rejected outright.

description.zh: 以 text/plain 请求体携带标记内容提交 php://input 包含请求，请求体被当作包含目标读取。命中判据：响应回显请求体中的标记。
description.en: POST a marker body with text/plain and include php://input. Success: the response echoes the marker from the request body.

title.en: Swap the body for command execution

description.zh: 把第 2 步的请求体换成系统命令代码再次包含，让内联代码被执行。命中判据：whoami 等命令输出返回响应。
description.en: Replace the step 2 body with command-executing code and re-include. Success: whoami output is returned.

description.zh: 命令无回显时改用 DNS 或 HTTP 外带结果，并把代码写入可包含路径维持访问。命中判据：接收端持续收到数据。
description.en: For blind cases exfiltrate over DNS/HTTP and drop code into an includable path. Success: the collector keeps receiving data.

prerequisites.zh: 工作目录中存在随机只读 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具，并记录其规范路径与清理责任。
prerequisites.en: A random read-only PAYLOADER_MARKER fixture exists in the working directory with its canonical path and cleanup owner recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 本地服务只监听 127.0.0.1，并可查看 URL 解码、最终路径、stream wrapper 和 include 结果日志。
prerequisites.en: The local service listens only on 127.0.0.1 and exposes URL-decoding, final-path, stream-wrapper, and include-result logs.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是服务端仅返回精确请求体 marker，Content-Type 与请求字节日志一致，且没有执行或写文件事件。单独的 HTTP 200、PHP warning、空响应、WAF 告警或一次超时都不足以证明文件包含。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the server returns only the exact body marker, Content-Type agrees with raw request logs, and no execution or file-write event occurs. HTTP 200 alone, a PHP warning, an empty response, a WAF alert, or a single timeout does not prove file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用工作目录 marker、localhost 与一次性请求 ID，禁止真实系统、凭据、环境和其他进程路径。
opsecTips.en: Use only working-directory markers, localhost, and one-time request IDs; prohibit real system, credential, environment, and other-process paths.

opsecTips.zh: 不提交可执行 PHP、WebShell、反向通道或序列化对象；每个请求设置三秒超时并在结束后清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit executable PHP, web shells, reverse channels, or serialized objects; cap each request at three seconds and clean fixtures afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对 text/plain 请求体形态的检测：以 multipart 携带数据仍可被 php://input 读取；包含行为生效即成功。
description.en: Carry the data as multipart, still readable via php://input, past plain-body detection; an effective inclusion confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 php://input 直接引用的规则：外面再包一层过滤器包装器；输出内容被转换处理即成功。
description.en: Wrap php://input inside an outer filter wrapper against direct-reference rules; the content being transformed confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对全小写包装器名匹配：大写混合仍被流层识别；请求体内容进入包含流程即成功。
description.en: Mixed-case the wrapper name, still recognized by the stream layer; request-body content entering inclusion confirms success.

name.zh: data:// Marker 数据流读取边界

description.zh: data:// Marker 数据流读取边界验证data:// 只读流是否在明确的 allow_url_fopen 与 allow_url_include 配置下进入目标读取或 include API。它只保留一个 include/read 输入，并以 PAYLOADER_MARKER、请求 ID 和最终解析记录作为证据。
description.en: data:// Marker Stream Read Boundary validates whether the read-only data:// stream reaches the target read or include API under explicit allow_url_fopen and allow_url_include settings. It retains one include or read input and uses PAYLOADER_MARKER, request ID, and final resolution records as evidence.

subCategory.zh: PHP 流包装器与远程包含

overview.zh: data:// Marker 数据流读取边界针对读取/包含入口接受内联数据流的场景：data:// 把 URI 中的数据暴露为流内容。验证在明确的 allow_url_fopen/allow_url_include 配置下 data:// 能否进入目标 API，以 marker 回显为证据。
overview.en: The data:// marker stream read boundary targets read/inclusion endpoints that accept inline data streams: data:// exposes URI-embedded data as stream content. It verifies whether data:// reaches the target API under explicit allow_url_fopen/allow_url_include configuration, using marker echo as evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入控制流 URI 且未限制 scheme，data:// 内联数据在读取 API 中作为内容返回；若进入 include 且 URL include 开启，内联 PHP 代码会被解释执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user-controlled stream URIs without scheme restrictions; data:// inline data is returned as content by read APIs, and under include semantics with URL include enabled, inline PHP code is interpreted and executed.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步向入口提交 ?file=data://text/plain,PAYLOADER_MARKER；命中判据为响应包含 data:// 流中的 marker 文本，证明内联数据流进入目标 API。确认读取后，核对 allow_url_fopen/allow_url_include 配置与最终函数是读取还是 include；若为 include 且内联代码被执行，按代码执行单独取证并记录配置。
exploitation.en: Submit ?file=data://text/plain,PAYLOADER_MARKER as in step 1; a hit is the marker text from the data:// stream appearing in the response, proving the inline stream reached the target API. After confirming the read, check allow_url_fopen/allow_url_include and whether the final function reads or includes; if it includes and inline code executes, document it separately as code execution with the configuration.

mitigation.zh: 文件入口只接受服务端对象 ID 并限制为 file scheme，关闭不需要的 allow_url_include；数据流只交给解析 API 而非 PHP 编译器。修复后重放第 1 步 data:// URI，确认被拒绝且正常读取不受影响。
mitigation.en: File endpoints accept only server-side object IDs restricted to the file scheme, keep unneeded allow_url_include off, and hand data streams only to parsing APIs, never the PHP compiler. After the fix, replay the step-1 data:// URI and confirm rejection while normal reads are unaffected.

description.zh: 用正常文件请求确认包含行为与响应形态，记录可用的参数名与错误线索。命中判据：不同路径返回可区分的内容。
description.en: Confirm include behavior with normal files and note parameter names. Success: different paths yield distinguishable content.

title.zh: 提交 data 流探测支持

description.zh: 向包含参数提交 data:// 纯文本流，测试内联数据能否直接作为包含目标。命中判据：响应包含流中写入的文本。
description.en: Submit a data://text/plain stream to see if inline data is includable. Success: the stream text appears in the response.

description.zh: 把第 2 步的流内容换成 PHP 代码或其 Base64 形式再次包含，实现无文件执行。命中判据：返回命令输出。
description.en: Swap the step 2 stream for PHP code or its Base64 form. Success: command output is returned without a file.

description.zh: 把可执行代码写入可包含的路径并周期性触发包含请求，形成稳定的控制点。命中判据：多次触发均返回一致的执行输出，通道持续可用。
description.en: Drop executable code into an includable path and trigger it periodically. Success: repeated triggers keep returning output.

prerequisites.zh: 工作目录中存在随机只读 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具，并记录其规范路径与清理责任。
prerequisites.en: A random read-only PAYLOADER_MARKER fixture exists in the working directory with its canonical path and cleanup owner recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 本地服务只监听 127.0.0.1，并可查看 URL 解码、最终路径、stream wrapper 和 include 结果日志。
prerequisites.en: The local service listens only on 127.0.0.1 and exposes URL-decoding, final-path, stream-wrapper, and include-result logs.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是纯文本 PAYLOADER_MARKER 被原样返回，配置快照与选中的 data wrapper 日志同时匹配。单独的 HTTP 200、PHP warning、空响应、WAF 告警或一次超时都不足以证明文件包含。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that plain PAYLOADER_MARKER is returned verbatim and both the configuration snapshot and selected data wrapper log match. HTTP 200 alone, a PHP warning, an empty response, a WAF alert, or a single timeout does not prove file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用工作目录 marker、localhost 与一次性请求 ID，禁止真实系统、凭据、环境和其他进程路径。
opsecTips.en: Use only working-directory markers, localhost, and one-time request IDs; prohibit real system, credential, environment, and other-process paths.

opsecTips.zh: 不提交可执行 PHP、WebShell、反向通道或序列化对象；每个请求设置三秒超时并在结束后清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit executable PHP, web shells, reverse channels, or serialized objects; cap each request at three seconds and clean fixtures afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对明文 marker 内容的检测：数据整体 Base64 编码后由包装器解码；输出 marker 即成功。
description.en: Base64-encode the data so the wrapper decodes it past plaintext detection; the marker being output confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 data://text/plain 完整前缀匹配：斜杠编码后解析等价；marker 回显即成功。
description.en: Encode the slash inside the MIME type so the prefix evades exact matching; an echoed marker confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过基于逗号首参位置的规则：插入 charset 参数改变结构；内容仍被解析输出即成功。
description.en: Insert a charset parameter to shift the payload position past first-argument rules; the content still being output confirms success.

name.zh: zip:// 归档成员读取边界

description.zh: zip:// 归档成员读取边界验证zip://archive.zip#member 是否只读取受控 ZIP 的单个 marker 成员。它只保留一个 include/read 输入，并以 PAYLOADER_MARKER、请求 ID 和最终解析记录作为证据。
description.en: zip:// Archive Member Read Boundary validates whether zip://archive.zip#member reads only one marker member from a controlled ZIP archive. It retains one include or read input and uses PAYLOADER_MARKER, request ID, and final resolution records as evidence.

overview.zh: zip:// 归档成员读取边界针对文件入口把上传归档按成员解析的场景：zip://archive#member 可直接读取 ZIP 内部文件。验证受控归档单个成员能否被读取，以成员内容回显与解析日志为证据。
overview.en: The zip:// archive-member read boundary targets file endpoints that resolve uploaded archives member-wise: zip://archive#member reads files inside a ZIP directly. It validates whether a single member of a controlled archive is readable, using member-content echo and parse logs as evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户可控制 zip URI 与成员名并进入支持归档 wrapper 的文件 API，外层扩展名校验不约束归档内部结构，归档成员因此绕过文件类型边界被直接访问。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user control of the zip URI and member name into an archive-wrapper-capable file API; outer-extension validation does not constrain archive internals, so members bypass the file-type boundary and are accessed directly.

exploitation.zh: 先准备含 marker.txt 的受控 ZIP 夹具，再按第 1 步提交 ?file=zip://./payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.zip%23marker.txt（%23 即井号成员分隔符）；命中判据为响应输出归档内 marker.txt 的内容。确认后逐一更换成员名与容器扩展名验证解析行为，逐条记录 wrapper 日志与请求 ID。
exploitation.en: Prepare a controlled ZIP fixture containing marker.txt, then submit ?file=zip://./payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.zip%23marker.txt as in step 1 (%23 is the hash member separator); a hit is marker.txt content from the archive in the response. Then vary member names and container extensions to map resolution behavior, logging wrapper activity and request IDs.

mitigation.zh: 上传对象使用随机服务端名称存储于 Web 根外，读取接口只接受对象 ID 并拒绝 zip:// 等 wrapper URI；校验真实文件类型而非外层扩展名。修复后重放第 1 步 zip URI，确认被拒绝且归档业务不受影响。
mitigation.en: Store uploads under random server-side names outside the web root, accept only object IDs in read endpoints, and reject wrapper URIs such as zip://; validate real file type rather than the outer extension. After the fix, replay the step-1 zip URI and confirm rejection while archive business flows are unaffected.

title.zh: 打包并上传 zip 归档
title.en: Pack and upload a zip archive

description.zh: 将待执行的代码或数据打包为 zip 归档，上传到服务器可访问目录。命中判据：上传成功且归档路径可预测。
description.en: Pack code or data into a zip and upload it to a reachable directory. Success: upload succeeds and the path is predictable.

title.zh: 用 zip 包装器读取成员

description.zh: 以 zip:// 加 %23 编码的井号定位归档内成员提交包含请求。命中判据：响应输出归档内成员文件的内容。
description.en: Include zip:// with a %23-encoded hash to target an archive member. Success: the member content is output.

title.zh: 切换成员读取敏感数据

description.zh: 沿第 2 步的引用格式更换归档与成员名，读取归档内的配置文件与凭据内容。命中判据：目标成员内容成功返回到响应中。
description.en: Following the step 2 reference format, swap archive/member names to read configs. Success: the target content returns.

description.zh: 把归档成员换成 PHP 文件后再次包含执行，配合 cmd 参数运行系统命令。命中判据：命令输出返回到响应页面中。
description.en: Place a PHP member in the archive, include it and drive it with parameters. Success: command output is returned.

prerequisites.zh: 工作目录中存在随机只读 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具，并记录其规范路径与清理责任。
prerequisites.en: A random read-only PAYLOADER_MARKER fixture exists in the working directory with its canonical path and cleanup owner recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 本地服务只监听 127.0.0.1，并可查看 URL 解码、最终路径、stream wrapper 和 include 结果日志。
prerequisites.en: The local service listens only on 127.0.0.1 and exposes URL-decoding, final-path, stream-wrapper, and include-result logs.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是归档清单只含 marker.txt，读取结果精确匹配 PAYLOADER_MARKER，最终成员路径与任务 ID 一致。单独的 HTTP 200、PHP warning、空响应、WAF 告警或一次超时都不足以证明文件包含。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the archive inventory contains only marker.txt, the read result exactly matches PAYLOADER_MARKER, and the final member path agrees with the job ID. HTTP 200 alone, a PHP warning, an empty response, a WAF alert, or a single timeout does not prove file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用工作目录 marker、localhost 与一次性请求 ID，禁止真实系统、凭据、环境和其他进程路径。
opsecTips.en: Use only working-directory markers, localhost, and one-time request IDs; prohibit real system, credential, environment, and other-process paths.

opsecTips.zh: 不提交可执行 PHP、WebShell、反向通道或序列化对象；每个请求设置三秒超时并在结束后清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit executable PHP, web shells, reverse channels, or serialized objects; cap each request at three seconds and clean fixtures afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对 %23 单层还原后仍拦截 # 的规则：二次编码在应用层才还原为成员分隔符；归档成员内容返回即成功。
description.en: Double-encode the member separator so it restores only at the application layer; returned archive member content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 zip://./ 固定相对前缀的匹配：遍历形式定位同一归档；成员读取成功即成功。
description.en: Locate the same archive via traversal against the fixed relative prefix; a successful member read confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对全小写 zip:// 匹配：大写包装器名仍被流层注册；成员内容回显即成功。
description.en: Uppercase the wrapper, still registered by the stream layer; echoed member content confirms success.

name.zh: PHAR 归档成员读取边界

description.zh: PHAR 归档成员读取边界验证phar:// 是否只读取受控归档成员，而不访问 metadata 或触发对象反序列化。它只保留一个 include/read 输入，并以 PAYLOADER_MARKER、请求 ID 和最终解析记录作为证据。
description.en: PHAR Archive Member Read Boundary validates whether phar:// reads only a controlled archive member without accessing metadata or triggering object deserialization. It retains one include or read input and uses PAYLOADER_MARKER, request ID, and final resolution records as evidence.

overview.zh: PHAR 归档成员读取边界针对文件入口按 PHAR 归档解析上传对象的场景：phar://archive/member 可访问归档内部成员。验证只读取受控成员且不触发 metadata 反序列化，以成员文本与调用栈为证据。
overview.en: The PHAR archive-member read boundary targets file endpoints that parse uploads as PHAR archives: phar://archive/member accesses internal members. It validates reading a controlled member only, without triggering metadata deserialization, using member text and call stacks as evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户可控 phar URI 进入文件 API 且未限制 scheme，PHP 按 PHAR 归档打开目标；历史版本与特定调用还会处理序列化 metadata，可能升级为对象反序列化。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a user-controlled phar URI entering file APIs without scheme restrictions, so PHP opens the target as a PHAR archive; older versions and certain calls also process serialized metadata, potentially escalating to object deserialization.

exploitation.zh: 先构造只含文本成员、无反序列化 metadata 的受控 PHAR 夹具，再按第 1 步提交 ?file=phar://./payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.phar/marker.txt；命中判据为响应输出归档内 marker.txt 内容。确认成员读取后，单独核对目标文件函数与 PHP 版本是否具备 metadata 处理行为，避免把成员读取误报为反序列化。
exploitation.en: Build a controlled PHAR fixture containing only a text member and no deserialization metadata, then submit ?file=phar://./payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.phar/marker.txt as in step 1; a hit is marker.txt content from the archive in the response. After confirming member read, separately check whether the target file function and PHP version perform metadata handling, so member reads are not misreported as deserialization.

mitigation.zh: 拒绝外部输入中的 phar:// 等非 file scheme，上传对象随机命名并存于 Web 根外；不对不可信归档触发元数据解析，升级 PHP 并限制服务账户文件权限。修复后重放第 1 步 phar URI，确认被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Reject non-file schemes such as phar:// in external input, store uploads under random names outside the web root; never trigger metadata parsing on untrusted archives, upgrade PHP, and limit service-account file permissions. After the fix, replay the step-1 phar URI and confirm rejection.

title.zh: 构造并上传 phar 归档

description.zh: 生成包含目标成员与恶意元数据的 phar 文件，并上传到服务器可访问的目录。命中判据：文件成功落盘且存储路径可以定位。
description.en: Generate a phar with the target member and hostile metadata, then upload. Success: the file lands at a locatable path.

title.zh: 用 phar 包装器读取成员

description.zh: 提交 phar:// 形式的路径包含归档成员，观察读取结果。命中判据：响应输出归档内成员文件的完整内容。
description.en: Include a phar:// path to read the archive member. Success: member content is output.

description.zh: 文件操作函数解析 phar:// 时自动反序列化元数据，激活内嵌的对象载荷。命中判据：出现目标类实例化或调用迹象。
description.en: File operations on phar:// auto-unserialize metadata, arming embedded objects. Success: signs of the target class instantiating.

title.zh: 串联 POP 链执行命令
title.en: Chain a POP gadget to RCE

description.zh: 把元数据指向 __destruct 触发的命令执行链，完成从读取到 RCE 的升级。命中判据：命令输出或外带数据返回。
description.en: Point metadata at a __destruct gadget chain to reach RCE. Success: command output or exfil data returns.

prerequisites.zh: 工作目录中存在随机只读 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具，并记录其规范路径与清理责任。
prerequisites.en: A random read-only PAYLOADER_MARKER fixture exists in the working directory with its canonical path and cleanup owner recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 本地服务只监听 127.0.0.1，并可查看 URL 解码、最终路径、stream wrapper 和 include 结果日志。
prerequisites.en: The local service listens only on 127.0.0.1 and exposes URL-decoding, final-path, stream-wrapper, and include-result logs.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是marker.txt 内容被精确返回，归档清单与读取日志一致，且没有 Phar::getMetadata 或对象实例化记录。单独的 HTTP 200、PHP warning、空响应、WAF 告警或一次超时都不足以证明文件包含。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that marker.txt is returned exactly, archive inventory agrees with read logs, and no Phar::getMetadata call or object instantiation is observed. HTTP 200 alone, a PHP warning, an empty response, a WAF alert, or a single timeout does not prove file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用工作目录 marker、localhost 与一次性请求 ID，禁止真实系统、凭据、环境和其他进程路径。
opsecTips.en: Use only working-directory markers, localhost, and one-time request IDs; prohibit real system, credential, environment, and other-process paths.

opsecTips.zh: 不提交可执行 PHP、WebShell、反向通道或序列化对象；每个请求设置三秒超时并在结束后清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit executable PHP, web shells, reverse channels, or serialized objects; cap each request at three seconds and clean fixtures afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对 phar://./ 明文特征的扫描：路径段编码后等价解析；归档成员内容返回即成功。
description.en: Encode path segments so the plaintext prefix evades scanning while parsing equivalently; returned member content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过固定相对前缀匹配：以遍历形式访问同一归档；成员读取成功即成功。
description.en: Access the same archive through traversal past fixed-prefix matching; a successful member read confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对成员名 marker.txt 直尾匹配：成员路径加子目录回跳；仍解析到目标成员即成功。
description.en: Insert a subdirectory hop into the member path against direct-suffix matching; still resolving the target member confirms success.

name.zh: PHP Session Marker 文件读取边界
name.en: PHP Session Marker File Read Boundary

description.zh: PHP Session Marker 文件读取边界验证文件型 Session 的受控 marker 是否能从明确的 session.save_path 被读取，而不注入 PHP 或竞争 Session 锁。它只保留一个 include/read 输入，并以 PAYLOADER_MARKER、请求 ID 和最终解析记录作为证据。
description.en: PHP Session Marker File Read Boundary validates whether a controlled marker in a file-backed session can be read from an explicit session.save_path without injecting PHP or racing the session lock. It retains one include or read input and uses PAYLOADER_MARKER, request ID, and final resolution records as evidence.

overview.zh: PHP Session Marker 文件读取边界针对文件型会话存储可被包含入口读取的场景：session.save_path 下的 sess_ 文件可按已知 ID 读回。验证受控 marker 会话文件能否被读取而不注入 PHP、不竞争会话锁。
overview.en: The PHP session marker file-read boundary targets file-based session storage reachable through inclusion endpoints: sess_ files under session.save_path can be read back by known ID. It validates reading a controlled marker session file without injecting PHP or racing session locks.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是文件型 Session 把会话数据落盘为可预测路径，包含/读取入口缺少根目录与 scheme 约束时，会话文件可被当作普通文件读回，泄露会话内容。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is file-based sessions persisting data at predictable paths; when inclusion/read endpoints lack root-directory and scheme constraints, session files can be read back as ordinary files, leaking session contents.

exploitation.zh: 先用受控 marker 值建立测试会话并确定其 sess_ 文件名，再按第 1 步提交 ?file=./payloader-fixture/sessions/sess_PAYLOADERMARKER；命中判据为响应包含该会话文件中的 PAYLOADER_MARKER 内容。确认后记录 session.save_path 与最终解析路径；不要注入 PHP 代码或竞争会话锁，保持只读取证。
exploitation.en: First establish a test session with a controlled marker value and determine its sess_ filename, then submit ?file=./payloader-fixture/sessions/sess_PAYLOADERMARKER as in step 1; a hit is the PAYLOADER_MARKER content of that session file in the response. Record session.save_path and the final resolved path; do not inject PHP or race session locks—keep evidence read-only.

mitigation.zh: 会话 ID 使用密码学随机并做字符集白名单，存储改用数据库键或哈希文件名；包含入口拒绝用户路径并验证最终规范路径在根目录内。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认会话文件不可读取且登录流程正常。
mitigation.en: Use cryptographically random session IDs with a character-set allowlist, and store sessions under database keys or hashed filenames; inclusion endpoints reject user paths and verify the final canonical path stays in the root. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm session files are unreadable while login flows work.

title.zh: 获取会话并写入可控内容

description.zh: 登录或访问目标取得 PHPSESSID，把可控字符串写入某个会话字段。命中判据：会话中存在攻击者可控的值。
description.en: Obtain a PHPSESSID and write a controllable string into a session field. Success: an attacker-controlled value persists in session.

title.zh: 包含会话文件读取内容

description.zh: 按 sess_[PHPSESSID] 命名规则构造路径提交包含请求。命中判据：响应包含会话中的标记内容。
description.en: Craft the sess_[PHPSESSID] path and include it. Success: the session marker content shows in the response.

description.zh: 把会话字段内容换成 PHP 代码并再次包含该会话文件执行。命中判据：whoami 等命令输出返回到响应中。
description.en: Replace the session field with PHP code and re-include the file. Success: command output returns.

title.zh: 处理器混用触发反序列化

description.zh: 写入侧与读取侧序列化处理器不一致时，注入竖线前缀的序列化对象触发还原。命中判据：注入对象被反序列化并执行。
description.en: When write/read handlers differ, inject a pipe-prefixed serialized object. Success: the injected object is unserialized and fires.

prerequisites.zh: 工作目录中存在随机只读 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具，并记录其规范路径与清理责任。
prerequisites.en: A random read-only PAYLOADER_MARKER fixture exists in the working directory with its canonical path and cleanup owner recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 本地服务只监听 127.0.0.1，并可查看 URL 解码、最终路径、stream wrapper 和 include 结果日志。
prerequisites.en: The local service listens only on 127.0.0.1 and exposes URL-decoding, final-path, stream-wrapper, and include-result logs.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是临时 session 文件只含 marker 数据，读取结果与 Session ID 和 save_path 日志一致，清理后同一路径失败。单独的 HTTP 200、PHP warning、空响应、WAF 告警或一次超时都不足以证明文件包含。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the temporary session file contains marker data only, the read result agrees with the session ID and save_path logs, and the same path fails after cleanup. HTTP 200 alone, a PHP warning, an empty response, a WAF alert, or a single timeout does not prove file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用工作目录 marker、localhost 与一次性请求 ID，禁止真实系统、凭据、环境和其他进程路径。
opsecTips.en: Use only working-directory markers, localhost, and one-time request IDs; prohibit real system, credential, environment, and other-process paths.

opsecTips.zh: 不提交可执行 PHP、WebShell、反向通道或序列化对象；每个请求设置三秒超时并在结束后清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit executable PHP, web shells, reverse channels, or serialized objects; cap each request at three seconds and clean fixtures afterward.

description.zh: 绕过相对拼接与 ./ 特征：直接绝对路径读会话文件；会话数据回显即成功。
description.en: Read the session file via an absolute path past relative concatenation; echoed session data confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 /var、/tmp 起始路径的黑名单：借 proc 别名等价访问；会话内容返回即成功。
description.en: Reach the session through the proc alias against path-prefix blacklists; returned session content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 sess_ 直达路径的删除过滤：双重写绕过后仍读到会话；内容一致即成功。
description.en: Use double-write traversal that still lands on the session file; identical content being read confirms success.

name.zh: /proc/self/cwd Marker 读取边界

description.zh: /proc/self/cwd Marker 读取边界验证/proc/self/cwd 符号链接是否让读取入口解析到当前工作目录中的批准 marker，而不触碰环境或其他进程。它只保留一个 include/read 输入，并以 PAYLOADER_MARKER、请求 ID 和最终解析记录作为证据。
description.en: /proc/self/cwd Marker Read Boundary validates whether the /proc/self/cwd symlink lets the read entry resolve to an approved marker in the current working directory without touching environments or other processes. It retains one include or read input and uses PAYLOADER_MARKER, request ID, and final resolution records as evidence.

overview.zh: /proc/self/cwd Marker 读取边界针对 Linux 符号链接辅助路径解析的场景：/proc/self/cwd 指向进程当前工作目录。验证该链接能否让读取入口解析到应用目录中的批准 marker，而不触碰环境或其他进程。
overview.en: The /proc/self/cwd marker read boundary targets Linux symlink-assisted path resolution: /proc/self/cwd points to the process working directory. It validates whether that symlink lets the read endpoint resolve an approved marker in the application directory, without touching the environment or other processes.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是读取入口接受绝对路径且未限制在批准根目录，/proc 伪文件系统的符号链接使相对约束失效，攻击者可借 cwd 定位应用目录并按目录结构构造越界路径。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a read endpoint accepting absolute paths without confining them to the approved root; symlinks in the /proc pseudo-filesystem defeat relative constraints, letting attackers locate the application directory via cwd and craft out-of-bounds paths along its layout.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步提交 ?file=/proc/self/cwd/payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt；命中判据为响应体为 PAYLOADER_MARKER 文本，证明 /proc/self/cwd 解析到应用工作目录。命中说明绝对路径与 procfs 链接均可进入读取入口，可继续用 /proc/self/ 其他条目评估信息暴露面，并逐条记录解析日志与请求 ID。
exploitation.en: Submit ?file=/proc/self/cwd/payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt as in step 1; a hit is the response body being the PAYLOADER_MARKER text, proving /proc/self/cwd resolves to the application working directory. A hit shows absolute paths and procfs symlinks both reach the read endpoint; probe other /proc/self/ entries to gauge information exposure, logging resolution activity and request IDs.

mitigation.zh: 读取接口拒绝 /proc 等伪文件系统路径与绝对路径，使用对象 ID 映射并在最终规范路径上强制根目录；以低权限只读身份打开文件。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认 procfs 路径被拒绝且业务读取正常。
mitigation.en: Reject pseudo-filesystem paths such as /proc and absolute paths in read endpoints, map by object ID, and enforce the root on the final canonical path; open files read-only with low privilege. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm procfs paths are rejected while business reads work.

description.zh: 用正常路径请求摸清包含接口行为与响应差异，记录报错中的路径信息。命中判据：不同路径返回可区分的结果。
description.en: Map the include endpoint with normal paths and note error path hints. Success: different paths give distinct responses.

description.zh: 提交 /proc/self/cwd 前缀路径读取应用目录内的文件，绕开对 Web 根的路径假设。命中判据：响应体为标记文本。
description.en: Use /proc/self/cwd prefixes to read files relative to the app cwd. Success: the marker text is returned.

description.zh: 沿第 2 步方式读取 /proc/self/cmdline 与 environ，获取进程启动参数与环境变量。命中判据：环境内容返回响应。
description.en: Extend step 2 to /proc/self/cmdline and environ. Success: process args and environment variables are returned.

description.zh: 把读到的环境变量与应用配置经 HTTP 或 DNS 外带，寻找数据库凭据等横向移动入口。命中判据：接收端收到完整数据。
description.en: Exfiltrate env vars and configs to find DB credentials for lateral movement. Success: the collector receives the data.

prerequisites.zh: 工作目录中存在随机只读 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具，并记录其规范路径与清理责任。
prerequisites.en: A random read-only PAYLOADER_MARKER fixture exists in the working directory with its canonical path and cleanup owner recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 本地服务只监听 127.0.0.1，并可查看 URL 解码、最终路径、stream wrapper 和 include 结果日志。
prerequisites.en: The local service listens only on 127.0.0.1 and exposes URL-decoding, final-path, stream-wrapper, and include-result logs.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是最终路径解析到工作目录 marker，响应精确匹配且审计中没有 environ、cmdline 或 fd 枚举。单独的 HTTP 200、PHP warning、空响应、WAF 告警或一次超时都不足以证明文件包含。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the final path resolves to the working-directory marker, the response matches exactly, and audit logs show no environ, cmdline, or fd enumeration. HTTP 200 alone, a PHP warning, an empty response, a WAF alert, or a single timeout does not prove file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用工作目录 marker、localhost 与一次性请求 ID，禁止真实系统、凭据、环境和其他进程路径。
opsecTips.en: Use only working-directory markers, localhost, and one-time request IDs; prohibit real system, credential, environment, and other-process paths.

opsecTips.zh: 不提交可执行 PHP、WebShell、反向通道或序列化对象；每个请求设置三秒超时并在结束后清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit executable PHP, web shells, reverse channels, or serialized objects; cap each request at three seconds and clean fixtures afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对 /proc/self/cwd 路径黑名单：用 root 别名同样锚定进程根；marker 文件读取成功即成功。
description.en: Anchor via the /proc/self/root alias instead, past cwd-path blacklists; a successful marker read confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 /proc/self/cwd/ 后紧跟文件名的精确匹配：插入 ./ 冗余段；读取成功即成功。
description.en: Insert redundant ./ segments past exact suffix matching; a successful read confirms success.

title.zh: 数字 PID 路径形式

description.zh: 绕过对 self 关键字的统一替换：混入数字 PID 目录仍解析到工作目录；内容返回即成功。
description.en: Mix numeric PID directories so blanket self rewriting misses it; returned content confirms success.

name.zh: 上传扩展名规范化差异

description.zh: 上传扩展名规范化差异将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：大小写、多扩展名、编码和服务器映射规则对允许扩展产生不同结论。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Extension Normalization Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: case, multiple extensions, encoding, and server mapping rules produce different allowlist decisions. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 上传扩展名规范化差异针对大小写、多扩展名、编码与服务器映射规则对同一文件名产生不同结论的场景。验证入口值、规范化结果与最终存储扩展名之间的一致性，以唯一 marker 建立可重复对照。
overview.en: Upload extension normalization differential targets scenarios where case, multi-extension, encoding, and server mapping rules reach different conclusions for the same filename. It compares the entry value, normalized result, and final stored extension, using a unique marker for repeatable contrasts.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是大小写、多扩展名、编码和服务器映射规则对允许扩展产生不同结论；只有当差异跨越预期目录、类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that case, multi-extension, encoding, and server-mapping rules reach different conclusions about allowed extensions; risk holds only when the difference crosses an expected directory, type, or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步与第 2 步的验证块逐条上传：先测 PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt.jpg、%00 截断、.phtml/.php5 替代扩展与大小写变体，再对照写入顺序、ADS（::$DATA）、分号截断与尾随点/空格；每条上传后回读存储名并记录接受状态与原因。命中判据为某一变体的最终存储扩展名越过允许扩展边界，形成跨处理器的存储结果对照。
exploitation.en: Upload item by item through the verification blocks of steps 1 and 2: first test PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt.jpg, %00 truncation, .phtml/.php5 alternatives, and case variants; then contrast write order, ADS (::$DATA), semicolon truncation, and trailing dot/space. Read back the stored name after each upload and record acceptance status and reason. A hit is any variant whose final stored extension crosses the allowed-extension boundary, forming a cross-handler storage contrast.

mitigation.zh: 生成服务端对象名，在目标文件系统语义下统一校验名称、内容和类型，并把上传目录设为不可执行。修复后同时重放第 1、2 步异常样例与正常样例，确认 marker 不再越界且合法文件流程保持可用。
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names, validate name, content, and type uniformly under target filesystem semantics, and make upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay the step-1 and step-2 anomalous samples alongside normal samples and confirm markers no longer escape while legitimate file flows keep working.

description.zh: 先上传正常文件记录响应、存储名与提示信息，推断黑名单或白名单的校验口径。命中判据：校验规则可以从响应中推断出来。
description.en: Upload a normal file and read responses/storage names to infer list-based rules. Success: the rule style becomes inferable.

description.zh: 依次上传双扩展名、%00 截断、phtml、php5、phar 与大小写变体，观察放行与落盘结果。命中判据：存在被放行的脚本类变体。
description.en: Upload double-extension, %00-truncation, phtml/php5/phar and case variants. Success: some script variant gets through.

description.zh: 改用 Windows 数据流、分号截断与尾随点空格变体，穿透不同折叠规则。命中判据：最终存储名绕过黑名单。
description.en: Try ADS names, semicolon truncation and trailing dot/space forms. Success: the stored name evades the blacklist.

description.zh: 对放行的文件回读存储名并发起访问请求，确认脚本扩展被服务器解析执行。命中判据：请求返回代码执行的输出结果。
description.en: Read back the stored name and request it to confirm execution. Success: the request yields code output.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 服务端二次解码后截断为 .php。判据：存储文件为可执行 php。
description.en: Second decode stage truncates to .php. Success: stored file executes.

description.zh: 大小写变形加分号截断干扰后缀判断。判据：以 php 语义执行。
description.en: Case variance plus semicolon truncation. Success: executes as PHP.

description.zh: Windows 保存时剥离尾点空格还原 .php。判据：落盘文件名以 .php 结尾。
description.en: Windows strips trailing dot/space on write. Success: on-disk name ends with .php.

description.zh: 中间 jpg 干扰黑白名单首尾判断。判据：最终以 php 执行。
description.en: Middle extension confuses first/last checks. Success: executes as PHP.

name.zh: 上传 Content-Type 声明边界

description.zh: 上传 Content-Type 声明边界将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：上传策略直接信任 multipart 部件的 Content-Type 声明。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Content-Type Declaration Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: upload policy directly trusts the multipart part Content-Type declaration. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 上传 Content-Type 声明边界针对上传策略直接信任 multipart 部件 Content-Type 声明的场景：声明类型与真实内容可能不一致。验证以两种声明上传同一 marker，对照服务端是否校验实际内容。
overview.en: The upload Content-Type declaration boundary targets upload policies that directly trust the multipart part's Content-Type declaration, which can diverge from real content. It uploads the same marker under two declarations, contrasting whether the server validates actual content.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是上传策略直接信任 multipart 部件的 Content-Type 声明而不与内容和扩展名交叉校验；声明类型因此成为可被客户端任意指定的分类依据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an upload policy that trusts the multipart part's Content-Type declaration without cross-checking content and extension, letting the declared type become a client-controlled classification basis.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步以 text/plain 与 application/octet-stream 两种声明上传同一 PAYLOADER_MARKER 文件；命中判据为服务端按声明类型分类存储且未对实际内容做检测，两份文件的存储元数据呈现不同类型。上传后逐一回读并记录声明类型与检测类型字段，形成声明被直接采信的对照证据。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, upload the same PAYLOADER_MARKER file declared as text/plain and application/octet-stream; a hit is the server classifying storage by the declared type without inspecting actual content, with the two files' stored metadata showing different types. Read each back and record declared versus detected type fields, forming contrast evidence that the declaration was taken at face value.

mitigation.zh: 对上传内容执行真实类型检测并与扩展名、声明类型交叉校验，不一致时拒绝或降级处理；存储使用服务端对象名且目录不可执行。修复后重放第 1 步两种声明，确认分类不再随声明变化且正常上传可用。
mitigation.en: Perform real content-type detection on uploads, cross-check against extension and declared type, and reject or downgrade mismatches; store under server-side object names in non-executable directories. After the fix, replay both step-1 declarations and confirm classification no longer follows the declaration while normal uploads work.

description.zh: 上传普通文件记录响应内容与存储信息，摸清入口参数与上传处理流程。命中判据：正常上传链路完整可用且可重复。
description.en: Upload a benign file and capture response and storage details. Success: the normal flow works end to end.

description.zh: 分别以 text/plain 与 application/octet-stream 声明提交同一文件，测试声明是否被直接采信。命中判据：两种声明均被接受落盘。
description.en: Submit the same file declared as text/plain and octet-stream. Success: both declarations are accepted and stored.

title.zh: 组合变形文件名落盘脚本
title.en: Pair fake type with name mutations

description.zh: 结合扩展名与文件名变形，让脚本文件借助假声明类型通过检查落盘。命中判据：脚本文件存储成功且路径可访问。
description.en: Combine extension and filename mutations with the fake type. Success: a script file is stored.

title.zh: 访问触发解析建立执行

description.zh: 访问落盘的脚本文件路径触发服务器解析执行。命中判据：返回命令或代码执行的输出结果，控制通道建立，并且重复提交时可以稳定复现该结果。
description.en: Request the stored script to trigger parsing. Success: command or code output is returned.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: MIME 声明为图片而内容为脚本，绕过仅查 Content-Type 的校验。判据：文件被执行。
description.en: Image MIME with script body passes header-only checks. Success: file executes.

description.zh: part 缺失 Content-Type 时后端取默认值放行。判据：上传成功。
description.en: Missing part Content-Type falls back to defaults. Success: upload accepted.

description.zh: 头部与值大小写变形绕过精确匹配。判据：通过校验并落盘。
description.en: Header/value case variance. Success: passes validation.

name.zh: 上传 Windows 尾随文件名

description.zh: 上传 Windows 尾随文件名将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：尾随空格、点、分号或控制编码在上传校验后被 Windows 或 Web 服务器折叠。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Windows Trailing Filename narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: trailing spaces, dots, semicolons, or encoded controls are folded after upload validation. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

subCategory.zh: 文件名与文件系统边界

overview.zh: 上传 Windows 尾随文件名针对尾随空格、点、分号或控制编码在校验后被 Windows 或 Web 服务器折叠的场景：校验名与落盘名可能不同。验证两个阶段对文件名的解释差异，以回读存储名为证据。
overview.en: Upload Windows trailing filenames target cases where trailing spaces, dots, semicolons, or control encodings are folded by Windows or the web server after validation, diverging the validated name from the stored name. It contrasts the two phases' interpretations using read-back storage names as evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是尾随空格、点、分号或控制编码在上传校验后被 Windows 或 Web 服务器折叠；只有当折叠使最终名称跨越类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is trailing spaces, dots, semicolons, or control encodings being folded by Windows or the web server after upload validation; risk holds only when folding pushes the final name across a type or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步与第 2 步的验证块逐条上传：先测尾随空格（原样、%20、%09）与 %00 截断变体，再测尾随点、多点、点空格混排与分号截断；每条上传后 HEAD 回读确认落盘名。命中判据为校验阶段接受的名称在落盘后被折叠为其他扩展名或类型，记录两个阶段的名称差异作为证据。
exploitation.en: Upload item by item through the verification blocks of steps 1 and 2: first trailing spaces (raw, %20, %09) and %00 truncation variants, then trailing dots, multiple dots, dot-space mixes, and semicolon truncation; HEAD-read back the stored name after each upload. A hit is a name accepted at validation being folded into a different extension or type on disk—record the two-phase name divergence as evidence.

mitigation.zh: 生成服务端对象名并在校验前对文件名做显式规范化，拒绝控制字符、尾随点空格与分号；上传目录不可执行。修复后同时重放第 1、2 步变体与正常样例，确认折叠差异消失且合法上传可用。
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names and normalize filenames explicitly before validation, rejecting control characters, trailing dots/spaces, and semicolons; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay the step-1 and step-2 variants alongside normal samples and confirm the folding divergence is gone while legitimate uploads work.

description.zh: 上传普通文件观察校验层与落盘层对文件名的处理差异，记录两层各自的解释结果。命中判据：两层行为可以清楚区分。
description.en: Upload a benign file to see how validation and storage treat names. Success: the two layers behave differently.

title.zh: 尾随空格与截断变体上传

description.zh: 以尾随空格、%20、%09 与 %00 截断文件名上传并回读。命中判据：某个变体被服务端接受并成功落盘存储。
description.en: Upload names with trailing spaces, %20/%09 and %00 truncation, then read back. Success: a variant is stored.

title.zh: 尾随点与分号变体上传

description.zh: 改用尾随点、多点、点空格混排与分号截断形式上传，观察落盘解释。命中判据：落盘名折叠出目标脚本扩展名。
description.en: Try trailing dots, multi-dot mixes and semicolon forms. Success: the stored name folds into the target extension.

description.zh: 对各变体做回读比对，锁定被 Windows 折叠出脚本扩展的形态。命中判据：确定可用于绕过校验的变体。
description.en: Read back each variant to pinpoint which folds into a script extension. Success: a bypass-capable variant is pinned.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.
