analysis.en: Confirmation requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 编码尾点在 Windows 落盘时还原。判据：实际文件为 .php。
description.en: Encoded dot restored on write. Success: actual file is .php.

description.zh: 多点空格序列绕过单一尾缀检测。判据：保存为 php。
description.en: Alternating dots and spaces. Success: saved as PHP.

description.zh: 尾随空白被文件系统剥离。判据：php 后缀保留。
description.en: Trailing whitespace stripped by the filesystem. Success: .php suffix survives.

name.zh: 上传 NTFS ADS 文件名

description.zh: 上传 NTFS ADS 文件名将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：应用允许冒号文件名，而 NTFS 把后续部分解释为 Alternate Data Stream。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload NTFS ADS Filename narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the application permits colons while NTFS interprets the suffix as an Alternate Data Stream. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

subCategory.zh: 文件名与文件系统边界

overview.zh: 上传 NTFS ADS 文件名针对应用允许冒号文件名而 NTFS 把后续部分解释为 Alternate Data Stream 的场景：冒号名在校验与存储两层含义不同。验证 ::DATA、命名流等变体的存储与回读差异。
overview.en: Upload NTFS ADS filenames target cases where the application allows colon-containing names while NTFS interprets the suffix as an Alternate Data Stream, giving colon names different meanings at validation and storage layers. It contrasts storage and read-back across ::DATA and named-stream variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用允许冒号文件名，而 NTFS 把冒号后内容解释为 Alternate Data Stream；只有当该差异使内容越过类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application allowing colon-containing filenames while NTFS interprets content after the colon as an Alternate Data Stream; risk holds only when this difference lets content cross a type or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步依次上传 filename 为 PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt::DATA、::INDEX_ALLOCATION 与命名流三种冒号变体，每条上传后按命令中的 HEAD 请求回读；命中判据为某一变体的存储结果与校验阶段判定不一致（如内容写入默认流或流类型改变），记录冒号在两层的不同解释作为证据。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, upload the three colon variants PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt::DATA, ::INDEX_ALLOCATION, and a named stream as filenames, HEAD-reading back after each as shown in the command; a hit is any variant whose stored result diverges from the validation verdict (e.g., content written to the default stream or stream type changed)—record the colon's differing interpretations at the two layers as evidence.

mitigation.zh: 文件名校验拒绝冒号与保留流语法，生成服务端对象名并在目标文件系统语义下统一校验；上传目录不可执行。修复后重放第 1 步全部冒号变体，确认被统一拒绝且正常上传可用。
mitigation.en: Reject colons and reserved stream syntax in filename validation, generate server-side object names, and validate uniformly under target filesystem semantics; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay all step-1 colon variants and confirm uniform rejection while normal uploads work.

description.zh: 从响应与路径行为确认目标为 Windows 与 NTFS 存储，且文件名按原样传递。命中判据：冒号类名称未被前置拒绝。
description.en: Confirm a Windows/NTFS backend that passes filenames through. Success: colon-style names are not pre-rejected.

description.zh: 上传 ::$DATA 与命名流形式的文件名并逐一回读，测试 NTFS 流解释。命中判据：某流形式被接受落盘。
description.en: Upload ::$DATA and named-stream filenames and read each back. Success: a stream form is stored.

title.zh: 回读流内容定位落盘形态
title.en: Read streams to locate stored data

description.zh: 回读默认流与命名流的内容，确定数据实际写入的流位置。命中判据：指定流的内容可以正常读取出来，多次提交均能得到相同结果。
description.en: Read default and named streams to find where data lands. Success: the stream content is readable.

title.zh: 借数据流隐藏后门内容
title.en: Hide backdoor content in a stream

description.zh: 把脚本内容写入命名流中，躲避常规的文件枚举与内容检查。命中判据：指定流路径可读出隐藏的内容，并且该效果可以稳定重复取得。
description.en: Write backdoor content into a named stream to dodge enumeration. Success: the stream path yields the content.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: ADS 流名后接扩展名欺骗后缀校验。判据：以 php 数据流写入。
description.en: Stream suffix plus fake extension. Success: written as PHP data stream.

description.zh: 冒号写法把内容存入命名流，路径显示为 .jpg。判据：文件存在且可包含执行。
description.en: Colon form stores content in a named stream shown as .jpg. Success: includable file exists.

description.zh: 编码冒号绕过 :: 检测。判据：ADS 写入成功。
description.en: Encoded colon bypasses :: detection. Success: ADS write succeeds.

name.zh: 上传双重写入扩展名

description.zh: 上传双重写入扩展名将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：过滤器通过重复字符串替换删除扩展片段并在单次清洗后重新形成受保护后缀。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Double-Write Extension Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: a filter strips extension fragments with replacement and allows a protected suffix to re-form after one pass. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 上传双重写入扩展名针对过滤器通过重复字符串替换删除扩展片段的场景：单次清洗后受保护后缀会重新拼合。验证 ttxtxt、tTxTxt 等变体在清洗与落盘两个阶段的差异。
overview.en: Upload double-write extensions target filters that delete extension fragments via repeated string replacement, letting protected suffixes reassemble after a single cleaning pass. It contrasts the cleaning and storage phases across ttxtxt, tTxTxt, and related variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是过滤器通过重复字符串替换删除扩展片段，单次清洗后重新形成受保护后缀；只有当重组后的扩展名越过处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a filter deleting extension fragments through repeated string replacement, reassembling the protected suffix after a single cleaning pass; risk holds only when the reassembled extension crosses a handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的验证块以 PAYLOADER_MARKER.ttxtxt、tTxTxt、txttxtt、aasasa 等双重写入变体逐条上传，每条上传后按原文件名 HEAD 回读；命中判据为清洗后的存储名重新拼出受保护扩展名（如 .txt 或 .php），记录清洗输入、清洗输出与落盘名三者对照作为证据。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, upload the double-write variants PAYLOADER_MARKER.ttxtxt, tTxTxt, txttxtt, and aasasa one by one, HEAD-reading back under the original filename after each; a hit is the cleaned storage name reassembling the protected extension (e.g., .txt or .php)—record the cleaning input, cleaned output, and stored name as three-way contrast evidence.

mitigation.zh: 停止使用字符串替换清洗，改为对最终规范化名称执行允许列表校验并生成服务端对象名；上传目录不可执行。修复后重放第 1 步全部双重写入变体，确认存储名不再拼出受保护后缀且正常上传可用。
mitigation.en: Stop string-replacement cleaning; validate the final normalized name against an allowlist and generate server-side object names; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay all step-1 double-write variants and confirm stored names no longer reassemble protected suffixes while normal uploads work.

description.zh: 提交含敏感片段的文件名，观察服务端字符串替换清洗的行为细节。命中判据：确认存在单次替换式清洗逻辑，为下一步利用保留完整的输出内容。
description.en: Submit names with sensitive fragments to observe replace-based sanitizing. Success: a single-pass replace is confirmed.

description.zh: 以 ttxtxt 类双重写入变体上传，让清洗后重新拼出受保护扩展名。命中判据：落盘文件扩展复原成功。
description.en: Upload ttxtxt-style double-written names so sanitizing reassembles the extension. Success: the stored name recovers it.

description.zh: 回读原文件名确认最终存储形态与扩展名归属。命中判据：存储名中包含目标脚本扩展且可被访问，同时排除缓存或随机因素干扰。
description.en: Read back under the original name to confirm the stored form. Success: the name carries the target extension.

title.zh: 触发脚本解析建立控制

description.zh: 访问落盘文件触发服务器脚本解析执行，建立命令控制通道。命中判据：返回代码执行的输出结果，整个过程可随时重复执行。
description.en: Request the stored file to trigger script parsing. Success: execution output is returned.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 过滤剥离一次 php 后仍剩 php。判据：最终后缀可执行。
description.en: Removing one php still leaves php. Success: executable suffix remains.

description.zh: 大小写变形叠加双写。判据：绕过大小写敏感剥离。
description.en: Case variance on top of double writing. Success: survives case-sensitive stripping.

description.zh: 带版本号后缀双写。判据：剥离后仍解析为 php。
description.en: Version-suffixed duplication. Success: still parsed as PHP after stripping.

name.zh: 上传后包装器引用边界

description.zh: 上传后包装器引用边界将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：上传后的文件引用被交给 zip、phar 或其他运行时 wrapper 继续解释。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Post-Upload Wrapper Reference Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: a post-upload file reference is handed to zip, phar, or another runtime wrapper for further interpretation. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 上传后包装器引用边界针对上传后的文件引用被交给 zip、phar 等运行时 wrapper 继续解释的场景：引用路径可指向归档内部成员。验证两类归档 wrapper 引用能否按路径读到成员内容。
overview.en: The post-upload wrapper reference boundary targets uploaded file references being handed to runtime wrappers like zip and phar for further interpretation, where a reference path can point inside archives. It validates whether the two archive wrapper references read member content by path.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是上传后的文件引用被交给 zip、phar 或其他运行时 wrapper 继续解释；只有当解释结果跨越预期目录、类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is uploaded file references being handed to zip, phar, or other runtime wrappers for continued interpretation; risk holds only when the interpretation crosses an expected directory, type, or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步分别提交 zip:///tmp/payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.zip#marker.txt 与 phar:///tmp/payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.phar/marker.txt 两条引用；命中判据为按引用读到归档成员内容。记录 wrapper 选择与成员解析日志；命中后核对入口是读取还是 include 语义，后者按代码执行单独取证。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, submit the two references zip:///tmp/payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.zip#marker.txt and phar:///tmp/payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.phar/marker.txt separately; a hit is member content read by reference path. Log wrapper selection and member resolution; on a hit, determine whether the entry reads or includes—the latter needs separate code-execution evidence.

mitigation.zh: 拒绝控制字节和动态路径，改用逻辑标识允许列表，并让所有组件消费同一规范化结果；上传目录不可执行。修复后重放第 1 步两条引用，确认 wrapper 引用被拒绝且对象 ID 读取正常。
mitigation.en: Reject control bytes and dynamic paths, switch to logical-identifier allowlists, and have all components consume the same normalized result; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay both step-1 references and confirm wrapper references are rejected while object-ID reads work.

title.zh: 上传归档文件定位路径

description.zh: 把 zip 与 phar 归档上传到目标服务器，确认可访问的存储路径。命中判据：归档成功落盘且路径可以预测。
description.en: Upload zip and phar archives and confirm reachable storage paths. Success: archives land predictably.

description.zh: 在包含或读取入口提交 zip:// 与 phar:// 引用路径，读取归档成员。命中判据：按引用读到成员内容。
description.en: Feed zip:// and phar:// references into the read/include entry. Success: member content comes back.

title.zh: 切换成员读取敏感数据

description.zh: 沿第 2 步的引用格式更换归档与成员名，读取归档内配置与凭据。命中判据：目标成员内容成功返回，并且输出内容完整可供利用。
description.en: Following the step 2 format, swap archive and member names. Success: the target content is returned.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是字节级请求、运行时解析日志和唯一 marker 输出三者一致，普通输入与缺失 marker 对照均失败。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the byte-level request, runtime parser log, and unique marker output agree while plain-input and missing-marker controls fail. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 以过滤器包装器读源码绕过直读限制。判据：返回 base64 内容。
description.en: Filter wrapper reads the file. Success: base64 content returned.

description.zh: phar 元数据反序列化触发。判据：内容被执行或反序列化。
description.en: Phar metadata deserialization fires. Success: payload executes.

description.zh: 编码 # 锚绕过字面匹配。判据：zip 内文件被包含。
description.en: Encoded anchor evades literal matching. Success: archive member included.

description.zh: data 流直接注入代码。判据：命令输出返回。
description.en: Direct code injection via the data stream. Success: command output returned.

name.zh: 文件下载路径规范化差异

description.zh: 文件下载路径规范化差异将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：下载参数在 URL 解码、分隔符折叠和根目录约束之间出现不一致。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: File Download Path Normalization Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the download parameter is interpreted inconsistently across URL decoding, separator folding, and root confinement. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 文件下载路径规范化差异针对下载参数在 URL 解码、分隔符折叠和根目录约束之间不一致的场景。验证 ../、....//、双重编码与反斜杠七种变体的解码与最终路径差异，以 marker 回读为准。
overview.en: The file-download path normalization differential targets download parameters inconsistent across URL decoding, separator folding, and root constraints. It contrasts decoding and final-path behavior across seven variants—../, ....//, double encoding, and backslashes—judged by marker read-back.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是下载参数在 URL 解码、分隔符折叠和根目录约束之间出现不一致；只有当差异使最终路径越过预期目录或类型边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is download parameters inconsistent across URL decoding, separator folding, and root constraints; risk holds only when the difference pushes the final path past an expected directory or type boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步对 download 参数依次施加 ../、....//、单次与双重编码、反斜杠七种变体并记录每次响应；命中判据为某一变体返回根目录外 PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt 的内容。再用第 2 步以纯查询串形式重放双重编码与反斜杠变体，对照 curl 场景验证不同入口的解码顺序差异；两条路径的命中都应记录最终解析路径作为证据。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, apply the seven variants—../, ....//, single and double encoding, backslashes—to the download parameter and record each response; a hit is any variant returning the out-of-root PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt content. Then replay the double-encoding and backslash variants as pure query strings per step 2, contrasting decoding-order differences between entry points; record the final resolved path for every hit as evidence.

mitigation.zh: 使用服务端对象标识，统一解码和规范化，并在打开文件前强制执行根目录与 scheme 允许列表。修复后同时重放第 1、2 步异常样例与正常样例，确认 marker 不再越界且合法下载保持可用。
mitigation.en: Use server-side object identifiers, unify decoding and normalization, and enforce root-directory and scheme allowlists before opening files. After the fix, replay the step-1 and step-2 anomalous samples alongside normal samples and confirm markers no longer escape while legitimate downloads keep working.

title.zh: 定位下载参数与正常文件

description.zh: 请求正常文件下载记录响应形态与参数名，摸清入口行为与限制。命中判据：正常文件可以稳定重复下载，为后续深入利用打下基础。
description.en: Download a normal file to capture response shape and parameter names. Success: normal downloads work reliably.

description.zh: 对下载参数施加 ../、....//、单双编码与反斜杠七类变体，观察解码差异。命中判据：某变体返回根外文件内容。
description.en: Apply ../, ....//, single/double encodings and backslash variants. Success: one variant returns outside files.

description.zh: 以纯查询串形式投递编码变体，测试不同入口对解码顺序的处理差异。命中判据：发现可利用的解码不一致点，并且重复提交时可以稳定复现该结果。
description.en: Re-submit encoded variants as raw query strings to compare decoding order. Success: an exploitable mismatch appears.

description.zh: 用命中的变体构造路径，读取服务器配置、凭据与源码文件并外带。命中判据：敏感内容成功返回响应，多次提交均能得到相同结果。
description.en: Use the winning variant to pull configs, credentials and sources. Success: sensitive content returns.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是最终路径或处理器日志与唯一 marker 返回相互印证，正常路径和缺失 marker 对照均不命中。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that final-path or handler logs agree with the unique marker response while normal-path and missing-marker controls do not match. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 双重解码后还原 ../。判据：返回 passwd 内容。
description.en: Double decoding restores ../. Success: passwd returned.

description.zh: 过滤剥离一次 ../ 后仍余遍历。判据：读出目标文件。
description.en: Stripping one pass still leaves traversal. Success: file read.

description.zh: 代理剥离分号段后端仍遍历。判据：200 且含 root 行。
description.en: Proxy strips ;params, backend traverses. Success: 200 with root line.

description.zh: 编码反斜杠绕过仅匹配 / 的规则。判据：内容返回。
description.en: Encoded backslashes dodge slash-only rules. Success: content returned.

name.zh: 文件下载流包装器边界

description.zh: 文件下载流包装器边界将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：下载参数被文件系统之外的 URI 或运行时 stream wrapper 解析。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: File Download Stream-Wrapper Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: a download parameter is resolved by URI or runtime stream wrappers outside the intended filesystem contract. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 文件下载流包装器边界针对下载参数被文件系统之外的 URI 或运行时 stream wrapper 解析的场景。验证六个常见参数名的遍历探测与 file://、php://filter 两类 wrapper 的接受情况。
overview.en: The file-download stream-wrapper boundary targets download parameters resolved by URIs beyond the filesystem or runtime stream wrappers. It validates traversal probing across six common parameter names plus acceptance of the file:// and php://filter wrappers.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是下载参数被文件系统之外的 URI 或运行时 stream wrapper 解析；只有当 wrapper 解释结果跨越预期目录、类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is download parameters being resolved by URIs outside the filesystem or by runtime stream wrappers; risk holds only when wrapper interpretation crosses an expected directory, type, or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步先用 path、filepath、filename、doc 等六个常见参数名逐一探测 ../ 遍历，找到可控参数后以 file:// 与 php://filter wrapper 读取 PAYLOADER_MARKER；命中判据为 wrapper URI 返回 marker 内容而非普通文件响应。记录哪个参数可控、wrapper 是否被接受及其解析日志；php://filter 命中时同时核对返回的是编码数据还是执行结果。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, first probe ../ traversal across six common parameter names (path, filepath, filename, doc, and others); once a controllable parameter is found, read PAYLOADER_MARKER via the file:// and php://filter wrappers. A hit is a wrapper URI returning marker content rather than an ordinary file response. Record which parameter is controllable, whether wrappers are accepted, and their parse logs; on a php://filter hit, also check whether the return is encoded data or an execution result.

mitigation.zh: 使用服务端对象标识，统一解码和规范化，并在打开文件前强制执行根目录与 scheme 允许列表，拒绝一切 wrapper URI。修复后重放第 1 步全部参数与 wrapper 探测，确认被统一拒绝且合法下载保持可用。
mitigation.en: Use server-side object identifiers, unify decoding and normalization, enforce root-directory and scheme allowlists before opening files, and reject all wrapper URIs. After the fix, replay every step-1 parameter and wrapper probe and confirm uniform rejection while legitimate downloads keep working.

description.zh: 用 file、path、filename、doc、download 等参数名提交 ../ 遍历探测。命中判据：某参数返回上级目录文件。
description.en: Probe ../ across file/path/filename/doc/download params. Success: one parameter returns a parent-dir file.

title.zh: 读取根外文件确认越界

description.zh: 沿第 1 步命中的参数读取根目录之外的标记文件。命中判据：越界内容成功返回到下载响应中，并且该效果可以稳定重复取得。
description.en: Follow the parameter that hit in step 1 to read outside the root. Success: out-of-root content returns.

description.zh: 改用 file:// 与 php://filter 包装器读取源码与数据流内容。命中判据：包装器目标内容可读。
description.en: Swap in file:// and php://filter wrappers for sources and streams. Success: wrapper targets are readable.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是最终路径或处理器日志与唯一 marker 返回相互印证，正常路径和缺失 marker 对照均不命中。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that final-path or handler logs agree with the unique marker response while normal-path and missing-marker controls do not match. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 包装器路径绕过本地路径限制。判据：返回文件内容。
description.en: Wrapper path bypasses local-path checks. Success: content returned.

description.zh: expect 包装器直接执行命令。判据：返回 uid 输出。
description.en: expect wrapper runs commands. Success: uid output returned.

description.zh: data 流验证包装器开放。判据：回显 MARKER。
description.en: Confirms wrapper support. Success: MARKER echoed.

name.zh: 文件下载旧式终止符边界

description.zh: 文件下载旧式终止符边界将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：空字节、路径填充或分隔符变体在旧式组件之间被截断或二次规范化。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: File Download Legacy-Terminator Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: null bytes, path padding, or separator variants are truncated or renormalized across legacy components. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 文件下载旧式终止符边界针对空字节、路径填充或分隔符变体在旧式组件之间被截断或二次规范化的场景。验证 %00、%00.txt、点填充、....//、..; 与反斜杠变体的截断差异。
overview.en: The file-download legacy-terminator boundary targets null bytes, path padding, or separator variants being truncated or re-normalized between legacy components. It contrasts truncation behavior across %00, %00.txt, dot padding, ....//, ..;, and backslash variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是空字节、路径填充或分隔符变体在旧式组件之间被截断或二次规范化；只有当截断使最终文件名越过类型或目录边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is null bytes, path padding, or separator variants being truncated or re-normalized between legacy components; risk holds only when truncation pushes the final filename past a type or directory boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步以 %00、%00.txt、点填充、....//、..; 与反斜杠变体对同一路径逐条请求；命中判据为某一变体在截断或折叠后返回根目录外的 PAYLOADER_MARKER 内容。每条请求记录发送值与最终解析文件名，形成校验层与文件系统层的对照；%00 类变体阴性时注明运行时版本，作为现代组件已拒绝空字节的证据。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, request the same path with the %00, %00.txt, dot-padding, ....//, ..;, and backslash variants one by one; a hit is any variant returning out-of-root PAYLOADER_MARKER content after truncation or folding. Record the sent value and final resolved filename per request as a validation-layer versus filesystem-layer contrast; when %00 variants are negative, note the runtime version as evidence that modern components reject null bytes.

mitigation.zh: 拒绝控制字节和动态路径，改用逻辑标识允许列表，并让所有组件消费同一规范化结果。修复后同时重放第 1 步终止符变体与正常样例，确认 marker 不再越界且合法下载保持可用。
mitigation.en: Reject control bytes and dynamic paths, switch to logical-identifier allowlists, and have all components consume the same normalized result. After the fix, replay the step-1 terminator variants alongside normal samples and confirm markers no longer escape while legitimate downloads keep working.

description.zh: 请求正常下载判断组件年代与解码行为，推断其对终止符的敏感程度。命中判据：入口对编码变体存在明显反应。
description.en: Download normally to gauge the component's age and decoding habits. Success: it reacts to encoded variants.

description.zh: 以 %00、%00.txt、点填充、....// 与 ..; 变体请求同一路径。命中判据：某变体命中目标文件。
description.en: Request one path with %00, %00.txt, dot padding, ....// and ..; forms. Success: a variant hits the file.

title.zh: 命中截断读取目标文件
title.en: Read targets via the working truncation

description.zh: 用命中的变体构造路径，读取受限目录中的目标文件内容。命中判据：目标文件内容成功返回到响应，为下一步利用保留完整的输出内容。
description.en: Use the winning variant to read restricted files. Success: file content is returned.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是字节级请求、运行时解析日志和唯一 marker 输出三者一致，普通输入与缺失 marker 对照均失败。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the byte-level request, runtime parser log, and unique marker output agree while plain-input and missing-marker controls fail. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 二次解码还原 %00 截断白名单后缀。判据：返回内容。
description.en: Second decode restores truncation. Success: content returned.

description.zh: 整体编码绕过明文 ../ 规则。判据：读出文件。
description.en: Everything encoded. Success: file read.

description.zh: 解码后成为查询串前缀截断白名单后缀。判据：返回 passwd。
description.en: Decodes to a query prefix truncating the allowlisted suffix. Success: passwd returned.

name.zh: POSIX 路径遍历规范化

description.zh: POSIX 路径遍历规范化将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：相对段在应用过滤后由 POSIX 路径解析继续折叠并越过允许根目录。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: POSIX Path-Traversal Normalization narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: relative segments are folded by POSIX path resolution after filtering and escape the allowed root. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: POSIX 路径遍历规范化针对相对段在应用过滤后仍由 POSIX 路径解析继续折叠的场景。验证按深度 1-4 递增的 ../ 遍历，确定折叠与根目录回退的真实行为，以 marker 命中深度为证据。
overview.en: POSIX path-traversal normalization targets relative segments that keep collapsing through POSIX path resolution after application filtering. It validates ../ traversal at depths 1-4 to determine real folding and root-fallback behavior, using the hit depth as evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是相对段在应用过滤后由 POSIX 路径解析继续折叠并越过允许根目录；只有当折叠使最终路径越过目录或类型边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is relative segments continuing to collapse through POSIX path resolution after application filtering and escaping the allowed root; risk holds only when folding pushes the final path past a directory or type boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的循环以深度 1、2、3、4 依次发送 ../ 遍历并请求 PAYLOADER_MARKER；命中判据为某一深度返回 marker 内容，脚本会打印命中 depth。记录首个命中深度与最终解析路径，说明应用过滤与 POSIX 折叠之间的差异数量；随后可在同一入口测试双重编码变体扩大对照面。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, send ../ traversal at depths 1, 2, 3, and 4 in a loop requesting PAYLOADER_MARKER; a hit is marker content at some depth, and the script prints the hit depth. Record the first hit depth and final resolved path to quantify the gap between application filtering and POSIX folding; then broaden the contrast with double-encoding variants on the same endpoint.

mitigation.zh: 拒绝绝对、设备和父目录形式，通过受限目录句柄访问文件，并在最终路径上执行边界检查。修复后同时重放第 1 步各深度样例与正常样例，确认 marker 不再越界且合法读取保持可用。
mitigation.en: Reject absolute, device, and parent-directory forms, access files through a confined directory handle, and run boundary checks on the final path. After the fix, replay the step-1 depth samples alongside normal samples and confirm markers no longer escape while legitimate reads keep working.

description.zh: 找到接收路径的读取或下载参数并请求正常文件记录行为。命中判据：路径参数直接决定返回的内容，同时排除缓存或随机因素干扰。
description.en: Find the path-taking parameter and fetch a normal file. Success: the parameter drives returned content.

description.zh: 按深度 1 到 4 循环提交 ../ 前缀路径，观察哪一深度命中根外文件。命中判据：某深度返回标记内容。
description.en: Loop ../ at depths 1-4 to see which escapes the root. Success: a depth returns the marker content.

description.zh: 用命中的深度构造路径读取 passwd 与应用配置，并把结果外带。命中判据：接收端收到完整文件内容。
description.en: With the winning depth, read passwd and configs and exfiltrate. Success: the collector receives content.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是批准根目录外的唯一 marker 被读取，且规范路径或网络解析日志与请求 ID 精确关联。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the unique marker outside the approved root is read and canonical-path or network-resolution logs correlate exactly with the request ID. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 多斜杠规范化等价绝对路径。判据：200 返回内容。
description.en: Extra slashes normalize to the absolute path. Success: 200 with content.

description.zh: 内联 ./ 不改变语义。判据：内容返回。
description.en: Inline ./ is semantically neutral. Success: content returned.

description.zh: 尾段绕过以 passwd 结尾的规则。判据：仍读出文件。
description.en: Trailing segments evade suffix rules. Success: file still read.

description.zh: 编码斜杠绕过路径起始检测。判据：200。
description.en: Encoded slashes bypass path-start checks. Success: 200.

name.zh: Windows 路径遍历规范化

description.zh: Windows 路径遍历规范化将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：反斜杠、驱动器路径和 8.3 短名在 Windows 层绕过上层字符串过滤。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Windows Path-Traversal Normalization narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: backslashes, drive paths, and 8.3 short names bypass string filters before Windows resolution. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: Windows 路径遍历规范化针对反斜杠、驱动器路径和 8.3 短名在 Windows 层绕过上层字符串过滤的场景。验证驱动器、反斜杠与短文件名三类变体在过滤与文件系统两层之间的解释差异。
overview.en: Windows path-traversal normalization targets backslashes, drive paths, and 8.3 short names bypassing upper-layer string filtering at the Windows layer. It contrasts interpretation across filtering and filesystem layers for drive, backslash, and short-name variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是反斜杠、驱动器路径和 8.3 短名在 Windows 层绕过上层字符串过滤；只有当两层的解释差异使最终路径越过目录或类型边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is backslashes, drive paths, and 8.3 short names bypassing upper-layer string filtering at the Windows layer; risk holds only when the two layers' interpretation gap pushes the final path past a directory or type boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留 BASE 变量后逐条提交驱动器（C:%5c…）、反斜杠与 8.3 短文件名变体；命中判据为短文件名或反斜杠变体返回 PAYLOADER_MARKER 文本。每条记录发送值与最终解析路径，标注 Windows 版本与服务器组件，因为短名生成与反斜杠折叠行为随版本不同。
exploitation.en: Keeping the BASE variable as in step 1, submit drive (C:%5c…), backslash, and 8.3 short-name variants one by one; a hit is short-name or backslash variants returning the PAYLOADER_MARKER text. Record sent value and final resolved path per request, noting the Windows version and server component, since short-name generation and backslash folding vary by version.

mitigation.zh: 拒绝绝对、设备和父目录形式，通过受限目录句柄访问文件，并在最终路径上执行边界检查；禁止 8.3 短名（NtfsDisable8dot3NameCreation）。修复后重放第 1 步全部变体，确认被统一拒绝且合法读取保持可用。
mitigation.en: Reject absolute, device, and parent-directory forms, access files through a confined directory handle, and run boundary checks on the final path; disable 8.3 short names (NtfsDisable8dot3NameCreation). After the fix, replay all step-1 variants and confirm uniform rejection while legitimate reads keep working.

title.zh: 判断 Windows 目标形态

description.zh: 从响应与路径行为判断目标是否为 Windows 文件系统处理。命中判据：反斜杠与盘符形式被服务端接受。
description.en: Judge from responses whether paths hit a Windows filesystem. Success: backslash and drive forms are accepted.

title.en: Read via drive and short-name forms

description.zh: 提交盘符、反斜杠与 8.3 短文件名变体请求目标文件。命中判据：短名或反斜杠变体返回文件内容，整个过程可随时重复执行。
description.en: Submit drive-letter, backslash and 8.3 short-name variants. Success: a variant returns the content.

title.en: Use short names to slip filters

description.zh: 用 8.3 短名形式访问被过滤规则拦截的长文件名目标。命中判据：目标文件内容成功返回响应，并且输出内容完整可供利用。
description.en: Access filtered long names via their 8.3 short forms. Success: the target content is returned.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the unique marker outside the approved root is read and canonical-path or network-resolution logs correlate exactly with the request ID. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.
