opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 编码反斜杠绕过分隔符规则。判据：返回 win.ini。
description.en: Encoded backslashes. Success: win.ini returned.

description.zh: 二次解码还原遍历。判据：内容返回。
description.en: Double decoding restores traversal. Success: content returned.

description.zh: Windows API 接受正斜杠。判据：读出文件。
description.en: Windows accepts forward slashes. Success: file read.

description.zh: 盘符与分隔符全编码。判据：200。
description.en: Drive letter and separators fully encoded. Success: 200.

name.zh: UNC 路径解析边界

description.zh: UNC 路径解析边界将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：应用把用户路径传给支持 UNC 的 Windows API 并触发网络解析。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: UNC Path Resolution Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the application passes a user path to a Windows API that accepts UNC and triggers network resolution. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: UNC 路径解析边界针对应用把用户路径传给支持 UNC 的 Windows API 并触发网络解析的场景：\\host\share 形式可发起出站连接。验证指向受控域名的 UNC 路径能否触发解析行为。
overview.en: The UNC path resolution boundary targets user paths passed to UNC-capable Windows APIs, triggering network resolution: \\host\share forms can create outbound connections. It validates whether a UNC path pointing at a controlled domain triggers resolution.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把用户路径传给支持 UNC 的 Windows API 并触发网络解析；只有当解析行为产生出站连接或越界读取时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user paths passed to UNC-capable Windows APIs, triggering network resolution; risk holds only when resolution produces outbound connections or out-of-bounds reads.

exploitation.zh: 在受控 DNS 或监控主机上准备捕获，再按第 1 步复用受控入口的 BASE 变量提交指向 example.invalid 的 UNC 路径；命中判据为响应返回 PAYLOADER_MARKER 文本或 UNC 解析日志记录对应查询。记录出站查询的目标与协议作为证据；生产环境测试时必须使用自有域名，避免指向真实内部主机。
exploitation.en: Prepare a capture on controlled DNS or a monitoring host, then submit a UNC path pointing at example.invalid reusing the controlled entry's BASE variable as in step 1; a hit is the response returning PAYLOADER_MARKER text or the UNC resolution log recording the query. Record the outbound query target and protocol as evidence; on production tests always use your own domain, never real internal hosts.

mitigation.zh: 拒绝绝对、设备和父目录形式以及 UNC 路径，通过受限目录句柄访问文件，并在最终路径上执行边界检查；限制服务账户的出站 SMB。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认 UNC 查询不再产生且合法读取保持可用。
mitigation.en: Reject absolute, device, and parent-directory forms as well as UNC paths, access files through a confined directory handle, and run boundary checks on the final path; restrict service-account outbound SMB. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm no UNC queries occur while legitimate reads keep working.

description.zh: 找到接受路径的接口参数并摸清正常响应形态与限制。命中判据：参数可控并能直接影响文件访问结果，为后续深入利用打下基础。
description.en: Find the path-taking parameter and its normal behavior. Success: the parameter steers file access.

title.zh: 提交 UNC 路径触发解析

description.zh: 以 %5c%5c 开头的 UNC 路径提交请求，观察服务端是否发起解析。命中判据：返回内容或解析日志出现查询。
description.en: Submit %5c%5c UNC paths and watch for server-side resolution. Success: content returns or resolution logs appear.

title.zh: 指向攻击者共享捕获凭据
title.en: Point UNC at an attacker share

description.zh: 把 UNC 主机指向攻击者侧 SMB 监听，触发目标认证回连。命中判据：捕获到 NTLM 请求或哈希。
description.en: Aim the UNC host at an attacker SMB listener. Success: an NTLM request or hash is captured.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是批准根目录外的唯一 marker 被读取，且规范路径或网络解析日志与请求 ID 精确关联。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the unique marker outside the approved root is read and canonical-path or network-resolution logs correlate exactly with the request ID. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: UNC 路径触发 NTLM/SMB 回连。判据：攻击机收到认证请求。
description.en: UNC triggers SMB callback. Success: authentication arrives at the attacker host.

description.zh: 尝试管理共享访问。判据：收到回连或文件读取。
description.en: Attempts admin share access. Success: callback or file read.

description.zh: 编码反斜杠绕过字面匹配。判据：回连到达。
description.en: Encoded backslashes. Success: callback received.

name.zh: 路径遍历旧式终止与截断

description.zh: 路径遍历旧式终止与截断将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：终止字节、短名和路径填充在旧式解析链上改变最终文件名。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Path-Traversal Legacy Termination and Truncation narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: terminator bytes, short names, and path padding alter the final filename in a legacy parsing chain. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 路径遍历旧式终止与截断针对终止字节、短名和路径填充在旧式解析链上改变最终文件名的场景。验证 %00、%2500、8.3 短名、/./ 填充与尾缀点空格五类变体的最终文件名差异。
overview.en: Path-traversal legacy termination and truncation targets terminator bytes, short names, and path padding changing the final filename across legacy parsing chains. It contrasts final filenames across five variant classes: %00, %2500, 8.3 short names, /./ padding, and trailing dot/space.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是终止字节、短名和路径填充在旧式解析链上改变最终文件名；只有当变化使最终目标越过目录或类型边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is terminator bytes, short names, and path padding changing the final filename across legacy parsing chains; risk holds only when the change pushes the final target past a directory or type boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的验证块逐条提交 %00、%2500、8.3 短名、/./ 填充与尾缀点空格五类变体，每条记录发送值与最终解析文件名；命中判据为某一变体的最终文件名与校验层判定不同并指向根目录外的 marker。%00 类变体阴性时记录运行时版本，说明现代组件已拒绝空字节，避免误报。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, submit the five variant classes—%00, %2500, 8.3 short names, /./ padding, and trailing dot/space—one by one, recording sent value and final resolved filename per request; a hit is a final filename differing from the validation verdict and pointing at the out-of-root marker. When %00 variants are negative, record the runtime version showing modern components reject null bytes to avoid false positives.

mitigation.zh: 拒绝控制字节和动态路径，改用逻辑标识允许列表，并让所有组件消费同一规范化结果。修复后同时重放第 1 步终止符变体与正常样例，确认 marker 不再越界且合法读取保持可用。
mitigation.en: Reject control bytes and dynamic paths, switch to logical-identifier allowlists, and have all components consume the same normalized result. After the fix, replay the step-1 terminator variants alongside normal samples and confirm markers no longer escape while legitimate reads keep working.

description.zh: 摸清接受路径参数的读取或包含接口的响应形态与限制。命中判据：路径变化会直接改变返回内容，并且重复提交时可以稳定复现该结果。
description.en: Map how the path-taking endpoint responds to input. Success: path changes alter the response.

description.zh: 以 %00、%2500、8.3 短名、/./ 填充与点空格尾缀变体请求目标路径。命中判据：某类变体命中文件。
description.en: Try %00, %2500, 8.3 names, /./ padding and dot-space suffixes. Success: a class hits the file.

title.zh: 命中截断打开目标文件

description.zh: 用命中的变体构造路径，读取受限目录中的目标文件。命中判据：目标文件内容成功返回到响应中，多次提交均能得到相同结果。
description.en: Craft paths with the working variant to read restricted files. Success: file content returns.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是字节级请求、运行时解析日志和唯一 marker 输出三者一致，普通输入与缺失 marker 对照均失败。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the byte-level request, runtime parser log, and unique marker output agree while plain-input and missing-marker controls fail. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 双重解码还原截断。判据：返回 passwd。
description.en: Double decode restores truncation. Success: passwd returned.

description.zh: Windows 分隔符加截断。判据：读出文件。
description.en: Windows separators plus truncation. Success: file read.

description.zh: 分号段被代理剥离。判据：200。
description.en: Semicolon segments stripped by proxies. Success: 200.

name.zh: PHP 文件包含运行时边界

description.zh: PHP 文件包含运行时边界将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：动态 include 参数可选择本地文件、会话或 PHP stream wrapper 而不是固定模板。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: PHP File-Inclusion Runtime Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: a dynamic include parameter selects local files, sessions, or PHP stream wrappers instead of fixed templates. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: PHP 文件包含运行时边界针对动态 include 参数可选择本地文件、会话或 PHP stream wrapper 的场景：包含目标不再是固定模板。验证本地 marker 的 log/env/会话文件包含与 php://filter base64 读取两类行为。
overview.en: The PHP file-inclusion runtime boundary targets dynamic include parameters able to select local files, sessions, or PHP stream wrappers instead of fixed templates. It validates including local marker log/env/session files and php://filter Base64 reads.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是动态 include 参数可选择本地文件、会话或 PHP stream wrapper 而不是固定模板；只有当选择结果跨越预期目录、类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a dynamic include parameter able to select local files, sessions, or PHP stream wrappers instead of fixed templates; risk holds only when the selection crosses an expected directory, type, or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留 BASE 变量后先包含本地 marker 的 log/env/会话文件，确认动态 include 对常规文件的选择行为；再用 php://filter 加 convert.base64-encode 读取同一 marker 文件，命中判据为返回的 Base64 解码后等于 marker 内容。两类命中分别记录最终解析路径与 wrapper 日志；若包含的是会话文件，同时核对会话内容是否被解释执行。
exploitation.en: Keeping the BASE variable as in step 1, first include the local marker's log/env/session files to confirm dynamic include's selection of regular files; then read the same marker via php://filter with convert.base64-encode—a hit is returned Base64 decoding to the marker content. Record final resolved paths and wrapper logs for both hit classes; when a session file is included, also check whether its content is interpreted and executed.

mitigation.zh: 拒绝控制字节和动态路径，改用逻辑标识允许列表，并让所有组件消费同一规范化结果；禁止用户输入进入 include/require。修复后重放第 1 步全部包含目标，确认被统一拒绝且固定模板加载保持可用。
mitigation.en: Reject control bytes and dynamic paths, switch to logical-identifier allowlists, and have all components consume the same normalized result; keep user input out of include/require. After the fix, replay every step-1 inclusion target and confirm uniform rejection while fixed template loading keeps working.

description.zh: 找到传入 include 的参数并用正常路径摸清包含行为与响应差异。命中判据：包含内容随参数取值变化。
description.en: Find the parameter feeding include and probe it with normal paths. Success: content changes with the parameter.

description.zh: 依次包含日志、环境与会话文件，并以 base64 过滤器读取内容。命中判据：标记内容被完整读出返回。
description.en: Include log/env/session files and read them via the base64 filter. Success: the marker content is returned.

description.zh: 用第 2 步的包含入口换 base64 过滤器读取应用源码文件。命中判据：解码后得到源码与密钥信息。
description.en: Reuse the step 2 entry with a base64 filter over app sources. Success: decoded source reveals secrets.

description.zh: 把可控文件写入代码后再次包含执行，完成从读取到执行的升级。命中判据：命令输出返回到响应中，并且该效果可以稳定重复取得。
description.en: Write code into a controllable file and include it. Success: command output is returned.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是字节级请求、运行时解析日志和唯一 marker 输出三者一致，普通输入与缺失 marker 对照均失败。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the byte-level request, runtime parser log, and unique marker output agree while plain-input and missing-marker controls fail. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 过滤器链读出源码 base64。判据：返回可解码内容。
description.en: Reads source as base64. Success: decodable content returned.

description.zh: data 包装器直接注入代码。判据：命令输出。
description.en: Injects code via the data wrapper. Success: command output.

description.zh: expect 包装器执行命令。判据：uid 输出。
description.en: expect wrapper executes. Success: uid output.

description.zh: 允许远程包含时拉取载荷。判据：载荷执行。
description.en: Fetches the payload when RFI is allowed. Success: payload executes.

name.zh: 归档成员路径规范化

description.zh: 归档成员路径规范化将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：解压器在写入前未验证成员路径规范化后仍位于目标目录。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Archive Member-Path Normalization narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the extractor does not verify that a normalized member path remains inside the destination before writing. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 归档成员路径规范化针对解压器在写入前未验证成员路径的场景：zip-slip 成员可在解压时越过目标目录。验证构造含 ../outside 成员的 ZIP 后，解压端归一化行为是否越界。
overview.en: Archive member-path normalization targets extractors that do not validate member paths before writing: zip-slip members can escape the target directory during extraction. It builds a ZIP containing a ../outside member and checks whether the extractor's normalization stays in bounds.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解压器在写入前未验证成员路径规范化后仍位于目标目录；只有当成员写入跨越目标目录边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is extractors not verifying that member paths remain inside the target directory after normalization before writing; risk holds only when member writes cross the target-directory boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的脚本构造含 ../outside 成员的测试 ZIP 并列出全部原始成员名，确认成员路径按预期构造；然后把归档交给目标解压流程执行，命中判据为成员被写到解压根目录之外（outside 目录出现 PAYLOADER_MARKER）。记录解压器返回的规范化成员名与实际落盘位置形成对照；测试完成后清理越界文件并恢复环境。
exploitation.en: Build a test ZIP containing a ../outside member with the step-1 script and list all raw member names to confirm construction; then hand the archive to the target extraction flow. A hit is the member written outside the extraction root (PAYLOADER_MARKER appearing in the outside directory). Record the extractor's normalized member names versus actual on-disk locations as a contrast; clean up escaped files and restore the environment afterwards.

mitigation.zh: 逐项规范化并验证成员目标，拒绝父目录、绝对路径和链接成员，并在独立临时目录使用安全解压 API。修复后重放第 1 步构造的 zip-slip 归档，确认写入被拒绝且正常归档解压不受影响。
mitigation.en: Normalize and verify each member target, reject parent-directory, absolute, and link members, and use safe extraction APIs in an isolated temp directory. After the fix, replay the step-1 zip-slip archive and confirm writes are rejected while normal archive extraction is unaffected.

description.zh: 打包含 ../outside 成员的测试 zip 并核对原始成员名。命中判据：归档成员名保留 ../ 序列。
description.en: Pack a zip whose members carry ../outside names. Success: the members keep their ../ sequences.

title.en: Feed it to the extract feature

description.zh: 把归档上传到解压功能并触发完整的提取流程。命中判据：解压完成且没有出现路径相关的报错，为下一步利用保留完整的输出内容。
description.en: Upload the archive and trigger extraction. Success: extraction completes without path errors.

description.zh: 检查解压根之外的路径是否出现被提取出的文件。命中判据：越界文件成功写出且内容完整可用，同时排除缓存或随机因素干扰。
description.en: Check whether files appear outside the extraction root. Success: an out-of-root file is written.

title.en: Overwrite configs or drop a backdoor

description.zh: 调整成员路径覆盖应用配置文件，或把脚本写到可执行位置。命中判据：覆盖后的文件被应用加载生效，整个过程可随时重复执行。
description.en: Aim members at app configs or an executable path. Success: the overwritten file takes effect.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是原始成员名、解析后名称和最终写入路径与唯一 marker 任务相互关联，正常归档仍留在解压根内。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the raw member name, decoded name, and final write path correlate with the unique marker job while the normal archive remains inside the extraction root. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 归档成员名编码遍历 Zip Slip。判据：解压落点越出目标目录。
description.en: Encoded member name achieves Zip Slip. Success: extracted outside the target.

description.zh: 绝对成员名直接落系统路径。判据：写入 /tmp。
description.en: Absolute member lands on system paths. Success: written to /tmp.

description.zh: Windows 分隔符绕过 / 检测。判据：解压越界。
description.en: Windows separators evade / checks. Success: extraction escapes.

name.zh: 归档符号链接目标边界

description.zh: 归档符号链接目标边界将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：解压流程创建符号链接后继续写入或未验证链接目标是否离开解压根。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Archive Symlink-Target Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the extraction flow creates symlinks and writes through them or never validates whether targets leave the root. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 归档符号链接目标边界针对解压流程创建符号链接后继续写入或未验证链接目标的场景：链接可指向解压根之外。验证 tar 与 zip 两类符号链接成员在解压器中的跟随行为。
overview.en: The archive symlink-target boundary targets extraction flows that create symlinks and keep writing, or never validate link targets, allowing links to point outside the extraction root. It validates how extractors follow tar and zip symlink members.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解压流程创建符号链接后继续写入或未验证链接目标是否离开解压根；只有当写入经由链接越过目录边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is extraction flows creating symlinks and continuing to write, or never validating whether link targets leave the extraction root; risk holds only when writes cross the directory boundary via a link.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的脚本分别构造指向解压根外 marker 的 tar 与 zip 符号链接成员，先确认成员类型与目标路径；再把两个归档分别交给目标解压流程，命中判据为解压器跟随链接后把 PAYLOADER_MARKER 写到根目录之外。记录链接创建、写入路径与最终落盘位置；测试完成后立即删除链接与越界文件。
exploitation.en: Construct tar and zip symlink members pointing at an out-of-root marker with the step-1 script, confirming member types and target paths first; then hand both archives to the target extraction flow. A hit is PAYLOADER_MARKER written outside the root after the extractor follows the link. Record link creation, write paths, and final on-disk locations; delete the links and escaped files immediately after testing.

mitigation.zh: 逐项规范化并验证成员目标，拒绝父目录、绝对路径和链接成员，并在独立临时目录使用安全解压 API。修复后重放第 1 步构造的链接归档，确认链接成员被拒绝且正常解压不受影响。
mitigation.en: Normalize and verify each member target, reject parent-directory, absolute, and link members, and use safe extraction APIs in an isolated temp directory. After the fix, replay the step-1 link archives and confirm link members are rejected while normal extraction is unaffected.

description.zh: 打包指向解压根外目标的 tar 与 zip 符号链接成员备用。命中判据：归档内包含指向根外的链接成员。
description.en: Pack tar/zip members that symlink outside the root. Success: the archives contain link members.

description.zh: 提交归档让解压器在目标目录写出符号链接文件。命中判据：解压完成后链接文件成功生成，并且输出内容完整可供利用。
description.en: Submit the archive so extraction writes the links. Success: the link files appear after extraction.

description.zh: 通过生成的符号链接读取解压根之外的文件内容。命中判据：越界内容成功返回到响应中，为后续深入利用打下基础。
description.en: Read through the created links to reach outside files. Success: out-of-root content returns.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是原始成员名、解析后名称和最终写入路径与唯一 marker 任务相互关联，正常归档仍留在解压根内。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the raw member name, decoded name, and final write path correlate with the unique marker job while the normal archive remains inside the extraction root. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 符号链接指向 shadow。判据：解压后可读哈希。
description.en: Symlink to shadow. Success: hashes readable after extraction.

description.zh: 链接私钥。判据：读出私钥内容。
description.en: Symlink to the private key. Success: key content read.

description.zh: 双层链接绕过单层目标检测。判据：最终读到 passwd。
description.en: Two-hop chain evades single-level checks. Success: passwd reached.

name.zh: 归档文件名编码差异

description.zh: 归档文件名编码差异将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：归档库、操作系统和业务层对反斜杠、标志位或文件名编码解释不同。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Archive Filename-Encoding Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: archive libraries, operating systems, and application layers interpret backslashes, flags, or filename encodings differently. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 归档文件名编码差异针对归档库、操作系统和业务层对反斜杠、标志位或文件名编码解释不同的场景：同一成员名在不同层含义不同。验证反斜杠分隔成员名的字节保留与解析差异。
overview.en: The archive filename-encoding differential targets archive libraries, operating systems, and business layers interpreting backslashes, flag bits, or filename encodings differently, giving one member name different meanings per layer. It validates byte preservation and parsing of backslash-separated member names.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是归档库、操作系统和业务层对反斜杠、标志位或文件名编码解释不同；只有当解释差异使成员写入或读取跨越目录边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is archive libraries, operating systems, and business layers interpreting backslashes, flag bits, or filename encodings differently; risk holds only when interpretation gaps push member writes or reads across a directory boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的脚本构造以反斜杠分隔的成员名并输出 repr、flag_bits 与归档原始字节，确认归档库实际保留的文件名字节；再把归档交给目标解压流程，命中判据为某一层把反斜杠当分隔符折叠成目录结构并写出 PAYLOADER_MARKER。记录各层解析出的成员名对照；处理含中文或特殊编码文件名时同样保留原始字节证据。
exploitation.en: Construct backslash-separated member names with the step-1 script, outputting repr, flag_bits, and the archive's raw bytes to confirm what the archive library actually preserves; then hand the archive to the target extraction flow. A hit is any layer folding backslashes into directory structure and writing PAYLOADER_MARKER. Record each layer's parsed member names as a contrast; keep raw-byte evidence for non-ASCII or specially encoded names too.

mitigation.zh: 逐项规范化并验证成员目标，拒绝父目录、绝对路径和链接成员，统一各层对文件名编码的解释，并在独立临时目录使用安全解压 API。修复后重放第 1 步归档，确认反斜杠成员被按字面拒绝且正常解压可用。
mitigation.en: Normalize and verify each member target, reject parent-directory, absolute, and link members, unify filename-encoding interpretation across layers, and use safe extraction APIs in an isolated temp directory. After the fix, replay the step-1 archive and confirm backslash members are rejected literally while normal extraction works.

title.zh: 构造反斜杠成员名归档

description.zh: 打包文件名含反斜杠的 zip 并输出原始字节与标志位信息。命中判据：归档库完整保留了成员名字节，并且重复提交时可以稳定复现该结果。
description.en: Pack a zip with backslash-slash member names and dump raw bytes. Success: member-name bytes survive.

description.zh: 提交归档观察解压端是否把反斜杠拆分为路径分隔符。命中判据：成员文件被写到不同的目录层级，多次提交均能得到相同结果。
description.en: Submit it and watch whether backslashes become separators. Success: members land at different depths.

title.zh: 借拆分差异越出解压根
title.en: Escape the root via the split

description.zh: 调整成员名让解压写出路径越过解压根目录限制。命中判据：越界文件成功落盘且路径可访问，并且该效果可以稳定重复取得。
description.en: Tune member names so the split writes outside the root. Success: an escaped file lands on disk.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是原始成员名、解析后名称和最终写入路径与唯一 marker 任务相互关联，正常归档仍留在解压根内。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the raw member name, decoded name, and final write path correlate with the unique marker job while the normal archive remains inside the extraction root. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 超长编码被宽松解码器还原为 /。判据：成员越界解压。
description.en: Overlong form decoded to / by lenient parsers. Success: member escapes.

description.zh: 截断名内后缀。判据：落盘文件后缀变化。
description.en: Truncates the stored suffix. Success: on-disk suffix changes.

description.zh: 混合分隔符绕过单一形态检测。判据：路径遍历成功。
description.en: Mixed separators evade single-form checks. Success: traversal works.

name.zh: 上传声明类型不一致

description.zh: 上传声明类型不一致将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：客户端声明的 Content-Type 被当作可信文件类型而未与内容和扩展名交叉校验。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Declared-Type Mismatch narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the client-declared Content-Type is trusted without checking content and extension. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 上传声明类型不一致针对客户端声明 Content-Type 被当作可信文件类型的场景：声明与内容、扩展名可能不一致。验证以 image/jpeg 声明上传文本 marker 后服务端的分类与存储行为。
overview.en: Upload declared-type mismatch targets client-declared Content-Type treated as trusted file type, which can diverge from content and extension. It uploads a text marker declared as image/jpeg and contrasts the server's classification and storage behavior.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是客户端声明的 Content-Type 被当作可信文件类型而未与内容和扩展名交叉校验；只有当分类结果跨越类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is client-declared Content-Type treated as trusted file type without cross-checking content and extension; risk holds only when the classification crosses a type or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留 BASE 与 MARKER 变量，以 type=image/jpeg 声明上传文本 marker，再对照正常声明上传一份；命中判据为 HEAD 回读确认存储成功且声明类型被记录为分类依据，与另一份形成对照。记录声明类型、检测类型与存储名三个字段；若服务端把声明为图片的文件送入图片处理链，需单独评估解析器暴露面。
exploitation.en: Keeping the BASE and MARKER variables as in step 1, upload the text marker declared as type=image/jpeg, then upload a control with the honest declaration; a hit is HEAD read-back confirming storage with the declared type recorded as the classification basis, contrasting with the control. Record declared type, detected type, and stored name; if image-declared files enter the image-processing chain, separately assess parser exposure.

mitigation.zh: 生成服务端对象名，在目标文件系统语义下统一校验名称、内容和类型，声明仅作提示不作为依据；上传目录不可执行。修复后重放第 1 步两种声明，确认分类随真实内容而非声明变化且正常上传可用。
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names and validate name, content, and type uniformly under target filesystem semantics, treating declarations as hints only; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay both step-1 declarations and confirm classification follows real content, not declarations, while normal uploads work.

description.zh: 上传普通文件记录响应与存储信息，摸清入口参数与处理流程。命中判据：正常上传链路完整可用可重复，为下一步利用保留完整的输出内容。
description.en: Upload a benign file and capture response and storage info. Success: the normal flow works.

description.zh: 以 image/jpeg 声明上传文本内容文件并回读，测试声明是否被直接采信。命中判据：上传成功且类型按声明记录。
description.en: Upload a text body declared as image/jpeg and read it back. Success: it is stored under the declared type.

description.zh: 回读上传对象确认存储路径与元数据的实际形态。命中判据：对象按伪造的声明类型保存落盘，同时排除缓存或随机因素干扰。
description.en: Read the object back to confirm storage and metadata. Success: it persists under the fake type.

title.zh: 触发下游按假类型处理
title.en: Make downstream trust the fake type

description.zh: 让下游组件按错误的类型解析文件，触发异常或注入行为。命中判据：出现可被利用的解析偏差，整个过程可随时重复执行。
description.en: Let downstream parse it under the wrong type. Success: an exploitable parsing deviation appears.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

wafBypass.command:
Content-Type: image/jpeg
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="shell.php"

<?php system("id");?>

description.zh: 声明图片但文件名与内容均为 PHP。判据：执行成功。
description.en: Image MIME with PHP name and body. Success: executes.

description.zh: 缺失类型时后端按扩展名放行。判据：上传落盘。
description.en: Missing type falls back to extension checks. Success: stored on disk.

wafBypass.command:
Content-Type: image/x-ms-bmp
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="shell.bmp"

<?php system("id");?>

description.zh: 位图 MIME 掩护脚本内容。判据：可被包含执行。
description.en: BMP MIME covering script body. Success: includable and executable.

name.zh: 上传签名与内容不一致

description.zh: 上传签名与内容不一致将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：校验器只检查少量 magic bytes，而下游组件继续消费完整文件。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Signature-Content Mismatch narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the validator checks only a short magic-byte prefix while downstream components consume the full file. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 上传签名与内容不一致针对校验器只检查少量 magic bytes 而下游继续消费完整文件的场景：文件头与实际内容可以完全不同。验证 JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP 四种魔术头夹具在检测与解析两层的差异。
overview.en: Upload signature-content mismatch targets validators checking only a few magic bytes while downstream keeps consuming the full file—header and actual content can differ entirely. It contrasts detection versus parsing layers across JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP magic-header fixtures.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是校验器只检查少量 magic bytes，而下游组件继续消费完整文件；只有当两层差异使文件进入非预期处理器时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is validators checking only a few magic bytes while downstream components keep consuming the complete file; risk holds only when the two-layer difference routes the file into an unintended handler.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步生成 JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP 四种魔术头加 marker 尾部的夹具并输出文件大小与前 12 字节，确认头部按预期构造；再把四个夹具分别上传，命中判据为签名检测放行而下游解析行为与声明类型不符（解码失败或进入其他处理器）。记录每条的检测结论与下游处理结果对照。
exploitation.en: Generate the four fixtures—JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP magic headers with marker tails—per step 1, outputting file size and first 12 bytes to confirm construction; upload each fixture in turn. A hit is signature checks passing while downstream parsing diverges from the declared type (decode failure or entry into another handler). Record detection verdicts versus downstream handling per fixture as a contrast.

mitigation.zh: 生成服务端对象名，对上传内容执行完整解码校验而非仅查头部，并把上传目录设为不可执行。修复后重放第 1 步四类夹具，确认内容与签名不符的上传被拒绝且正常图片处理可用。
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names, perform full decoding validation on upload content rather than header-only checks, and keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay the step-1 fixtures and confirm uploads whose content mismatches the signature are rejected while normal image processing works.

description.zh: 生成 JPEG、PNG、GIF、BMP 四种魔术头加可控尾部的文件。命中判据：夹具头部合法而尾部内容可控。
description.en: Emit JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP headers with attacker-controlled tails. Success: headers pass while tails are yours.

description.zh: 提交夹具文件通过仅检查文件签名的上传检测流程。命中判据：文件被接受并成功落盘存储，并且输出内容完整可供利用。
description.en: Submit the fixtures against signature-only checks. Success: they are accepted and stored.

description.zh: 让下游按真实内容解析文件，触发注入代码或异常执行路径。命中判据：注入的尾部内容被解析执行，为后续深入利用打下基础。
description.en: Get downstream to parse the real content. Success: the injected tail is parsed or executed.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 魔数检测通过而内容为脚本。判据：解析器执行 PHP。
description.en: Magic bytes pass while the tail is script. Success: PHP executes.

description.zh: GIF 魔数掩护 SSI 指令。判据：shtml 解析执行。
description.en: GIF magic covering SSI directives. Success: executes as shtml.

description.zh: 同时是合法 PNG 与 PHP。判据：两种解析器各自成功。
description.en: Valid as both PNG and PHP. Success: both parsers succeed.

name.zh: 上传文件名解析差异

description.zh: 上传文件名解析差异将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：入口、存储层和静态文件服务器对多扩展名与文件名边界的解释不同。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Filename Parser Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: ingress, storage, and static serving layers interpret multiple extensions and filename boundaries differently. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 上传文件名解析差异针对入口、存储层和静态文件服务器对多扩展名与文件名边界解释不同的场景：同一文件名在不同层产生不同结论。验证多个 filename 变体的存储名与判定结果对照。
overview.en: The upload filename-parser differential targets entry, storage, and static file servers interpreting multi-extension names and filename boundaries differently—the same name yields different conclusions per layer. It contrasts stored names and verdicts across filename variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是入口、存储层和静态文件服务器对多扩展名与文件名边界的解释不同；只有当差异使最终文件跨越类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is entry, storage, and static file servers interpreting multi-extension names and filename boundaries differently; risk holds only when the difference pushes the final file past a type or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步复用受控夹具中的 BASE 与 MARKER 变量，以 txt.jpg、双扩展、大小写与分号变体逐一上传同一内容；命中判据为不同 filename 变体产生不同的存储名与判定结果，说明至少两层对边界解释不一致。每条上传后 HEAD 回读记录存储名、Content-Type 与处理器路由，形成解析差异矩阵。
exploitation.en: Reusing the fixture's BASE and MARKER variables as in step 1, upload the same content under txt.jpg, double-extension, case, and semicolon filename variants; a hit is different filename variants producing different stored names and verdicts, showing at least two layers disagree on the boundary. After each upload, HEAD-read back and record stored name, Content-Type, and handler routing to form a parsing-difference matrix.

mitigation.zh: 生成服务端对象名，在目标文件系统语义下统一校验名称、内容和类型，让入口与存储消费同一规范化结果；上传目录不可执行。修复后重放第 1 步全部变体，确认存储名与判定一致且正常上传可用。
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names, validate name, content, and type uniformly under target filesystem semantics, and have entry and storage consume the same normalized result; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay all step-1 variants and confirm stored names and verdicts agree while normal uploads work.

description.zh: 以不同的 filename 变体多次上传同一文件内容并回读。命中判据：变体之间产生了不同的存储文件名。
description.en: Upload the same body under different filename variants. Success: variants yield different stored names.

title.zh: 比对存储名找解析差异
title.en: Diff stored names for parser gaps

description.zh: 比对各层对文件名的解释结果，定位口径不一致的组件位置。命中判据：找到可以被利用的分歧层，并且重复提交时可以稳定复现该结果。
description.en: Compare how each layer interprets the names to find disagreeing components. Success: a divergent layer is found.

title.zh: 借差异落盘可执行文件
title.en: Land an executable via the gap

description.zh: 利用解释分歧让脚本扩展只被其中一层看到，绕过检查。命中判据：脚本文件成功存储且可访问，多次提交均能得到相同结果。
description.en: Use the divergence so only one layer sees the script extension. Success: the script file is stored.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: filename* 优先于 filename 造成解析差异。判据：落盘为 shell.php。
description.en: filename* wins over filename in some parsers. Success: saved as shell.php.

wafBypass.command:
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="a.jpg"
Content-Disposition: form-data; filename="b.php"

description.zh: 两个 Content-Disposition 各取所需。判据：以 php 落盘。
description.en: Two headers parsed differently. Success: stored as PHP.

description.zh: 重复 filename 参数取值差异。判据：php 后缀生效。
description.en: Repeated parameter picks differ. Success: .php suffix wins.

description.zh: 无引号形态绕过带引号匹配。判据：上传成功。
description.en: Unquoted form. Success: upload accepted.

name.zh: Multipart 内容类型解析差异

description.zh: Multipart 内容类型解析差异将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：代理、Web 服务器和应用框架对 multipart 边界与部件类型的解析不一致。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Multipart Content-Type Parser Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the proxy, web server, and application framework parse multipart boundaries and part types differently. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: Multipart 内容类型解析差异针对代理、Web 服务器和应用框架对 multipart 边界与部件类型解析不一致的场景：手工构造的报文可被不同层拆解为不同部件。验证定长 multipart 报文在解析端的处理。
overview.en: The multipart content-type parser differential targets proxies, web servers, and application frameworks disagreeing on multipart boundaries and part types: a hand-crafted message can decompose differently per layer. It validates how the parser handles a fixed-length multipart message.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是代理、Web 服务器和应用框架对 multipart 边界与部件类型的解析不一致；只有当解析差异使部件被不同层归入不同类型或处理器时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is proxies, web servers, and application frameworks disagreeing on multipart boundaries and part types; risk holds only when parsing differences route a part into different types or handlers per layer.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步以原始 socket 向 127.0.0.1:8080 发送定长 multipart 报文（boundary 为 PAYLOADER_BOUNDARY）并回读完整响应；命中判据为应用端解析出的部件名、类型或存储结果与报文字面不一致，说明边界处理存在层间差异。对照 curl 标准上传的解析结果一并记录；同时核对 Content-Length 与实际字节数是否被各层一致采纳。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, send a fixed-length multipart message (boundary PAYLOADER_BOUNDARY) over a raw socket to 127.0.0.1:8080 and read back the full response; a hit is the application's parsed part name, type, or storage result diverging from the message literal, showing cross-layer boundary-handling differences. Record alongside a curl standard-upload control; also verify Content-Length versus actual byte count is adopted consistently across layers.

mitigation.zh: 生成服务端对象名，对上传内容统一解析与校验，边界处理遵循规范并让各层消费同一结果；上传目录不可执行。修复后重放第 1 步手工报文与标准上传对照，确认解析结论一致且正常上传可用。
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names, parse and validate uploads uniformly, follow the specification for boundary handling, and have all layers consume one result; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay the step-1 hand-crafted message against a standard-upload control and confirm parsing agrees while normal uploads work.

title.zh: 手工构造 multipart 报文

description.zh: 以原始 socket 发送定长 multipart 报文并回读完整响应。命中判据：服务器接受手工构造的报文。
description.en: Send a hand-built, fixed-length multipart message over raw socket. Success: the server accepts it.

title.zh: 变换边界与长度试探差异

description.zh: 调整边界字符串、Content-Length 与类型头，测试解析口径差异。命中判据：出现可利用的解析分歧。
description.en: Vary boundary, Content-Length and type headers. Success: an exploitable parsing gap appears.

title.zh: 借解析差落盘脚本文件
title.en: Land a script via the gap

description.zh: 利用解析分歧让脚本文件绕过类型检查成功存储。命中判据：脚本落盘且存储路径可以被访问请求，并且该效果可以稳定重复取得。
description.en: Use the gap to store a script past type checks. Success: it lands at a reachable path.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。

wafBypass.command:
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=A

--B

<?php system("id");?>

description.zh: 声明与实际 boundary 不一致导致前后端解析差异。判据：后端按 B 解析出文件。
description.en: Declared vs actual boundary differ across parsers. Success: backend extracts the file.

description.zh: part 内双 Content-Type 取值差异。判据：以可执行类型落盘。
description.en: Two part-level types parsed differently. Success: stored as executable type.

description.zh: 仅 LF 的分隔被宽松解析器接受。判据：上传成功。
description.en: LF-only framing accepted by lenient parsers. Success: upload accepted.

name.zh: 文件元数据下游解析边界

description.zh: 文件元数据下游解析边界将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：入口只校验文件容器，而缩略图、索引或元数据提取器继续解析可控字段。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: File Metadata Downstream-Parser Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: ingress validates only the container while thumbnailing, indexing, or metadata extraction parses controlled fields. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

subCategory.zh: 文档活动内容与公式注入

overview.zh: 文件元数据下游解析边界针对入口只校验文件容器而缩略图、索引或元数据提取器继续解析可控字段的场景。验证用 exiftool 向 JPEG 三个元数据字段写入 marker 后的写入与回读。
overview.en: The file-metadata downstream-parser boundary targets entries validating only the file container while thumbnailers, indexers, or metadata extractors keep parsing attacker-controlled fields. It validates writing markers into three JPEG metadata fields with exiftool and reading them back.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是入口只校验文件容器，而缩略图、索引或元数据提取器继续解析可控字段；只有当字段内容进入有副作用的下游解析器时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the entry validating only the container while thumbnailers, indexers, or metadata extractors keep parsing controlled fields; risk holds only when field content reaches downstream parsers with side effects.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步复制夹具 JPG 到临时工作目录，用 exiftool 向 Comment、XMP Description 与 ICC ProfileDescription 写入 PAYLOADER_MARKER 并以 -json 回读；命中判据为三个字段均按预期写入且可被读取，证明元数据可控字段可到达下游解析器。随后在授权范围内让目标业务处理该文件，观察缩略图或索引层是否读取这些字段，并记录处理日志。
exploitation.en: Copy the fixture JPG into a temp working directory as in step 1, write PAYLOADER_MARKER into Comment, XMP Description, and ICC ProfileDescription with exiftool, and read back with -json; a hit is all three fields written and readable as expected, proving controllable metadata fields reach downstream parsers. Then have the target business process the file within scope, observing whether thumbnailing or indexing reads these fields, and record processing logs.

mitigation.zh: 生成服务端对象名，上传时剥离或重写非必要元数据字段，并对下游解析器启用严格字段允许列表；处理容器隔离运行。修复后重放第 1 步写入流程，确认受控字段被清除且正常图片功能可用。
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names, strip or rewrite non-essential metadata fields at upload, and enforce strict field allowlists on downstream parsers; run processing containers isolated. After the fix, replay the step-1 write flow and confirm controlled fields are removed while normal image features work.

description.zh: 用 exiftool 向 JPEG 的 Comment、XMP 与 ICC 字段写入内容并以 JSON 回读。命中判据：三个字段均写入成功。
description.en: Write marker content into Comment, XMP and ICC fields via exiftool. Success: all three fields accept it.

description.zh: 提交写入元数据的文件，触发下游组件解析其中的字段内容。命中判据：解析流程实际读取了注入字段，为下一步利用保留完整的输出内容。
description.en: Submit the file so downstream parses its metadata. Success: the injected fields are consumed.

title.zh: 借解析缺陷执行注入内容
title.en: Execute injected content via the flaw

description.zh: 让注入内容进入执行或请求路径，实现 SSRF 或代码执行效果。命中判据：注入产生可观测的副作用，同时排除缓存或随机因素干扰。
description.en: Steer injected content into execution or request paths. Success: an observable side effect fires.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.en: Confirmation requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 注释字段注入活动内容被下游渲染。判据：查看器执行脚本。
description.en: Comment field payload rendered downstream. Success: viewer executes it.

description.zh: 关键词字段携带 PHP。判据：被包含时执行。
description.en: Keyword field carries PHP. Success: executes when included.

description.zh: 文本块注入脚本。判据：展示时执行。
description.en: Text chunk carries script. Success: executes on display.

name.zh: 上传文件名空字节边界

description.zh: 上传文件名空字节边界将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：文件名在 HTTP、字符串 API 和底层文件接口之间因 NUL 字节产生截断差异。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Filename Null-Byte Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: a filename is truncated differently across HTTP, string APIs, and native file interfaces because of a NUL byte. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 上传文件名空字节边界针对文件名在 HTTP、字符串 API 和底层文件接口之间因 NUL 字节产生截断差异的场景：校验名与存储名可能不同。验证含 NUL 的 multipart 报文在两层的截断结果。
overview.en: The upload filename null-byte boundary targets filenames diverging across HTTP, string APIs, and low-level file interfaces due to NUL-byte truncation, so validated and stored names can differ. It contrasts truncation results at the two layers with NUL-bearing multipart messages.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是文件名在 HTTP、字符串 API 和底层文件接口之间因 NUL 字节产生截断差异；只有当截断使存储名越过类型或目录边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is filenames diverging across HTTP, string APIs, and low-level file interfaces due to NUL truncation; risk holds only when truncation pushes the stored name past a type or directory boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步以原始 socket 发送文件名含 NUL 字节的 multipart 报文并回读完整响应，记录应用层返回的存储名与文件系统层实际落盘名；命中判据为两层截断点不同导致存储名与校验名不一致（如 NUL 后的扩展名被截去或保留）。对照正常无 NUL 上传形成基线；阴性时记录运行时版本说明 NUL 已被统一拒绝。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, send a multipart message with a NUL byte in the filename over a raw socket and read back the full response, recording the application-layer stored name versus the actual on-disk name; a hit is different truncation points at the two layers making the stored name diverge from the validated name (e.g., the post-NUL extension truncated or kept). Contrast with a normal no-NUL upload baseline; when negative, record the runtime version showing NUL is uniformly rejected.

mitigation.zh: 拒绝控制字节和动态路径，文件名在所有层消费同一规范化结果，改用服务端对象名；上传目录不可执行。修复后重放第 1 步 NUL 报文与正常对照，确认截断差异消失且正常上传可用。
mitigation.en: Reject control bytes and dynamic paths, have all layers consume one normalized filename, and switch to server-side object names; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay the step-1 NUL message against a normal control and confirm the truncation divergence is gone while normal uploads work.

title.zh: 发送含空字节文件名报文

description.zh: 以原始 socket 提交文件名含 NUL 字节的 multipart 报文并回读。命中判据：服务器未拒绝该报文。
description.en: Post a multipart message whose filename contains NUL via raw socket. Success: the server accepts it.

description.zh: 记录应用层与文件系统层对 NUL 的截断位置，找出解释差异。命中判据：两层截断口径存在不同，整个过程可随时重复执行。
description.en: Record where app and filesystem truncate at NUL. Success: the two layers disagree.

title.zh: 借截断落盘目标扩展名
title.en: Land the target extension via truncation

description.zh: 让校验层与落盘层看到不同的扩展名，实现脚本文件落盘。命中判据：目标扩展的文件成功存储，并且输出内容完整可供利用。
description.en: Make validation and storage see different extensions. Success: the script extension lands on disk.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是字节级请求、运行时解析日志和唯一 marker 输出三者一致，普通输入与缺失 marker 对照均失败。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the byte-level request, runtime parser log, and unique marker output agree while plain-input and missing-marker controls fail. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 空字节置于主名内绕过位置检测。判据：落盘后缀为 php。
description.en: Null inside the base name. Success: stored suffix becomes .php.

description.zh: 扩展名中间截断重组。判据：后缀还原为 php。
description.en: Splits and rejoins the extension. Success: suffix restored to php.

description.zh: 超长编码在旧解析器还原为截断。判据：php 生效。
description.en: Overlong form decodes to truncation on old parsers. Success: .php wins.

name.zh: 文件包含路径空字节边界

description.zh: 文件包含路径空字节边界将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：包含参数与自动追加后缀在不同运行时层被 NUL 截断。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: File-Include Path Null-Byte Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: an include parameter and an automatically appended suffix are truncated at different runtime layers by a NUL. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

overview.zh: 文件包含路径空字节边界针对包含参数与自动追加后缀在不同运行时层被 NUL 截断的场景：%00 可让校验后缀与实际打开文件不一致。验证 marker 正例、MISSING 负例与 %00 截断三类请求的对照。
overview.en: The file-include path null-byte boundary targets inclusion parameters and auto-appended suffixes truncated by NUL at different runtime layers, so the validated suffix and the actually opened file can differ. It contrasts marker-positive, MISSING-negative, and %00-truncation requests.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是包含参数与自动追加后缀在不同运行时层被 NUL 截断；只有当截断使最终打开文件越过类型或目录边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is inclusion parameters and auto-appended suffixes being NUL-truncated at different runtime layers; risk holds only when truncation pushes the finally opened file past a type or directory boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步先发送 marker 正例建立基线，再发送 MISSING 负例确认错误行为，最后发送 %00 截断路径变体；命中判据为 %00 变体在当前运行时返回 marker 内容而非拼接路径错误，比对解析日志确认截断发生。阴性时记录 PHP 版本，因为现代 PHP 通常拒绝 NUL，不能把旧版本语义套到当前目标。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, first send the marker-positive request to set a baseline, then the MISSING negative to confirm error behavior, and finally the %00-truncation variant; a hit is the %00 variant returning marker content on the current runtime rather than a concatenated-path error, with parse logs confirming truncation. When negative, record the PHP version—modern PHP usually rejects NUL, so legacy semantics must not be assumed for the current target.

mitigation.zh: 拒绝控制字节和动态路径，改用逻辑标识允许列表，并让所有组件消费同一规范化结果。修复后重放第 1 步三类请求，确认 %00 变体被拒绝且正常包含保持可用。
mitigation.en: Reject control bytes and dynamic paths, switch to logical-identifier allowlists, and have all components consume the same normalized result. After the fix, replay the step-1 request trio and confirm the %00 variant is rejected while normal inclusion keeps working.

description.zh: 用正常路径请求摸清包含接口的参数与响应形态差异。命中判据：包含内容随参数取值发生变化，为后续深入利用打下基础。
description.en: Probe the include endpoint with normal paths. Success: included content tracks the parameter.

description.zh: 以 %00 截断形式提交包含路径，并以正反例判别截断效果。命中判据：截断后的路径被服务端接受处理，并且重复提交时可以稳定复现该结果。
description.en: Submit %00-truncated include paths, judging effect with positive and negative probes. Success: truncation takes hold.

title.zh: 命中截断包含目标文件

description.zh: 调整截断位置让包含命中预期的文件或脚本。命中判据：目标内容被执行或成功返回响应，多次提交均能得到相同结果。
description.en: Tune the truncation point so the include hits the intended file. Success: its content runs or returns.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the byte-level request, runtime parser log, and unique marker output agree while plain-input and missing-marker controls fail. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 二次解码还原 %00。判据：包含 shell 而非 shell.php 模板。
description.en: Second decode restores the null. Success: includes shell instead of the template.

description.zh: 编码遍历加截断。判据：越目录包含成功。
description.en: Encoded traversal plus truncation. Success: cross-directory include works.

description.zh: 过滤器内截断白名单后缀。判据：读出 config 源码。
description.en: Truncates inside the filter wrapper. Success: config source read.

name.zh: 文件路径长度截断差异

description.zh: 文件路径长度截断差异将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：超长路径在校验、数据库和文件系统边界采用不同长度限制或截断策略。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: File Path-Length Truncation Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: overlong paths encounter different limits or truncation policies in validation, persistence, and filesystem layers. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

subCategory.zh: 文件名与文件系统边界

overview.zh: 文件路径长度截断差异针对超长路径在校验、数据库和文件系统边界采用不同长度限制的场景：截断点不同导致最终文件名不同。验证 /./ 填充、长字母尾缀与多点尾缀三类超长变体。
overview.en: File path-length truncation differentials target overlong paths hitting different length limits across validation, database, and filesystem boundaries—different truncation points yield different final filenames. It validates three overlong variant classes: /./ padding, long letter suffixes, and multi-dot suffixes.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是超长路径在校验、数据库和文件系统边界采用不同长度限制或截断策略；只有当截断使最终文件名越过目录或类型边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is overlong paths hitting different length limits or truncation policies across validation, database, and filesystem boundaries; risk holds only when truncation pushes the final filename past a directory or type boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的验证块逐条提交 /./ 填充、长字母尾缀与多点尾缀三类超长路径变体，每条记录发送长度与最终解析文件名；命中判据为某一变体在截断后指向根目录外的 PAYLOADER_MARKER。对照校验层接受的长度与文件系统实际处理的长度；阴性时记录各层长度上限，作为现代系统已统一截断的证据。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, submit the three overlong variant classes—/./ padding, long letter suffixes, and multi-dot suffixes—one by one, recording sent length and final resolved filename per request; a hit is any variant pointing at the out-of-root PAYLOADER_MARKER after truncation. Contrast the length accepted at validation versus what the filesystem actually processed; when negative, record each layer's length cap as evidence modern systems truncate uniformly.

mitigation.zh: 拒绝控制字节和动态路径，改用逻辑标识允许列表，统一各层长度上限并在打开前校验最终路径。修复后重放第 1 步全部超长变体，确认截断差异消失且合法读取保持可用。
mitigation.en: Reject control bytes and dynamic paths, switch to logical-identifier allowlists, unify length caps across layers, and validate the final path before opening. After the fix, replay all step-1 overlong variants and confirm the truncation divergence is gone while legitimate reads keep working.

description.zh: 找到对超长路径敏感的读取或包含入口并摸清行为。命中判据：超长路径没有被入口直接拒绝，并且该效果可以稳定重复取得。
description.en: Find a read/include entry that tolerates very long paths. Success: long paths are not rejected outright.

description.zh: 以 /./ 填充、字母与多点尾缀构造超长路径变体提交。命中判据：某个填充长度触发了截断行为，为下一步利用保留完整的输出内容。
description.en: Submit /./ padding, letter and multi-dot suffix variants. Success: a length triggers truncation.

title.zh: 命中截断长度访问目标
title.en: Hit targets at the truncation length

description.zh: 按命中的长度构造路径访问受限目录中的目标文件。命中判据：目标文件内容成功返回到响应，同时排除缓存或随机因素干扰。
description.en: Build paths at the working length to reach restricted files. Success: target content returns.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是字节级请求、运行时解析日志和唯一 marker 输出三者一致，普通输入与缺失 marker 对照均失败。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the byte-level request, runtime parser log, and unique marker output agree while plain-input and missing-marker controls fail. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 超长路径触发截断差异。判据：截断后仍指向目标文件。
description.en: Overlong path triggers truncation. Success: still resolves to the target after truncation.

description.zh: 超长文件名在旧系统截断。判据：截断后保留 .txt 之前可利用形态。
description.en: Long name truncates on legacy systems. Success: exploitable form survives.

description.zh: 超过 260 触发不同解析。判据：长路径被规范化绕过。
description.en: Beyond 260 chars changes parsing. Success: normalization bypassed.

name.zh: Windows 尾随名称规范化

description.zh: Windows 尾随名称规范化将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：尾随点、空格、大小写和短文件名在 Windows 路径解析中被折叠。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Windows Trailing-Name Normalization narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: trailing dots, spaces, case, and short names are folded during Windows path resolution. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

subCategory.zh: 文件名与文件系统边界

overview.zh: Windows 尾随名称规范化针对尾随点、空格、大小写和短文件名在 Windows 路径解析中被折叠的场景：上传校验名与存储名可能不同。验证五类尾随变体上传后的最终存储名。
overview.en: Windows trailing-name normalization targets trailing dots, spaces, case, and short names folded during Windows path resolution, so upload-validated and stored names can differ. It validates final stored names across five trailing variant classes.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是尾随点、空格、大小写和短文件名在 Windows 路径解析中被折叠；只有当折叠使存储名越过类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is trailing dots, spaces, case, and short names folded during Windows path resolution; risk holds only when folding pushes the stored name past a type or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的脚本逐个上传尾随点、尾随空格、::$DATA、大写与 /./ 长路径五种变体并打印状态码，每条上传后回读存储名；命中判据为某一变体的最终存储名与提交名不一致（如尾随点被折叠、大小写被改写），说明校验层与文件系统层对名称解释不同。记录两层的名称对照与 Windows 版本。
exploitation.en: Upload the five variants—trailing dot, trailing space, ::$DATA, uppercase, and /./ long path—one by one with the step-1 script printing status codes, reading back stored names after each; a hit is a final stored name diverging from the submitted name (trailing dot folded, case rewritten), showing the validation and filesystem layers interpret names differently. Record both layers' names plus the Windows version.

mitigation.zh: 生成服务端对象名，在目标文件系统语义下统一校验名称、内容和类型，显式拒绝尾随点空格；上传目录不可执行。修复后重放第 1 步五种变体，确认存储名与判定一致且正常上传可用。
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names, validate name, content, and type uniformly under target filesystem semantics, and explicitly reject trailing dots and spaces; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay the step-1 variants and confirm stored names and verdicts agree while normal uploads work.

description.zh: 逐个上传尾随点、尾随空格、::$DATA、大写与长路径五种变体并打印状态。命中判据：部分变体被接受。
description.en: Upload trailing dot/space, ::$DATA, case and long-path variants. Success: some variants are accepted.

description.zh: 回读各变体确定服务端折叠规则与最终存储名称。命中判据：折叠规则可以被明确归纳出来，整个过程可随时重复执行。
description.en: Read back each variant to infer the folding rules. Success: the folding behavior is pinned down.

description.zh: 用折叠差异让受限扩展名在校验之后落盘生效。命中判据：目标扩展文件可以被访问执行，并且输出内容完整可供利用。
description.en: Use folding so a restricted extension survives validation. Success: the target file is reachable.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 冒号点形态归一化差异。判据：访问到同一文件流。
description.en: Colon-dot normalization differential. Success: same stream accessed.

description.zh: 多点序列剥离后等价。判据：读取成功。
description.en: Dots stripped to the equivalent name. Success: read succeeds.

description.zh: 编码尾缀绕过明文检测。判据：访问成功。
description.en: Encoded suffix. Success: access succeeds.

name.zh: NTFS ADS 名称边界

description.zh: NTFS ADS 名称边界将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：冒号与流类型在应用文件名校验和 NTFS Alternate Data Streams 解析之间含义不同。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: NTFS ADS Name Boundary narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: colons and stream types have different meanings in application checks and NTFS Alternate Data Streams resolution. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

subCategory.zh: 文件名与文件系统边界

overview.zh: NTFS ADS 名称边界针对冒号与流类型在应用文件名校验和 NTFS Alternate Data Streams 解析之间含义不同的场景。验证 ::$DATA、命名流、::INDEX_ALLOCATION、%00 截断与短名变体的两层解释差异。
overview.en: The NTFS ADS name boundary targets colons and stream types meaning different things in application filename validation versus NTFS Alternate Data Streams parsing. It contrasts two-layer interpretations across ::$DATA, named streams, ::INDEX_ALLOCATION, %00 truncation, and short-name variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是冒号与流类型在应用文件名校验和 NTFS Alternate Data Streams 解析之间含义不同；只有当解释差异使内容写入或读取越过类型边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is colons and stream types meaning different things in application filename validation versus NTFS ADS parsing; risk holds only when interpretation gaps push content writes or reads past a type boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的验证块逐条提交 PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt. . . .、::$DATA、::$DATA.txt、%00 截断与 PAYLOA~1 短名变体，每条上传后 HEAD 回读；命中判据为某一变体在应用层与 NTFS 层产生不同的存储或读取结果（如内容写入默认流、流内容按主文件返回）。记录两层的解释对照与目标文件系统类型。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, submit the variants—PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt. . . ., ::$DATA, ::$DATA.txt, %00 truncation, and the PAYLOA~1 short name—one by one, HEAD-reading back after each; a hit is any variant producing different storage or read results at the application layer versus the NTFS layer (content written to the default stream, stream content returned as the main file). Record both layers' interpretations plus the target filesystem type.

mitigation.zh: 生成服务端对象名，文件名校验拒绝冒号与保留流语法，并在目标文件系统语义下统一校验；上传目录不可执行。修复后重放第 1 步全部变体，确认被统一拒绝且正常上传可用。
mitigation.en: Generate server-side object names, reject colons and reserved stream syntax in filename validation, and validate uniformly under target filesystem semantics; keep upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay all step-1 variants and confirm uniform rejection while normal uploads work.

title.zh: 提交 ADS 变体矩阵

description.zh: 以 ::$DATA、命名流、截断与短名变体提交请求，观察接受情况。命中判据：某个变体被服务端接受处理。
description.en: Submit ::$DATA, named-stream, truncation and short-name variants. Success: a variant is accepted.

description.zh: 记录应用层与 NTFS 层对同一名称的不同解释，定位分歧点。命中判据：两层解释口径存在不一致，为后续深入利用打下基础。
description.en: Compare how the app and NTFS interpret the same names. Success: the layers disagree.

title.zh: 借差异绕过扩展名检查
title.en: Evade extension checks via the gap

description.zh: 让检查层与文件系统看到不同的名称，使受限名称生效。命中判据：受限名称成功落盘并可以使用，并且重复提交时可以稳定复现该结果。
description.en: Make the checker and filesystem see different names. Success: the restricted name takes effect.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.zh: 写入 shell.php 的命名流而表面为 jpg。判据：shell.php 存在且流可执行。
description.en: Writes a named stream of shell.php shown as jpg. Success: stream executable.

description.zh: DATA 流后接后缀欺骗校验。判据：数据流写入。
description.en: DATA stream with fake suffix. Success: stream written.

description.zh: 命名流内容不出现在目录枚举。判据：dir 不可见但可读。
description.en: Named stream hidden from enumeration. Success: readable but not listed.

name.zh: 通用 XML 本地文件实体

description.zh: 归并 Linux 与 Windows file URI 的最小 root 文档，验证通用 XML parser 的外部通用实体文件读取边界。
description.en: Groups minimal root documents with Linux and Windows file URIs to test external-general-entity file reads in a generic XML parser.

overview.zh: 覆盖通用 XML 解析器的本地文件实体读取验证：以最小 root 文档承载 Linux 与 Windows file URI 实体，回显 marker 内容确认读取能力。适用于系统存在多个 XML 入口时按入口逐一盘点的场景。
overview.en: Covers local file-entity read verification for generic XML parsers: a minimal root document carrying Linux and Windows file URI entities, with echoed marker content confirming read capability. Suitable for inventorying multiple XML entry points one by one.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是各入口可能复用不安全的 XML 工厂、resolver 或高权限转换服务，允许外部通用实体展开；某一格式命中不能推断其他入口，每个解析器需独立验证。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is entry points possibly sharing unsafe XML factories, resolvers, or high-privilege conversion services that allow external general entity expansion; a hit in one format does not imply others, and each parser needs independent verification.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以通用 XML 本地实体读取两个平台路径；解析后回显 marker 内容即确认本地实体读取可用。执行前把两个系统路径按目标平台改为工作目录内不同随机 marker 文件，并按实际通用 XML 入口分别提交，逐入口记录结果。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to read two platform paths via generic XML local entities; echoed marker content after parsing confirms local entity reads. Before running, replace both system paths with different random marker files inside the working directory per target platform, submit at each actual generic XML entry, and record results per entry.

mitigation.zh: 在共享 XML 工厂层统一禁用 DTD、外部实体与 XInclude，对 resolver 实施协议与路径默认拒绝；修复后各入口重放文件实体应报禁止错误，并维护入口级回归矩阵。
mitigation.en: Disable DTDs, external entities, and XInclude uniformly at the shared XML factory layer, default-deny protocols and paths in resolvers; after the fix, replaying file entities at each entry must raise forbidden errors, with an entry-level regression matrix maintained.

description.zh: 在目标站点寻找接收XML的接口，如SOAP端点、文件上传或REST API，提交一份结构正常的XML文档，响应正常解析无报错即锁定注入入口。
description.en: Look for endpoints that accept XML, such as SOAP services, uploads, or REST APIs; a well-formed document parsing cleanly locks in the injection entry.

title.zh: 注入外部实体读取系统文件
title.en: Inject an external entity to read system files

description.zh: 用执行区的通用XML实体载荷，在DOCTYPE中声明xxe实体指向file:///etc/passwd并引用，响应中回显该文件内容即确认本地文件读取成立。
description.en: Use the execution payload to declare an xxe entity pointing at file:///etc/passwd inside the DOCTYPE and reference it; the file's contents echoed in the response confirm local file read.

title.zh: 替换目标收集敏感配置
title.en: Swap targets to harvest sensitive configs

description.zh: 把实体SYSTEM路径改为win.ini、应用配置或数据库连接文件，继续用第2步的载荷逐个读取，拿到凭据与密钥即完成扩大战果。
description.en: Point the entity at win.ini, app configs, or database connection files and rerun the step-2 payload; retrieved credentials and keys mark the expanded haul.

title.zh: 利用读取成果横向移动

description.zh: 用读到的数据库账号尝试远程登录，或以配置密钥伪造会话令牌，任一登录成功即从文件读取推进到内网立足阶段。
description.en: Try the harvested database accounts remotely or forge session tokens with the leaked keys; any successful login advances the attack into internal network foothold.

prerequisites.zh: 已按实际入口把基础 XML、SVG、Office XML、远程 DTD 和协议 scheme 分配给对应 parser/worker，不将整套集合一次性投递。
prerequisites.en: Basic XML, SVG, Office XML, remote DTD, and protocol schemes are mapped to their actual parser or worker entry and the full collection is never submitted at once.

prerequisites.zh: 每个格式使用独立合法 fixture、沙箱 marker 和唯一任务/回调 token，记录 parser 能力矩阵、文件/网络审计和派生输出。
prerequisites.en: Each format uses an independent valid fixture, sandbox marker, and unique job or callback token, recording a parser capability matrix, file or network audit, and derived output.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求已识别通用 XML parser 的进程读取对应 marker 且值进入解析结果；路径文本、DOCTYPE 接受或 open 失败不是内容读取。
analysis.en: A positive requires the identified generic XML parser process to read the corresponding marker and place its value in parsed output; path text, accepted DOCTYPE, or failed open is not a content read.

opsecTips.zh: XXE 综合矩阵每轮只测试一个格式/机制并使用 marker；禁止真实文件、元数据、gopher 和公共目标，出现扩张、外连或 worker 压力时停止。
opsecTips.en: The XXE matrix tests one format and mechanism per run with a marker; real files, metadata, gopher, and public targets are forbidden, and testing stops on expansion, egress, or worker pressure.

opsecTips.zh: 逐格式删除 fixture、marker、DTD/token 和派生产物，关闭监听器，清理各 parser/任务缓存与日志，并更新能力矩阵。
opsecTips.en: Delete per-format fixtures, markers, DTDs, tokens, and derived artifacts, close listeners, clear each parser and job cache plus logs, and update the capability matrix.

title.zh: 无 XML 声明压缩形态

description.zh: 去掉 <?xml 声明并压缩空白，规避“声明+DOCTYPE”完整结构匹配；成功判据：passwd 内容回显。
description.en: Drops the <?xml declaration and whitespace to evade matching of the full declaration+DOCTYPE structure. Success: passwd contents echoed.

description.zh: 利用 file:/ 与 file:/// 等价性绕过 file:/// 固定前缀检测；成功判据：文件内容仍被读取。
description.en: Exploits equivalence of file:/ and file:/// to bypass the fixed file:/// prefix check. Success: the file is still read.

description.zh: 换读 /proc/self/environ 规避对 /etc/passwd 路径的专项规则；成功判据：环境变量内容回显。
description.en: Reads /proc/self/environ instead to dodge rules specific to /etc/passwd. Success: environment variables are echoed.

name.zh: SVG 本地文件外部实体

description.zh: 隔离 SVG text 节点中的 file URI 实体，验证 SVG 图片处理 worker 的服务端实体展开。
description.en: Isolates a file-URI entity in an SVG text node to test server-side entity expansion by an SVG image worker.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SVG 图片处理链的服务端实体展开验证：以 SVG text 节点承载本地文件实体，栅格或预览结果文本中出现 marker 即确认入口可读本地文件。适用于头像、图标等服务端处理 SVG 的场景。
overview.en: Covers server-side entity expansion verification in SVG image-processing chains: an SVG text node carrying a local file entity, with marker content appearing in rasterized or preview output confirming the entry reads local files. Suitable for server-side SVG processing such as avatars and icons.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 SVG 图片 worker 服务端解析 XML 时允许外部实体，text 节点内的实体在栅格化时展开；图片处理进程具备文件读取权限时即形成读取原语。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the SVG image worker's server-side XML parsing allowing external entities, expanding entities inside text nodes during rasterization; any file-read permission on the image-processing process becomes a read primitive.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 SVG 文本节点承载本地文件实体，把 /etc/passwd 改为图片 worker 沙箱中的随机 marker.txt；触发一次预览或栅格任务，结果文本中出现 marker 内容即确认 SVG 入口可读本地文件。若预览为图片输出，可对比像素或 OCR 提取文本判断。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to carry a local file entity in an SVG text node, replacing /etc/passwd with a random marker.txt inside the image worker's sandbox; trigger a preview or rasterization job, and marker content in the output text confirms the SVG entry reads local files. If the preview is an image, compare pixels or OCR the text to judge.

mitigation.zh: SVG 处理器禁用 DTD 与外部实体，图片 worker 无网络、低权限并以最小文件视图运行；修复后实体 SVG 处理应报错或输出不含 marker 内容。
mitigation.en: Disable DTDs and external entities in the SVG processor, and run image workers network-free with low privileges and a minimal file view; after the fix, processing entity-bearing SVGs must error or produce output without marker content.

description.zh: 寻找接受SVG上传并做预览、栅格化或缩略图的接口，先提交一张正常SVG确认处理成功，任务正常完成即锁定承载实体的入口。
description.en: Find an interface that uploads SVGs for preview, rasterization, or thumbnails; a normal SVG processing cleanly locks in the entity carrier.

title.en: Upload the SVG to trigger file read

description.zh: 用执行区的SVG实体载荷，把外部实体藏在text节点内上传并触发预览，渲染文本或处理日志中出现目标文件内容即确认读取。
description.en: Use the execution payload hiding the external entity inside a text node and trigger the preview; the file contents appearing in rendered text or logs confirm the read.

description.zh: 将file:///etc/passwd换成应用配置、环境文件或密钥路径，沿用第2步的载荷重新上传，收集到的凭据即进入下一阶段利用素材。
description.en: Swap the file URI for app configs, env files, or key paths and re-upload with the step-2 payload; collected credentials fuel the next stage.

title.zh: 转向盲读取建立外带通道
title.en: Build an out-of-band channel for blind reads

description.zh: 若预览不回显内容，把实体改为指向外部HTTP端点的形式，用自己的接收服务确认解析器发起请求，为盲读取搭建外带回连通道。
description.en: If the preview gives no echo, point the entity at an attacker HTTP endpoint and watch the receiver; a hit confirms an out-of-band channel for blind reads.

prerequisites.zh: 已按实际入口把基础 XML、SVG、Office XML、远程 DTD 和协议 scheme 分配给对应 parser/worker，不将整套集合一次性投递。
prerequisites.en: Basic XML, SVG, Office XML, remote DTD, and protocol schemes are mapped to their actual parser or worker entry and the full collection is never submitted at once.

prerequisites.zh: 每个格式使用独立合法 fixture、沙箱 marker 和唯一任务/回调 token，记录 parser 能力矩阵、文件/网络审计和派生输出。
