analysis.en: State the PHP API, configuration prerequisite, and actual result for each line. Source read, stream parsing, archive access, and code interpretation are distinct risks and should not share one severity automatically.

opsecTips.zh: 使用只含固定标记的测试文件/归档，不读取配置或提交可执行系统命令。
opsecTips.en: Use test files and archives containing only fixed markers; do not read configuration or submit executable system commands.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只验证一个 wrapper，并在结束后删除上传的测试归档和请求体缓存。
opsecTips.en: Validate one wrapper at a time and remove uploaded test archives and request-body caches afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对 php://filter 前缀的封锁：借压缩包装器读取 gzip 编码源；解压后得到源码即成功。
description.en: Read through the compression wrapper past php://filter blocks; decompressing the result yields the source.

description.zh: 绕过对 convert.base64 单段特征的规则：前置字符过滤器改变链形态；解码输出为源码即成功。
description.en: Prepend a string filter to change the chain shape past single-segment signatures; a decoded source output confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 config.php 明文资源名匹配：文件名百分号编码；Base64 解码得源码即成功。
description.en: Percent-encode the resource filename past plaintext matching; decoding the output yields the source.

name.zh: PHP 上传文件名与扩展名绕过
name.en: PHP Upload Filename and Extension Bypass

description.zh: 使用替代 PHP 扩展、双扩展、大小写、控制字符、分号、冒号与 NTFS ADS 变体，验证上传校验与 Web 服务器执行映射是否一致。
description.en: Uses alternative PHP extensions, double extensions, casing, controls, semicolons, colons, and NTFS ADS variants to test consistency between upload validation and web-server execution mapping.

subCategory.zh: 上传扩展名与文件名解析差异
subCategory.en: Upload Extension and Filename Parsing Differentials

overview.zh: PHP 上传文件名与扩展名绕过针对上传校验与 Web 服务器执行映射不一致的场景：替代扩展、双扩展、大小写与控制字符可改变处理器路由。验证多个文件名变体的存储名、Content-Type 与处理器对照。
overview.en: PHP upload filename and extension bypass targets inconsistencies between upload validation and web-server execution mapping: alternative extensions, double extensions, case, and control characters can change handler routing. It contrasts stored names, Content-Type, and handlers across filename variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是仅检查最后扩展名或原始文件名，而下游对大小写、分号、控制字符、双扩展或 NTFS 数据流采用不同规则；若上传目录可执行，校验为图片的文件仍可能映射到 PHP 处理器。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is checking only the final extension or raw filename while downstream applies different rules for case, semicolons, control characters, double extensions, or NTFS data streams; if upload directories are executable, files validated as images can still map to the PHP handler.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步以 shell.php5、shell.phtml、shell.pht、shell.php.jpg 等变体逐个上传同一无害文本标记；每条记录入口校验名、规范存储名、响应 Content-Type 和是否落入可执行处理器。命中判据为同一内容在不同文件名下产生不同的存储名、Content-Type 与处理器路由，说明校验与执行映射不一致。确认后对落入手器的文件回传 cmd 参数验证执行，或改测大小写与 ADS 变体扩大对照。
exploitation.en: Upload the same harmless text marker under shell.php5, shell.phtml, shell.pht, shell.php.jpg, and similar variants one by one per step 1; record the entry-validated name, canonical stored name, response Content-Type, and whether the file lands in an executable handler each time. A hit is the same content producing different stored names, Content-Type, and handler routing under different filenames, showing validation and execution mapping disagree. After confirmation, verify execution by requesting the handler-routed file with a cmd parameter, or broaden the contrast with case and ADS variants.

mitigation.zh: 使用服务端随机对象 ID 存储在 Web 根目录之外，上传目录明确不可执行；按允许列表同时验证规范扩展名、MIME 和内容签名，拒绝控制字符、保留名、ADS 和多重扩展；下载通过固定处理器设置安全 Content-Type 与附件头。修复后重放第 1 步全部变体。
mitigation.en: Store uploads under random server-side object IDs outside the web root with explicitly non-executable upload directories; validate canonical extension, MIME, and content signature together against an allowlist, rejecting control characters, reserved names, ADS, and multi-extensions; serve downloads through a fixed handler with safe Content-Type and attachment headers. After the fix, replay all step-1 variants.

description.zh: 上传正常图片与被拒的php文件记录校验行为，区分黑白名单与Content-Type检查，即明确需要绕过的规则类型。
description.en: Upload a normal image and a rejected php file to see the checks; black/white list versus content-type defines the bypass target.

title.en: Submit filename variants one by one

description.zh: 用执行区载荷依次上传php5、phtml、%00截断等变体，任一文件落盘且可被访问执行即找到绕过的后缀形式。
description.en: Upload php5, phtml, and null-truncation variants per the execution payload; any file landing and executing finds the bypass.

title.en: Connect to the webshell to run commands

description.zh: 访问第2步落地的脚本并传参执行whoami等命令，输出正常返回即完成从上传到服务器控制的推进。
description.en: Visit the landed script and run whoami via parameters; normal output completes upload-to-control.

prerequisites.zh: 目标允许上传文件并可观察最终存储名与服务方式
prerequisites.en: The target permits uploads and exposes the final stored name and serving behavior.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离实例使用无害文本标记而非 WebShell 作为文件内容
prerequisites.en: An isolated instance uses harmless text markers rather than webshell content.

analysis.zh: 上传成功、文件可访问和代码可执行是三个不同阶段。报告必须给出最终规范文件名、存储位置与处理器证据，不能从扩展名推断执行。
analysis.en: Upload acceptance, file accessibility, and code execution are separate stages. Report the final canonical name, storage location, and handler evidence rather than inferring execution from an extension.

opsecTips.zh: 测试内容只能是无害文本或服务器端固定标记，不上传 WebShell 或命令执行代码。
opsecTips.en: Test content must be harmless text or a fixed server-side marker; do not upload webshell or command-execution code.

opsecTips.zh: 每个测试文件完成后立即删除，并确认 CDN、对象存储和备份中无残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete each test file immediately afterward and verify no residue remains in CDN, object storage, or backups.

name.zh: LFI PHP Filter 转换边界

description.zh: 使用 ROT13、字符集转换、压缩加 Base64 和无显式转换的 filter URI，验证过滤链实际输出及资源读取边界。
description.en: Uses ROT13, character-set conversion, compression plus Base64, and a filter URI without an explicit transform to verify actual filter output and resource-read boundaries.

subCategory.zh: PHP 流包装器与远程包含

overview.zh: LFI PHP Filter 转换边界针对过滤链实际输出与资源读取边界的验证场景：ROT13、字符集转换与压缩加 Base64 各自产出不同形态。验证四条 filter URI 与离线预期字节的比对。
overview.en: The LFI PHP filter transformation boundary targets validating actual filter-chain output and resource-read boundaries: ROT13, charset conversion, and compression-plus-Base64 each yield different forms. It compares four filter URIs against offline expected bytes.

vulnerability.zh: 当用户能控制 resource 和 filter 链且文件根目录未受约束时，应用可能以变换后的形式泄露本地内容或绕过简单响应检查；仅收到乱码、空响应或 PHP warning 不证明目标文件被读取。
vulnerability.en: When users control resource and filter chain without file-root constraints, the application may leak local content in transformed form or bypass simple response checks; garbled output, empty responses, or PHP warnings alone do not prove the target file was read.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步把四条 filter URI 中的 index.php 替换为隔离标记资源，按原顺序逐条执行并离线计算每条链的预期输出字节；命中判据为转换后字节与离线预期完全一致，证明过滤器链被应用且资源读取受控可复现。不带显式转换的最后一条作为解析对照，不自动视为绕过；全部比对结果记录为转换基线，用于后续检测规则验证。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, replace index.php in the four filter URIs with an isolated marker resource, execute them in original order, and compute each chain's expected output bytes offline; a hit is transformed bytes exactly matching offline expectations, proving the filter chain applied and resource reads are reproducibly controlled. The final URI without explicit conversion serves as a parsing control, not automatically a bypass; record all comparison results as transformation baselines for later detection-rule validation.

mitigation.zh: 外部输入只选择预定义文件对象和转换选项，服务端组装固定 filter 链并校验规范路径位于根目录内；不允许任意 wrapper、filter 名称或 resource。修复后重放第 1 步四条 URI 并比较所有转换基线，确认任意链被拒绝且正常转换功能可用。
mitigation.en: Let external input select only predefined file objects and transformation options; assemble fixed filter chains server-side and verify canonical paths stay within the root; never allow arbitrary wrappers, filter names, or resources. After the fix, replay the step-1 URIs and compare all transformation baselines, confirming arbitrary chains are rejected while normal transformation features work.

description.zh: 验证参数可读取本地文件并观察是否存在关键字拦截，记录被拒形式，即选定转换链绕过路线。
description.en: Verify local reads and note keyword blocks; the rejected shapes select the transform-chain route.

description.zh: 用执行区载荷提交rot13、iconv与zlib组合的filter URI，响应内容按对应算法可还原成源码即确认转换链生效。
description.en: Submit the rot13, iconv, and zlib filter URIs per the execution payload; output reversing to source confirms the chain.

title.zh: 解码内容挖掘深层漏洞
title.en: Decode output to mine deeper flaws

description.zh: 按链式逆运算还原读取结果，查找包含点与命令执行入口，复验成功即把读取能力转化为执行路径。
description.en: Reverse the transforms to recover content and hunt includes and command sinks; a confirmed flaw converts read into execution.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认目标文件 API 支持 PHP stream filter，并能记录实际加载的 filter 名称
prerequisites.en: The target file API is confirmed to support PHP stream filters and the filters actually loaded can be observed.

prerequisites.zh: 测试资源只包含已知 UTF-8 随机标记，可离线计算 ROT13、UTF-16 与压缩编码预期值
prerequisites.en: The test resource contains only a known UTF-8 random marker whose ROT13, UTF-16, and compressed encodings can be calculated offline.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须把特定 filter 输出与同一标记资源的文件读取关联起来。乱码、Base64 外观、warning、空响应或最后一条无转换 URI 的处理差异都只是诊断信号，不能单独证明 LFI。
analysis.en: A positive must correlate a specific filter output with a read of the same marker resource. Garbled data, a Base64 appearance, warnings, empty responses, or differential handling of the no-transform control are diagnostic signals and cannot alone prove LFI.

opsecTips.zh: 所有 resource 指向单个无敏感标记文件并限制响应大小；任何非标记文件访问立即停止
opsecTips.en: Point every resource to one nonsensitive marker file and cap response size; stop immediately on any access to a nonmarker file.

opsecTips.zh: 完成后删除离线转换产物、标记文件和响应副本，并清除 PHP/代理缓存
opsecTips.en: After completion delete offline transform artifacts, the marker file, and response copies, and clear PHP and proxy caches.

description.zh: 绕过对单次转换特征的检测：两轮字符集往返改变字节形态；按最终编码解读即成功。
description.en: Round-trip charsets twice past single-transform signatures; interpreting the final encoding confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 convert 直接开头的规则：前置小写化过滤器；解码后按需还原大小写即成功。
description.en: Prefix a lowercase filter before encoding past convert-leading rules; restoring case after decoding confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 utf-16 组合特征库：改走 UTF-7 输出通道；按 UTF-7 解码即得源码。
description.en: Emit through UTF-7 instead, past utf-16 signature lists; decoding as UTF-7 yields the source.

name.zh: LFI PHAR 归档成员读取边界

description.zh: 使用伪装为 JPG 和 PNG 的两个 phar:// 成员路径验证 PHP 是否按归档解析上传对象并读取指定成员。
description.en: Uses two phar:// member paths disguised as JPG and PNG uploads to test whether PHP parses an uploaded object as an archive and reads the named member.

overview.zh: LFI PHAR 归档成员读取边界针对 PHP 把上传对象按 PHAR 归档解析并读取内部成员的场景：外层扩展名不决定实际解析器。验证伪装为 JPG 与 PNG 的 phar:// 成员路径能否返回 marker 文本。
overview.en: The LFI PHAR archive-member read boundary targets PHP parsing uploaded objects as PHAR archives and reading internal members: the outer extension does not decide the actual parser. It validates phar:// member paths disguised as JPG and PNG returning marker text.

vulnerability.zh: 若用户能控制上传内容和后续 phar URI，应用的普通文件访问边界可能变成归档成员访问；风险取决于目标 API、归档有效性和成员使用方式，文件上传成功或 wrapper 报错不是阳性。
vulnerability.en: If users control upload content and subsequent phar URIs, the application's ordinary file-access boundary can become archive-member access; risk depends on the target API, archive validity, and member usage—upload success or wrapper errors are not positives.

exploitation.zh: 先构造伪装 JPG/PNG 的受控 PHAR（成员只含纯文本 marker.txt），上传后按第 1 步逐条提交 phar:// 成员路径，一次一个；命中判据为成员路径返回 marker.txt 文本。记录目标 API 与归档解析日志；验证限于成员读取，不得从文件名推断代码执行。
exploitation.en: Build a controlled PHAR disguised as JPG/PNG whose member holds only plain-text marker.txt first, upload it, then submit the phar:// member paths one at a time per step 1; a hit is the member path returning marker.txt text. Record the target API and archive-parse logs; scope validation to member reads—never infer code execution from filenames.

mitigation.zh: 上传对象使用随机服务端名称和不可执行存储，后续访问通过对象 ID，不接受 wrapper URI；在文件调用前校验 scheme、真实路径和允许媒体格式；清除旧上传并回归普通图片读取。修复后重放第 1 步成员路径，确认被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Store uploads under random server-side names in non-executable storage, access them later via object IDs, and never accept wrapper URIs; validate scheme, real path, and allowed media formats before file calls; clear old uploads and regression-test ordinary image reads. After the fix, replay the step-1 member paths and confirm rejection.

title.en: Find an upload plus access pair

description.zh: 确认存在可上传文件且能通过路径参数访问文件内容的组合点，正常上传与读取成功即具备phar利用前提。
description.en: Confirm a pair of upload plus path-based access; a clean upload and read satisfy the phar prerequisite.

title.en: Upload an archive and read a member

description.zh: 用执行区载荷把phar路径传入读取参数访问归档内成员，返回成员文件内容即确认phar流包装器可用。
description.en: Pass the phar path per the execution payload to read a member; member content confirms the phar stream wrapper works.

title.zh: 借元数据触发反序列化

description.zh: 在归档元数据中放入对象并以反序列化入口复现，构造POP链触发，命令执行或回连成功即升级为RCE。
description.en: Embed an object in archive metadata and replay a deserializing entry with a POP chain; execution or a callback upgrades to RCE.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离上传目录允许创建自有 PHAR 测试归档，归档成员仅含随机纯文本标记
prerequisites.en: The isolated upload directory permits a controlled PHAR test archive whose member contains only a random plaintext marker.

prerequisites.zh: 已记录 PHP 版本、phar.readonly、目标文件 API 和上传后的规范文件路径
prerequisites.en: The PHP version, phar.readonly setting, target file API, and canonical uploaded-file path are recorded.

analysis.zh: 确认结果仅限目标应用通过 phar wrapper 打开受控归档并返回 marker.txt。上传成功、扩展名伪装、外层文件读取、元数据解析错误或成员名含 shell.php 都不能证明代码执行或反序列化。
analysis.en: A confirmed result is limited to the target application opening the controlled archive through the phar wrapper and returning marker.txt. Upload success, extension disguise, outer-file reading, metadata errors, or a member named shell.php proves neither code execution nor deserialization.

opsecTips.zh: 归档禁止对象元数据、可执行 stub 和脚本成员；首次返回纯文本标记后立即停止
opsecTips.en: Forbid object metadata, executable stubs, and script members in the archive; stop immediately after the first plaintext marker return.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除上传对象、归档构建目录、对象存储副本和相关缓存索引
opsecTips.en: After testing delete the uploaded object, archive build directory, object-store copies, and related cache indexes.

description.zh: 绕过对 /shell.php 明文成员名的匹配：分隔符编码后等价解析；代码被包含执行即成功。
description.en: Encode the member separator past plaintext member-name matching; the code being included confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 .jpg 后缀与 phar 组合特征：轮换 png 扩展的同一归档；执行成功即成功。
description.en: Rotate to a PNG-extension copy of the archive against jpg-combo signatures; successful execution confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对成员名直尾匹配：子目录回跳改变路径形态；仍解析到 shell 成员即成功。
description.en: Insert a subdirectory hop past direct member-suffix matching; still resolving the shell member confirms success.

name.zh: LFI 跨平台路径规范化差异

description.zh: 使用 Linux 与 Windows 遍历、重复分隔符、分号和空字节历史变体验证输入校验与最终文件系统规范化是否一致。
description.en: Uses Linux and Windows traversal, repeated separators, semicolons, and a historical null-byte form to test consistency between input validation and final filesystem canonicalization.

overview.zh: LFI 跨平台路径规范化差异针对输入校验与最终文件系统规范化不一致的场景：Linux 与 Windows 遍历、重复分隔符、分号与空字节可产生不同解析。验证四类遍历变体在目标平台的最终落点。
overview.en: LFI cross-platform path canonicalization targets inconsistencies between input validation and final filesystem normalization: Linux and Windows traversal, repeated separators, semicolons, and null bytes parse differently. It validates where four traversal-variant classes land on the target platform.

vulnerability.zh: 若入口按字符串过滤而下游再次解码或采用不同分隔符规则，校验值可能留在根目录内而文件系统目标已越界；现代 PHP 通常拒绝 URL 中的空字节，因此 %00 成功必须由实际版本证据证明。
vulnerability.en: If the entry filters by string while downstream decodes again or applies different separator rules, the validated value can stay inside the root while the filesystem target has escaped; modern PHP usually rejects null bytes in URLs, so %00 success requires actual version evidence.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步把目标操作系统的末端文件替换为根目录外随机标记，然后逐行提交 ../../../etc/passwd、....//....//、....\....\ 与 ..;/..;/ 四类遍历变体并记录每层解码；命中判据为某一变体解析后返回根目录外的标记内容。%00 仅作为版本相关负对照，不预设可截断；命中后记录首个成功变体与最终规范路径，说明校验层与文件系统层的规则差异。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, replace the trailing file with a random out-of-root marker for the target OS, then submit the four traversal-variant classes—../../../etc/passwd, ....//....//, ....\....\, and ..;/..;/—line by line, recording each decoding layer; a hit is any variant resolving to return the out-of-root marker content. Treat %00 only as a version-dependent negative control without presuming truncation; on a hit, record the first successful variant and final canonical path to expose the rule gap between validation and filesystem layers.

mitigation.zh: 使用对象 ID 选择文件，将候选路径在单次完整解码后与固定根目录组合，解析真实路径并验证其仍为根目录后代；拒绝绝对路径、空字节和平台不支持分隔符。修复后重放第 1 步全部变体与合法样例，确认遍历被拒绝且正常文件功能可用。
mitigation.en: Select files by object ID, combine candidate paths with a fixed root after a single full decode, resolve the real path, and verify it remains a root descendant; reject absolute paths, null bytes, and unsupported platform separators. After the fix, replay all step-1 variants and legitimate samples, confirming traversal is rejected while normal file features work.

description.zh: 提交标准的点点斜杠序列观察是否被规范化拦截，记录拒绝行为，即确定需要变形绕过的具体环节。
description.en: Submit plain dot-dot-slash sequences and record rejections; the blocking stage identifies what to mutate.

description.zh: 用执行区载荷按目标系统尝试双重斜杠、分号与反斜杠族变体，任一形式返回根外文件内容即找到规范化差异。
description.en: Try the doubled-slash, semicolon, and backslash families per the execution payload; any root-escaping read finds the canonicalization gap.

title.zh: 读取凭据文件扩大战果

description.zh: 以第2步放行的变体重构指向passwd、shadow与配置的路径，收集账号口令与密钥即完成敏感信息收割。
description.en: Rebuild passwd, shadow, and config paths in the passing variant; accounts, passwords, and keys complete the harvest.

prerequisites.zh: Linux 和 Windows 测试根目录外各放置一个无敏感随机标记文件，且文件审计已启用
prerequisites.en: A nonsensitive random-marker file exists just outside the test root on both Linux and Windows, with file auditing enabled.

prerequisites.zh: 已识别代理、框架、语言运行时和文件系统的全部解码与规范化步骤
prerequisites.en: Every decoding and canonicalization step in the proxy, framework, language runtime, and filesystem is identified.

analysis.zh: 有效路径遍历要求最终规范路径离开批准根目录且目标进程读取根外随机标记。输入含 `../`、组件返回不同错误、日志显示解码或历史 %00 语法被接受都不是充分证据。
analysis.en: Valid traversal requires the final canonical path to leave the approved root and the target process to read the outside random marker. An input containing ../, differential errors, logged decoding, or acceptance of historical %00 syntax is not sufficient evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只读取专用根外标记，不使用 /etc、Windows 系统文件或应用配置；首次越界读取即停止
opsecTips.en: Read only the dedicated outside marker, never /etc, Windows system files, or application configuration, and stop on the first escaped read.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除两套标记与审计导出，清理应用缓存并确认原系统路径没有文件事件
opsecTips.en: Afterward delete both marker sets and audit exports, clear application caches, and confirm the original system paths have no file events.

description.zh: 绕过对 ../ 与 ..\ 双形态的删除过滤：反斜杠编码后混合使用；文件内容返回即成功。
description.en: Mix encoded backslashes past both-form traversal removal; returned file content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对任何明文遍历序列的匹配：全部编码由应用层解码；读取成功即成功。
description.en: Encode everything so no plaintext sequence survives until application decoding; a successful read confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过按单一分隔符归一化的规则：正反斜杠交错叠加；规范化后仍到达目标即成功。
description.en: Interleave separators so single-separator normalization misses them; still reaching the target after canonicalization confirms success.

name.zh: LFI Data Wrapper 解释边界

description.zh: 使用明文和 Base64 的三个 data:// PHP 片段区分内联流读取、源码回显与 include 条件下的代码解释。
description.en: Uses three plaintext and Base64 data:// PHP fragments to distinguish inline-stream reading, source reflection, and code interpretation under include conditions.

subCategory.zh: PHP 流包装器与远程包含

overview.zh: LFI Data Wrapper 解释边界针对 data:// 内联流被普通读取还是被 include 当作 PHP 源解释的区分场景：明文与 Base64 只是传输差异。验证三条 data:// URI 在包含入口的解释行为。
overview.en: The LFI data-wrapper interpretation boundary targets distinguishing whether data:// inline streams are read ordinarily or interpreted as PHP source by include—plaintext versus Base64 is only transport difference. It validates three data:// URIs at the inclusion entry.

vulnerability.zh: 当外部输入控制 include 目标且 URL include 可用时，内联数据可能成为可解释源；若片段仅被输出、下载、写日志或因配置失败，则不能称为 RCE，phpinfo 文本本身也不证明函数运行。
vulnerability.en: When external input controls the include target with URL include available, inline data can become interpretable source; fragments merely output, downloaded, logged, or failing on configuration do not constitute RCE, and phpinfo text alone proves no function ran.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留三条原始 URI 作追溯，实际执行前把三条分别重写为输出同一随机标记的 PHP 片段（明文与 Base64 两种编码各测）；命中判据为重写后的 data 流被包含并输出同一随机标记，证明流进入 include 解释。同时记录 allow_url_include 配置与最终函数语义；若流仅作为文本回显，记录为读取命中而非代码执行，两类证据分开归档。
exploitation.en: Keep the three original URIs from step 1 for traceability, but before executing rewrite each as a PHP fragment outputting the same random marker (testing both plaintext and Base64 encodings); a hit is the rewritten data stream included and outputting the same random marker, proving the stream entered include interpretation. Record the allow_url_include configuration and final function semantics; if the stream only echoes as text, log it as a read hit rather than code execution—archive the two evidence classes separately.

mitigation.zh: 模板加载使用服务端映射，不接受 URI；关闭不需要的 URL include，限制 wrapper，并让内容展示与代码解释走独立路径。修复后回归合法模板、纯文本 data 流和全部三条负向输入，确认解释前被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Load templates via server-side mapping and never accept URIs; disable unneeded URL include, restrict wrappers, and keep content display and code interpretation on separate paths. After the fix, regression-test legitimate templates, plaintext data streams, and all three negative inputs, confirming rejection before interpretation.

description.zh: 验证参数触发服务端包含且远程地址被拒，尝试wrapper形式不被过滤，即选择data流注入路线。
description.en: Verify server-side inclusion with remote URLs refused while wrapper forms pass; the data-stream route is selected.

title.en: Confirm interpretation with a data stream

description.zh: 用执行区载荷提交明文与Base64两种data URI，页面输出流内定义的标记即确认内容被当作代码解释。
description.en: Submit the plain and Base64 data URIs per the execution payload; the marker printing confirms code interpretation.

title.en: Swap in a command payload for execution

description.zh: 把data流内容替换为执行系统命令的脚本，沿用第2步的提交方式访问，命令结果回显即完成代码执行。
description.en: Rebuild the data stream as a command script and revisit as in step 2; command output completes code execution.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认输入最终进入 include/require，并记录 allow_url_fopen 与 allow_url_include 的实际值
prerequisites.en: Input is confirmed to reach include or require, and the actual allow_url_fopen and allow_url_include values are recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 所有原始 PHP 片段先离线审查并替换为只输出随机标记的无副作用内容
prerequisites.en: Every original PHP fragment is reviewed offline and replaced with side-effect-free content that only prints a random marker.

analysis.zh: 完整证据是目标 include/require 解释了改写后的随机标记片段并产生预期输出。Base64 解码、源码回显、phpinfo 字符串出现、统一 500 或 WAF 命中只能说明传输或过滤行为。
analysis.en: Complete evidence is that the target include or require interpreted the rewritten random-marker fragment and produced its expected output. Base64 decoding, source reflection, the string phpinfo, a generic 500, or a WAF match demonstrates only transport or filtering behavior.

opsecTips.zh: 离线解码并禁用原始 phpinfo/system 片段，只执行单次随机标记输出；出现子进程立即停止
opsecTips.en: Decode offline and disable the original phpinfo or system fragments, executing only a one-time random-marker output; stop immediately if a child process appears.

opsecTips.zh: 测试完成清理请求日志中的编码代码、opcode 缓存和临时模板，并轮换测试标记
opsecTips.en: At completion clean encoded code from request logs, clear opcode caches and temporary templates, and rotate the test marker.

description.zh: 绕过对 data://text/plain 完整前缀的匹配：合法省略形式；phpinfo 页面渲染即成功。
description.en: Use the legal MIME-omitted form past full-prefix matching; a rendered phpinfo page confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 ;base64 直接接载荷的检测：插入字符集参数；内容被解码执行即成功。
description.en: Insert a charset parameter to shift the payload; decoded content executing confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对标准 Base64 字符集特征的检测：编码数据再百分号编码；应用两次解码后执行即成功。
description.en: Percent-encode the base64 blob past canonical-alphabet detection; execution after double decoding confirms success.

name.zh: LFI Expect Wrapper 执行前提

description.zh: 以单条 expect:// 输入验证 PECL expect 扩展是否注册、用户流 URI 是否可达以及 PHP 运行身份能否启动受控程序。
description.en: Uses one expect:// input to verify registration of the PECL expect extension, reachability of a user-controlled stream URI, and whether the PHP identity can start a controlled program.

subCategory.zh: PHP 流包装器与远程包含

overview.zh: LFI Expect Wrapper 执行前提针对 PECL expect 扩展是否注册、用户流 URI 是否可达以及 PHP 运行身份能否启动受控程序的前提验证场景。验证单条 expect:// 输入在目标环境的完整链路。
overview.en: LFI expect-wrapper execution preconditions target validating whether the PECL expect extension is registered, user stream URIs are reachable, and the PHP runtime identity can launch controlled programs. It validates the full chain of a single expect:// input in the target environment.

vulnerability.zh: 文件包含或读取功能若接收任意 wrapper URI，且生产运行时错误启用 expect，攻击者可能让 PHP 创建子进程；unknown wrapper、命令文本回显、PECL 包存在或输入到达控制器都不是执行证据。
vulnerability.en: If file-inclusion or read functionality accepts arbitrary wrapper URIs and production runtimes wrongly enable expect, attackers can make PHP spawn child processes; unknown-wrapper errors, echoed command text, PECL package presence, or input reaching the controller are not execution evidence.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步的原行 expect://cat /etc/passwd 只作来源记录，实际执行必须替换为 expect://marker-helper 并由进程策略保证仅输出随机标记；命中判据为 marker-helper 的随机标记出现在响应中，证明扩展注册、流可达与进程权限三项前提同时成立。逐项记录 PHP 版本、已注册 wrapper 与错误类型；未命中时区分扩展缺失、scheme 拒绝与权限不足，不把 PECL 包存在当作执行证据。
exploitation.en: The step-1 original line expect://cat /etc/passwd is for source record only—execution must be replaced with expect://marker-helper, with process policy guaranteeing random-marker output; a hit is the marker-helper's random marker in the response, proving extension registration, stream reachability, and process permissions all hold. Record PHP version, registered wrappers, and error types item by item; on a miss, distinguish missing extension, scheme rejection, and insufficient permissions—never treat PECL package presence as execution evidence.

mitigation.zh: 卸载 expect 扩展，文件入口拒绝非 file scheme，PHP 服务账户禁止启动子进程并限制系统调用。修复后重放第 1 步 expect URI，确认在解析或策略层被拒绝，同时验证合法文件对象仍可用。
mitigation.en: Uninstall the expect extension, have file entries reject non-file schemes, forbid the PHP service account from spawning child processes, and restrict system calls. After the fix, replay the step-1 expect URI and confirm rejection at the parsing or policy layer while legitimate file objects remain usable.

title.en: Confirm the expect extension is loaded

description.zh: 通过报错或phpinfo信息确认目标加载expect包装器，参数能进入文件函数即具备执行链前提。
description.en: Confirm via errors or phpinfo that expect is loaded and the parameter reaches a file function; the execution chain is primed.

description.zh: 用执行区载荷提交expect://开头的路径，响应出现命令输出即确认包装器把输入交给shell真实执行。
description.en: Submit the expect:// path per the execution payload; command output confirms the wrapper hands input to a shell.

description.zh: 把expect命令换成回连语句，沿用第2步的参数形式触发，控制端收到交互会话即完成主机控制。
description.en: Swap the expect command for a reverse shell, triggering as in step 2; the session at the controller owns the host.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在一次性隔离 PHP 实例安装 expect 扩展，并确认 stream_get_wrappers 返回 expect
prerequisites.en: The expect extension is installed only in a disposable isolated PHP instance and stream_get_wrappers confirms expect.

prerequisites.zh: 原始 cat 命令替换为固定 marker-helper，PHP 身份无网络、写入和读取敏感文件权限
prerequisites.en: The original cat command is replaced by a fixed marker-helper, and the PHP identity lacks network, write, and sensitive-file read privileges.

analysis.zh: 唯一可确认结果是目标 PHP 父进程启动受控 marker-helper 并返回对应随机输出。expect 字符串被接受、扩展已安装、wrapper 出现在列表或错误发生变化只证明前提，不证明命令执行。
analysis.en: The only confirmed result is the target PHP parent launching the controlled marker-helper and returning its random output. Acceptance of the expect string, an installed extension, a listed wrapper, or changed errors proves prerequisites, not command execution.

opsecTips.zh: 用应用控制和系统策略双重限制只可运行 marker-helper；出现其他 PID、文件访问或网络事件立即终止
opsecTips.en: Use both application and operating-system controls to permit only marker-helper; terminate immediately on any other PID, file access, or network event.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后销毁隔离实例、撤销帮助程序签名允许项并删除进程审计中的测试令牌
opsecTips.en: Afterward destroy the isolated instance, revoke the helper's signing allow-entry, and remove test tokens from process audit.

description.zh: 绕过对单命令指纹的匹配：追加链式命令改变整体特征；两个命令输出均返回即成功。
description.en: Append a chained command past single-fingerprint matching; both outputs returning confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对空格分隔特征的过滤：用 shell 内部字段分隔符变量替代；输出正常返回即成功。
description.en: Replace spaces with the IFS variable past space-separator filtering; normal output returning confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对分号和空格的统一过滤：用换行符分隔复合命令；两条输出均出现即成功。
description.en: Separate compound commands with a newline past semicolon-and-space filtering; both outputs appearing confirms success.

name.zh: PHP Expect Wrapper 命令边界

description.zh: 使用 expect:// 命令 URI 验证可选 Expect 扩展是否把文件型输入转换为操作系统进程执行。
description.en: Uses expect command URIs to test whether the optional Expect extension turns file-oriented input into operating-system process execution.

overview.zh: PHP Expect Wrapper 命令边界针对可选 Expect 扩展把文件型输入转换为操作系统进程执行的场景：expect:// 仅在扩展安装且目标 API 支持 wrapper 时适用。验证命令 URI 在目标环境的执行链路。
overview.en: The PHP expect-wrapper command boundary targets the optional Expect extension converting file-type input into operating-system process execution: expect:// applies only when the extension is installed and the target API supports wrappers. It validates the execution chain of command URIs in the target environment.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户控制通用 stream URI，运行环境启用可执行 wrapper，应用未限制 scheme；PHP 服务身份因此可启动任意允许程序，影响受其系统权限和出站边界限制。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user-controlled generic stream URIs with executable wrappers enabled in the runtime and no scheme restrictions; the PHP service identity can thus launch any permitted program, impact bounded by its system permissions and egress rules.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步原行仅说明命令边界，真实验证选择一条并把命令替换为只输出随机固定标记的无害测试程序后提交 expect://；命中判据为标记输出出现在响应中，证明扩展、wrapper 注册与进程权限同时成立。不运行 whoami/cat/ls/pwd 等真实命令；未命中时记录 PHP 版本、已注册 wrapper 清单与错误类型，区分扩展缺失、scheme 拒绝与权限不足。
exploitation.en: The step-1 originals only illustrate the command boundary—for real validation pick one, replace the command with a harmless test program emitting a random fixed marker, and submit expect://; a hit is marker output in the response, proving extension, wrapper registration, and process permissions all hold. Never run real commands like whoami/cat/ls/pwd; on a miss, record the PHP version, registered wrapper list, and error types to distinguish missing extension, scheme rejection, and insufficient permissions.

mitigation.zh: 生产移除不需要的 Expect 扩展，文件功能只允许固定 file scheme 和对象映射，禁止用户选择 stream wrapper；PHP 运行身份最小权限，限制子进程与出站网络，并监控 Expect/异常进程。修复后重放第 1 步变体，确认被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Remove unneeded Expect extensions in production, allow only fixed file schemes and object mapping for file features, and never let users choose stream wrappers; run the PHP identity least-privileged, restrict child processes and egress, and monitor Expect or anomalous processes. After the fix, replay the step-1 variants and confirm rejection.

description.zh: 寻找把输入传给执行函数的参数，先提交无害探测观察响应差异，出现可区分输出即锁定注入点。
description.en: Find parameters feeding execution functions and send a harmless probe; a distinguishable output locks the injection point.

title.en: Run a probe via the expect wrapper

description.zh: 用执行区载荷提交expect://whoami等URI，响应回显当前用户名即确认包装器可执行系统命令。
description.en: Submit expect://whoami style URIs per the execution payload; the username echoing confirms system command execution.

description.zh: 把命令换为写马或反向连接语句，沿用第2步的提交形式触发，得到稳定会话即完成控制权获取。
description.en: Swap in a webshell write or reverse connection, triggering as in step 2; a stable session completes control.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离 PHP 实例确认 Expect 扩展已安装且输入进入通用 stream API
prerequisites.en: Testing occurs only on an isolated PHP instance after confirming the Expect extension and a generic stream sink.

prerequisites.zh: 可将命令改为固定标记输出并采集子进程审计
prerequisites.en: Commands can be replaced with fixed marker output and child-process auditing is available.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 PHP 进程实际启动改写后的标记程序。Expect 扩展不存在、URI 解析失败、命令文字回显均是假阳性；不得运行原系统命令。
analysis.en: A positive requires the PHP process to start the rewritten marker program. Missing extension, URI parse failure, or reflected command text are false positives, and the original OS commands must not run.

opsecTips.zh: 仅在一次性容器运行单个固定标记程序，看到输出后停止。
opsecTips.en: Run one fixed-marker program only in a disposable container and stop when output appears.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除程序、终止残留子进程并核对无网络连接或临时文件。
opsecTips.en: Remove the program, terminate residual children, and verify no network connection or temporary file remains afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对 expect://whoami 明文特征的拦截：对命令做百分号编码；成功判据：返回当前用户名。
description.en: Evades plaintext expect://whoami signatures by percent-encoding the command. Success: current username is returned.

description.zh: 绕过命令关键词黑名单：expect 内执行 base64 解码管道，$IFS 代替空格；成功判据：whoami 输出回显。
description.en: Bypasses command blacklists by running a base64-decode pipeline inside expect with $IFS as whitespace. Success: whoami output reflected.

description.zh: 利用 shell 引号拆分混淆命令名，绕过完整单词匹配；成功判据：返回用户名。
description.en: Obscures the command name with shell quote-splitting to defeat whole-word matching. Success: username returned.

name.zh: PHP Zip Wrapper 归档成员包含

description.zh: 使用伪装为图片/文本的 ZIP 容器和成员路径验证文件包含点是否从归档中读取或解释 PHP 成员。
description.en: Uses ZIP containers disguised as image or text files and member paths to test whether an inclusion sink reads or interprets a PHP member from an archive.

overview.zh: PHP Zip Wrapper 归档成员包含针对文件包含点从归档中读取或解释 PHP 成员的场景：容器外扩展名不决定内部成员是否可被处理。验证伪装为图片/文本的 ZIP 容器与成员路径组合。
overview.en: PHP zip-wrapper archive-member inclusion targets inclusion points reading or interpreting PHP members from archives: the container's outer extension does not decide whether internal members are processed. It validates ZIP containers disguised as images/text combined with member paths.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是上传校验只看外层文件名，应用又允许用户构造 zip URI 和成员名进入文件 API；若该 API 是 include，固定成员可被 PHP 解释，若只是读取，影响限于归档内容披露。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is upload validation checking only the outer filename while the application lets users craft zip URIs and member names into file APIs; if the API is include, fixed members can be interpreted by PHP, while pure reads limit impact to archive-content disclosure.

exploitation.zh: 先构造成员只含固定文本或 echo 标记的专用测试 ZIP 并上传，再按第 1 步以 shell.png、shell.gif、shell.txt、shell.html 四种容器扩展名逐条提交 zip://shell.png%23shell.php 变体；命中判据为容器内成员按预期被读取或包含执行并输出固定标记。先判断入口是读取还是 include，不上传可接收命令的脚本；include 语义命中按代码执行单独取证。
exploitation.en: First build a dedicated test ZIP whose members contain only fixed text or echo markers and upload it, then submit zip://shell.png%23shell.php variants across the four container extensions shell.png, shell.gif, shell.txt, and shell.html one by one per step 1; a hit is the member read or included as expected with the fixed marker output. First determine whether the entry reads or includes, never uploading command-receiving scripts; archive include-semantics hits separately under code execution.

mitigation.zh: 上传对象使用随机 ID 存在 Web 根外且不可执行，校验真实文件类型并限制归档部件；文件读取通过服务端对象映射，不允许用户 wrapper/成员路径；禁止动态 include 上传内容。修复后重放第 1 步全部容器变体，确认被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Store uploads under random IDs outside the web root in non-executable storage, validate real file types, and restrict archive parts; serve file reads via server-side object mapping and never allow user wrapper/member paths; forbid dynamically including uploaded content. After the fix, replay all step-1 container variants and confirm rejection.

description.zh: 验证文件可上传且路径参数能触发包含，普通文件读取成功即具备归档成员利用的组合条件。
description.en: Verify uploads land and the path parameter triggers inclusion; a plain read satisfies the archive-member setup.

title.en: Upload the archive under masked names

description.zh: 用执行区载荷把zip改名为png等后缀上传，再以zip://加%23成员路径访问，成员内容被包含执行即确认绕过。
description.en: Rename the zip to png per the execution payload and access via zip:// plus %23; the member executing confirms the bypass.

title.en: Execute the member payload for a shell

description.zh: 在归档成员中放入命令脚本并沿用第2步的访问方式触发，命令输出返回即拿到服务器执行权限。
description.en: Pack a command script as the member and trigger via the step-2 access; command output grants server execution.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离实例允许上传测试 ZIP 且输入进入支持 zip:// 的文件 API
prerequisites.en: The isolated instance permits a test ZIP upload and input reaches a zip-aware file API.

prerequisites.zh: 归档成员只包含固定文本/PHP echo 标记并可完整清理
prerequisites.en: The archive member contains only fixed text or PHP echo marker and can be fully removed.

analysis.zh: 阳性边界分为成员可读与成员被 PHP 解释，两者影响不同。上传成功、外层扩展通过或 zip URI 被解析但无标记均是假阳性。
analysis.en: The positive boundary separates readable members from PHP-interpreted members, which have different impact. Upload success, accepted outer extension, or parsed URI without the marker is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 先用纯文本成员，确认读取后即停止；无专项批准不使用 PHP 标记。
opsecTips.en: Start with a plain-text member and stop after read confirmation; do not use a PHP marker without explicit approval.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后从上传目录、对象存储、缓存和备份队列删除所有归档。
opsecTips.en: Remove every archive from upload storage, object storage, cache, and backup queues afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对 %23 还原后 .php 成员特征的拦截：二次编码在应用层还原；归档代码执行即成功。
description.en: Double-encode the member separator so it restores only in the application; in-archive code executing confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 zip:// 相对形式匹配：绝对路径访问同一上传归档；命令执行输出返回即成功。
description.en: Access the same upload via an absolute path past relative-form matching; returned command output confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 .png/.gif 组合特征的检测：轮换 html 扩展的同一归档；包含执行成功即成功。
description.en: Rotate to an HTML-extension copy against image-combo signatures; successful inclusion confirms success.

name.zh: PHP Phar Wrapper 归档成员边界

description.zh: 使用不同外层扩展名的 phar:// 成员路径验证 PHP 文件操作是否打开 Phar 归档并触发成员读取或元数据处理。
description.en: Uses phar archive-member paths under different outer extensions to test whether PHP file operations open a Phar and trigger member reads or metadata handling.

overview.zh: PHP Phar Wrapper 归档成员边界针对 PHP 文件操作打开 Phar 归档并触发成员读取或元数据处理的场景：安全验证只需证明容器或成员边界，不应使用反序列化 gadget。验证不同外层扩展名的 phar:// 成员路径。
overview.en: The PHP phar-wrapper archive-member boundary targets PHP file operations opening Phar archives and triggering member reads or metadata handling: safe validation proves only container or member boundaries and should not use deserialization gadgets. It validates phar:// member paths across outer extensions.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户可控制 phar URI 或上传容器路径，应用未限制 wrapper、文件类型与成员名；影响可从成员读取到特定版本的元数据反序列化，但后者必须由实际版本和调用栈单独证明。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user-controlled phar URIs or uploaded container paths without wrapper, file-type, or member-name restrictions; impact ranges from member reads to version-specific metadata deserialization, though the latter needs independent proof from actual version and call stack.

exploitation.zh: 先构造无 gadget 的测试 Phar（成员只含固定文本）并上传，再按第 1 步以 shell.png、shell.gif、shell.txt、shell.html 四种外层扩展名逐条提交 phar://shell.png/shell.php 变体；命中判据为成员文本按预期返回，证明容器被按 Phar 解析。不使用序列化对象或可执行 shell.php 成员；命中后核对目标文件函数与 PHP 版本是否具备元数据反序列化行为，作为独立验证维度。
exploitation.en: First build a gadget-free test Phar (members containing only fixed text) and upload it, then submit phar://shell.png/shell.php variants across the four outer extensions shell.png, shell.gif, shell.txt, and shell.html one by one per step 1; a hit is member text returned as expected, proving the container was parsed as Phar. Never use serialized objects or executable shell.php members; on a hit, separately check whether the target file function and PHP version exhibit metadata deserialization as an independent dimension.

mitigation.zh: 上传对象存于 Web 根外并使用随机 ID，禁止用户选择 wrapper 或成员路径；关闭不需要的 phar 写入/处理能力，升级 PHP 和依赖，反序列化只接受受信类型，并监控 phar URI。修复后重放第 1 步全部变体，确认被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Store uploads outside the web root under random IDs and forbid user-chosen wrappers or member paths; disable unneeded phar write/processing capabilities, upgrade PHP and dependencies, accept only trusted types in deserialization, and monitor phar URIs. After the fix, replay all step-1 variants and confirm rejection.

description.zh: 确认目标PHP版本phar可用且存在上传与访问组合点，正常归档能被读取即具备攻击前提。
description.en: Confirm phar support for the PHP version plus the upload/access pair; a readable plain archive clears the prerequisite.

title.en: Access a member behind an image suffix

description.zh: 用执行区载荷上传改后缀的phar并以phar://路径访问成员，成员内容返回即确认包装器处理伪装归档。
description.en: Upload the renamed phar per the execution payload and access via phar://; member content confirms disguised archives are processed.

description.zh: 在归档元数据植入对象链并访问触发反序列化，命令回连成功即把成员读取升级为远程代码执行。
description.en: Plant an object chain in the metadata and trigger deserialization on access; a callback upgrades member read to RCE.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离 PHP 版本中确认 phar wrapper 和目标文件 API
prerequisites.en: Testing occurs only on an isolated PHP version after confirming the phar wrapper and target file API.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 Phar 不含对象反序列化 gadget，只含固定文本成员
prerequisites.en: The test Phar contains no deserialization gadget and only a fixed text member.

analysis.zh: 阳性是 PHP 进程打开无 gadget Phar 并读取固定成员。签名错误、上传成功、URI 文本或理论 gadget 可用性是假阳性；不得把成员读取写成反序列化 RCE。
analysis.en: A positive is the PHP process opening the gadget-free Phar and reading its fixed member. Signature errors, upload success, URI text, or theoretical gadget availability are false positives; member read must not be labeled deserialization RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 禁止序列化对象和 gadget，只验证固定文本成员，成功后立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Never include serialized objects or gadgets; test only a fixed text member and stop on success.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除归档、清空上传索引和缓存，并验证 PHP 临时目录无副本。
opsecTips.en: Remove the archive, clear upload indexes and caches, and verify no copy remains in the PHP temporary directory.

description.zh: 绕过对 /shell.php 成员名特征的匹配：分隔符编码等价解析；代码被包含执行即成功。
description.en: Encode the member separator past member-name matching; the code being included and executed confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对成员名直尾匹配：子目录回跳改变路径形态；仍解析到 shell 成员即成功。
description.en: Hop through a subdirectory past direct member-suffix matching; still resolving the shell member confirms success.

title.zh: gzip 压缩 PHAR 载体

description.zh: 绕过对原始 phar 字节特征的检测：gzip 压缩形态的 phar 归档仍可流式解析；执行成功即成功。
description.en: Use the gzip-compressed phar form, still stream-parsed, past raw-byte signatures; successful execution confirms success.

name.zh: Session ID 路径遍历

description.zh: 通过 session_id、PHPSESSID 与 JSESSIONID 中的父目录片段，验证文件型会话存储是否把外部标识直接拼接为文件路径。
description.en: Uses parent-directory segments in session_id, PHPSESSID, and JSESSIONID to test whether file-backed session stores concatenate external identifiers into filesystem paths.

overview.zh: Session ID 路径遍历针对文件型会话存储把外部标识直接拼接为文件路径的场景：session_id、PHPSESSID 与 JSESSIONID 中的父目录片段可越过会话根目录。验证三类会话标识的遍历行为。
overview.en: Session ID path traversal targets file-based session storage concatenating external identifiers directly into file paths: parent-directory segments in session_id, PHPSESSID, and JSESSIONID can escape the session root. It validates traversal across the three session-identifier variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是会话 ID 缺少严格字符集和长度约束，经过 URL 解码后直接与目录拼接；若存储层未解析规范路径并验证根目录，编码斜杠和父目录段可能访问任意文件。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is session IDs lacking strict character-set and length constraints, concatenated into directories after URL decoding; if the storage layer does not resolve canonical paths and verify the root, encoded slashes and parent segments can reach arbitrary files.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步按目标实际使用的 Cookie 或参数选择一行，把系统路径替换为测试标记后逐条提交 session_id=../../../、URL 编码与 PHPSESSID/JSESSIONID 变体，不要同时设置多个会话标识；命中判据为会话组件按注入的 ID 打开对应路径并返回标记内容。记录会话实现类型与最终解析路径；命中后评估是读取、覆盖还是异常会话加载三种影响。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, choose the line matching the target's actual cookie or parameter, replace system paths with test markers, and submit session_id=../../../, URL-encoded, and PHPSESSID/JSESSIONID variants one by one—never set multiple session identifiers at once; a hit is the session component opening the injected path and returning marker content. Record the session implementation type and final resolved path; on a hit, assess the three impact classes: read, overwrite, or anomalous session loading.

mitigation.zh: 使用密码学随机且固定编码的会话 ID，并在框架入口实施长度与字符集白名单；存储层使用哈希或数据库键而不是原始 ID 文件名；若必须落盘，解析规范路径并强制根目录、禁用符号链接越界。修复后重放第 1 步变体，确认遍历被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Use cryptographically random session IDs with fixed encoding and enforce length and character-set allowlists at the framework entry; store sessions under hashes or database keys instead of raw ID filenames; when disk storage is required, resolve canonical paths, enforce the root, and forbid symlink escape. After the fix, replay the step-1 variants and confirm traversal is rejected.

description.zh: 确认应用使用的会话Cookie名称与文件存储后端，提交正常会话观察响应，锁定会话ID进入文件路径的环节。
description.en: Identify the session cookie name and file backend; observing a normal session pins where the ID reaches a file path.

title.en: Inject a path to read files

description.zh: 用执行区载荷把会话ID替换为遍历路径提交，响应或错误信息出现目标文件内容即确认会话处理器按路径打开文件。
description.en: Replace the session ID with a traversal string per the execution payload; file contents in the response confirm path-based opens.

description.zh: 沿用第2步的注入形式把路径指向配置与密钥文件，收集到可用口令即转向其他系统登录利用。
description.en: Repoint the injected path at configs and key files per the step-2 form; reusable passwords pivot to other logins.

prerequisites.zh: 目标使用客户端可控会话标识并可能采用文件存储
prerequisites.en: The target accepts a client-controlled session identifier and may use file storage.

prerequisites.zh: 测试环境提供会话目录外的无敏感标记文件
prerequisites.en: A nonsensitive marker file exists outside the session directory in the test environment.

analysis.zh: 重点区分会话失效与文件路径越界。只有规范路径、文件访问或标记读取能确认后者；重新签发 Cookie 通常说明实现安全拒绝了非法 ID。
analysis.en: Distinguish session invalidation from filesystem escape. Only canonical path, file access, or marker reads prove the latter; issuing a new cookie often means the invalid ID was safely rejected.

opsecTips.zh: 将 `/etc/passwd` 等示例目标全部替换为无敏感测试标记。
opsecTips.en: Replace examples such as /etc/passwd with a nonsensitive test marker.

opsecTips.zh: 使用独立测试账号并在结束后清理其会话文件和 Cookie。
opsecTips.en: Use an isolated test account and remove its session files and cookies afterward.

description.zh: 编码遍历入会话标识。判据：会话加载 passwd 内容。
description.en: Encoded traversal in the session cookie. Success: session loads passwd.

description.zh: 空字节去除默认后缀。判据：读到 passwd。
description.en: Null byte strips the default suffix. Success: passwd read.

description.zh: 绝对路径直接指定文件。判据：会话文件命中。
description.en: Absolute path directly. Success: session file resolved.

name.zh: wkhtmltopdf 静态 File 图片资源

description.zh: 验证静态 img 的 file URI 是否能由 wkhtmltopdf 打开渲染沙箱内的本地图片，并与脚本化文件 iframe 分离。
description.en: Tests whether wkhtmltopdf can open a sandbox-local image through a static img file URI, separate from the scripted file-iframe path.

overview.zh: wkhtmltopdf 静态 File 图片资源针对静态 img 的 file URI 能否由渲染器打开沙箱内本地图片的场景：无需 JavaScript 即可触发本地资源加载。验证 img 引用 marker.png 的渲染行为，与脚本化 iframe 分离。
overview.en: The wkhtmltopdf static file image resource targets whether static img file URIs open local images in the rendering sandbox: local resource loading triggers without JavaScript. It validates rendering of an img referencing marker.png, kept separate from the scripted iframe.

vulnerability.zh: 若不可信 HTML 可指向渲染主机文件，格式可解析的内容可能进入 PDF；路径接受、open 尝试或破图图标不证明文件内容已经读出。
vulnerability.en: If untrusted HTML can point at renderer-host files, parseable content may enter the PDF; accepted paths, open attempts, or broken-image icons do not prove file content was read.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留原行作来源追踪，实际渲染只指向临时 marker.png 并提交到 HTML 转 PDF 入口；命中判据为 PDF 中出现 marker 图片内容，证明静态 img 的 file URI 触发了本地资源加载。记录 wkhtmltopdf 版本、本地访问开关与渲染身份权限；与脚本化 iframe 结果分开归档，静态资源不需要脚本执行前提，命中即可单独成立。
exploitation.en: Keep the step-1 original for source tracing, but render only against a temp marker.png and submit to the HTML-to-PDF entry; a hit is marker image content in the PDF, proving the static img file URI triggered local resource loading. Record the wkhtmltopdf version, local-access switch, and renderer-identity permissions; archive separately from the scripted iframe—static resources need no script-execution precondition, so a hit stands alone.

mitigation.zh: 禁用本地文件访问或只允许规范化资源根；渲染容器仅挂载批准资产，并拒绝输入中的 file scheme 和路径逃逸。修复后重放第 1 步静态 img，确认 file URI 被拒绝且正常图片渲染可用。
mitigation.en: Disable local file access or allow only a normalized resource root; mount only approved assets in the rendering container and reject file schemes and path escapes in input. After the fix, replay the step-1 static img and confirm file URIs are rejected while normal image rendering works.

description.zh: 寻找把用户内容渲染成PDF的功能，提交含标记的HTML确认输出包含标记，即锁定注入HTML的入口。
description.en: Find a feature rendering user content to PDF; a marker in HTML surviving into the output locks the injection entry.

title.en: Inject a file-scheme image to read files

description.zh: 用执行区载荷在HTML中放img标签指向file:///etc/passwd，生成的PDF文本层出现该文件内容即确认本地读取。
description.en: Embed an img pointing at file:///etc/passwd per the execution payload; contents in the PDF text layer confirm local read.

description.zh: 把资源地址换成内网URL与云元数据地址，继续以第2步的渲染方式触发，PDF出现内网响应内容即完成内网渗透推进。
description.en: Swap the resource for internal URLs and metadata endpoints, rendering as in step 2; internal content in the PDF advances inward.

prerequisites.zh: 原 `/etc/passwd` 替换为渲染沙箱内带可见随机标记的最小图片
prerequisites.en: The original /etc/passwd path is replaced with a minimal image carrying a visible random marker inside the rendering sandbox.

prerequisites.zh: 已冻结本地文件访问开关和 base URL，文件审计覆盖 wkhtmltopdf 进程
prerequisites.en: Local-file access settings and base URL are frozen and file audit covers the wkhtmltopdf process.

analysis.zh: 文件 read 和 PDF 中随机图像标记的组合证明静态本地资源可达。若只出现 URI、权限错误或破图占位，则没有文件内容泄露证据。
analysis.en: The combination of a file read and the random image marker in the PDF proves static local-resource reach. A URI, permission error, or broken-image placeholder alone is not evidence of file-content disclosure.

opsecTips.zh: 只挂载 marker 图片目录，禁止系统路径、符号链接和宿主卷进入渲染容器
opsecTips.en: Mount only the marker-image directory and prohibit system paths, symlinks, and host volumes in the render container.

opsecTips.zh: 限制图片尺寸、解码内存和文件数，验证后删除图片、PDF 与工作目录
opsecTips.en: Limit image dimensions, decode memory, and file count, then delete the image, PDF, and working directory after validation.

description.zh: link 标签读取本地文件。判据：PDF 报错或内容包含文件。
description.en: link tag fetch. Success: error or content in PDF.

description.zh: CSS 背景触发读取。判据：资源加载日志。
description.en: CSS background fetch. Success: fetch logged.

description.zh: embed 标签引用。判据：渲染异常暴露内容。
description.en: embed tag reference. Success: render error leaks content.

name.zh: PHP 服务端命令脚本变体

description.zh: 按 system、shell_exec、passthru、eval、assert、回调、反射与短标签整理 PHP 服务端命令脚本，用于检测上传或模板内容是否被 PHP 解释。
description.en: Organizes PHP command scripts using system, shell_exec, passthru, eval, assert, callbacks, reflection, and short tags to test whether uploaded or templated content is interpreted by PHP.

overview.zh: PHP 服务端命令脚本变体针对上传或模板内容被 PHP 解释器的检测场景：system、shell_exec、passthru、eval、assert、回调与短标签构成变体集合。验证选定行在目标版本的执行与标记返回。
overview.en: PHP server-side command script variants target detecting whether uploaded or template content is interpreted as PHP: system, shell_exec, passthru, eval, assert, callbacks, and short tags form the variant set. It validates execution and marker return of a selected line on the target version.

vulnerability.zh: 根因通常是上传目录可执行、模板/缓存文件被写入 Web 根目录，或业务代码把请求参数交给 eval、assert、危险回调和命令函数；攻击面同时包含文件落地位置、PHP 处理器映射和动态函数调用。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is usually executable upload directories, template/cache files written into the web root, or business code passing request parameters to eval, assert, dangerous callbacks, and command functions; the attack surface spans file landing locations, PHP handler mapping, and dynamic invocation together.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步把所有命令/参数替换为返回固定字符串的无害表达式，并一次只使用与目标 PHP 版本匹配的一行（旧版专属 API 单独核对）；命中判据为选定行在目标 PHP 版本上执行并返回固定标记输出。逐条记录处理器解释证据与静态下载/源码显示的差异；确认解释成立后再按需评估参数可控的执行维度，卡片目标始终是检测解释而非部署 WebShell。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, replace all commands/parameters with harmless expressions returning a fixed string and use only the line matching the target PHP version at a time (version-exclusive APIs checked separately); a hit is the selected line executing on the target PHP version and returning fixed marker output. Record handler-interpretation evidence versus static download/source display per line; once interpretation is confirmed, assess parameter-controlled execution dimensions as needed—the card's goal stays detecting interpretation, never deploying webshells.

mitigation.zh: 上传文件使用随机对象 ID 存在 Web 根目录外且不可执行，下载经固定处理器返回；移除 eval/assert 和动态回调，禁用不需要的危险函数，升级受支持 PHP，限制 Web 账户权限，并监控上传目录出现 PHP 标签或子进程。修复后重放第 1 步样例，确认无解释执行。
mitigation.en: Store uploads under random object IDs outside the web root as non-executable and serve downloads via a fixed handler; remove eval/assert and dynamic callbacks, disable unneeded dangerous functions, upgrade to supported PHP, limit web-account permissions, and monitor PHP tags or child processes appearing in upload directories. After the fix, replay the step-1 samples and confirm no interpreted execution.

description.zh: 测试上传点允许的类型与落盘路径可访问性，确认服务器解析PHP，即选定要植入的脚本形式。
description.en: Probe allowed types and reachable storage paths and confirm PHP parsing; the script shape is chosen.

description.zh: 用执行区载荷上传system或eval型脚本到可执行目录，访问文件不报404且返回预期输出即确认落地成功。
description.en: Upload the system/eval script per the execution payload into an executable directory; a non-404 with expected output confirms the landing.

title.zh: 执行命令提权与持久化
title.en: Run commands to escalate and persist

description.zh: 通过脚本传参执行whoami、net user与计划任务写入，权限提升或新增账户成功即完成服务器持久控制。
description.en: Drive whoami, net user, and scheduled-task writes through the script; escalation or a new account completes persistent control.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离实例存在可能将用户内容交给 PHP 处理器的上传或模板数据流
prerequisites.en: An isolated instance has an upload or template flow that may reach a PHP handler.

prerequisites.zh: 使用无害固定标记替代系统命令并可查看处理器日志
prerequisites.en: Harmless fixed markers replace system commands and handler logs are available.

analysis.zh: 根据最终处理结果分级：静态源码泄露、PHP 标记解释、动态请求求值和系统子进程是递增的不同风险。不能因为文件扩展名或危险函数文本存在就假定执行。
analysis.en: Classify by outcome: static source disclosure, PHP marker interpretation, dynamic request evaluation, and system child process are progressively different risks. Filename or dangerous-function text alone does not establish execution.

opsecTips.zh: 不得把原始命令型片段直接部署；只使用固定输出、无外部参数的最小标记脚本。
opsecTips.en: Never deploy the original command-capable fragments; use only a minimal fixed-output marker with no external parameters.

opsecTips.zh: 验证后立即删除上传文件、清理 opcode/cache/CDN，并核对没有残留进程或访问 URL。
opsecTips.en: Immediately remove uploads, clear opcode, application, and CDN caches, and verify no process or reachable URL remains.

description.zh: system 拆分拼接后以变量函数调用，规避静态关键词；成功判据：cmd 参数命令执行。
description.en: Splits system into a spliced variable-function call to evade static keywords. Success: the cmd parameter command executes.

description.zh: 以 array_map 回调形式触发 system，打断 system( 直呼特征；成功判据：输出回显。
description.en: Triggers system via an array_map callback to break the direct system( signature. Success: output reflected.

description.zh: 换 popen sink 并循环读输出，规避 system/shell_exec 查杀；成功判据：命令输出逐行返回。
description.en: Switches the sink to popopen and loops the output to evade system/shell_exec killing. Success: command output returned line by line.

name.zh: CSP base-uri 与相对 URL 重定向
name.en: CSP base-uri and Relative URL Retargeting

description.zh: 使用 base 元素验证页面是否缺少 base-uri 限制，并导致相对脚本、表单或导航 URL 被重定向到非预期来源。
description.en: Uses a base element to test whether a missing base-uri restriction retargets relative scripts, forms, or navigation URLs to an unintended origin.

overview.zh: 覆盖 CSP base-uri 缺失时的相对 URL 重定向验证：注入 base 元素改变文档解析基址，观察相对脚本、表单或导航 URL 是否指向外部来源。适用于评估页面是否缺少 base-uri 限制的场景。
overview.en: Covers relative-URL retargeting verification when CSP base-uri is missing: injecting a base element to change the document's parse base, observing whether relative script, form, or navigation URLs point at external origins. Suitable for checking whether a page lacks base-uri restrictions.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是可在有效位置注入 base 元素且 CSP 未设置 base-uri 'none'/'self'，页面后续相对 URL 使用攻击者基址；实际影响取决于 script-src、form-action 与资源完整性配置。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a base element injectable at an effective position while CSP lacks base-uri 'none'/'self', so subsequent relative URLs resolve against the attacker's base; actual impact depends on script-src, form-action, and subresource integrity settings.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令注入指向 {ATTACKER_HOST} 的 base 元素，监听器收到一个无副作用的相对资源请求即确认 base-uri 未限制时的重定向边界。先记录无注入页面的 document.baseURI 与无害相对资源 URL 作对照；标签作为文本显示、位于首个 base 之后或被 CSP 阻断均为阴性。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject a base element pointing at {ATTACKER_HOST}; the listener receiving one side-effect-free relative-resource request confirms the retargeting boundary when base-uri is unrestricted. Record the clean page's document.baseURI and a harmless relative-resource URL as controls; the tag rendering as text, sitting after the first base, or being CSP-blocked is negative.

mitigation.zh: 修复 HTML 注入并设置 CSP base-uri 'none' 或至少 'self'，安全相关脚本与提交目标使用可信绝对 URL，配合 script-src、form-action 与 SRI；base 固定放在文档前部，避免后续输入抢占。
mitigation.en: Fix HTML injection and set CSP base-uri 'none' or at least 'self', use trusted absolute URLs for security-relevant scripts and form targets with script-src, form-action, and SRI, and pin the base element at the document head to prevent later input from taking over.

title.zh: 记录原始 URL 解析基线

description.zh: 保存 CSP、document.baseURI 和一个无副作用相对资源的绝对解析结果。
description.en: Save CSP, document.baseURI, and the absolute resolution of one side-effect-free relative resource.

title.zh: 注入自有 base 来源

description.zh: 替换示例域后提交 base 标签，并保持页面、会话和缓存一致。
description.en: Replace the example origin, submit the base tag, and hold page, session, and cache state constant.

description.zh: 匹配 DOM 属性、document.baseURI、网络请求和 CSP 事件，排除浏览器预取。
description.en: Match DOM attributes, document.baseURI, network requests, and CSP events, excluding browser prefetch.

description.zh: 加入限制并修复注入后重放，确认合法相对资源保留而外部基址无效。
description.en: After adding the directive and fixing injection, replay to preserve legitimate relative resources while the external base is ineffective.

prerequisites.zh: 输入可在 document head 或首个有效 base 之前创建元素
prerequisites.en: Input can create an element in the document head or before the first effective base.

prerequisites.zh: 页面存在可观察的相对 URL 资源且测试域完全受控
prerequisites.en: The page has an observable relative-URL resource and the test origin is fully controlled.

analysis.zh: base 注入的影响由具体被改写资源决定，应报告实际 URL 解析和后续安全边界，不能仅因 document.baseURI 改变就按 XSS 最高影响评级。
analysis.en: Impact depends on the specific retargeted resource. Report actual URL resolution and downstream boundary rather than rating a baseURI change as full XSS automatically.

opsecTips.zh: 测试监听器不记录 Cookie/查询敏感值，只验证固定资源名。
opsecTips.en: The listener should not retain cookies or sensitive query values and should verify only a fixed resource name.

opsecTips.zh: 不要点击真实表单或触发脚本；优先观察无害图片/链接解析。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit real forms or trigger scripts; prefer observing a harmless image or link resolution.

description.zh: 绕过 base href 单属性匹配：附加 target 改变形态。判据：页面相对资源被劫持到攻击域。
description.en: Extra attribute changes the signature; relative URLs resolve to attacker host. Success: resources hijacked.

description.zh: 绕过小写 <base href 规则。判据：相对链接指向攻击域。
description.en: Uppercase form defeats lowercase rules. Success: links resolve to attacker host.

description.zh: 绕过 href="..." 带引号匹配：无引号加尾空格仍有效。判据：劫持生效。
description.en: Unquoted value with trailing space still parses. Success: hijack works.

description.zh: 绕过根路径 base 检测：带目录路径劫持相对引用。判据：相对 JS/CSS 请求指向攻击域。
description.en: Directory-bearing base avoids root-path detection. Success: relative assets fetched from attacker.

name.zh: DOCTYPE 实体片段组合（读取+带外）

description.zh: 使用本地外部实体引用、实体消费节点和外部 DTD，验证 XML 解析器是否允许文件解析或带外网络加载。
description.en: Uses a local external entity declaration, an entity-consuming node, and an external DTD to test whether an XML parser permits file resolution or out-of-band network loading.

subCategory.zh: 基础实体注入与过滤差异

overview.zh: 覆盖 XML 实体的文件读取与带外双通道验证：本地外部实体声明、实体消费节点与外部 DTD 探针三行按目标 XML 结构组合提交。回显文件内容或 {LAB_OAST} 收到 DTD 请求即确认对应通道。
overview.en: Covers dual-channel verification of XML entity file reads and out-of-band loading: three lines — a local external entity declaration, an entity-consuming node, and an external DTD probe — composed per the target XML structure. Echoed file content or {LAB_OAST} receiving the DTD request confirms the corresponding channel.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析器允许 DTD、外部通用实体或外部子集并以应用权限访问文件或网络；异步文档处理器可能在上传成功后才触发，证据必须关联实际解析任务。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is parsers allowing DTDs, external general entities, or external subsets with application-privilege access to files or networks; async document processors may trigger only after upload success, so evidence must tie to the actual parse task.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令的三行（实体声明、消费节点与外部 DTD 探针）按目标 XML 结构组合提交；回显文件内容或 {LAB_OAST} 收到 DTD 请求即确认对应通道，文件与外部域替换为隔离标记资源。先提交无 DOCTYPE 的合法 XML 基线，再记录任务 ID、解析日志、文件访问与回连。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command's three lines (entity declaration, consuming node, external DTD probe) composed per the target XML structure; echoed file content or {LAB_OAST} receiving the DTD request confirms the channel, with files and external domains swapped for isolated marker resources. Submit a DOCTYPE-free valid XML baseline first, then record task IDs, parse logs, file accesses, and callbacks.

mitigation.zh: 在所有同步与异步解析器禁用 DOCTYPE、外部实体、外部子集与 XInclude，采用安全预设并限制文件系统与出站网络；对 XML 派生格式采用同样策略并保留回显/盲 XXE 回归样例。
mitigation.en: Disable DOCTYPE, external entities, external subsets, and XInclude across all synchronous and asynchronous parsers using secure presets with restricted filesystems and egress; apply the same policy to XML-derived formats, keeping echo/blind XXE regression samples.

title.zh: 确认 XML 解析任务

description.zh: 定位同步或异步解析组件、输入架构和日志关联字段。
description.en: Identify the synchronous or asynchronous parser, input schema, and log-correlation field.

title.zh: 组合并提交受控实体文档
title.en: Compose and submit a controlled entity document

description.zh: 按目标架构组合声明与消费节点，或使用一次性外部 DTD，并替换为标记资源。
description.en: Compose declaration and consuming node for the target schema or use a one-time external DTD, replacing targets with markers.

description.zh: 匹配标记输出、文件审计或唯一回连与解析任务，排除应用其他组件请求。
description.en: Match marker output, file audit, or unique callback to the parse job, excluding requests from other application components.

description.zh: 修复所有解析器后重放恶意与正常 XML，确认实体不解析且业务数据仍可处理。
description.en: After fixing every parser, replay malicious and normal XML to confirm no entity resolution while business data still parses.

prerequisites.zh: 目标端点或异步任务实际解析 XML
prerequisites.en: The endpoint or asynchronous job actually parses XML.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离环境提供无敏感标记文件和自有 HTTPS/DNS 回连服务
prerequisites.en: The isolated environment provides a nonsensitive marker file and controlled HTTPS or DNS callback service.

analysis.zh: 本地读取与带外 XXE 证据不同：前者依赖受控标记进入输出或文件审计，后者依赖一次性域与任务关联。通用解析错误不能确认任何一种。
analysis.en: In-band and out-of-band XXE require different evidence: marker output or file audit for the former, and a one-time domain correlated to the parse job for the latter. A generic parse error confirms neither.

opsecTips.zh: 将 `/etc/passwd` 和公共回连域替换为本地测试标记与自有一次性域。
opsecTips.en: Replace /etc/passwd and public callback domains with a local test marker and controlled one-time domain.

opsecTips.zh: 限制文档大小、实体数量与等待窗口，防止资源耗尽和长期回连监听。
opsecTips.en: Limit document size, entity count, and observation window to prevent resource exhaustion and long-lived listeners.

wafBypass.command:
POST /stockCheck HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/xml; charset=UTF-16

FE FF 00 3C 00 3F 00 78 00 6D 00 6C ...（DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file://{FILE_PATH}">] 的 UTF-16LE 编码字节）

description.zh: 绕过按 ASCII 匹配 <!ENTITY/SYSTEM 的规则：整包以 UTF-16 传输，WAF 字符串规则失效；成功判据：解析器仍展开实体并回显文件。
description.en: Evades ASCII-based <!ENTITY/SYSTEM rules by sending the whole document as UTF-16 so string rules miss it. Success: the parser still expands the entity and echoes the file.

title.zh: PUBLIC 外部 DTD 变体

description.zh: 用 PUBLIC 形式代替 SYSTEM 声明外部 DTD，规避 SYSTEM "http 特征；成功判据：{LAB_OAST} 收到 DTD 请求。
description.en: Uses the PUBLIC form instead of SYSTEM to declare the external DTD, evading SYSTEM "http signatures. Success: {LAB_OAST} receives the DTD request.

wafBypass.command:
<!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY % a SYSTEM "file://{FILE_PATH}"><!ENTITY b "%a;"><!ENTITY c "&b;"><!ENTITY d "&c;">]>
<stockCheck><productId>&d;</productId></stockCheck>

description.zh: 多级实体链间接引用文件内容，打断 SYSTEM file:// 直连 &xxe; 的组合特征；成功判据：响应中出现文件内容。
description.en: Chains multiple entities to dereference the file indirectly, breaking the SYSTEM file:// plus &xxe; pattern. Success: file contents appear in the response.

name.zh: PHP Filter Wrapper 源码读取

description.zh: 使用 php://filter 的 Base64 转换与 resource 参数验证文件读取/包含入口是否可返回 PHP 源码或测试文件内容。
description.en: Uses php://filter Base64 conversion and resource parameters to test whether a read or include sink can return PHP source or test-file content.

subCategory.zh: PHP 流包装器与远程包含

overview.zh: PHP Filter Wrapper 源码读取针对文件读取/包含入口可返回 PHP 源码或测试文件内容的场景：Base64 转换让源码以数据形式返回。验证 convert.base64-encode 与 resource 参数的路径变体。
overview.en: The PHP filter-wrapper source read targets read/inclusion entries returning PHP source or test-file content: Base64 transformation returns source as data. It validates convert.base64-encode with resource path variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户可控制读取/包含资源名，应用未限制 wrapper scheme 和规范路径；filter 将原本不可直接查看的 PHP 文件编码返回，路径遍历或绝对路径进一步扩大读取范围。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user-controlled read/inclusion resource names without wrapper-scheme or canonical-path restrictions; the filter encodes PHP files that could not be viewed directly, while traversal or absolute paths widen the read scope further.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步把 config/flag/passwd 全部替换为测试标记后逐条提交 php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=../config.php 等路径变体；命中判据为响应是 Base64 串且解码后等于标记文件内容。按已确认路径模型选择遍历深度并逐条记录；先验证读取 API 是否支持 wrapper，再决定 filter 语法是否适用，避免对不支持 wrapper 的入口误报。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, replace all config/flag/passwd with test markers and submit php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=../config.php and similar path variants one by one; a hit is a Base64 response decoding to the marker-file content. Choose traversal depth by the confirmed path model and record each request; first confirm the read API supports wrappers before deciding whether the filter syntax applies, avoiding false positives on wrapper-less entries.

mitigation.zh: 用服务端对象 ID 映射文件，不将用户输入传给通用文件 API；必须读取时只允许 file 资源、固定根目录和规范路径；禁用不需要的 wrapper，最小化 PHP 账户文件权限，并轮换任何已确认泄露的配置密钥。修复后重放第 1 步全部变体。
mitigation.en: Map files by server-side object ID and never pass user input to generic file APIs; when reads are required allow only file resources, fixed roots, and canonical paths; disable unneeded wrappers, minimize PHP-account file permissions, and rotate any confirmed leaked configuration secrets. After the fix, replay all step-1 variants.

title.zh: 确认 PHP 文件读取 API

description.zh: 从输入追踪到具体读取/包含函数、wrapper 支持和规范文件根。
description.en: Trace input to the exact read or include function, wrapper support, and canonical file root.

title.zh: 读取单一 Base64 标记

description.zh: 替换所有敏感目标并选择一条匹配路径变体，保留请求与文件审计。
description.en: Replace every sensitive target, choose one matching path variant, and retain request and file audit.

title.zh: 核对解码内容与访问来源
title.en: Verify decoded content and access provenance

description.zh: 解码响应并匹配固定标记哈希，同时确认读取由 PHP 进程发生。
description.en: Decode the response, match the fixed marker hash, and confirm the PHP process performed the read.

title.zh: 限制 Wrapper 与根目录
title.en: Restrict wrappers and the file root

description.zh: 修复后重放合法文件和全部变体，确认业务读取保留且 wrapper/越界目标拒绝。
description.en: After remediation replay valid files and all variants to preserve business reads while rejecting wrappers and out-of-root targets.

prerequisites.zh: 目标已确认运行 PHP，且用户输入进入文件读取或包含 API
prerequisites.en: The target is confirmed to run PHP and user input reaches a file-read or include API.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离实例提供无敏感 PHP 标记文件和文件访问审计
prerequisites.en: An isolated instance provides a nonsensitive PHP marker file and file-access auditing.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要 PHP 进程读取专用文件且解码内容与标记一致。错误、空白或任意 Base64 字符串是假阳性；还应区分源码读取与 include 执行。
analysis.en: A positive requires the PHP process to read the dedicated file and decoded content to match the marker. Errors, blanks, or arbitrary Base64 are false positives, and source read must remain distinct from include execution.

opsecTips.zh: 达到第一个固定标记后停止，不读取真实 config、flag、passwd 或 index.php。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first fixed marker and do not read real config, flag, passwd, or index.php files.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除标记、清理应用缓存，并遮盖报告中的路径和编码内容。
opsecTips.en: Remove the marker, clear application caches, and redact paths and encoded content from the report afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对单一 base64 过滤器特征：叠加 ROT13 变换改变输出形态；先反转再解码得源码即成功。
description.en: Stack ROT13 over base64 past single-filter signatures; reversing then decoding yields the source.

description.zh: 绕过对固定层数 ../ 特征的匹配：混入 ./ 冗余段改变形态；解码得到同一文件源码即成功。
description.en: Pad with redundant ./ segments past fixed-depth matching; decoding yields the same file source.

description.zh: 绕过对 base64 关键字封锁：改用 UTF-32 转换输出；按对应编码解读即成功。
description.en: Switch to UTF-32 output past base64 keyword blocks; interpreting the encoding confirms success.

name.zh: PyYAML Object/Apply 不安全加载边界

description.zh: 使用一条 `!!python/object/apply` 输入验证目标 PyYAML 版本与 Loader 是否允许构造 subprocess.check_output 调用，并以无副作用帮助程序限定证据。
description.en: Uses one !!python/object/apply input to test whether the target PyYAML version and Loader permit construction of a subprocess.check_output call, with evidence constrained to a side-effect-free helper.

overview.zh: PyYAML Object/Apply 不安全加载边界针对目标 PyYAML 版本与 Loader 允许构造 subprocess 调用的场景：safe_load 应拒绝该标签。验证单条 object/apply 输入在目标 Loader 下的构造行为。
overview.en: The PyYAML object/apply unsafe-load boundary targets target PyYAML versions and loaders permitting subprocess-call construction: safe_load should reject the tag. It validates construction behavior of the single object/apply input under the target loader.

vulnerability.zh: 若应用用不安全 Loader 解析不可信 YAML，object/apply 可把数据边界升级为 Python 可调用对象执行；标签被识别、错误中出现 subprocess 或 YAML 语法通过并不等于函数被调用。
vulnerability.en: If the application parses untrusted YAML with an unsafe loader, object/apply escalates the data boundary into Python callable execution; tag recognition, subprocess appearing in errors, or passing YAML syntax do not equal function invocation.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步危险原行仅作来源记录，执行前把参数数组替换为签名 marker-helper（不读取 /etc/passwd、不运行任意命令）后提交到目标解析入口；命中判据为 marker-helper 被构造调用并输出随机标记。逐项记录 PyYAML 版本与实际使用的 Loader（safe_load 应拒绝该标签）；标签被识别或报错含 subprocess 时记为阴性，不据此断言执行。
exploitation.en: The step-1 dangerous original is for source record only; before executing, swap the argument array for a signed marker-helper (no /etc/passwd reads, no arbitrary commands) and submit to the target parsing entry; a hit is the marker-helper constructed and invoked with random-marker output. Record the PyYAML version and actual loader per request (safe_load rejecting the tag is expected); tag recognition or subprocess in errors is negative—never assert execution from it.

mitigation.zh: 对不可信输入使用 safe_load/SafeLoader 或更简单的数据格式，绑定明确 schema，禁止 Python 专用标签并升级受支持 PyYAML；运行身份还应限制子进程、文件和网络权限。修复后重放第 1 步输入，确认标签被拒绝且合法配置解析正常。
mitigation.en: Use safe_load/SafeLoader or simpler data formats for untrusted input, bind explicit schemas, forbid Python-specific tags, and upgrade to supported PyYAML; also restrict child-process, file, and network permissions for the runtime identity. After the fix, replay the step-1 input and confirm the tag is rejected while legitimate configuration parsing works.

title.zh: 记录 Loader 与安全基线
title.en: Record the Loader and safe baseline

description.zh: 保存依赖版本、加载 API、普通 YAML 结果和 safe_load 对 Python 标签的拒绝证据。
description.en: Preserve dependency version, load API, ordinary YAML result, and evidence that safe_load rejects the Python tag.

title.zh: 替换为 Marker Helper 后解析
title.en: Parse after replacing with the marker helper

description.zh: 不运行原始 cat，使用一次性令牌和短超时在隔离 Loader 中提交一次。
description.en: Do not run the original cat command; submit once to the isolated Loader with a one-time token and short timeout.

title.zh: 关联构造器、子进程与输出
title.en: Correlate constructor, child process, and output

description.zh: 匹配 YAML 构造器日志、父子 PID、帮助程序哈希和随机输出，排除错误文本。
description.en: Match YAML constructor logs, parent-child PIDs, helper hash, and random output while excluding error text.

title.en: Switch to SafeLoader and clean up

description.zh: 修复后重放普通 YAML 与 object/apply，确认前者正常、后者在构造前拒绝，再删除帮助程序。
description.en: After remediation replay ordinary YAML and object/apply, preserve the former and reject the latter before construction, then delete the helper.

prerequisites.zh: 已冻结 Python、PyYAML 版本和实际 Loader 调用，并确认输入完整进入 YAML 解析器
prerequisites.en: Python and PyYAML versions and the actual Loader call are frozen, and input is confirmed to reach the YAML parser intact.

prerequisites.zh: 原始 cat 命令替换为只输出一次性随机标记的固定帮助程序，且进程创建可审计
prerequisites.en: The original cat command is replaced with a fixed helper that only prints a one-time random marker, and process creation is auditable.

analysis.zh: 完整阳性是目标不安全 Loader 处理该标签并由 Python 父进程启动受控 marker-helper，输出与请求令牌一致。YAML 可解析、标签出现在异常、subprocess 模块已导入或安全 Loader 拒绝都不能证明执行。
analysis.en: A complete positive is the target unsafe Loader processing the tag and the Python parent launching the controlled marker-helper with output matching the request token. Parseable YAML, a tag in an exception, an imported subprocess module, or rejection by a safe Loader does not prove execution.

opsecTips.zh: 只允许签名 marker-helper 且限制为一次子进程；出现文件读取、网络连接或其他可执行文件立即停止
opsecTips.en: Allow only the signed marker-helper and one child process; stop immediately on a file read, network connection, or any other executable.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除帮助程序、YAML 样例和进程审计导出，销毁隔离虚拟环境并轮换令牌
opsecTips.en: After testing delete the helper, YAML sample, and process-audit export, destroy the isolated virtual environment, and rotate the token.

description.zh: 参数拆成 argv 数组形式，绕过匹配完整命令字符串 'cat /etc/passwd' 的规则；成功判据：返回 passwd 内容。
description.en: Splits into an argv array to evade rules matching the full command string. Success: passwd contents returned.

description.zh: 命令 base64 化执行，规避敏感路径与命令名明文；成功判据：输出回显。
description.en: Base64-encodes the command to avoid plaintext paths and command names. Success: output echoed.

description.zh: object/new 直接构造 Popen，避开 apply+check_output 特征组合；成功判据：加载后进程生成（OAST/文件验证）。
description.en: Constructs Popen directly via object/new to avoid the apply+check_output signature pair. Success: process spawns after loading (verify via OAST/file).

name.zh: SSRF file URI 按系统选点读取

description.zh: 使用 Linux 与 Windows file URI 验证服务端 URL 获取器是否允许读取本地文件。
description.en: Uses Linux and Windows file URIs to test whether a server-side URL fetcher permits local-file reads.

overview.zh: SSRF file URI 本地文件读取覆盖本地资源协议场景：针对服务端 URL 获取功能，验证底层 URL 库是否识别 file 协议并返回本机资源。验证维度涵盖 Linux 与 Windows 两类路径（nginx 日志、hosts 文件）的逐条验证与执行主体确认。
overview.en: SSRF file URI Local File Read covers local-resource schemes: for server-side URL fetching, verify whether the underlying URL library recognizes the file protocol and returns local resources. Verification dimensions cover Linux and Windows paths (nginx logs, hosts file) item by item plus executor confirmation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是只校验 URL 字符串或主机而未对解析后的 scheme 建立允许列表，通用 URL 库随后把 file 分派到本地文件处理器；应用进程权限决定可读范围，网络边界预期因此被绕过。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is validating only the URL string or host without a post-resolution scheme allowlist, after which the general URL library dispatches file to the local file handler; the application process's privileges set the readable scope, bypassing the intended network boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先用自有 HTTP URL 证明请求确实由服务端发起；再按服务端操作系统与 URL 库选择对应行，把真实系统文件替换为隔离标记文件逐条提交；通过响应中的标记、文件访问日志或调用栈确认读取发生在服务端组件。返回 400、协议不支持或仅客户端下载均为阴性。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first proves the request truly originates server-side with an owned HTTP URL; then select the matching line for the server OS and URL library, replacing real system files with isolated marker files and submitting one at a time; confirm the read happened in the server component via the response marker, file-access logs, or call stack. A 400, unsupported protocol, or client-only download is negative. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 解析 URL 后只允许明确需要的 HTTP/HTTPS，拒绝 file 及未知协议并在每次重定向后重新校验；让获取服务运行在无敏感文件访问的隔离身份中，限制文件系统与网络权限并记录拒绝原因。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，file 协议应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: After parsing, allow only explicitly required HTTP/HTTPS, reject file and unknown schemes, and revalidate after every redirect; run the fetch service under an isolated identity without sensitive file access, constrain filesystem and network permissions, and log rejection reasons. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the file protocol must be denied.

description.zh: 使用自有 HTTP 标记与请求日志证明 URL 由后端获取器处理。
description.en: Use a controlled HTTP marker and request logs to prove that the backend fetcher processes the URL.

title.zh: 提交平台匹配的 file URI

description.zh: 把示例文件改为测试标记，逐平台提交并记录服务端请求 ID。
description.en: Replace example files with a test marker, submit by platform, and record the server request ID.

description.zh: 关联响应标记、文件审计或调用栈，排除浏览器和客户端侧协议处理。
description.en: Correlate marker output, file audit, or call traces and exclude browser or client-side scheme handling.

title.zh: 限制协议与权限后回归
title.en: Regress after scheme and privilege restrictions

description.zh: 只保留业务所需协议后重放正常 HTTP 与本地 URI，确认前者可用而后者拒绝。
description.en: After retaining only business-required schemes, replay normal HTTP and local URIs to preserve the former and reject the latter.

prerequisites.zh: 目标功能由服务端获取用户提供的 URL
prerequisites.en: A server-side feature fetches a user-provided URL.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离环境提供无敏感本地标记文件和文件访问遥测
prerequisites.en: The isolated environment provides a nonsensitive local marker and file-access telemetry.

analysis.zh: 关键是归因到服务器端进程及其文件权限。页面中出现路径或客户端打开 file URI 都不构成 SSRF 本地读取。
analysis.en: Attribution to the server process and its filesystem privileges is essential. A path in a page or a client opening a file URI is not server-side local access.

opsecTips.zh: 将所有系统文件目标替换为无敏感标记，并在测试容器限制读取权限。
opsecTips.en: Replace every system-file target with a nonsensitive marker and restrict read permissions in the test container.

opsecTips.zh: 不要通过接口读取应用日志本身，以免报告中带出其他用户数据。
